title: Process Specialist, CT, Control Tower
description:
Network Flow Control Tower:
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life and your day to join a company that redefines itself every day. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon.

Network Flow CT is the central control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon's European Transportation Middle Mile network, supporting both domestic and inter-country transportation movements for European geographies. Control Tower Team is the central owner to manage the sort center capacities in ATROPS and operates with a vision to provide uninterrupted sort center flows by managing the virtual capacities, tracking inbound flows and reacting to network disruptions that impact the Sort Center Flow. CT team plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's European transportation network and thereby has direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve customers on time.

Purview of a Process Specialist
Process Operations Specialist works across the EU in a cross-functional environment with Sort Centers, Forecasting ,Supply Chain, FCs, to determine future demand for Sort Centers Capacity and translates the aforementioned into accurate capacity plans. S/he also maintains and reports up to date and accurate statistics, management reports and analysis. S/he also facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. Process Operations Specialist also provide timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
· Understanding of analytical simulations and assessments. Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
· Reporting and analysis through tools, portals and reports; following solution-driven approach to systems and processes, using advanced computer literacy (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word) and Data-warehouse analysis.
· Pull and report data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus – this ability will be developed over time for a candidate who is fundamentally strong analytically.
· Develop and understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure that they are delivered.
· Scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by flow execution
· Communicate with external customers
· Provide real-time customer experience by working in 24x7 operating environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer- ML Network Stack, ML Network Stack - Annapurna Labs
description:
We are seeking an experienced engineer to join our team that owns the network stack for EC2 distributed AI/ML systems. The team develops support for a variety of frameworks and communication libraries including NCCL, NVSHMEM, NIXL, NCCL GIN, and Perplexity kernels. Solid knowledge of Linux, networking, and performant coding is important. Experience with embedded systems is valued, and experience with high-speed networking or HPC/RDMA interconnects is highly valued.

If you like solving hard problems, want to work with HPC and ML customers, iterate fast and deliver meaningful solutions at scale, then come join us! This truly is a role at the forefront of AI/ML—you'll be working on features for the largest clusters, with the largest customers, for the largest AI models. .

The organization you would be joining is Annapurna Labs, an integral part of Amazon that develops hardware and software components that are critical building blocks for EC2 infrastructure. Every instance in EC2 is running some type of hardware designed by Annapurna Labs. We specialize in designing software, systems, and chips that optimize the AWS customer experience.

Key job responsibilities
Be a senior engineer on a team that builds and maintains the infrastructure that monitors and reports on functionality and performance of massive testing workloads run at scale. Use internal Amazon CI/CD tools, Linux, and public AWS products to automate the delivery of our software to customers, saving developer time. Write Python code that effortlessly spools up large clusters and runs benchmarks and applications for ML and HPC workloads. Use AWS Managed Grafana and Athena to digest the massive amount of performance data generated by these workloads and create dashboards for developers and stakeholders. Invent automatic mechanisms to alert developers to functional and performance regressions so they never reach reach customers. Manage the complexity of infrastructure that covers many instance types, software stacks, Linux operating systems, cutting-edge releases and make it easy to evolve.

A day in the life
As a Senior SDE III on the Elastic Compute team at Annapurna Labs, you work where silicon meets software — your decisions ripple across millions of EC2 instances and shape the performance, security, and cost efficiency of the AWS compute platform. A day might start by root-causing a fleet-wide latency anomaly across the full stack, from the hypervisor and Nitro offload path down to firmware; move into owning the architecture for a multi-year initiative and leading the design review where the hard questions about scale, failure domains, and safe fleet-wide rollout get asked — often co-designed directly with silicon and hardware partners; and end deep in a low-level C/C++ or Rust change, a down-to-the-instruction performance investigation, or twenty minutes pairing with a newer engineer because raising the bar around you is part of the job, not a distraction from it. The systems you build run continuously, at massive scale, with little tolerance for error — so a great day ends with something shipped or a hard problem genuinely understood, knowing your work will be quietly running in data centers around the world tomorrow.

About the team
The organization you would be joining is Annapurna Labs, an integral part of AWS that develops hardware and software components that are critical building blocks for EC2 infrastructure. Every instance in EC2 is running some type of hardware designed by Annapurna Labs. We specialize in designing software, systems, and chips that optimize the AWS customer experience.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Outreach Specialist (Metro)
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Outreach Specialist conducts outreach and housing navigation activities to individuals experiencing homelessness. The Outreach Specialist assists individuals with collecting documents necessary for housing, and provides linkage to ongoing supportive services. The Outreach Specialist will address the individuals’ immediate needs and work to engage them in services using best practice standards. The Outreach Specialist is the primary point of contact for individuals and provides screening, triage, crisis intervention, access to interim housing, and transportation services, with the goal of assisting individuals experiencing homelessness with moving into permanent housing.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS INCLUDE, but are not limited to the following:

  • Conducts outreach activities to engage individuals experiencing homelessness and support them in pursuing permanent housing options.
  • Receives, assesses and triages referrals from collaborative partners.
  • Conducts standardized screening and triages individuals experiencing homelessness.
  • Provides an appropriate level of services and interventions utilizing best practices and service models to meet the individual needs of each participant.
  • Assists individuals with collecting documents necessary for applying for permanent supportive housing.
  • Connects individuals to supportive services including: mental health, medical care, substance abuse, employment, etc as needed.
  • Provides linkage to mainstream resources, such as DPSS or Social Security Disability.
  • Provides transportation assistance.
  • Assists individuals with accessing permanent housing opportunities including permanent supportive housing, move-in assistance, shared housing, affordable housing, etc.
  • Conducts follow-up activities to ensure completion of the housing plan.
  • Documents services and completes data entry into HMIS database within timeframes outlined by funder and agency.
  • Attends case conferencing meetings to coordinate services with other providers.
  • Attends clinical consultation, individual supervision, team meetings, and trainings as required by the funder and agency.
  • Other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Frequently exposed to outdoor weather and driving conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Stand and sit for long periods of time; move and walk to various locations; climb stairs, stoop, kneel, reach, pull, push, bend, twist, and occasionally lift and or move objects. Use hands to finger, handle or feel.
  • See, hear and speak clearly in order to give and receive information and instructions.
  • Ability to interact with other employees, clients, customers and members of the public.
  • Ability to work effectively under time constraints, prioritize work, multi-task, and adapt to changing work demands.
  • Gather, analyze, synthesize, and classify information. Transcribe, enter, and post data.
  • Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or complaints.
  • Requires use of a computer keyboard.
  • Travel to off-site meetings.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of transitional and permanent housing resources throughout Los Angeles County.
  • Knowledge of housing issues in San Gabriel Valley preferred.
  • Knowledge of HUD guidelines and experience working with subsidized housing programs such as Section 8, Shelter Plus Care and others.
  • Current knowledge of interventions, models and principles related to best practice standards.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • Proficient in use of laptop computer and Microsoft Windows and Office software programs (Word, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, G-Mail).
  • Ability to accurately enter client data and notes in HMIS Homeless Management Information System.
  • Proficient with office communication equipment and machines (telephone, copier, calculator, fax machine, personal computer, laptop, computer printer and scanner).
  • Possess valid California driver's license and have access to properly registered vehicle.

EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in human services or similar field preferred.
  • 1 year of experience working with homeless individuals in an outreach/navigation capacity or case management experience.
  • Successful demonstration of required skills through current or past USHS employment may be considered in lieu of the standard required years of experience.



Monday through Friday 6am-2:30pm
40hrs/week, Full Time, Non-exempt

title: CSV & CQV
description:
About Company:

JC Automation Corp. (JCA) was founded in 1997 with the mission of filling a gap between technology and regulatory requirements in the life science manufacturing industry. The company offers highly capable resources at an affordable cost to build solutions and execute projects in: Automation, Control Systems Integration, Information Technology, System Integration and Regulatory Compliance.

JCA is a HUBZone Certified Small Business Firm, NMSDC Certified Minority Business Enterprise, and Certified Critical Industry Supplier. It’s mission is to add value by delivering quality services & solutions on time all the time by transforming processes & technology into business advantages.

ABOUT THE ROLE


We are seeking experienced Computer System Validation (CSV) and Commissioning, Qualification & Validation (CQV) professionals to support a high-priority automation and computerized systems program within a cGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. Resources will contribute to the full validation and qualification lifecycle for critical manufacturing systems.In this role, you will author and execute validation deliverables, lead change control activities, perform Data Integrity assessments, and support commissioning and equipment qualification. Strong regulatory knowledge, excellent documentation discipline, and the ability to work independently within an established quality system are essential.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Team Participation: Actively participate in team meetings to provide input on project timeline considerations, activities, escalations, and status of assigned tasks.

• CSV & CQV Execution: Execute Computer System Validation and Commissioning & Qualification activities for computerized systems, equipment, facilities, and utilities, including commissioning support and qualification activities such as Validation Plans, Security Plans, Administration and Operational SOPs, Installation and Operational Verification, Test Summaries, Risk Assessments, Master Document Lists, Traceability Matrices, Disaster Recovery Plans, Business Continuity Plans, Performance Qualification, System Inventory Lists, Source Code Reviews, User Requirements, and Design Specifications.

Facilities & Utilities Commissioning: Support commissioning and qualification activities for GMP facilities and utilities, including installation verification, functional testing, system turnover, punch list resolution, and applicable IQ/OQ/PQ documentation.

• Procedure Development: Develop and revise controlled procedures in alignment with current regulatory expectations and site quality systems.

• Data Integrity: Perform Data Integrity assessments and support remediation activities for computerized systems.

• Change Control: Lead change control meetings, generate change control documentation for computer system validation and equipment qualifications, and present changes to the Change Control Review Board.

• External Connectivity: Support external system connectivity installation and operational verification.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer, Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical), Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 2–4 years of experience authoring and executing CSV or CQV deliverables in a pharmaceutical or biotech GMP environment.

• Demonstrated experience with full CSV lifecycle documentation — URS, Design Specs, IQ/OQ/PQ, Traceability Matrix, Risk Assessment, Summary Reports.

• Experience generating and presenting change controls in a formal pharmaceutical quality system.

• Working knowledge of Data Integrity principles and ALCOA++.

• Bilingual in English and Spanish (oral and written)

title: Solutions Architect, National Security & Defence
description:

These customers include government agencies, state-owned companies, educational institutions, healthcare and non-profit organisations. Our Public Sector teams help customers build a deeper understanding of hyper-scale cloud technology and application architectures, and they have the consultative skills required to drive deliver successful outcomes.

As an AWS Solutions Architect, you will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures.

Internally, you will be an advocate acting on behalf of the customer to help drive continual improvements to the AWS platform, sharing their needs and wants to inform the roadmap of AWS features and services. You will also help shape the future of the Solutions Architecture organisation by helping to hire, coach and mentor others.

You will participate in the creation and sharing of recommended practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelise and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt Job Grade:

Primary Department: Family Programs

Reports to: Membership Director or SPD

Revision Date: 07/02/2024 Leadership Level:

The YMCA of Greater Hartford is an association open to all committed to helping people reach their potential in spirit, mind, and body. Our commitment is based on the belief that the purpose of this three-fold development is to live out the values of Caring, Honest, Respect and Responsibility.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the direction of the Membership Director or Senor Program Director, the Activity Associate - Kid Zone will assist with the care and supervision of children and with maintenance of toys and equipment; while parent/guardian are using the YMCA’s facility.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. In conjunction with other staff members, carry out daily activities required to care for children including, but not limited to, serving snacks and lunch, bottle feedings, comforting injured or upset children, etc.
  2. Participate with children in play activities, ensuring premier quality and innovation.
  3. Constantly monitor children’s activities and behavior.
  4. Be responsible for clean-up and maintenance of toys and materials.
  5. Immediately communicate any problems or concerns with program, staff, children or parents to the appropriate staff member.
  6. Support and contribute to a safe, clean environment for staff and members.
  7. Report to supervisor immediately any evidence of child abuse including physical, mental, emotional and/or neglect.
  8. Maintain confidentiality of information provided by parents, staff and administration.
  9. Consistently provide friendly, courteous assistance, exceeding members’ expectations every day, which includes building and maintaining healthy professional relationships with parents, children, host agencies, and staff.
  10. Perform other tasks as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Experience working with children and an understanding of child development.
  2. Ability to build relationships with staff, volunteers, and parents/guardians.
  3. Ability to create a positive and supportive atmosphere for learning and relationship-building.
  4. CPR, AED, and First Aid certifications within 30 days of hire.
  5. At least 16 years of age.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENT:

  • Ability to walk, stand, and sit (including on the floor) for long periods of time.
  • Must be able to lift and/or assist children up to 30 pounds in weight.
  • Visual and auditory ability to respond to critical situations and physical ability to act swiftly in an emergency


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance: Available to full-time employees working 30 or more hours per week. The YMCA covers 90% of employee medical premiums for eligible high-deductible health plans.

title: Diana 115 1st Assistant Operator 1st Shift
description:
Position Overview:

The Diana 115 Specialty Gluer 1st Assistant Operator supports and leads day-to-day operations of the Diana 115 folder-gluer. This position is responsible for assisting with and independently performing machine set-ups, running to standard, and ensuring safe, conforming, and efficient production. The 1st Assistant must be capable of operating autonomously in the absence of the Operator while maintaining quality, safety, and productivity standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Assist the Operator with machine set-up, make-ready, running, and shutdown of the Diana 115 folder-gluer.

· Independently set up and run the machine to established standards when required.

· Ensure compliance with all quality requirements, including box checks, sampling plans, and product conformity standards.

· Follow and enforce all safety rules and procedures; promote a safe working environment for all crew members.

· Accurately complete all required production reporting and data entry.

· Lead and coordinate the activities of assistants and utility personnel to ensure efficient workflow.

· Operate and troubleshoot auxiliary equipment, including but not limited to:

o Hot melt units

o Cold glue units

o Ejector units

o Marsh printer units

o Straub taper units

· Monitor machine performance and make adjustments to maintain efficiency and quality.

· Assist with or perform cleaning, preventive maintenance, lubrication, and inspection tasks in accordance with TPM standards.

· Communicate production needs, quality issues, and equipment concerns to the Operator and supervision.

· Maintain housekeeping standards in the machine center.

Required Skills, Training & Qualifications

· Knowledge of standard box plant operations and finishing processes.

· Ability to think in spatial terms to set up and troubleshoot complex folding and gluing configurations.

· Strong mathematical skills, including converting fractions to decimals.

· Working knowledge of hand tools and machine tooling used in folding and gluing operations.

· Ability to perform basic computer functions and production data entry.

· Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to direct crew activities.

· Ability to operate autonomously without direct supervision when required.

· Ability to read, write, and speak English.

Physical Requirements

· Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive motions.

· Ability to lift, bend, reach, and perform manual adjustments during set-ups and operation.

Preferred Qualifications

· Prior experience operating or assisting on a Diana folder-gluer or similar folding and gluing equipment.

· Experience in a corrugated packaging or manufacturing environment.

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

title: Riverside Stripper Operator 2nd Shift
description:
Position Overview:

The Stripper Operator is responsible for the safe, efficient, and accurate operation of the stripping area within the converting department. This position plays a key role in ensuring that all finished products are stripped to specification while minimizing waste and maximizing throughput. The Stripper Operator must be able to perform stripping operations across various configurations, maintain product quality, and direct support personnel when multiple stripping guns or lines are in operation.

Key Responsibilities:

· Operate stripping equipment safely and efficiently in accordance with company and quality standards.

· Set up and adjust stripping configurations to achieve optimal product flow and minimal waste.

· Monitor product quality throughout the stripping process and take corrective action when necessary.

· Direct and coordinate the activities of other team members when multiple stripping guns or lines are in use.

· Follow documented stripping procedures as outlined in the Quality Manual to ensure product conformity.

· Maintain accurate records of production, waste, and downtime.

· Perform routine housekeeping and preventative maintenance tasks in the stripping area.

· Communicate effectively with machine operators, assistants, and supervisors regarding production schedules and any quality or equipment issues.

· Identify opportunities to improve stripping efficiency and participate in continuous improvement initiatives.

· Adhere to all safety, quality, and operational procedures to maintain a compliant and organized work environment.

Qualifications and Requirements:

· High school diploma or GED required.

· Minimum of 6 months experience in a corrugated or manufacturing environment preferred.

· Ability to determine sequential stripping order to maximize output and efficiency.

· Skilled in operating and troubleshooting stripping equipment and tools.

· Strong understanding of stripping methods and configurations for various box styles and materials.

· Ability to read and follow factory cards, CAD drawings, and production specifications.

· Solid math and measurement skills; must be able to use a tape measure accurately.

· Strong communication and organizational skills.

· Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

· Must be able to stand, bend, and lift materials for extended periods in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills:

· Previous experience in die cutting or stripping operations in a corrugated packaging facility.

· Familiarity with multiple stripping gun systems and safety protocols.

· Working knowledge of quality control standards and documentation practices.

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

Own insights and help drive scalable, decision-ready impact

title: Jr. Universal Banker
description:
About Byline Bank

Headquartered in Chicago, Byline Bank, a subsidiary of Byline Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE:BY), is a full-service commercial bank serving small- and medium-sized businesses, financial sponsors and consumers. Byline Bank has approximately $9.9 billion in assets and operates over 40 branch locations throughout the Chicago and Milwaukee metropolitan areas. Byline Bank offers a broad range of commercial and community banking products and services, including small-ticket equipment leasing and U.S. Small Business Administration loans. Byline Bank is a member of FDIC and an Equal Housing Lender.

At Byline Bank, we take pride in being an award-winning workplace. Some of our recent recognitions include:

  • U.S. News & World Report’s Best Companies to Work for in the Midwest 2024-2025, 2025-2026 and Best Companies to Work for in Finance and Insurance & Overall 2025-2026.
  • Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Midsize Workplaces for Women 2026
  • Best Companies Group’s Best Remote and Hybrid Workplaces in America 2026
  • Chicago Sun Times Chicago’s Best Workplaces 2024, 2025
  • Best Companies Group and Illinois SHRM (Society for Human Resource Management) Best Workplaces in Illinois 2024, 2025, 2026

By joining our team, you will become part of an organization that values growth, collaboration, and innovation. We strive to create an environment where employees feel supported and are empowered to excel in their roles. If you're looking for a career with a company that puts people first and makes a difference in the communities we serve, Byline Bank is the place for you.


Objective of Position:


The Jr. Universal Banker is responsible for assisting the Universal Bankers (UBs) and conducting cash vault transactions in an accurate and timely manner. This role provides sales and servicing of all bank products and services. The Jr. Universal Banker will work with the other universal bankers, operations and sales team to achieve deposit, business, and consumer relationship growth while providing operational support and exceptional customer service.

The Jr. UB may be requested to provide support at other branch locations as business needs arise, including but not limited to staffing shortages due to PTO, unscheduled absences, or leaves, high customer volume, or special events. A professional image as outlined in the Byline Bank Employee Handbook is required.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Greets customers and direct incoming calls to appropriate staff.
  • Accurately processes transactions and new account openings in a timely and professional manner.
  • Constantly looks for ways to improve processes that will improve the customer’s experience and communicate those ideas to Branch Management.
  • Assesses and handles retail customers’ banking needs and obtain and process customer/account information, including cash handling.
  • Assists with opens and services accounts and identifies cross-selling opportunities for new and existing customers.
  • Assists UBs with calls on potential or existing customers to develop new business by promoting our bank’s services and products, with the goal of expanding relationships and bank profitability.
  • Displays exceptional customer service and sales skills and maintains a professional attitude.
  • Maintains accuracy and compliance in all account documentation.
  • Minimizes risk of losses, including cash differences and other controllable losses.
  • Maintains current knowledge of all Federal and State laws and regulations, along with the Bank’s policies and procedures.
  • Processes teller transactions in an accurate and timely manner (e.g. deposits, withdrawals, payments, transfers, check cashing, negotiable purchasing, etc.).
  • Processes and validates accuracy of coin and currency amounts related to incoming and outgoing cash shipments.
  • The incumbent also maintains current knowledge of competitor products, services, and current promotions.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Note: Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Qualifications:

  • High School Degree or GED required.
  • Some work experience preferred.
  • 1+ years of experience as a teller or personal banker is a plus.
  • Bi-lingual proficiency in Spanish preferred
  • Must be detail oriented with excellent organizational skills.
  • Team player with a strong desire to learn, exercise good leadership skills, independent judgment, discretionary thinking, creativity and be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office preferred.
  • Working knowledge of banking regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledgeable about a wide variety of retail bank products and administrative support
  • Strong time management skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate in a professional, accurate, and clear manner with internal & external stakeholders.
  • Makes sound judgments regarding customer service and risk to the bank, effectively balancing both. Understands when to escalate a problem or situation to management for resolution.
  • Continue to look for ways in which to complete tasks and duties in an efficient, cost-effective, and productive manner, without sacrificing excellent customer service.
  • Must be able to lift 30 pounds.


Physical Demands/Work Environment:
Usual office environment with frequent sitting, walking, and standing, and occasional climbing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and balancing. Frequent use of eye, hand, and finger coordination enabling the use of office equipment. Oral and auditory capacity enabling interpersonal communication as well as communication through automated devices.

title: State Estimation and Navigation Engineer
description:
About the role

This role is designed for an experienced state estimation specialist who will eventually own the navigation and estimation problem end-to-end for our interceptor systems.

This is a deep individual-contributor role. You will work alongside our GNC and autonomy leads to shape, architect, and independently execute the state estimation solutions that deliver mission-critical capability.

Navigation in our domain is unforgiving. Our vehicles are low-SWaP and operate in GPS-contested environments, across high-dynamic flight regimes, against maneuvering targets, with hard real-time constraints and little margin for a bad estimate.

We are looking for someone who treats this as the central challenge it is, and who has the depth to drive a solution from first-principles observability analysis through flight-proven, embedded implementation.

We are looking for evidence-driven engineers: individuals who prioritize physical reality over opinion and have the technical conviction to derive the best solution as supported by data. In this role, that means bringing the judgment to know which estimator architecture the problem actually demands, the rigor to prove it against flight data, and the autonomy to test, troubleshoot, validate in flight, and deliver an effective solution.

What you'll do

You will lead the design and implementation of the navigation and estimation stack, from first-principles observability analysis through flight-proven embedded execution. You will work in close partnership with the guidance and controls teams, but the architecture, rigor, and validation of the estimation solution are yours to drive.

You will focus on problems in all of the following areas:

  • Estimator Architecture & Design: Select and justify the estimator architecture the problem actually demands, including KF variants, factor graphs, and related approaches, grounded in observability analysis of the vehicle dynamics and sensor suite rather than defaulting to a familiar filter.
  • State-Driven Guidance & Control Co-Design: Work across the estimation-G&C boundary to align the available state with the guidance and control laws the intercept requires, recognizing that estimator capability and achievable guidance are mutually constraining.
  • GPS-Contested & Denied Navigation: Develop navigation solutions that hold up as GNSS degrades or disappears, maintaining a trustworthy state through the regimes where a bad estimate ends the mission.
  • Multimodal Sensor Fusion: Fuse heterogeneous sensing, including inertial, GNSS, vision, and seeker/target sensors, into a coherent, real-time state under low-SWaP constraints.
  • Robustness to Latency & Degradation: Handle delayed and asynchronous measurements, detect and ride through sensor degradation or outright failure, and inform the case for redundant or complementary sensing where the estimate demands it.
  • Target-Relative Navigation: Estimate the relative state of maneuvering targets with the fidelity and latency the intercept demands.
  • Sensor Selection & Integration: Partner with the hardware and electrical design teams to drive sensor selection, placement, and integration, closing the loop between what the estimator needs and what the vehicle carries.
  • Flight Validation: Prove estimators against truth data across SITL/HITL and real flight; instrument, troubleshoot, and characterize filter behavior from telemetry and logs.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: MS in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in estimation, navigation, or sensor fusion.
  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience, with an MS, developing state estimation and sensor fusion systems for dynamic platforms.
  • Estimation Depth: Hands-on expertise with Kalman-class estimators, including EKF/UKF, and the underlying theory, including process and measurement modeling, observability, tuning, and consistency analysis, applied to real systems rather than textbook problems.
  • Mobile or Field Robotics Estimation Experience: Direct experience developing state estimation for mobile or field robotics platforms, including ground, aerial, legged, or marine systems, operating in real-world conditions with onboard sensing and motion.
  • Real-System Validation: A track record of taking estimators beyond simulation onto hardware and validating them against flight or experimental truth data.
  • Software Skills: Strong C++ for on-vehicle implementation and Python for analysis and simulation.
  • Travel: Ability to travel as necessary to support rigorous flight testing events and campaigns.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

  • Education: PhD in a relevant field with a research focus in estimation, navigation, or sensor fusion.
  • GPS-Contested & Denied Navigation: Direct experience maintaining a trustworthy state as GNSS degrades or disappears, including alternative navigation, integrity monitoring, or anti-jam/anti-spoof awareness.
  • Target Tracking: Relative-state estimation against maneuvering targets, including high-G or high-closing-rate engagements.
  • Advanced Estimation Methods: Factor graphs, fixed-lag smoothing, GTSAM/Ceres or equivalent, and visual-inertial odometry (VIO).
  • Embedded & Real-Time Deployment: Estimators running on resource-constrained targets, including STM32, Jetson, and FPGA platforms, under RTOS/Linux, with attention to timing, fixed-point/numerical issues, and high-rate telemetry.
  • Simulation & Validation: High-fidelity physics modeling and digital-twin replication for estimator development and SITL/HITL validation.
  • Flight Regimes: High-speed multirotor or rocket systems; nonlinear dynamics and transition maneuvers.
  • Software Frameworks: ROS/ROS2 or other custom, lightweight middlewares.


Export Control

This position may involve access to technology, material, technical data, defense articles, or information subject to U.S. export-control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), and applicable contract requirements. Assignment to covered work is contingent upon the company’s ability to verify that the candidate is authorized to receive access to such items or information, including by qualifying as a “U.S. person” as defined in 22 C.F.R. § 120.62, or through any required export-control authorization, notice, approval, or access-control process.

title: Structural Dynamics Analyst
description:
Structural Dynamics Analyst


Houston Texas

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. We believe our mission is to further research, communications, and exploration beyond low lunar orbit. With multiple NASA lunar missions in the making and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

Intuitive Machines is seeking a talented and experienced Structural Dynamics Analyst to join our dynamic team. As a Structural Dynamics Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing and predicting the structural dynamic loads experienced by our aerospace vehicles.

Responsibilities:

  • Construct finite element models and superelements suitable for dynamic analyses.
  • Conduct comprehensive loads analysis and calculate structural responses to external loads including inertial, vibration, and acoustic.
  • Conduct modal analysis to characterize the dynamic behavior of aerospace structures and subsystems, identifying potential resonant frequencies and mode shapes.
  • Collaborate with structural design engineers to optimize vehicle structures and components for weight efficiency, structural integrity, and dynamic performance.
  • Collaborate with test engineers to define test plans that include load measurement instrumentation and response limits based on analysis results from dynamic analysis including factors such as material strength, notching, and mode shapes.
  • Prepare detailed technical reports, documentation, and presentation to communicate analysis results, findings, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and customers.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in structural dynamics, vibration, and/or launch/space vehicle dynamic analysis.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed engineering decisions.
  • Must be proficient with performing analytical simulations and finite element modeling in Nastran.
  • Proficient in performing static and dynamic analyses such as sine vibration, random vibration, shock, and vibro-acoustic analysis both with FEA and traditional hand calculations.
  • Experience in signal analysis and analyzing data in both the time and frequency domain.
  • Proficient in coding, performing simulations, and analyzing data in Matlab or Python.
  • Experience with vibration, shock, and modal testing, from writing test plans, execution, interpretation of results, and using data to correlate models.
  • Familiarity with relevant SMC / MIL-STD / NASA standards for analysis and test.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Beta CAE products for finite element modeling and data post-processing. (ANSA, META, EPYLISIS)
  • Experience with Simcenter (NX) Nastran

Join Our Team: At Intuitive Machines, we are passionate about pushing the boundaries of space exploration and shaping the future of aerospace technology. As a Loads & Dynamics Engineer, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects and contribute to the development of cutting-edge aerospace vehicles. If you are driven by innovation and ready to make an impact, we invite you to join us on our journey to the stars.

Building a centralized and reliable data pipeline



  • Collecting, cleaning, and inventorying nat cat claims data stored across various sources and formats (Excel, CSV, JSON, etc.)

Developing a user-friendly data loading/extraction interface



  • Creating an intuitive interface within Databricks (e.g., using Databricks Widgets or a notebook-based UI) allowing non-technical users to load/submit data with ease.

  • Implementing clear error messages and guided workflows to support data contributors across teams.


Enabling data visualization and self-service analytics



  • Building an interactive dashboard connected to the cleaned Databricks data layer, providing meaningful insights on the claims data

  • Integrating a data download feature, allowing authorized users to export clean, structured datasets directly from the platform


Documenting and maintaining the solution



  • Producing clear technical documentation covering the pipeline architecture, data dictionaries, and user guides

  • Following data engineering best practices (version control, modular code, reproducibility)

Education



  • Engineering or Master's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Data Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent)


Technical & Professional Skills



  • Programming skills in Python/R (pandas, PySpark) and/or SQL

  • Familiarity with ETL pipeline design and data quality concept

  • French and Business English - fluent (spoken and written)


Interpersonal skills

  • Strong communication skills

  • Curious and eager to learn about the insurance industry

  • Motivated by working in an international and dynamic environment


What We Offer

  • 60% reimbursement of Navigo pass

  • Generous Inter-Company Committee.

  • Company restaurant and meal vouchers.

During the recruitment process, feel free to inform the recruiters about any specific adjustments you may need for your job.

Required

Preferred

  • Experience working onsite and coordinating with construction, QA, engineering, and C&Q leads.

Technical Skills

  • Integrated schedule development and maintenance for C&Q (plan/actual/forecast).

  • Schedule controls practices: baseline management, progress updates, and forecasting.
  • Schedule impact and scenario analysis for C&Q reporting.
  • Production of schedule visuals and metrics for weekly/monthly forums and dashboard reporting.

Soft Skills

  • Strong cross-functional coordination with construction, QA, engineering, and C&Q leads.
  • Clear written and verbal communication for forums and stakeholder updates.
  • Proactive issue escalation and follow-through.
  • Collaborative alignment with the Project Integrator and project team on evolving schedule changes.

title: Sosionomi, Esperi Koti Pansio
description:
Hei sosionomi! Etsitkö mielenkiintoista työtä mielenterveyskuntoutujien parista? Meillä on haussa osaava ja työstään innostunut sosionomitaustainen työkaveri sijaisuuteen - olisitko se sinä?

Koti Pansio työpaikkana

Koti Pansio tarjoaa yhteisöllistä asumista ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista yhteensä 34 aikuiselle mielenterveyskuntoutujalle. Yksikkömme on erikoistunut vaativien ja somaattisesti haastavien asukkaiden hoitoon. Pansio sijaitsee Turussa, kauniilla alueella lähellä merta. Meille on tärkeää, että asukkaamme voivat elää mielekästä ja itsensä näköistä arkea. Kuljemme heidän rinnallaan tukien ja avustaen heitä itsenäisessä päätöksenteossa, oman arjen hallinnassa ja toimimisessa osana yhteisöä.

Tutustu kotimme arkeen lisää Instagramista: [@esperi_pansio](https://www.instagram.com/esperi_pansio/)

Sosionomin työ meillä

Sosionomina tehtävänkuvasi on monipuolinen. Työajasta noin 70% teet arjen aktiviteettien ja ryhmätoimintojen suunnittelua ja toteuttamista, yhteistyötä eri verkostojen, omaisten ja työyhteisön kanssa sekä edistät omalta osaltasi asiakkaiden voimavarojen tukemista. Loput työajasta sisältää hoitotyötä, jossa pääpaino on asukkaiden avustamisessa päivittäisissä toiminnoissa, mutta erityisesti aamutoimissa, heidän tarpeidensa mukaisesti. Mikäli olet suorittanut lääkeluvat, niin työtehtäviisi voi myös kuulua lääkehoidonseurantaa ja lääkehuoltoa. Tehtävässä toimit läheisessä yhteistyössä asukkaiden läheisten ja moniammatillisen tiimin kanssa.

Työsuhteen tiedot

Tehtävä on määräaikainen sijaisuus 31.1.27 asti. Työ on kokoaikatyötä ja arkisin tehtävää aamuvuoroa. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen mukaan.

Palkka

Palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityistä sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Sosionomin pohjapalkka on kokemuslisistä riippuen palkkaluokan G24D mukaisesti 2 811,09 - 3 071,09 €/kk.

Tehtävässä edellytämme

- sosionomin tutkintoa

- voimassa olevia lääkelupia, hygieniapassia sekä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa

- sote-ammattikorttia

- vähintään toimivaa suomen peruskielitaitoa (B1)
- kielitaito tulee tarvittaessa voida osoittaa


- Valmius esittää rikosrekisteriote ennen työn alkua

Katsomme eduksi aikaisemman kokemuksen mielenterveyskuntoutujien kanssa työskentelystä tai suuntautumisen mielenterveystyöhön opinnoissa.

Miksi sinun kannattaisi tulla juuri meille töihin?

- laadukas perehdytys ja koko tiimin tuki - me haluamme että sinä onnistut!

- mielenkiintoinen työympäristö ja mahdollisuus kehittää ammattitaitoasi mm. koulutusten kautta

- monipuoliset työsuhde-edut mm. Cityshopparin alennukset, työmatkaetu

- kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Mahtavaa!

Lähetä hakemuksesi 28.10. mennessä ja kerro meille itsestäsi! Älä aikaile, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi hakuaikana ja sovimme aloituksesta heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Haluatko kuulla tehtävästä lisää? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä yksikönjohtaja Sari Mantere p. 050 570 7759, sp. sari.mantere@esperi.fi.

Tervetuloa osaksi meidän porukkaamme!


Esperi Koti Pansio

Esperi on suomalainen asumispalveluita tarjoava valtakunnallinen yritys. Työllistämme yli 7200 sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaista, ja Esperi-koteja löytyy yli 100 paikkakunnalta ympäri Suomen. Kodeissamme asuu ikäihmisiä, mielenterveyskuntoutujia sekä vammaispalvelun asiakkaita. Hoitotyötä teemme asukaslähtöisesti ja laadukkaasti. Korkea asukastyytyväisyys (50 NPS) on ylpeytemme aihe. title: Technical Design Artist, Intern 2027
description:
Company Overview
ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments.

Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost-effective response to one of the fastest-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community.

Following a $200 million Series B at a $2.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real-world impact on national security.

ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit .

Our interns aren't fetching coffee or shadowing — they're working alongside the same engineers and product teams building the systems we ship.

As a Technical Design Artist Intern, you'll work at the intersection of art, engineering, and real-time technology. You'll help build and improve the Unreal Engine 5 systems that bring our products to life — from 3D assets and materials to visual effects, tools, and content pipelines.

This is early-career work with real stakes. You'll work closely with engineers and technical artists to solve problems, build things, and iterate on technology that needs to perform reliably in real-world environments.

Location: Austin, TX (on-site)
Duration: Summer 2027 (~10–12 weeks)
Pay: Paid Internship (to be discussed during interviews)

What You'll Do

  • Build and integrate 3D assets, materials, textures, animations, and visual effects in Unreal Engine 5.

  • Work closely with engineers and technical artists to develop and iterate on real-time visual systems.

  • Create materials and shaders using Unreal Engine's Material Editor, including custom node-based and HLSL-based solutions where appropriate.

  • Build tools and workflows that help artists and engineers work faster and more consistently.

  • Use Blueprints and Python to automate repetitive tasks and improve content pipelines.

  • Help investigate and solve performance issues across graphics, memory, rendering, and content.

  • Work with Unreal Engine technologies such as Nanite, Lumen, Niagara, and Chaos.

  • Collaborate with engineers and product teams to understand technical requirements and turn them into working visual solutions.

  • Document tools, workflows, and technical decisions so others can build on your work.

  • Take projects from an initial idea through implementation, feedback, and iteration.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Game Development, Computer Graphics, Animation, Interactive Media, or a related field.

  • Coursework, project, or internship experience with Unreal Engine, real-time graphics, technical art, 3D content creation, or game development.

  • Experience working in Unreal Engine 5, including familiarity with the editor, Materials, and Blueprints.

  • Experience with a 3D content creation tool such as Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max.

  • Basic understanding of real-time rendering, including materials, lighting, textures, geometry, and performance.

  • An interest in understanding how software and technical systems work.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Curiosity about working closely with engineers and learning how technical decisions affect the final product.

  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather create something, get feedback, and iterate than wait for a perfect spec.

  • A portfolio or examples of projects that demonstrate your work with Unreal Engine, 3D content, shaders, tools, visual effects, or other real-time technology.

You'll Stand Out

  • Experience with Python, C++, or HLSL.

  • Experience building Unreal Engine tools or workflows with Blueprints or Python.

  • Experience creating custom materials, shaders, or visual effects.

  • Experience with Niagara, Nanite, Lumen, Control Rig, or Chaos.

  • Experience with Houdini or procedural content generation.

  • Experience using graphics or performance profiling tools such as RenderDoc, PIX, Unreal Insights, or the Unreal GPU Visualizer.

  • Experience working directly with software engineers on a technical or creative project.

  • Projects involving simulation, robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, or other real-time technology.

  • Experience taking a project from prototype to a working, usable result.

Why ACS

  • Direct impact: Your work contributes to products that are built for real-world use — not stuck in a slide deck.

  • Real ownership: You'll work directly with the engineers and product team building Bullfrog and contribute to real product decisions from day one.

  • Small team, big scope: At a startup this size, interns take on meaningful problems and see their work move from concept to implementation.

  • Cross-functional experience: Work alongside designers, product managers, and engineers to understand what it takes to build and ship a product.

  • Mentorship: Learn from experienced engineers and product builders who have designed and fielded real defense systems.

Location: Melbourne/Sydney, Australia || Hybrid

SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. What You Will Get to Do:

We are experiencing rapidly growing demand for performance testing, driven by new, complex migration programs and the expansion of our technology platform. We are seeking a Senior Performance Test Engineer with 10+ years proven experience in complex, high volume enterprise systems and strong LoadRunner background to join our team with a shared passion for performance excellence. The role covers performance testing of our expanding .NET-based solution, combining business critical batch and online systems with new microservices and cloud technologies.

Key responsibilities of this role include:

  • Self-managed full performance test life cycle: define test requirements and scope, planning/schedule, test scenario and build, execution, monitor, analysis and reporting of accurate results and status to target audiences within timeframes.
  • Collaboration with delivery teams to resolve performance defects.
  • Delivery of all test artefacts including Test Plan, Progress Reports, and Test Summary Reports to certify Releases to Production.
  • Active participation in performance risk identification (business and technical impact) and mitigation actions, establishment of performance NFRs and benchmarks.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our products, services, and technology to effectively communicate and bridge the performance gap between business and technical teams.
  • Drive and define performance testing strategy, process, and tools for efficient and effective Program delivery, and to align with industry standards.
  • Build and optimize automated performance test pipelines to reduce cost & increase coverage.
  • Ownership of test environment and capacity planning.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross functional, multi-region team located in AU and India. Flexibility to attend meetings/workshop at reasonable overlapped hours.

What You Will Bring:

Technical Skills

  • 10+ years in performance test engineering role which includes microservices and cloud-based technology.
  • Preferred experience within superannuation, wealth management or other financial services (e.g. the Big 4 banks) domain.
  • Mastery of Performance Test Tools:
    • Knowledge of scripting languages and the ability to write code for test automation. Mandatory: Microfocus LoadRunner HTTP Protocol - C coding + manual correlation. Desirable: JMeter, Gatling, K6 etc. Database languages: MS SQL, Postgres
    • Monitoring and Analysis: Mandatory: LoadRunner Analysis. Desirable: Microsoft perfmon, Grafana
  • Strong understanding and hands-on technology experience with the following:
    • Operating System: Windows Server, Database: SQL Server 2019+, Application Development Platforms: .NET.
    • Cloud-based: Microservices: architecture, principles, and best practices. Kubernetes: Container orchestration and management, including deployment strategies, scaling, and resource management.
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate performance testing into the CI/CD process.
  • Proficiency with Confluence and JIRA
  • Proficiency with version control GIT
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments where rapid iterations and continuous improvement are practiced.
  • Education and qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

title: WPO (Site Related /Enabling Projects, Civil & Structural)
description:
About Company:

JC Automation Corp. (JCA) was founded in 1997 with the mission of filling a gap between technology and regulatory requirements in the life science manufacturing industry. The company offers highly capable resources at an affordable cost to build solutions and execute projects in: Automation, Control Systems Integration, Information Technology, System Integration and Regulatory Compliance.

JCA is a HUBZone Certified Small Business Firm, NMSDC Certified Minority Business Enterprise, and Certified Critical Industry Supplier. It’s mission is to add value by delivering quality services & solutions on time all the time by transforming processes & technology into business advantages.


ABOUT THE ROLE

A Work Package Owner is responsible for a defined scope area of the project from an Owner governance and integration perspective. The WPO maintains visibility of contractor performance, identifies risks and constraints, coordinates stakeholder interfaces, drives issue resolution, and ensures the package progresses toward mechanical completion and turnover in accordance with project objectives.

The WPO acts as the Owner's advocate in the field, ensuring decisions are made promptly, interfaces are properly managed, and risks are identified early while maintaining clear alignment among design, procurement, construction, systems completion, and CQV teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Base Work Package Ownership

  • Serve as the Owner representative for an assigned Base Work Package from field mobilization through mechanical completion and turnover.
  • Maintain overall awareness of package safety, quality, schedule, cost, productivity, and risk performance.
  • Establish and maintain package-level execution readiness and interface tracking plans.
  • Ensure Owner obligations and deliverables are completed in accordance with project requirements.

Contractor Performance Monitoring

  • Monitor contractor performance against approved safety, quality, schedule, and productivity goals.
  • Participate in field walks, coordination meetings, readiness reviews, and contractor progress discussions.
  • Identify emerging performance issues and escalate concerns through appropriate project governance channels.
  • Verify contractor-reported progress and support project controls reporting activities.

Constraint Management

  • Identify and track constraints impacting package execution.
  • Coordinate timely resolution of Owner-driven and cross-functional constraints.
  • Facilitate decisions related to design clarifications, procurement issues, access requirements, permits, turnover priorities, and operational interfaces.
  • Escalate unresolved constraints to project leadership when required.

Interface Management

  • Coordinate package interfaces with adjacent work packages, utility systems, infrastructure, commissioning activities, and operational stakeholders.
  • Ensure interface risks are identified, documented, tracked, and resolved.
  • Support planning and execution of tie-ins, shutdowns, energizations, and system integration activities.

Safety Oversight

  • Promote project safety culture and Owner HSE expectations.
  • Participate in safety observations, field engagements, audits, and leadership walks.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with project safety requirements.
  • Track and escalate significant safety concerns, trends, and recurring issues.

Quality Oversight

  • Monitor field quality performance and implementation of approved quality plans.
  • Support inspection readiness and adherence to project quality requirements.
  • Participate in quality reviews and issue resolution activities.
  • Track quality trends, deficiencies, punch list status, and corrective action closure.

Owner Equipment & Vendor Integration

  • Coordinate installation readiness and integration of Owner-furnished equipment and systems.
  • Interface with equipment suppliers and vendor representatives to support successful installation, startup, and turnover activities.
  • Track supplier deliverables, technical support requirements, and commissioning readiness.

Schedule & Progress Management

  • Support package-level progress assessment and forecasting activities.
  • Review contractor look-ahead plans and identify risks to upcoming work.
  • Coordinate Owner actions necessary to support planned execution activities.
  • Monitor milestone achievement and turnover readiness.

Turnover & CQV Readiness

  • Ensure package execution supports the project's systems-based turnover strategy from the earliest stages of construction.
  • Monitor progress against mechanical completion, systems completion, turnover, and CQV readiness milestones.
  • Coordinate with Construction Management, System Owners, Turnover Leads, CQV, Operations, and contractors to identify and remove barriers to system handover.
  • Promote construction sequencing and workface planning that enables phased turnover and efficient CQV execution.
  • Track and drive closure of deficiencies, punch list items, documentation gaps, testing activities, and turnover deliverables affecting system readiness.
  • Advocate for turnover and startup priorities during package planning and interface discussions.
  • Escalate risks that could impact mechanical completion, turnover milestones, commissioning activities, qualification schedules, or startup objectives.

Reporting & Communication

  • Provide routine package status updates including risks, constraints, safety trends, quality concerns, schedule impacts, and interface issues.
  • Maintain package dashboards, action-item logs, and issue trackers.
  • Present package status and recommendations to project leadership as required.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related technical discipline; equivalent construction and industry experience considered.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience supporting complex industrial, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, semiconductor, or similar capital projects.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multi-disciplinary construction, startup, and turnover activities.
  • Strong understanding of contractor management, construction execution, quality systems, and project controls.
  • Experience with systems completion, mechanical completion, turnover, and CQV processes preferred.
  • Strong stakeholder management, interface management, and problem-solving skills.
  • OSHA 30 preferred.
  • English required; Spanish strongly preferred for projects located in Puerto Rico

Work Package Owner Roles

Site Related /Enabling Projects

  • Focus on site infrastructure, tie-ins, utility expansion, brownfield interfaces, enabling works, shutdown coordination, and external utility integration.

Civil & Structural

  • Focus on foundations, concrete, structural steel, building envelope, architectural systems, and associated interfaces supporting facility readiness.

title: Electrical Test Engineer
description:

title: Maatalouskoneiden korjaaja/ metallityöntekijä, tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava, aloitus HETI, HUITTINEN
description:
Huittisissa olisi työtä tarjolla maatalouskoneiden korjaajalle/ metallialan työntekijälle. Työtä on tarjolla aluksi tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavana, tarkoituksena on myöhemmässä vaiheessa tarjota täydet työtunnit vakituisesti. Osaavan tekijän kanssa neuvottelemme mieluusti palkasta. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme Epassin!
Pääset työskentelemään pieneen metallipajaan, jossa tulee toimimaan myös maatalouskoneiden korjaamo. Etsimme tehtävään käytännönläheistä ja motivoitunutta työntekijää, joka olisi kiinnostunut hitsaamisesta ja koneiden korjaamisesta.
Eduksi tässä tehtävässä on:
MIG/ MAG- hitsauksen ja metallityöstön osaaminen
Kiinnostus traktoreihin, maatalouskoneisiin ja työkoneisiin
Mekaaninen osaaminen ja ongelmanratkaisukyky
Hydrauliikan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi

Työt alkavat mahdollisimman nopealla aikataululla. Alkuun töitä on tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavana, tarkoitus on vakiinnuttaa tästä vakituinen, kokoaikainen työ. Työsuhteessa sovelletaan maatalousalan työehtosopimusta, palkka on vähintään 15€/h, mutta neuvottelemme mieluusti palkasta osaavan henkilön kanssa.

Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!




---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: ED Tech PRN
description:
ED Tech (FT)

POSITION SUMMARY

  • ED techs are employed to take care of patients’ everyday needs.
  • Conducts personal care duties such as bathing, dressing, and feeding patients, as well as brushing teeth and combing hair.
  • Helps patients in and out of bed, often by lifting or carrying them, and assist them with walking.
  • Answers patients' calls for help, take their vital signs, and monitor their behavior and physical condition for progress or deterioration.
  • Works under the supervision of an experienced nurse, and reports any problems or worsening in a patient's condition to the facility staff.
  • Other job requirements may include stocking and keeping storerooms tidy and cleaning patient rooms.

OVERVIEW

  • The evaluation is to assure individual performance, departmental goals and organizational goals are aligned. It is designed to support communication between the manager and the employee. Employee perception of their own performance is very important. To maximize the benefit of this process, both the manager and the employee participate in the evaluation process.

QUALIFICATIONS

    • Reads and understands the English language.
    • Ability to think critically and analytically with little or no supervision
    • Ability to work effectively in situations of high stress and conflict and communicate goals and outcomes.
    • Ability to process information and prioritize
    • Possesses exceptional verbal and written communication skills
    • Possesses independent work habits, is self-reliant and self-directed
    • Ability to learn, adapt, and change as required by the job functions

  1. Education

  2. Licensure
    • PCT I – highschool or college Certified Assistant program preferred
    • PCTII – certified nursing assistant license required
    • PCTIII - certified nursing assistant license required plus EKG or lab draw competencies completed
  3. Experience
    • 1 - 2 years experience in a healthcare setting preferred.
  4. Interpersonal skills
  1. Essential technical/motor skills
  2. Essential physical requirements
    • Heavy: Exert 50 – 100 lb. of force occasionally and/or up to 30 lb. of force frequently - greater than 75%
  1. Essential mental requirements
  1. Essential sensory requirements
  2. Other
    • Ability to communicate effectively and document information accurately
    • Ability to deal efficiently and effectively with a wide variety of individuals

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

    • Level I

    • Neonates 1 - 30 days

JOB SPECIFIC DUTIES AND PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

  • Below are those tasks, duties, and responsibilities that comprise the means of accomplishing the position’s purpose and objectives. These are critical or fundamental to the performance of the position. They are the major functions for which the person in the position is held accountable. Following are the essential functions of the position, along with the corresponding performance standards.
  • Demonstrates the skills and judgment necessary to provide direct care to patients under the direct supervision of licensed personnel as evidenced by:
    • Observes and reports patient's status and needs.

    • Transports patients.

    • Assists with admissions, transfers and discharges.

EDUCATION AND COMPETENCY
