title: Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The mission

You will be the reference point for the most complex hardware interventions across our sites.

Mistral's compute is our largest investment and the foundation of frontier AI in Europe. As a Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer (L4-L5), you own the interventions that require the highest level of technical expertise: multi-node failures in production, full-rack deployments of GPU-dense systems, and vendor escalations where you speak as the technical authority for our sites.

You'll work end-to-end — compute, storage, interconnect, power and cooling interfaces — across our data center footprint, raising the bar on reliability as our capacity grows. This is a hands-on senior IC role: deep technical leadership and mentorship, no direct line management.

Location: Based at one of our data centers in the Paris region, with occasional visits to our other sites as needed.

What you'll do

  • Lead complex interventions — vendor-level and multi-node operations in production: full rack builds and bring-up, GPU-dense platform deployment (H100/H200-class and next-gen, including liquid-cooled racks), intricate recabling, post-restart diagnosis. You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback.

  • Own vendor management — coordinate repairs, part replacements and escalations directly with hardware vendors; hold them to their SLAs; drive proactive fixes from failure trends.

  • Diagnose at depth — correlate symptoms across compute, storage, interconnect and cooling; read BMC/IPMI consoles, OS logs and crash dumps; methodical root‑cause analysis that ends in concrete corrective actions.

  • Deploy and validate — structured bring-up and validation of new racks and platforms; work with networking and infrastructure teams to take installations from delivery to production-ready.

  • Lift the team — mentor and pair with L1-L3 engineers on live operations; turn your knowledge into SOPs, checklists and training material; propose and build small automation (Python/Bash) to shorten MTTR.

  • Work the facility interface — partner with critical facilities/engineering ops on power, cooling (air and liquid), PDU and monitoring (BMS/EPMS) boundaries; enforce ESD/LOTO/PPE and audit-ready change discipline everywhere.

  • Own spares & reliability — plan spares strategy, track fleet failure trends, and run proactive vendor actions before incidents happen.

About you

  • 6+ years in data center / server hardware or L2/L3 hardware support, including complex hands‑on work in production environments (HPC/AI/cloud at scale strongly preferred).

  • End‑to‑end hardware expertise: CPU/memory/PCIe (incl. accelerators), NICs, PSUs, drives, network, power and cooling interfaces (DLC included); strong judgment on when and how to elevate.

  • Diagnostics depth: confident with BMC/IPMI logs, Linux logs and CLI checks; structured root‑cause analysis.

  • Deployment experience: you've taken racks from delivery to production, with concrete examples to show for it.

  • Vendor fluency: you've managed hardware vendors — RMAs, field replacements, escalations — to concrete outcomes.

  • Impeccable safety and discipline: ESD/LOTO/PPE without exception; clean, labeled, auditable work.

  • Communication & mentoring: clear status updates and handovers; able to coach engineers during live incidents with composure.

  • Mobility: willing to visit our other sites in the Paris region as needed.

Nice to have

  • GPU-dense platform experience: NVIDIA H-series (H100/H200) or GB-series rack deployments.

  • High-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), RAID/storage (NVMe/SAS/SATA), vendor tooling (iDRAC/iLO/IPMI).

  • Automation (Python/Bash) for ops tooling and reporting; ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory/RMA flows.

  • Hardware qualification, burn-in or factory validation background.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work‑life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location‑specific perks.

For the most up‑to‑date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend-Leaning) - CoreMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The Music team owns music and sound effects end to end at ElevenLabs. We turn research breakthroughs into APIs and creative tools, from the backend systems that bring in new models to the interfaces creators use inside ElevenCreative. Five new research engineers have just joined the music research group, and models for stem separation and MIDI transcription are in progress.

You’ll join as a Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ll work with research and research engineering to bring model improvements into production, and build and run the APIs behind them. You’ll also sync with go-to-market to decide which features, including bespoke enterprise ones, get built next. Occasionally you’ll join customer calls when a customer wants someone technical.

Engineers act as PMs. You’ll be handed ambiguous goals and expected to break them down. That means working through the legal questions, choosing the engineering approach, and planning the launch with growth. Models set the limits, so you’ll design systems that let a better model be swapped in later. Engineering is often only half the job.

Requirements

  • A strong Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ve built and shipped production APIs and backend systems.

  • A product decomposition mindset. You’ve taken a vague goal, weighed trade-offs and shipped without analysis paralysis.

  • Proactive ownership. You drive work end to end without a ticket board or someone assigning tasks.

  • Comfortable working across research, legal, safety, growth, design and enterprise customers.

  • Genuinely excited about music and AI. You’re the kind of person who prototypes ideas for fun and pushes the good ones into production.

Bonus: music or audio experience (even as a hobby), or experience shipping ML models into production.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in Central European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Vastuumyyjä 25-30h/vk, Finlayson Pop-Up, Vaasa Rewell
description:
Vastuullisuus - rohkeus - uteliaisuus, ovatko nämä arvoja, jotka ovat myös sinun toimintasi sydän?

Finlaysonilla olemme vakuuttuneita siitä, että ainoa oikea tapa kunnioittaa yrityksen historiaa, on toimia yhtä vastuullisesti, rohkeasti ja ennakkoluulottomasti kuin varhaiset omistajamme. Tavoitteenamme on olla läpinäkyvin tekstiilialan yritys maailmassa. Lupaamme avata toimitusketjumme täysin läpinäkyväksi ja tehdä työtä puuvillan jäljitettävyyden eteen. Pyrimme vähentämään tekstiilijätettä suunnittelemalla kestäviä ja kierrätettäviä tuotteita. Meille yhteiskunnallinen vastuu tarkoittaa, että olemme jotain mieltä. Otamme osaa yhteiskunnalliseen keskusteluun, puolustamme meille tärkeitä asioita ja seisomme kantamme takana.

Haluaisitko sinä hypätä mukaan inspiroivaan työympäristöön, jossa vallitsee tekemisen meininki?


Haemme Finlaysonin Pop-Up myymälään

VASTUUMYYJÄÄ

Miksi Finlayson? Työntekijät vastaavat
- Kiinnostavat tuotteet, viihtyisät toimitilat ja laadukkaat työvälineet
- Työyhteisössä voi olla oma itsensä, tunteita ja mielipiteitä saa jakaa rohkeasti
- Tiimissä jokainen tekee parhaansa tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi ja yhdessä teemme maailmasta paremman paikan olla ja elää

Tule siis tekemään asiakkaiden arjesta juhlaa ja osaksi lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa jokaisen työpanos on merkityksellinen yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi. Kun asennettasi kuvaa ennakkoluulottomuus ja rohkeus myyntityössä, vain taivas on rajana. Etsimme periksiantamatonta työpanosta sekä ratkaisukeskeistä myynnillistä asennetta omaa persoonaa unohtamatta - Tule kirjoittamaan Finlaysonin värikästä tarinaa, jolla on historiaa jo vuodesta 1820 lähtien.


Vastuumyyjän roolissa sinulla on merkittävä rooli Pop up -myymälän onnistumisesta, sillä tulet vastaamaan myymälän myynnistä, muun tiimin perehdyttämisestä sekä päivittäisen työn ohjaamisesta käyttäen omaa esimerkkiäsi. Olet mukana myymälän avaukseen ja rakentamiseen liittyvissä prosesseissa, vastuullasi on kampanjoiden aikataulutus ja myyntien seuranta, raportointi, tilausten tekeminen sekä työvuorolistojen laadinta. Vastuutehtävien lisäksi tulet olemaan myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun tehtävissä yhdessä tiimisi kanssa, joten työtehtäviin kuuluu myös palvelu kassalla, kuorman vastaanotto sekä esillepanot. Finlaysonin Pop Up myymälöissä pääset myös Finlaysonin tuotteiden lisäksi myymään mm. Vallilan ja Reino&Ainon tuotteita!

Finlayson on kulkenut pitkän matkan suomalaisten arjessa, ja pääset jatkamaan tätä matkaa myymällä uniikkeja sekä haluttuja kodintekstiileitä asiakkaalle. Saat tiimisi inspiroitumaan aktiivisella työpanoksellasi ja motivoit tiimiläisiä omalla tekemiselläsi. Finlayson Pop upeissa arki on hektistä ja saatat silmänräpäyksessä seistä tilanteen edessä, jossa et ole aiemmin ollut - oletko valmis ottamaan haasteen vastaan?

Työ on sesonkiin perustuva määräaikaisuus Marraskuun alusta Tammikuun loppuun saakka. Vastuumyyjällä työtunteja on tarjolla noin 25-30 h/viikko ja vuorot sijoittuvat myymälän aukioloaikoihin, myös ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroihin.

Työsuhde solmitaan työntekijän ja StaffPointin välille ja työssä noudatetaan kaupan alan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus määräytyy Kaupan TES:n C-vaativuusluokan (vaativa ammattitehtävä) mukaan, 13,96–16,90 €/h kokemuksesta ja työskentelypaikkakunnasta riippuen. Tuntipalkan päälle maksetaan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset ilta-, lauantai-, sunnuntai- ja muut lisät.

EDELLYTÄMME SINULTA

Tahtotilaa ja sitoutumista työskennellä Finlaysonin brändin ja arvojen mukaisesti
Etsimme oma-aloitteista, aktiivista ja rohkeaa myyjää, jolla on kyky nähdä nopeasti muuttuvat tilanteet mahdollisuuksina, tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä sekä kykyä auttaa koko tiimiä onnistumaan niin yksilöinä kuin yhdessä
Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen vastaavista tehtävistä
Tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten henkilö, joka omaa hyvät tietotekniset taidot
Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

TARJOAMME SINULLE

Mahdollisuuden ottaa askeleen uralla kohti vastuullisempia työtehtäviä. Saat työhön tukea ja neuvoja Finlaysonilta ja haluamme olla osana ammatillista kehittymistäsi
Ikimuistoisen talvisesongin kannustavassa työympäristössä. Pop upeissa työskennellään pienissä tiimeissä, joten saat ikään kuin Finlayson perheen ympärillesi
Myytäväksi laadukkaat ja kestävät tuotteet, joiden takana on innovatiivisia tarinoita ja jotka ovat tuotettu vastuullisesti
Sinulla on mahdollisuus työskennellä myös tulevissa Pop up -sesongeissa

HAKUOHJEET

Rekisteröidy hakijaksi [www.staffpoint.fi](http://www.staffpoint.fi) ja jätä CV ja hakemuskirjeesi järjestelmäämme. Tuothan hakemuksessasi esille aikaisemman asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntikokemuksen, mistä näet olevan hyötyä tätä tehtävää hakiessasi.

Hakemuksia voidaan käsitellä jo ennen haun päättymistä, joten jätä hakemuksesi viipymättä! #Työniloa


Finlayson Oy

Vuonna 1820 perustettu Finlayson on yksi maamme vanhimpia yrityksiä, ja nykyään myös yksi Suomen kiinnostavimmista yrityksistä. Olemme vakuuttuneita siitä, että ainoa oikea tapa kunnioittaa yrityksen historiaa, on toimia yhtä vastuullisesti, rohkeasti ja ennakkoluulottomasti kuin varhaiset omistajamme. Tavoitteenamme on olla läpinäkyvin tekstiilialan yritys maailmassa. Lupaamme tehdä työtä puuvillan jäljitettävyyden eteen ja avata toimitusketjumme täysin läpinäkyväksi. title: Process Improvement Specialist Intern - 2027

There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. What’s in it for you?

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
Plan and implement continuous improvement initiatives designed to innovate the driver experience and make our processes more efficient

Use AI tools and data analytics to identify process inefficiencies, automate repetitive tasks, and prototype solutions

Analyse feedback and use data to own and implement process improvements at the site

You will also use AI-powered tools to analyse data, generate insights, and accelerate the development of solutions — from automating reports to modelling the impact of process changes before implementation.



You will be based at one of our locations and accountable for positively influencing operational efficiency. If needed, you will carry out analysis at other local or national sites. title: Systemutvikler med programmeringserfaring til Team plattform
description:
Oppdragsbeksrivelse:

Divisjon helsepersonell i NHN realiserer helsesektorens plattform for samhandlingstjenester som muliggjør digital kommunikasjon, samhandling og arbeidsflyt mellom aktører og personell i helsesektoren, og tilrettelegger for informasjonstjenester der aktører i helsesektoren konsumerer data fra flere ulike API’er som NHN tilgjengeliggjør igjennom «samhandlingsplattformen».

Arbeid i dag består i å implementere en hendelsesorientert arkitektur, der data inn til samhandlingsplattformen betraktes som hendelser som publiseres videre ut til de informasjonstjenestene som har behov for disse hendelsene.

Samhandlingsplattformen realiseres av ulike leveranseteam som har ansvar for ulike deler av plattformen. Leveranseteamene er autonome, hvilket innebærer at de har kompetanse og kapasitet til å ivareta design, utvikling, test og forvaltning av de applikasjonene de har ansvar for. Applikasjonene skal kjøres i kontainere på NHN's private skyplattform som realiseres via VMware Cloud Foundation, hvor VMware Tanzu Kubernetes benyttes som orkestreringsplattform.

NHN har behov for en systemutvikler med sterk programmeringserfaring som kan inngå i team plattform for å lage komponenter, rutiner og yte rådgivning til andre leveranseteam som kjører sine applikasjoner i NHN privat sky. Teamet har en viktig rolle i å bistå i arbeidet med å migrere eksisterende tjenester over til vår Kubernetes-plattform, samtidig som nødvendige støttekomponenter utvikles for å kunne automatisere vår deployment-kjede for API-baserte informasjonstjenester som skal tilbys til helsesektoren. Teamet samarbeider tett med driftsdivisjonen i NHN som har ansvaret for NHN privat sky, og bistår i utviklingen av støttekomponenter som benyttes for å administrere Kubernetes-clustre som opprettes på VMWare Tanzu Kubernetes-plattform og VITI (vår egen private sky basert på Kubernetes og 100% open-source komponenter), avvikshåndtering, automasjon og andre funksjoner som går helt ned i virtualiseringslaget i skyen.

Spesifikt for denne rollen: Det er både forvaltningsarbeid og utviklingsarbeid i denne rollen. Konsulenten skal arbeide sammen med (minst en) junior utvikler (DevOps), og må ha kommunikasjons- og pedagogiske evner deretter. Det kan tilkomme andre arbeidsoppgaver underveis i utførelsen av bistanden. Kunden kan også benytte konsulenten i andre prosjekter dersom Kunden anser dette hensiktsmessig.

Absolutte krav:

  • Tilbudt konsulent må ha god kompetanse på og minimum 3 års dokumentert erfaring med .NET og Core v9.

  • Tilbudt konsulent må ha minimum 4 års dokumentert erfaring med utvikling av REST-basert API.

  • Tilbudt konsulent må ha minimum 3 års dokumentert erfaring med Kubernetes som orkestreringsplattform, og utvikling og deployment av software på en slik plattform.

  • Tilbudt konsulent må ha gode kommunikasjonsegenskaper både muntlig og skriftlig på norsk og engelsk.

  • Tilbudt konsulent må ha minimum 6 års dokumentert erfaring fra utvikling i team basert på smidige prinsipper.

  • Tilbudt konsulent må ha minimum 5 års dokumentert erfaring med kontinuerlig utvikling og deploy (CI/CD), med bruk av GitLab.

  • Tilbudt konsulent må ha kompetanse på og dokumentert erfaring med støttekomponenter for sikkerhet som benyttes på containerplattform (Eksempler: Container/image-scanning, vault-teknologi for hemmeligheter, trivy, kyverno og liknende).

Evalueringskrav:

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør ha erfaring fra tilsvarende oppdrag/leveranser, spesielt rettet mot god evne til å overføre kompetanse til mindre erfarne utviklere (DevOps). Dette kravet tillegges mer vekt i evalueringen.

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør være flink med mennesker, engasjert og nysgjerrig, være åpen og like å samarbeide med andre, samt være interessert i prosesser og trives med teamarbeid. Dette kravet tillegges mer vekt i evalueringen.

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør ha kompetanse på og erfaring med kø-teknologier som RabbitMQ og Apache Kafka.

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør ha kompetanse på og erfaring med sikring av informasjonstjenester (OWASP, OAuth, o.l.).

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør ha erfaring med flere Kubernetes leverandører, som Talos, VMware, AKS og GKE.

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør ha erfaring med drift og deployment av gitlab-runners i Kubernetes.

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør ha erfaring med Sonatype Nexus Repository.

  • Tilbudt konsulent bør ha kompetanse på utvikling av front- og backend med hovedvekt på Angular og Blazor.

Omfang og varighet: En system-utvikler i inntil 100% stilling, Varighet: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2027. Opsjon om forlengelse.

Arbeidssted: Trondheim. Teamet praktiserer en hybrid kontorhverdag hvor det noen ukedager jobbes hjemmekontor og andre ukedager i NHNs kontorlokaler i Trondheim. Det forventes at konsulenten tilpasser seg teamets behov for å møtes fysisk.

Haemme asiakkaallemme panimotuotteiden hyllyttäjää. Työtä on tarjolla 10-20 tuntia viikossa. Työt sijoittuvat pääasiassa arkipäiville, mutta tarvittaessa Lauantaille. title: Data Center Infra Engineer - 2027 Internship, Logistics Team
description:
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:
- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Using internal Computerized Maintenance
- Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

- Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.
- Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
- Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

title: Riverside ExpertFold 145 Operator 1st Shift
description:
Position Overview:

The Expertfold 145 Gluer Operator is responsible for the safe, conforming, and efficient operation of the Expertfold 145 gluer. This position performs machine setup, operation, troubleshooting, and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) to ensure high-quality production output. The operator must be capable of determining both simple and complex folding and gluing sequences while leading a crew of assistants and floor workers. Strong leadership, spatial reasoning, and mechanical aptitude are essential for success in this role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

- Machine Setup & Operation

· Perform full machine setup, ensuring all tooling, guides, glue systems, and folding components are correctly configured for each job.

· Run the Expertfold 145 gluer safely, efficiently, and in compliance with quality and production standards.

· Determine and execute both simple and complex folding and gluing sequences based on CAD drawings, job tickets, and product specifications.

· Monitor machine performance and make necessary adjustments to maintain production speed, product quality, and machine uptime.

- Crew Leadership & Workflow Coordination

· Direct activities of two assistants and additional floor workers as required.

· Train and guide crew members to support efficient operation, proper feeding, stacking, and housekeeping.

· Communicate job requirements, obstacles, and needs clearly to crew members and supervisors.

- Quality & Compliance

· Ensure product conformity through in-process checks, verifying glue application, fold accuracy, and finished product dimensions.

· Follow sampling plans, hard card requirements, and plant quality procedures.

· Maintain documentation and production records accurately.

- Maintenance & Housekeeping

· Perform daily, weekly, and periodic TPM tasks, including cleaning, lubrication, inspections, and minor adjustments.

· Report equipment issues promptly and support maintenance personnel as needed.

· Maintain machine center cleanliness and organization consistent with company standards.

Required Education, Skills & Qualifications

· 6–12 months of experience as an assistant operator on folding/gluing equipment or related machinery.

· Strong understanding of standard box plant operations and converting processes.

· Ability to think in spatial terms and visualize complex folds and gluing sequences.

· Mathematical ability to convert measurements to decimals and apply them accurately.

· Reasonable tool knowledge and mechanical aptitude.

· Ability to perform basic computer functions related to machine operation and production reporting.

· Strong communication skills and ability to lead and coordinate a small crew.

Preferred Attributes

· Experience operating the Expertfold 145 or similar gluer models.

· Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to address machine or material issues quickly.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.

· A commitment to safety, quality, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

title: Calvary House Director
description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE: Calvary House Director

DEPARTMENT: Calvary House

REPORTS TO: Director of Facilities

STATUS: Exempt, Salary

HOURS: Full-Time (45)

LOCATION: Fort Lauderdale

__________________________________________________________________

At Calvary Chapel, we are called to make disciples of Jesus Christ by connecting people to God, people to people, and people to outreach. Our vision is to reach our community and change our world. As a staff member, it’s not what we do, it's who we are.

Your passion:

As the Director you must have a passion for those affected by addiction. In this role, God will use you to encourage, empower, and share the hope of freedom through Jesus Christ to men who have become ensnared in the vicious cycle of addiction.

You are:

  • Convinced a relationship with Jesus changes everything in a person’s life

  • Committed to keeping your family as your first ministry

  • Dedicated to your personal study of God’s Word

  • Consistently placing a high priority on worship and your personal prayer life

  • An excellent and generous steward of your personal finances

  • Obedient to God to take a Sabbath and make space for soul-keeping

  • Deeply compassionate towards people who are in need or hurting

  • Excited about global missions and local outreach - You want to change the world

  • A part of a healthy friendship community and accountability circle

  • Willing to give up personal pleasures and freedoms in order to live a life above reproach and that is aligned with our Leadership Covenant

  • Able to counsel and encourage others using God’s word

  • Able to lead and delegate appropriate responsibilities to others

You will:

  • Provide vision and create plans for the overall ministry including growth and expansion of the program as well as internal processes and procedures, outreach, and volunteer opportunities.

  • Select, train, lead, and disciple staff and interns.

  • Counsel residents along with their families to restore and strengthen relationships.

  • Create a sustainable process for successful transition for graduating residents

  • Work closely with the church support staff to determine job placement and discipleship of residents.

  • Meet regularly with Calvary House staff and ministry partners ( mental health counselors and program facilitators) to evaluate growth, determine individual goals, and create a plan of action for residents

  • Organize opportunities for residents to volunteer at the church, in the community, and on the mission field.

  • Manage the budget and expenditures for Calvary House

  • Build, maintain, and foster collaborative relationships with other organizations including residential ministries and rehabilitation centers.

You have:

  • A high level of experience working in addiction

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft/ Google programs for producing reports and presentations.

  • The ability to project manage, organize, prioritize, and multi-task.

  • The gift of discernment and the ability to effectively communicate areas of concern in someone’s life.

  • A strong understanding of God’s word and the gospel message.

  • Experience in one-on-one counseling, addiction counseling, crisis counseling, and marital counseling, using a biblical foundation.

What you are required to know:

  • We are an EEO employer

  • You will be required to work evenings and/or weekends to assist with special events and/or emergencies

  • You may have to bend or stand for prolonged periods of time, lift, pull, push and/or move up to 50 pounds

  • This is a full-time (45 hours/week), salary-exempt position

  • This role requires spiritual leadership and continued pursuit of growth, development, and knowledge of the Bible as well as practical application for Calvary House staff and residents.

It would be incredible if:

  • You are active and enjoy team outings such as paintball, fishing, bowling, and the gym

  • You loved the outdoors and enjoyed camping

  • You have a passion to teach God’s word

  • You have a passion to disciple men 7 families

Work Schedule:

Staff culture is important to what we do. To love like family, we require all staff to attend all staff meetings, and department meetings and serve with a willing heart, especially at all major campus events. Full-time (45 hours/week); however, the incumbent may be required to work an evening or weekend day to help with a special event, project, or in an emergency situation.

title: Päiväkodin johtaja Pilke Kilonkallio ja Pilke Playschool Peippo
description:
Pilkkeen tavoitteena on olla Suomessa varhaiskasvatuksen toimialan paras. Tämä tavoite saavutetaan työskentelemällä yhdessä. Työtä luotsaavat Pilkkeen päiväkotien johtajat – myös sinä. Johtajana saat rakentaa oman päiväkotisi toimintaa, vaikuttaa vahvasti oman työsi sisältöön ja olla mukana kehittämässä koko Pilkkeen varhaiskasvatusta.



Etsimme innostunutta ja ammattitaitoista määräaikaista Hallinnollista päiväkodin johtajaa Pilke Kilonkallioon ja Pilke Playschool Peippoon Espooseen vastaamaan laadukkaasta varhaiskasvatuksesta ja henkilöstön hyvinvoinnista. Päiväkodin johtajana olet osa tiimiä, joka tarjoaa lapsille turvallisen, hauskan ja oppimista tukevan ympäristön.



Päiväkodin johtajan tehtävä meillä

Sinulla on kokonaisvastuu henkilöstöjohtamisesta, oman yksikön taloudesta, laadusta sekä pedagogisesta johtamisesta. Vastaat yksikkösi henkilöstön työsuhdeasioista koko työsuhteen elinkaaren ajan esimerkiksi palkkojen, perehdytyksen, työvuorosuunnittelun sekä rekrytoinnin osalta erilaisia järjestelmiä hyödyntäen. Olet myös yhteydessä vanhempiin ja muihin sidosryhmiin, sekä edistät päiväkodin näkyvyyttä ja houkuttelevuutta.



Tuleva työpaikkasi,

Pilke Kilonkallio, Espoo (Kilo)

Pilke Kilonkallio sijaitsee luonnonläheisellä ja rauhallisella Kilonkallion asuinalueella Espoossa, lähellä Kilon juna-asemaa ja Leppävaaran palveluita. Päiväkodin suojaisa ja suuri piha sekä vieressä sijaitseva metsä tarjoavat erinomaiset mahdollisuudet ulkoiluun ja retkeilyyn. Päiväkodissa toimii kuusi lapsiryhmää, joista yksi on esiopetusryhmä.

Päiväkodin vahvuutena on englannin kielirikasteinen varhaiskasvatus, jossa englannin kieli on luonteva osa lasten arkea. Johtajalta odotetaan pedagogista näkemystä kielirikasteisen toiminnan johtamiseen, henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämiseen sekä yhteisöllisen toimintakulttuurin vahvistamiseen. Päiväkoti soveltuu johtajalle, joka arvostaa luonnon hyödyntämistä oppimisympäristönä ja haluaa johtaa aktiivista, kehittyvää työyhteisöä.

Pilke Playschool Peippo, Espoo (Suvela)

Pilke Playschool Peippo sijaitsee Suvelassa Espoossa. Kodikas päiväkoti tarjoaa varhaiskasvatusta ja esiopetusta kansainvälisessä ympäristössä. Päiväkodissa toimii kuusi lapsiryhmää, joissa varhaiskasvatusta toteutetaan suomen ja englannin kielellä. Yksi ryhmistä on esiopetusryhmä.

Peipon erityispiirre on laajamittainen kaksikielinen varhaiskasvatus, jossa lapset toimivat päivittäin sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Päiväkodin tavoitteena on kasvattaa lapsista uteliaita maailmankansalaisia ja herättää kiinnostus eri kieliä ja kulttuureja kohtaan. Johtajalta edellytetään vahvaa pedagogista osaamista, kykyä johtaa monikielistä toimintaympäristöä sekä ymmärrystä kansainvälisen ja kulttuurisesti monimuotoisen työyhteisön johtamisesta.



Odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta henkilöstöjohtamisesta ja esihenkilötyöstä, yrittäjähenkistä, ratkaisukeskeistä ja myönteistä asennetta sekä erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja. Tavoitehakuisuus, valmentava johtamistyyli sekä sitoutuminen varhaiskasvatuksen korkeaan laatuun on tämän johtamistehtävän ytimessä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa sekä kykyä toimia luontevasti kaksikielisessä toimintaympäristössä.

Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan varhaiskasvatuslain mukainen kelpoisuus päiväkodin johtajan tehtävään sekä voimassa olevan rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä.



Me haluamme tarjota sinulle

- Kilpailukykyisen sopimuspalkan, johon vaikuttavat aiempi kokemus, koulutustausta ja erityisosaaminen,

- Innostavan, ketterän ja lämpimän toimintakulttuurin, jossa aidosti arvostetaan varhaiskasvatuksen ja johtamisen ammattitaitoa.

- Työyhteisön, jossa ollaan sitoutuneita toimimaan lapsen parhaaksi.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer at Beyond Sports



Location: Budapest, Hungary
Duration: 12 months FTC
Working Arrangement: Onsite


Join Our Team as a Senior DevOps Engineer at Beyond Sports!

Are you passionate about resilient cloud platforms, elegant automation, and leading the infrastructure behind next-generation digital experiences that capture global audiences?

At Beyond Sports, we don’t just visualise sports, we reinvent how fans experience them. Together with partners like NFL, NHL, FIFA and Disney, we push the boundaries of real-time sports data, 3D graphics and AI-driven storytelling. Our Platform Engineering team is the backbone of all of it. We run a multi-cloud estate across AWS and Azure, with Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps at the heart of how we work.

If you’re an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer with deep Azure expertise, a strong grasp of networking and the Well-Architected Framework, and a desire to lead and mentor within a collaborative platform team, this is the perfect next step in your career.



What Your Day Will Look Like

As our primary Senior DevOps Engineer for Azure, you’ll play a pivotal role in keeping the platforms behind some of the world’s biggest sports experiences reliable, secure and performant.

Working alongside the wider Platform Engineering team and our development squads, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of our Azure estate, from AKS and Function Apps to Front Door, App Gateway and Azure DNS. When you’re not working in Azure, you’ll get stuck into our AWS estate (our main cloud), collaborating closely with the team across EKS, IAM, CloudFront, Route 53 and more.

One day you might be designing hub-and-spoke network architecture, managing Infrastructure as Code in Terraform, or standardising CI/CD pipelines across GitLab, Bitbucket and ArgoCD. The next, you could be investigating a production issue, rotating certificates and secrets, validating backup integrity, or mentoring a colleague on automation best practices.

You’ll serve as a key technical lead within the team, driving operational excellence, security and continuous improvement. Because we thrive on collaboration and shared ownership, your work will directly shape how reliably millions of sports fans can access our products worldwide.



What We Value

At Beyond Sports, we move fast, collaborate closely, and build things that haven’t existed before.

You’ll fit right in if you:

  • Bring deep technical craft, building scalable, secure and well-architected cloud infrastructure

  • Take full ownership of platform maintenance, from patching and backups to monitoring, health checks and remediation

  • Automate routine tasks and workflows wherever you see the opportunity, using Bash, Python or similar

  • Stay calm and methodical under pressure, investigating and resolving production and infrastructure issues and supporting incidents as part of an on-call rotation

  • Champion best practices in automation, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure management, and mentor others to raise the bar across the team

  • Keep documentation, runbooks and training materials accurate, clear and useful

  • Drive strong, proactive collaboration with development teams to diagnose and resolve back-end issues



Your Background

You don’t need to tick every box, but we’re generally looking for:

  • Proven experience managing distributed systems at scale

  • Strong proficiency with Azure, Kubernetes and Terraform, with in-depth knowledge of the Well-Architected Framework

  • Solid understanding of networking, DNS, and Landing Zone / Hub and Spoke architectures

  • A strong grasp of CI/CD workflows and Infrastructure as Code principles

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana

  • Competence with databases including RDS, PostgreSQL and MySQL

  • Development experience with an object-oriented programming language (e.g. Java)

  • Proficiency in AWS, or a genuine willingness to learn

  • Strong communication skills and an analytical, quality-focused, proactive approach to problem-solving



Nice to Have (But Not Required)

  • Hands-on AWS experience across EKS, IAM, CloudFront, Route 53 and S3, as well as CloudFormation

  • Familiarity with Grafana’s LGTM stack (Loki, Mimir) and synthetic monitoring tools such as UpTrends

  • Experience with Kafka, the Linkerd service mesh, or Karpenter for Kubernetes autoscaling

  • Exposure to secrets and identity tooling such as Vault, Authentik and SSO

  • Experience with VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, VPN and WAF configuration

Why Level Up Your Career at Beyond Sports

Fast-moving, creative, and innovative: that’s our world.

  • High Impact: Your work directly underpins the platforms that millions of sports fans rely on globally

  • Technical Leadership: Own our Azure estate as our go-to Senior DevOps Engineer while mentoring colleagues and setting standards

  • Multi-Cloud Variety: Work across Azure and AWS with a modern stack spanning Kubernetes, GitOps, observability and service mesh

  • Growth Culture: Take on more responsibility and help shape the evolution of our infrastructure

  • Real Collaboration: Partner closely with the wider Platform Engineering team, development squads and sports domain experts

And we make sure it’s a great place to work:

Hungary Benefits

  • Annual Leave: Standard according to local labour law.

  • Sony Group Discounts: Generous discounts across Sony Group products and services.

  • Other Benefits: Flexible Cafeteria options (SZÉP Card, Nursery & Kindergarten contributions, Annual MOL Bubi Pass), Private Medical Insurance, Life & Accident Insurance, MindentMent Dental Clinic discounts, Seniority Awards, and an Employee Assistance Program.

Ready to Power the Future of Sports Entertainment?

If you’re excited about building resilient cloud infrastructure, leading on Azure within a multi-cloud environment, and contributing to a brand that’s helping redefine sports entertainment, we’d love to hear from you.

At Beyond Sports, you won’t just keep the lights on. You’ll help bring sports to life.

Building Assistant

Operational Support and Services Office

www.ufcw.org

Organization:

United Food and Commercial Workers International Union (UFCW) is North America’s neighborhood union; standing together to improve the lives and livelihoods of workers, families and communities. Our members work primarily in the retail food, meatpacking, poultry, food processing and manufacturing and retail store industries.


Location:

Washington DC, near Metro (on-site)

Position Description:

The Building Assistant supports the day-to-day operation and readiness of UFCW workplace areas by maintaining employee lounges and conference-room service areas, managing beverage and related supply inventory, supporting meetings and special events, providing Reception backup, assisting with Operational Support and Services projects and large mailings, maintaining workplace postings and notices, coordinating vending-machine service, and providing other operational support as needed.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned. This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented.

Maintains the cleanliness, organization, stocking and day-to-day readiness of employee lounges, pantry areas, conference-room service areas and related equipment in accordance with established procedures and checklists.


Maintains coffee, tea, water and related beverage service throughout the workday in employee lounges and conference rooms.


Maintains inventory of lounge, conference-room and beverage-service supplies; monitors stock levels, receives and stores supplies, and prepares and submits replenishment orders as needed in accordance with established approval procedures.


Provides setup, service and breakdown support for in-house meetings, luncheons, employee programs, special events and other functions overseen by the Operational Support and Services Office, including beverage service and related logistical support.


Provides primary backup coverage for the Reception area as needed, including answering and routing telephone calls, greeting and directing visitors, providing general information and performing other routine front-desk responsibilities.


Assists with Operational Support and Services projects and large-scale mailings as needed, including envelope stuffing, assembling materials, preparing mailings and other general production support.

Posts and replaces updated Departmental Telephone listings monthly in designated locations; monitors and updates UFCW bulletin board postings; and posts or distributes notices, signage and other Operational Support and Services communications as directed.


Serves as the primary point of contact for vending-machine services, including reporting equipment or

stocking issues, requesting service or replenishment, coordinating vendor access, and assisting with employee concerns or refund requests as appropriate.


Serves as backup to the General Office Clerk V for retrieving and forwarding copier counts and for broader Operational Support and Services office-supply inventory and ordering.


Maintains punctuality and timely completion of assigned responsibilities and deadlines; develops courteous and effective working relationships with employees at all levels, tenants, vendors and representatives of external organizations; and protects the confidentiality of sensitive information encountered in the course of assigned duties.


QUALIFICATIONS:


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While each of the following requirements represents the desired level of competency for the above-described position, the UFCW reserves the right to modify such standards when the job or position does not otherwise require a particular level of performance.

Other Knowledge/Skills/Abilities Required

The ability to work an 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. workday.


High school diploma or equivalent preferred.


Previous experience in office services, facilities support, hospitality, customer service, reception or a related work environment preferred.


Basic computer proficiency, including email, Microsoft 365 applications, simple data entry, printing documents and using shared electronic files or systems.


Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to monitor supplies, maintain orderly work areas and follow established procedures.


Ability to provide courteous customer service and communicate effectively with employees, visitors, vendors and external representatives.


Ability to work independently, use sound judgment, take initiative and shift priorities when routine work is interrupted by meetings, Reception coverage or other time-sensitive needs.


Ability to read and interpret safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals, and to understand and communicate applicable rules, policies and procedures.


Ability to carry out instructions provided in written, oral or diagram form.


Attendance

Attendance will be a determining consideration in all cases where two or more applicants have equal ability, qualifications and/or reliability.


Job Demands

Work is generally routine but may require shifting priorities and responding to time-sensitive or unexpected needs, including meeting support, supply needs, special events and Reception coverage.

Work is performed primarily in a normal office environment and throughout shared workplace areas. The position is on-site Monday through Friday and is not eligible for regularly scheduled telework. If the office is closed and employees are directed to work remotely, this position will generally be off in accordance with organizational policy.


Physical Demands

The position requires frequent standing and walking throughout the workday; bending, stooping, reaching, pushing and pulling; and lifting and carrying supplies and materials weighing up to 30 pounds. Duties may include moving supplies between work areas, handling cases of beverages and paper products, and setting up and breaking down meeting-service items. The position also requires written and oral communication, computer use and close vision.



Reasonable accommodations will be provided.


*Skills assessments with passing scores are required as part of our pre-employment process. *


COMPENSATION

title: Sandblaster
description:
Abrades surfaces of metal castings to remove adhering scale, shell, and dirt, and to impact specified finish by performing the following duties.


Hourly Pay Rate: $18.50-$19.00/hr. entry level


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Shovels or pours abrasives such as sand, grit, or shot of specified grade into machine hopper
  • Loads parts into cabinets
  • Turns valves on equipment to regulate pressure and composition of abrasive mixture flowing through nozzle or into tumbling barrel.
  • Starts equipment that directs blast or flow of abrasive laden compressed air, gas, or liquid over surface of parts.
  • Directs nozzle over surface of large parts or inserts arms through glove fitted cabinet openings and manipulates small parts under nozzle for specified interval.
  • Examines finished parts to ensure conformance to specifications.
  • Check sandblast cabinets after each break & end of shift, and check the blast nozzle for wear
  • Check appearance of the Aluminum Oxide blast media, dispose of media that appears “powdery”, replenish cabinet with new blast media

  • High School diploma preferred not required

  • Requires basic math skills

  • Noise level is usually loud
  • Use of Goff Machine when needed
  • Use of Tumble Machine when needed
  • Exposed to moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles
  • Prescribed safety equipment must be worn at all times

Tarjoamme
- Arvokkaan mahdollisuuden kerryttää alan työkokemusta
- Kansainvälisen työympäristön ja mahdollisuuden kurkistaa kasvuyrityksen arkeen
- Epassi lounasvähennyksen
- Joustavan etätyön (2 päivää / viikko)

Työtehtävät

Saapuvien ostopyyntöjen hallinta ja koordinointi, sisältäen seuraavat tehtävät:
- Ostopyyntöjen käsittely
- Ostotilausten (PO) luominen ja hallinta
- Tilausten tekeminen hyväksytyiltä toimittajilta annettujen ohjeistusten mukaisesti
- Toimitusten vastaanotto ja vahvistaminen ERP-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmässä
- Sisäisen logistiikan tukeminen ja saapuvien toimitusten koordinointi

Etsimme

- Perusymmärrystä hankintaprosesseista ja tilausten hallinnasta
- Kykyä hallita useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä tarkasti
- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
- Proaktiivista otetta työhön

Menestyäksesi roolissa olet:
- Tukea antava
- Stressinsietokykyinen
- Järjestelmällinen
- Vastuuntuntoinen

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle suoritetaan turvallisuusselvitys.

Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. title: VISALIA Asitrade-1 Utility 2nd Shift
description:
Position Overview:

The Asitrade Utility supports the efficient and safe operation of the Asitrade machine center. This position works closely with the crew to assist in machine operation, material handling, starch mixing, and quality checks. Responsibilities include delivering roll stock, monitoring the starch system, supporting the aerator, and performing various tasks to maintain continuous production flow. Flexibility, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work any shift are essential.

Key Responsibilities

- Machine Support & Operation

· Assist the machine crew in daily operation of the Asitrade machine.

· Perform additional machine-related tasks as directed by the operator.

· Tag loads, verify identification, and perform required quality checks to ensure product conformity.

- Material Handling

· Periodically operate a clamp truck to deliver rolls to the single facer.

· Safely operate stacker equipment and straighten/load labels as required.

· May be required to operate a powered pallet jack for material movement.

- Starch System Responsibilities

· Mix and monitor starch used in the Asitrade process.

· Record and communicate issues related to starch quality or machine performance.

- Quality & Documentation

· Accurately record waste by defect type within a continuous-running process.

· Ensure all paperwork, tagging, and documentation are completed correctly and on time.

· Identify quality issues and communicate corrective actions to the operator.

- General Duties

· Assist with cleanup, housekeeping, and general machine upkeep to maintain safe working conditions.

· Offer support across various machine functions to ensure uninterrupted production.

· Maintain flexibility with lunches, breaks, and task assignments according to production demands.

Required Skills, Training & Qualifications

· Ability to safely operate a stacker; ability to straighten and stack labels accurately.

· May be required to operate a powered pallet jack.

· Must accurately record waste and defect types during continuous production.

· Must be flexible with break and lunch coverage.

· Ability to work any shift based on production needs.

· Must be able to pass forklift and clamp truck licensing and certification processes.

· Ability and willingness to learn starch mixing and monitoring procedures.

· Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

· Basic mechanical aptitude.

· Experience with quality checking procedures or machine operations

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

title: Sr. Cyber Defense Specialist
description:
The ITS Cyber Defense Senior Specialist is a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert who strengthens the organization’s cyber defense posture through a blend of Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, and security engineering expertise. This role protects enterprise information systems and data from intentional or accidental destruction, disruption, or modification while minimizing the impact on those who need legitimate access to systems, files, networks, and data. The position independently leads and executes complex cybersecurity initiatives from planning through implementation, improves defensive controls and processes, drives detection and response activities for advanced threats, and serves as a trusted technical resource across IT, business teams, and external partners.

The role works closely across IT teams and business units to identify security gaps, define requirements, recommend solutions, and communicate risks, status, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. Provides expert-level consulting, leadership, and escalation support in the identification, analysis, mitigation, and escalation of security risks, anomalies, vulnerabilities, events, and incidents to the Manager, ITS Cyber Defense, in accordance with established procedures. This position is accountable for timely incident handling, detailed case management documentation, advanced analysis of security alerts and threat intelligence, processing of mitigations, and escalation of confirmed or suspected threat activity.

Responsibilities
  • Serves as a senior subject matter expert and escalation point for Cyber Defense, providing technical leadership and mentorship to team members.
  • Monitors, analyzes, investigates, and responds to security alerts and events across endpoint, network, identity, email, and cloud environments using enterprise security tools.
  • Performs alert triage and case management, including validating events, distinguishing false positives from true threats, documenting findings, assessing impact, and escalating in accordance with established procedures.
  • Supports and leads incident response activities, including scoping, evidence review, forensic support, documentation, containment actions, and escalation into formal incident response processes.
  • Administers and improves Cyber Defense technologies such as EDR, SIEM, NAC, vulnerability management tools, and other monitoring and control platforms, including tuning, troubleshooting, upgrades, and optimization.
  • Leads detection and response improvements by tuning alerts, reducing false positives, identifying visibility gaps, and implementing enhancements to tools, processes, and workflows.
  • Independently manages technical and operational improvement initiatives, including tool enhancements, process optimization, and reporting improvements, while communicating progress to stakeholders.
  • Partners with internal teams and external vendors to support troubleshooting, remediation, tool effectiveness, and implementation of Cyber Defense capabilities.
  • Contributes to the development and enhancement of Cyber Defense policies, standards, procedures, and compliance alignment with regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Participates in the IT Security on-call rotation and responds to high-priority events and incidents as required.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in information technology, information security, or risk-related roles.
  • 5+ years of direct cybersecurity experience in areas such as security operations, incident response, cyber defense, detection engineering, or related security disciplines.
  • Experience independently managing complex technical work, coordinating across teams, and driving security initiatives from assessment through implementation.
  • Availability to support after-hours or on-call activities if needed for incident response, security events, or critical business requirements.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, or equivalent are preferred.
  • Working knowledge of applicable cybersecurity and privacy frameworks, standards, and regulations, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF), SOX, HIPAA, and NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500.

title: Museomestari
description:
Salon taidemuseo Veturitalli on laadukkaita kuvataidesisältöjä tarjoava ammatillisesti hoidettu taidemuseo, joka toimii paitsi paikallisen kuvataiteen näyteikkunana tuottaa myös valtakunnallisesti merkittäviä näyttelykokonaisuuksia sekä esittää kotimaista ja kansainvälistä kiinnostavaa valokuvataidetta.

Haemme ma. MUSEOMESTARIA ajalle 4.1.-30.6.2027

Taidemuseo Veturitallissa pääset käyttämään kykyjäsi monipuolisesti. Meitä on täällä innovatiivinen tiimi, jota yhdistää intohimo kuvataiteeseen ja yleisölähtöiseen museotyöhön. Olemme sopiva sekoitus kokeneita konkareita ja tuoreita näkökulmia.

Museomestari vastaa meillä näyttely- ja kokoelmateosten säilytys-, pakkaus- ja ripustusratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta hankintoineen. Hän vastaa myös näyttelyiden rakennesuunnittelusta, rakentamisesta ja ripustuksesta sekä ohjaa näissä tilanteissa tilapäistä henkilökuntaa. Lisäksi hän avustaa intendenttiä kokoelmatyössä, suunnittelee taidemuseossa tarvittavan logistiikan sekä tarvittaessa kuljettaa teoksia ja tarpeistoja pakettiautolla.

Museomestari vastaa museo-, näyttely- ja tilatekniikan sekä koneiden toimivuudesta ja turvallisuudesta. Hän vastaa myös valaistustekniikasta ja mahdollisesta tapahtumatekniikasta. Työtä rytmittää pääasiallisesti vuoden näyttelykierto.

Tehtäviin kuuluu edelleen näyttely- ja taidevarastotilojen olosuhteiden seuraaminen ja yhteyshenkilönä toimiminen kiinteistönhuoltoon liittyvissä asioissa. Museomestari toimii taidevarastojen turvallisuushenkilönä ja ylläpitää pelastussuunnitelman mukaisesti kokoelmaturvallisuutta. Tehtävälista on pitkä, mutta kukaan meillä ei jää yksin: kokonaisuutta hallitaan yhteistyöllä.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on museomestarin ammattitutkinto tai soveltuvat tiedot ja taidot. Tehtävän hoidossa edellytetään B-ajokorttia sekä hyvää suomen ja vähintään tyydyttävää englannin kielen taitoa. Tehtävä edellyttää teknisen työn taitoja sekä it-taitoja ja halukkuutta oppia jatkuvasti uutta. Hyvät yhteistyö- ja ongelmanratkaisutaidot sekä omien töiden organisointikyky ovat eduksi tehtävässä onnistumisessa. Tehtävä edellyttää hyviä kommunikaatio- ja tiimityöskentelytaitoja, itsenäistä, tarkkaa ja huolellista työotetta. Arvostamme kiinnostusta kuvataiteeseen ja kulttuuriperinnön säilyttämiseen.

Etuina tarjoamme muun muassa:
- koulutusmahdollisuuksia
- tyky-rahaa Epassin kautta
- maksuttomia ohjattuja liikuntaryhmiä
- ruokailun edulliseen henkilökuntahintaan

Koulutusmyönteisenä työnantajana tarjoamme monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisen kehittämiseen. Työyhteisömme ovat monimuotoisia, kannustavia ja vastaanottavia. Panostamme hyvään johtajuuteen. Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Tehtävän tasopalkka on 2786,38 eur/kk sekä mahdollinen työkokemuslisä. Palkka maksetaan KVTES teknisten sopimuksen mukaan ja työaika on 38,25 h/viikko. Salon kaupungissa maksetaan myös henkilökohtaiseen työsuoritukseen perustuvaa lisää kuuden kuukauden jälkeen.
