title: QA Manager
description:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role

You'll have full ownership of our QMS, working on both EU MDR and US QMSR.

You'll report directly to Zahra, our Head of RAQA, and be the face of Sonio's quality, ensuring our processes scale as we grow and leading audits directly.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the QMS: maintain it, update procedures, and manage nonconformities and complaints, with a strong appetite for automation (Notion, HubSpot, n8n, Claude).

  • Lead all the audit phases: preparation, run, and follow-up

  • Train and upskill the company on quality: onboard all new hires on QA practices and processes, run regular training and refreshers for existing teams, and keep training material up to date as processes evolve.

  • Contribute to the ISMS alongside the security team: align QMS and ISMS processes (document control, CAPA, internal audits) and support HITRUST / SOC 2 audit readiness.

We expect this person to build a shared quality culture, not only by building processes, but also by ensuring they support the team's work and have a real impact on end-user quality delivery.

About the profile

Sonio is a mission-driven company, so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • 5 years of QMS management experience in software as a medical device. You bring strong knowledge of the MDR (Medical Device Regulation, Europe) and the QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation, USA).

  • You have experience leading audits.

  • Experience in post-market surveillance (PMS) and vigilance processes.

  • Proven experience automating tools and processes

  • You have experience building a quality culture with good English communication that allows you to get people on board with what you're building

  • Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, or HITRUST is a plus.

Location: Paris

Salary: 60-65K + 10%

We move fast and aspire to be transparent over the process - our objective is that the process from the first chat to an offer is no longer than a month. We also aspire to give an answer to every application in a week - if you have not heard from us, please follow up at careers@sonio.ai.

title: Campus 2027: AI & Data
description:
AI & Data Associate
  • Are you looking to get hands-on experience designing data ecosystems, building insightful dashboards, and implementing AI solutions?
  • Do you want to develop data and AI strategies for the Life Science industry, impacting millions of lives?
  • Is working with some of the brightest minds in the data management and analytics industry a goal?
  • Do you want to be the person who can both build an AI solution and explain to a client why it matters?
If you answer yes to any of these questions, read on and learn about Axtria's Full Time Opportunities
Why Axtria?
Axtria is an emerging force in the data analytics industry with corporate headquarters in Berkeley Heights, NJ. We work exclusively with companies in the Life Science industry, helping our clients solve some of their most complex problems. We blend information, analytics, AI, and technology to help organizations gain a competitive edge to improve patient outcomes and drive business growth.
What's in it for you?
Growth! Advancement of your technical, AI, and consulting skills. A high performance culture of doing the RIGHT thing. AI & Data Associates use cloud technology and AI to ingest, integrate, and process data to build advanced data platforms and analytical ecosystems for our clients.
Potential Responsibilities may include (but not limited to) any of the following activities:
  • Build and implement AI/ML models and agentic workflows within data pipelines and analytical ecosystems. Work with data scientists and engineers on Life Sciences use cases such as forecasting, omnichannel engagement, and customer or patient analytics.
  • Contribute to data modernization and Enterprise Data Management. Build and test pieces of cloud data ecosystems (Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks), and integrate GenAI for automated reporting and intelligent data discovery. You’ll also apply AI to Data Quality, Master Data Management, and Data Governance.
  • Evaluate AI solutions for technical feasibility, business value, and risk. Apply responsible AI practices (guardrails, data security, token cost) to everything you deliver.
  • Prepare and present your work. Explain analyses, build slides, and present to team and client audiences.
About You
  • Working towards a Bachelors or Masters with preference given to those studying Business Analytics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Math, Stats, or Operations Research (graduating between 12/2026 and 6/2027).
  • Business Acumen: Able to understand how a client’s business works and connect data and AI work to business outcomes. Life Science and pharma commercial operations knowledge is preferred, not required
  • Agentic AI Fluency: Can explain how AI agents work (models, tools, guardrails) to a client, and has built or used one hands-on, whether in coursework, an internship, or a personal project
  • Storytelling and Communication: Strong communication skills, comfortable presenting AI and data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, and able to turn analysis into a clear story
  • Problem-solving Mindset and Learning Agility: Obsessed with working through and solving complex data and AI challenges. Smart, adaptable, and quick to pick up new technologies
  • AI/ML Knowledge: Understanding of machine learning concepts and their integration with data platforms
  • AI Tools (preferred): Hands-on experience with AI assistants and coding tools such as Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or Copilot. Be ready to talk about how you use them and where they fall short.
  • Technical Skills: A foundation in Cloud Technology, and experience with SQL, Databricks and/or Snowflake
  • Visualization: Experience with Tableau, Power BI and understanding of AI-enhanced dashboard development
  • Dedicated Team Player who enjoys collaboration with the primary goal of “getting it done”
  • Must have permanent work authorization to work in the United States, without need of visa sponsorship
Life @ Axtria
Axtrians are passionate and thrive in a culture of collaboration and learning. We realize that AI and data expertise are in high demand, and our work has an enormous impact in the Life Science industry and on society. We don't take this lightly, thus constantly challenge ourselves to improve, innovate, and empower others through responsible AI practices. We highly encourage transparency in our nimble organization where we communicate freely without any hierarchical boundaries to share a wealth of knowledge and exciting AI innovations.

title: Claims Processing Supervisor
location: AllCare Health Headquarters, Grants Pass, OR, US
description:
Claims Processing Supervisor at AllCare Health with the Claims department!


We Are Seeking Qualified Candidates to Join Our Team!

AllCare Health offers competitive wages, an excellent benefits package including affordable healthcare, 401k retirement, wellness programs, and flexible schedule options.


Summary of the Position

The Claims Processing Supervisor ensures that all internal and external departmental performance requirements are consistently met. This role oversees the day-to-day activities of the claims processing team, determines work assignments and efficient workflows to meet contractual obligations, and serves as a hands-on resource for staff on training, questions, and claims processing best practices.


Essential Duties

  1. Provide one on one support, initial training for new hires and monthly mandatory training sessions for all claims processing staff.
  2. Establish and maintain a professional, supportive, provider service-oriented workplace culture with high standards of individual and team performance.
  3. Maintain production and quality monitoring logs and reports for both individual and overall departmental performance.

Job Duties

  • Supports and contributes to AllCare’s mission, vision, and values.
  • Maintains and monitors internal audit procedures to ensure staff compliance with departmental policies, procedures, and quality standards.
  • Ensures claims processing procedures are followed consistently and provides coaching or retraining as needed.
  • Maintains compliance with departmental policies and procedures related to HIPAA and protected health information (PHI).
  • Reviews, develops, maintains, and updates claims processing procedures, reference materials, and training resources.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of the duties, processes, and workflows performed by all positions supervised.
  • Organizes team workflow and assigns responsibilities to ensure appropriate coverage, including during staff absences.
  • Monitors individual and team productivity and quality and provides regular, constructive feedback.
  • Identifies and addresses employee performance, attendance, and workplace concerns in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
  • Conducts performance evaluations for direct reports.
  • Maintains clear and accurate documentation of employee performance discussions, coaching, and disciplinary actions.
  • Identifies and communicates system needs, process improvement opportunities, operational concerns, and staff-related issues to department leadership.
  • Demonstrates professional and respectful communication and behavior when working with employees, leadership, providers, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintains punctual, regular, and predictable attendance.
  • Works collaboratively within the department and across teams to support effective claims operations.
  • Respectfully receives and follows direction from the Sr. Claims Processing Manager and/or VP, Claims Administration & Payment Integrity.
  • Completes all required training, including assigned Relias Learning Management System (LMS) training.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

On Call Responsibilities

This position does not have any on call responsibilities.


Supervisory Responsibilities

Directly supervises 9 to 11 (nine to eleven) employees in the Claims department. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.


Qualifications

Ability to perform essential job duties with or without reasonable accommodation and without posing a direct threat to safety or health of employee or others. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.


Education

  • Highschool Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Bachelor's degree (BA) from a four-year college or university preferred; or equivalent combination of education & experience.


Experience

  • 2–4 years' experience in managed care, Medicare, and/or Medicaid claims processing (or an equivalent combination totaling at least 2 years), with a solid understanding of core claims concepts such as co-pays, deductibles, co-insurance, coordination of benefits, and pre-existing conditions, and demonstrated knowledge of claims workflows and adjudication practices.
  • Extensive knowledge of medical terminology and coding systems, including ICD-9, ICD-10, Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS), Diagnosis Related Grouper (DRG), Resource Utilization Groups (RUG), and Health Insurance Prospective Payment System (HIPPS) codes.
  • Knowledge of CMS 1500, UB-04, and other applicable claim forms, both paper and electronic.
  • Ability to research and resolve errors resulting in refunds and adjustments.
  • Prior supervisory, lead, or training experience strongly preferred.


Certificates, Licenses, and/or Registrations

  • AAPC certification such as CPC, CPB, or CPMA required within 12 months of hire. Equivalent nationally recognized coding, billing, or medical auditing certification may be considered.


Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with the Healthcare industry.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
  • Excellent organization and time-management skills.
  • Excellent computer skills, including the Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel).
  • Knowledge of and compliance with HIPAA regulations.
  • Excellent at breaking a project into definable and measurable tasks and tracking progress to completion.
  • Knowledge of research methodologies and/or data analysis.
  • Excellent at interpreting data and using it to solve problems and gain new insights.
  • Excellent at locating information and synthesizing information from various sources.
  • Knowledge of customer service and service recovery best practices.
  • Excellent customer service skills to respond appropriately and interact positively with upset customers.
  • Knowledge of phone customer service best practices and experienced with multi-line call centers.
  • Knowledge of training best practices and adult learning principles.
  • Excellent at training development and/or delivery.
  • Knowledge of the ways implicit bias, personal identity, and power and privilege impact individuals, organizations and systems.


Interpersonal Skills

  • Trust: Promotes honesty, transparency, and diligence. Approaches leadership with mindset of “power with” rather than “power over” and regularly includes others in planning and decision-making. Able to make and communicate difficult decisions in the best interest of AllCare Health.
  • Innovation: Ready to take advantage of unexpected opportunities; adapts quickly to change and is a teacher to assist with change within the organization. Commits to solving unresolved issues in an effort to collaborate and model problem solving. Proactively develop solutions to challenges, including by constantly looking at big-picture progress and thinking about people.
  • Relationships: Enthusiasm for meeting and engaging with people. Able to put people at ease, especially when there are lines of difference. Identifies and intervenes in problematic dynamics. Listens closely to understand needs or concerns and takes steps based on that input. Gets back to people in a timely manner. Takes pride in providing clear, helpful information.

title: Bird Department Zookeeper
description:
Bird Department Zookeeper
General Description
The Bird Department Zookeeper provides care, feeding, enrichment and training for Birds to ensure their well-being and contributes to outstanding guest experiences by ensuring that Bird exhibits are properly maintained.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  • Provide daily care, including but not limited to, feeding, enrichment, and operant conditioning training for birds.
  • Perform routine exhibit maintenance including mowing, trimming, and other routine maintenance activities.
  • Observe and document physical condition and behavior of animals.
  • Inspect facilities to ensure safety and security.
  • Capture and restrain animals as needed.
  • Clean animal enclosures and other exhibit areas.
  • Assist with artificial incubation and hand-rearing.
  • Monitor animal social conditions and situations.
  • Monitor feather-clipping schedules and make recommendations to supervisor when clipping is needed.
  • Develop and submit enrichment practices to Behavioral Husbandry Team.
  • Design, construct, and provide enrichment devices to animals.
  • Provide medical treatments as prescribed by the veterinarians.
  • Communicate needs for maintenance department work requests to lead keeper or supervisor.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
  • Maintain records, inventories and other information and provide written and verbal reports as required.
  • Conduct educational presentations in both formal and informal settings.
  • Train new staff as required.
  • Train and supervise interns.
  • Perform other duties as required.
Qualifications
Education and Experience
A bachelor's degree in zoology or a closely related discipline and two years' experience in the care and management of birds.
OR: An associate degree in a related discipline and four years experiences in the care of captive wildlife, two of which include the care and management of birds.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Ability to work with animals and to remain calm in strenuous circumstances.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to follow instructions.
  • Excellent time management skills.
Working Conditions
Work is performed indoors and outdoors with exposure to all seasonal weather conditions, with frequent exposure to and contact with dangerous animals, with risk of zoonotic disease transmission (Hepatitis B, Herpes B, Tuberculosis, Salmonella and others), and with exposure to computer monitors. Evening work may be required.

Physical Requirements
The Bird Department Zookeeper must be able to lift and move objects weighing up to 50 pounds. The individual must have the ability to perform the essential functions of the job satisfactorily with or without accommodations. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Just as we value and celebrate biodiversity, the DZS celebrates the diversity of our human community. We are committed to ensuring that our programs and facilities are fully accessible to create a welcoming and inclusive workplace for all.

title: Riverside Alpina 145 Gluer Operator 1st Shift
description:
Position Overview:

The Alpina 145 Gluer Operator is responsible for the safe, conforming, and efficient operation of the Alpina 145 gluer. This position performs machine setup, operation, troubleshooting, and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) to ensure high-quality production output. The operator must be capable of determining both simple and complex folding and gluing sequences while leading a crew of assistants and floor workers. Strong leadership, spatial reasoning, and mechanical aptitude are essential for success in this role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

- Machine Setup & Operation

· Perform full machine setup, ensuring all tooling, guides, glue systems, and folding components are correctly configured for each job.

· Run the Alpina 145 gluer safely, efficiently, and in compliance with quality and production standards.

· Determine and execute both simple and complex folding and gluing sequences based on CAD drawings, job tickets, and product specifications.

· Monitor machine performance and make necessary adjustments to maintain production speed, product quality, and machine uptime.

- Crew Leadership & Workflow Coordination

· Direct activities of two assistants and additional floor workers as required.

· Train and guide crew members to support efficient operation, proper feeding, stacking, and housekeeping.

· Communicate job requirements, obstacles, and needs clearly to crew members and supervisors.

- Quality & Compliance

· Ensure product conformity through in-process checks, verifying glue application, fold accuracy, and finished product dimensions.

· Follow sampling plans, hard card requirements, and plant quality procedures.

· Maintain documentation and production records accurately.

- Maintenance & Housekeeping

· Perform daily, weekly, and periodic TPM tasks, including cleaning, lubrication, inspections, and minor adjustments.

· Report equipment issues promptly and support maintenance personnel as needed.

· Maintain machine center cleanliness and organization consistent with company standards.

Required Education, Skills & Qualifications

· 6–12 months of experience as an assistant operator on folding/gluing equipment or related machinery.

· Strong understanding of standard box plant operations and converting processes.

· Ability to think in spatial terms and visualize complex folds and gluing sequences.

· Mathematical ability to convert measurements to decimals and apply them accurately.

· Reasonable tool knowledge and mechanical aptitude.

· Ability to perform basic computer functions related to machine operation and production reporting.

· Strong communication skills and ability to lead and coordinate a small crew.

Preferred Attributes

· Experience operating the Alpina 145 or similar gluer models.

· Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to address machine or material issues quickly.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.

· A commitment to safety, quality, teamwork, and continuous improvement

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

title: Work Package Owner
description:
About Company:

JC Automation Corp. (JCA) was founded in 1997 with the mission of filling a gap between technology and regulatory requirements in the life science manufacturing industry. The company offers highly capable resources at an affordable cost to build solutions and execute projects in: Automation, Control Systems Integration, Information Technology, System Integration and Regulatory Compliance.

JCA is a HUBZone Certified Small Business Firm, NMSDC Certified Minority Business Enterprise, and Certified Critical Industry Supplier. It’s mission is to add value by delivering quality services & solutions on time all the time by transforming processes & technology into business advantages.


ABOUT THE ROLE

A Work Package Owner is responsible for a defined scope area of the project from an Owner governance and integration perspective. The WPO maintains visibility of contractor performance, identifies risks and constraints, coordinates stakeholder interfaces, drives issue resolution, and ensures the package progresses toward mechanical completion and turnover in accordance with project objectives.

The WPO acts as the Owner's advocate in the field, ensuring decisions are made promptly, interfaces are properly managed, and risks are identified early while maintaining clear alignment among design, procurement, construction, systems completion, and CQV teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Base Work Package Ownership

  • Serve as the Owner representative for an assigned Base Work Package from field mobilization through mechanical completion and turnover.
  • Maintain overall awareness of package safety, quality, schedule, cost, productivity, and risk performance.
  • Establish and maintain package-level execution readiness and interface tracking plans.
  • Ensure Owner obligations and deliverables are completed in accordance with project requirements.

Contractor Performance Monitoring

  • Monitor contractor performance against approved safety, quality, schedule, and productivity goals.
  • Participate in field walks, coordination meetings, readiness reviews, and contractor progress discussions.
  • Identify emerging performance issues and escalate concerns through appropriate project governance channels.
  • Verify contractor-reported progress and support project controls reporting activities.

Constraint Management

  • Identify and track constraints impacting package execution.
  • Coordinate timely resolution of Owner-driven and cross-functional constraints.
  • Facilitate decisions related to design clarifications, procurement issues, access requirements, permits, turnover priorities, and operational interfaces.
  • Escalate unresolved constraints to project leadership when required.

Interface Management

  • Coordinate package interfaces with adjacent work packages, utility systems, infrastructure, commissioning activities, and operational stakeholders.
  • Ensure interface risks are identified, documented, tracked, and resolved.
  • Support planning and execution of tie-ins, shutdowns, energizations, and system integration activities.

Safety Oversight

  • Promote project safety culture and Owner HSE expectations.
  • Participate in safety observations, field engagements, audits, and leadership walks.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with project safety requirements.
  • Track and escalate significant safety concerns, trends, and recurring issues.

Quality Oversight

  • Monitor field quality performance and implementation of approved quality plans.
  • Support inspection readiness and adherence to project quality requirements.
  • Participate in quality reviews and issue resolution activities.
  • Track quality trends, deficiencies, punch list status, and corrective action closure.

Owner Equipment & Vendor Integration

  • Coordinate installation readiness and integration of Owner-furnished equipment and systems.
  • Interface with equipment suppliers and vendor representatives to support successful installation, startup, and turnover activities.
  • Track supplier deliverables, technical support requirements, and commissioning readiness.

Schedule & Progress Management

  • Support package-level progress assessment and forecasting activities.
  • Review contractor look-ahead plans and identify risks to upcoming work.
  • Coordinate Owner actions necessary to support planned execution activities.
  • Monitor milestone achievement and turnover readiness.

Turnover & CQV Readiness

  • Ensure package execution supports the project's systems-based turnover strategy from the earliest stages of construction.
  • Monitor progress against mechanical completion, systems completion, turnover, and CQV readiness milestones.
  • Coordinate with Construction Management, System Owners, Turnover Leads, CQV, Operations, and contractors to identify and remove barriers to system handover.
  • Promote construction sequencing and workface planning that enables phased turnover and efficient CQV execution.
  • Track and drive closure of deficiencies, punch list items, documentation gaps, testing activities, and turnover deliverables affecting system readiness.
  • Advocate for turnover and startup priorities during package planning and interface discussions.
  • Escalate risks that could impact mechanical completion, turnover milestones, commissioning activities, qualification schedules, or startup objectives.

Reporting & Communication

  • Provide routine package status updates including risks, constraints, safety trends, quality concerns, schedule impacts, and interface issues.
  • Maintain package dashboards, action-item logs, and issue trackers.
  • Present package status and recommendations to project leadership as required.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related technical discipline; equivalent construction and industry experience considered.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience supporting complex industrial, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, semiconductor, or similar capital projects.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multi-disciplinary construction, startup, and turnover activities.
  • Strong understanding of contractor management, construction execution, quality systems, and project controls.
  • Experience with systems completion, mechanical completion, turnover, and CQV processes preferred.
  • Strong stakeholder management, interface management, and problem-solving skills.
  • OSHA 30 preferred.
  • English required; Spanish strongly preferred for projects located in Puerto Rico

Work Package Owner Roles


HVAC / Cleanroom / Architectural

  • Focus on GMP architectural systems, environmental separation, cleanroom construction, finishes, and room readiness for CQV activities.

Process Piping / Mechanical Systems

  • Focus on process utilities, clean utilities, piping installation, mechanical completion, pressure testing, flushing, and turnover planning.

Modular Interconnects

  • Focus on field integration of modular systems, interface management, module tie-ins, vendor coordination, and turnover readiness.

Utilities & CSA Tie-Ins

  • Focus on brownfield integration activities, utility tie-ins, facility tie-ins, shutdown execution support, cutovers, temporary service transitions, demolition interfaces, structural modifications, and coordination with site operations. Responsible for ensuring tie-in readiness, stakeholder alignment, outage planning, permit coordination, operational acceptance, and successful transition from construction to commissioning while minimizing impacts to ongoing facility operations.

title: Mechanical Engineering Designer I
description:
As a Mechanical Engineering Designer I, you will help design the HVAC, plumbing, and building automation systems that keep buildings comfortable, efficient, and safe — taking project work from concept design through final construction documents alongside licensed P.E.s and a multidisciplinary team. You’ll work across a variety of building types, sizes, and delivery methods, with mentorship built into your day-to-day.
This role offers the chance to build hands-on expertise in Revit, AutoCAD, system sizing, and energy modeling, take on increasing client-facing responsibility, and grow toward licensure and a Mechanical Engineer career path — with the project variety of a nationally active practice and the ownership stake of an employee-owned (ESOP) firm.

PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES

Produce accurate building models and contract documents. Prepare Revit and AutoCAD models and drawing sets for assigned projects that clear senior-engineer and P.E. review with minimal rework, steadily increasing the share of each project package you can own independently.
Size and analyze mechanical systems with confidence. Perform HVAC and mechanical system sizing, static pressure calculations, and energy model inputs on 2–3 active projects, with accuracy confirmed in P.E. review and fewer corrections on each successive project.
Apply codes and controls knowledge to real designs. Research and document applicable plumbing, mechanical, and fuel/gas code requirements for every assigned project, and contribute sensor, actuator, and basic control strategy selections for Building Automation Systems (BAS) on at least one project.
Keep project teams aligned and deliverables clean. Check your own work before it goes to review, flag design and documentation inconsistencies to senior staff, assist with specifications that match the drawings and firm standards, and keep shared project documentation current for internal teams, consultants, contractors, and clients.
Ramp up quickly on the firm’s tools and standards. Within the first 90 days, reach working proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and the firm’s design and analysis tools, and contribute to the contract documents on at least one active project.
Grow toward licensure and client-facing leadership. Pursue the Fundamentals of Engineering (F.E.) exam, take part in team meetings and ‘Lessons Learned’ sessions on every project, and take on a growing share of client communication as you build trust through demonstrated expertise.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education and Licensure

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required.
Pursuing the Fundamentals of Engineering (F.E.) exam is preferred.
Post-graduation professional engineering experience preferred.

Technology Skills

Revit experience highly preferred.

title: DIRECTOR OF EMERGENCY & CRISIS SERVICES
description:
Position: Director of Emergency and Crisis Services
Employment Status: Full-Time
Location: Farmville, Virginia

General Description:

The Director of Emergency and Crisis Services is responsible for the overall coordination, operation, and delivery of mental health and substance use crisis services to individuals throughout Planning District 14.

This position provides leadership, clinical oversight, and supervision to Emergency Services staff and is responsible for ensuring crisis services are delivered in a timely, effective, and person-centered manner. The Director also supports program operations, staff development, regulatory compliance, and coordination with community partners involved in behavioral health crisis response.

The Director of Emergency and Crisis Services is directly accountable to the Executive Director of the agency. This position is designated as Level Two under the HIPAA Privacy Rule and is exempt under FLSA.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate-level degree in psychiatric social work, psychology, counseling, or a directly related field.
  • At least three years of experience in a mental health setting, including emergency or crisis services, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least one year of clinical supervisory experience with master's-level or higher clinical staff is preferred.
  • Must be licensed in Virginia as a Clinical Psychologist, LCSW, or LPC, or be license-eligible and able to obtain licensure within a timeframe established by the employer.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Plan, develop, coordinate, and oversee mental health and substance use emergency services.
  • Coordinate staffing schedules, including after-hours, weekend, holiday, and on-call coverage.
  • Provide direct crisis intervention, diagnostic evaluations, follow-up services, and backup clinical supervision as needed.
  • Ensure clinical documentation and case records are completed accurately and in accordance with agency policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor staff documentation and record-keeping practices.
  • Review and oversee monthly program statistics and reporting requirements.
  • Develop and provide in-service training and community education related to Emergency Services.
  • Build and maintain relationships with community agencies, hospitals, law enforcement, courts, and other service partners.
  • Represent Crossroads CSB at local, regional, and state meetings related to Emergency and Crisis Services.
  • Collaborate with agency leadership regarding behavioral health programs and service delivery.
  • Provide clinical supervision and consultation to Emergency Services clinical staff.
  • Complete employee performance evaluations and support staff development.
  • Assist with recruitment, hiring, performance management, disciplinary actions, and other personnel-related responsibilities.
  • Implement changes in Virginia mental health laws and ensure Emergency Services practices remain compliant.
  • Monitor program activities and complete required reporting related to the Performance Contract and other accountability measures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned consistent with the responsibilities of the position.

Knowledge

Successful candidates should have knowledge of:

  • Mental health disorders, developmental disabilities, and substance use disorders.
  • Crisis assessment, intervention, stabilization, and clinical treatment.
  • Clinical assessment and diagnosis.
  • Psychotropic medications and their potential effects.
  • Emergency Services program development, administration, and supervision.
  • Individual, group, and family counseling.
  • Program monitoring and evaluation.
  • Personnel management and staff supervision.
  • DSM-5 diagnostic criteria and application.
  • Effective leadership principles.
  • Virginia mental health laws and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

Skills

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong skills in:

  • Written and verbal communication.
  • Clinical and crisis assessment.
  • Crisis intervention and stabilization.
  • Staff supervision and leadership.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making.
  • Time management and managing multiple priorities.
  • Program development and strategic planning.
  • Financial and operational management.
  • Collaboration with individuals, families, staff, and community organizations.

Compensation and Benefits at Crossroads Services Board

At Crossroads Services Board, we are committed to offering a salary and fringe benefits package that is competitive with other agencies and businesses in our area. To support this goal, we conduct regular salary and benefits studies to ensure our offerings remain in line with market standards.

Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes:

  • Approximately 90% employer-paid coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Access to the National Health Service Corps Federal Loan Forgiveness Program, with potential eligibility for college loan repayment

  • Additional benefits that support the health, well-being, and professional development of our team members

We are dedicated to creating an environment where employees can thrive personally and professionally. Each staff member plays an essential role in our mission, and we value open communication through both formal and informal channels.

We look forward to a meaningful and rewarding partnership with each employee, built on mutual respect and shared success.

Asiantuntijoita haetaan asiakkaan tarjouskilpailuun. Toimeksiantojen toteutuminen ja laajuus tarkentuvat kilpailutuksen ja asiakkaan tarpeiden perusteella.

Minkälaisia osaajia etsimme?

Taloushallinto ja rahoitus

Etsimme SAP S/4HANA -konsultteja pääkirjan, osto- ja myyntireskontran, sisäisen laskennan sekä käyttöomaisuuslaskennan tehtäviin. Lisäksi haemme osaamista rahoitussuunnitteluun ja kassanhallintaan, varojen sijoittamiseen sekä pankki- ja tiliotekäsittelyyn.

Hankinta, laskutus, projektit ja kiinteistöhallinta

Mahdollisuuksia on myös SAP S/4HANA -ympäristön myyntilaskutuksen, hankinnan ja ostotilausten käsittelyn, projektinhallinnan sekä kiinteistöhallinnan parissa. Näissä tehtävissä hyödyksi on esimerkiksi SAP PS- tai RE-FX-osaaminen sekä oman sovellusalueen prosessien ja liittymien tuntemus.

Henkilöstöhallinto, palkanlaskenta ja ajanhallinta

Haemme SAP ECC -osaajia Suomen palkanlaskennan ja ajanhallinnan ylläpitoon ja tekniseen kehittämiseen. Kokonaisuuteen kuuluvat myös HR- ja CATS-toiminnot sekä henkilötietojen ja työaikakirjausten siirrot SAP ECC- ja SAP S/4HANA -järjestelmien välillä.

SAP-kehitys, käyttöliittymät ja käyttövaltuudet

Etsimme asiantuntijoita SAP S/4HANA- ja ECC-ympäristöjen tekniseen kehittämiseen, käyttövaltuuksiin ja workflow-ratkaisuihin. Osaamisalueita ovat myös Fiori Launchpad, SAP NetWeaver Portal ja FES / SAP Gateway. Tehtävästä riippuen työssä hyödynnetään esimerkiksi ABAP-kehitystä, laajennuksia, Adobe Forms -lomakkeita ja CDS-näkymiä.

Tietovarastointi, raportointi ja arkistointi

Haemme osaamista SAP BW -tietovaraston ja raportoinnin ylläpitoon ja kehittämiseen sekä SAP S/4HANA -arkistointiratkaisuihin. Raportoinnin ympäristössä käytetään muun muassa BW-prosessiketjuja, BEx Query Designeria, Web Application Designeria ja Open Hub -tekniikkaa. Arkistoinnissa hyödynnetään ulkoista InfoArchive-järjestelmää.

Basis, integraatiot ja järjestelmien valvonta

Etsimme SAP Basis -asiantuntijoita sovellusalustojen asennuksiin, päivityksiin, konfigurointiin ja vianselvitykseen. Lisäksi haemme SAP Solution Manager -osaamista ja valmiuksia tulevaan SAP Cloud ALM -siirtymään sekä integraatioasiantuntijoita SAP PO- ja CPI-ympäristöihin ja tulevaan SAP Integration Suite -kokonaisuuteen.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Sinulla on vahvaa käytännön kokemusta yhdestä tai useammasta edellä kuvatusta SAP-osaamisalueesta. Tunnet oman erikoisalasi ratkaisut ja pystyt hyödyntämään osaamistasi asiakkaan ylläpito- ja kehitystarpeissa.

Arvostamme itsenäistä työotetta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä sekä taitoa tehdä yhteistyötä asiakkaan asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Kokemus laajoista SAP-ympäristöistä ja järjestelmien välisistä riippuvuuksista auttaa tehtävissä onnistumisessa.

Sinun ei tarvitse hallita kaikkia ilmoituksessa mainittuja teknologioita tai sovellusalueita. Kerro hakemuksessasi, missä osaamisesi on vahvinta ja millaisista toimeksiannoista olet kiinnostunut.

Kiinnostuitko?

Mikäli olet kokenut SAP-konsultti tai tekninen SAP-asiantuntija ja etsit seuraavaa toimeksiantoasi, kerro meille osaamisestasi ja taustastasi. Lähetä CV ja lyhyt hakemuksesi sekä tuntiveloitustoiveesi mahdollisimman pian. Kerro samalla keskeiset SAP-osaamisalueesi, niihin liittyvä projektikokemuksesi sekä käytettävyytesi ja mahdollinen aloitusajankohtasi.

Etenemme sopivien osaajien kanssa jo hakuaikana.

Teemme erilaisia hakuja järjestelmästämme ja työnhakijanamme saat meiltä esim. tippi- ja uutiskirjeitä meillä avoinna olevista tehtävistä. Sinun kannattaakin siis olla aktiivinen ja seurata säännöllisesti avoimien työpaikkojemme tilannetta ja kiinnittää itsesi mukaan hakuun!

Poolia IT Oy

Poolia IT on ketterä ja alati kasvava rekrytointiyritys. Teemme tiiviisti yhteistyötä eri oppilaitosten kanssa ja meillä on useita asiakassuhteita, joiden kanssa saumaton yhteistyö on sujunut jo vuosia. Panostamme laadukkaaseen työnhakijakokemukseen, sekä hyvään aktiiviseen viestintään rekrytointiprosessin eri vaiheissa. Arvostamme kaikkia hakijoitamme ja työntekijöitämme, mikä takaa sen, että työtä tehdään ihmisläheisesti. Työviihtyvyyttä luomme mm. toimimalla työnantajana joustavasti ja järjestämällä työntekijöillemme erilaisia tapahtumia pitkin vuotta. Osana Poolia Oyä olemme Henkilöstöala HELA jäsen ja OMX-pörssinoteerattu yhtiö.

title: Cluster Revenue Analyst
description:
Hyatt is a global hospitality brand with one driving purpose\: to care for people so they can be their best. Through listening, noticing others and extending meaningful gestures, we consistently deliver distinct experiences that demonstrate how a little understanding goes a long way.

Are you ready to share this purpose?

Because we are looking for a Cluster Revenue Analyst for our three Amsterdam properties!

Andaz means "personal style" in Hindi. Andaz Amsterdam Prinsengracht means, five-star creative luxury in the heart of Amsterdam, expressed through local experiences, art & design and picture-perfect drinking and dining, in a playful Dutch-inspired environment. Five-star Hyatt Regency Amsterdam, brings botany & sustainability to life with an award-winning living interior, botanical inspired guestrooms, a passion for discovering our up and coming East neighborhood and a buzzing Indonesian Restaurant, Mama Makan. Hyatt Place Amsterdam Airport allows our guests to experience convenience and comfort done differently. Located in a peaceful part of Schiphol Airport business area and near Amsterdam city center, the hotel is at the intersection of work and play.

  • A strategic thinker who is also very organized and detail-oriented;

What does the ROLE entail?

  • Ensure accurate maintenance of Prio and Strategic Worflow across hotels

  • Update forecast and rates in all relevant systems. Ensure proper update of all transient rates modifiers and add on opportunity in RMT.
  • Prepare and provide analysis for the Months end / owners report to support the Cluster Director of Revenue in the reporting process

  • An entry to the Hyatt Family, a place where we care for people so they can be their best;

  • 12 free nights at Hyatt hotels globally every year and 20% Discounts at our F&B outlets and special discounts at our Spa

  • Travel Allowance, starting from a 5 kilometers travel distance from the hotel.

  • Your work attire is taken care of by our inhouse laundry.

  • 25 Vacation days

Wellbeing\:

“Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best – and we believe wellbeing is the ultimate realization of our purpose”

  • To support our colleagues mental wellbeing we provide access to “Headspace App” for all employees, free of charge as Hyatt's wellbeing assessment tool "Hyatt Well-Check"

  • Social Activities; Team building outings, Sports/wellbeing activities

  • Hotel gym access

Development\:

“Careers at Hyatt don’t have to follow a traditional career ladder or path with one pace and following only one direction. Rather, they can be customized and adapted based an employee’s individual circumstances and take the form of a career lattice”

  • International working experience with future international transfer happily facilitated.

  • Personal development plan, in order to reach your full potential.

  • A wide range of development tools through the Hyatt Learning platform for all colleagues. From E-Learnings to classroom sessions, Hyatt provides different solutions, depending on how you learn best (Example\: Excel courses, Leadership series etc.).

Diversity\:

“Inclusion and diversity are at the core of our purpose – we care for people so they can be their best – and we are deeply involved in actions that create a culture of opportunity for all”

  • An International team of over 15 different nationalities

  • Focus on Diversity, Equity and inclusion within our team. Through employee support groups (HyPride & Women@Hyatt), workshop and classroom trainings.

title: Mid Level Thermal Analyst - Nebula
description:
Thermal Analyst (Mid-Level)

Houston, TX

About Intuitive Machines:

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

About the Position:

Intuitive Machines is seeking a skilled Thermal Analysis Engineer to join our expanding team in Houston. We are actively building the next generation of spacecraft for lunar missions, and we need your talent to design, analyze, and test the thermal systems that will make these historic missions successful.

Responsibilities:

  • Thermal Modeling & Analysis: Develop, maintain, and run high-fidelity thermal models (using Thermal Desktop) to predict steady-state and transient temperature distributions across all mission phases (Launch, LV Separation, transit, lunar orbit, and surface operations).
  • Thermal Design: Design active and passive thermal control systems (ATCS/PTCS). Select and procure thermal hardware like thermal tapes, MLI, heaters, and thermal interface materials (TIMs).
  • Testing & Model Correlation: Support thermal verification and validation activities, including test planning, thermal vacuum (TVAC) testing, and correlating test data back to analytical models.
  • Generate TPS Documentation: Produce the vehicle's Thermal Protection System (TPS) document, providing clear, actionable instructions for the Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) team to accurately apply thermal solutions to the flight hardware.
  • Prepare Design Review Packages: Summarize complex analysis data, generate clear presentation decks, and present technical results during design review meetings to defend findings and align stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Data Gathering: Collaborate proactively with structures, propulsion, avionics, and power teams to identify thermal requirements and collect the necessary environments, power dissipation profiles, and physical geometries required to build comprehensive thermal models.

Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 3 - 7 years specifically dedicated to spacecraft thermal analysis.
  • Software: Proven hands-on proficiency with Thermal Desktop.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong core understanding of heat transfer principles and thermodynamics

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with ANSYS Mechanical.
  • Experience with FloCAD.


US EEO Statement:

Intuitive Machines is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Compliance Engineering Manager, eero Hardware Engineering
description:
As Manager of Regulatory Compliance Engineering, you will lead a team of individual contributors and technical leads responsible for ensuring HW compliance across eero’s growing portfolio of products. You will have the opportunity to work on enabling exciting eero products with industry leading connectivity technology. You will drive a culture of proactive compliance and design for safety integration into product development from early concept through sustaining. You will lead early development work assessing RF architecture, design validation, and ensuring eero’s product portfolio meets internal specifications and regulatory compliance. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical guidance, requiring both long-term thinking and practical execution to ensure products meet or exceed compliance requirements in all markets. Our ideal candidate wants to quickly solve problems, generate big ideas, and innovate to bring the best product to our customers while meeting regulatory requirements. This role requires a highly organized leader who is a strong communicator and influencer, able to support requirements with justifications and technically rich analysis. You will have a strong understanding of the physics behind RF communication, regulatory compliance scheme, and the processes required to specify, test, qualify, document, and maintain certifications related to EMI, EMC, RF, BT, Safety, and energy efficiency compliance for domestic and international markets. You will be the cornerstone of eero’s standardized and harmonized approach to HW compliance. You will have strong compliance engineering and design fundamentals and be able to distill complex requirements and issues to a variety of audiences. You will have strong program management skills to get “hands-on” with project ownership when business necessitates it.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, manage, and develop a team of Compliance Engineers and Compliance Program Managers, establishing team structure, responsibilities, priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across engineering, product, and business teams
- Provide strategic guidance to design teams regarding compliance & regulatory design requirements and system performance requirement
- Lead Design for Safety activities to ensure safety is designed into eero products
- Work with certifying agencies and organizations to ensure new and existing designs comply with local, regional and national regulations
- Partner with Contract Manufacturers, 3rd party labs, and TCB to test and validate eero products and support testing from a hardware and software perspective
- Manage and track HW compliance and validation metrics to ensure operational excellence and timely delivery
- Stay abreast to regulatory specifications to ensure internal standards and requirements are aligned with evolving specifications
- Obtain compliance approvals for all product lines to ensure entry into domestic and international locations and markets
- Dive deep into root cause analysis and partner on corrective actions

title: Operations Planner

Who We Are

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at .

View the SENS Product Catalog

Summary

As an Operations Planner, you will play a critical role in ensuring smooth production flow, accurate scheduling, and timely order fulfillment. You will act as the bridge between production, materials, scheduling, and shipping teams, identifying bottlenecks and communicating effectively to maintain operational excellence.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Production Team to plan output and review build schedules.
  • Support production scheduling for secondary manufacturing sites as needed.
  • Run SyteLine (ERP) system reports across all product lines to identify part shortages and flag exception messages to procurement for immediate action to ensure priorities are met and production downtime is minimized.
  • Partner closely with Procurement to communicate and expedite material shortages identified through ERP reporting and manual review.
  • Attend daily Tier 2 production meetings with Leads and Supervisors.
  • Collect daily/weekly data from production line boards and compile into a central reporting system.
  • Communicate issues from the production line to materials and planning teams.
  • Assist scheduling with tracking on-time delivery (OTD) performance and investigating root causes of delayed sales orders, providing updates to stakeholders.
  • Conduct Clear to Build and Critical BOM Path reviews to ensure there are no material shortages before the production line gets to a build.
  • Evaluate and update Planning BOMs (Bills of Materials) on a monthly basis, using demand and performance reports to true up forecasted material usage, in coordination with the Scheduler, who updates Planning BOM’s within SyteLine.
  • Generate and distribute planning reports for Buyers and Production to support daily execution.
  • Assist with KPI data collection and presentation.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of experience in production planning, production scheduling, or supply chain within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookups, PivotTables, and similar data analysis functionality.
  • Experience working with ERP/MRP systems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or related field.

title: Radio Frequency Engineer
description:
sition Title

Radio Frequency Engineer

Position Classification

Exempt

Position Type

This position is full-time and requires on-site support at MCTSSA. The Contractor shall generally work Monday through Friday during the established core hours at MCTSSA, typically 0800–1600, excluding Government holidays. The actual work schedule and hours may vary based on customer requirements, mission requirements, operational needs, and the operational tempo at MCTSSA. Deviations from the typical schedule, including adjustments to start and end times, may be required to support customer and mission requirements.

Work Location

Marine Corps Tactical Systems Support Activity (MCTSSA), Camp Pendleton, CA

Position Description

The Radio Frequency (RF) Engineer provides RF and transmission engineering expertise for developmental test and evaluation of the Advanced Reconnaissance Vehicle (ARV) program in support of Program Manager Light Armored Vehicles (PM LAV). The individual delivers expert engineering services for the integration, configuration, and troubleshooting of radio assets and transmission paths supporting test events for both vendor solutions, and assesses RF performance across static, mobile, and afloat test scenarios. This position provides dedicated, non-overlapping coverage operating from the System Integration Laboratory (SIL) in order to protect vendor proprietary data and ensure unbiased analysis.

Essential Position Functions

  • Five years' demonstrated radio frequency or communications engineering experience supporting tactical radio systems, waveforms, or transmission systems.
  • Deliver expert engineering services for the integration, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of radio assets, transmission paths, and associated communications systems supporting test events for both vendor solutions.
  • Configure and operate radio assets within a man-portable, deployable SIL environment supporting essential MAGTF C2 software applications.
  • Conduct RF performance analysis and assessment during static, mobile, and afloat test scenarios, including link performance, transmission path characterization, and interference identification.
  • Perform root cause analysis of RF and transmission-related test incidents and provide engineering recommendations for resolution.
  • Conduct technical assessments and integration evaluations of emerging radio and communications technologies for use with the LAV Family of Vehicles and ARV to determine feasibility, suitability, and operational relevance.
  • Provide RF engineering input to test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test and evaluation architecture diagrams.
  • Support the delivery and installation of Mobile MAGTF Test Suites to vendor sites, providing appropriate engineering and system expertise during installation.
  • Enter all Test Incident Reports (TIRs) into the designated tracking system within 24 hours of identification, and submit trip reports within 5 business days of trip completion.
  • Proficiency with RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power meters.
  • CompTIA Security+ or equivalent DoD IAT Level II certification (desired).
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (desired).
  • Experience with military tactical radio systems and MANET waveforms (desired).
  • Working knowledge of spectrum management and frequency authorization processes (desired).

Competencies for the role

The Radio Frequency Engineer demonstrates advanced expertise in RF and transmission engineering applied to tactical communications systems under test. This role requires strong diagnostic and analytical skills, proficiency with RF test instrumentation, the ability to characterize and troubleshoot link and transmission performance in laboratory, vehicle, and afloat environments, and the discipline to maintain strict separation of competing vendor data while supporting both vendor teams.

Physical Requirements for the role

This position requires the ability to work at a computer for extended periods, including viewing monitors, using keyboards, and operating standard office and test equipment. The role also requires the ability to enter, occupy, and perform test duties within small vehicle passenger compartments during static, mobile, and afloat scenarios while wearing personal protective equipment (PPE), including body and head protective gear. The individual must be able to stand and walk for extended periods, work in field and shipboard conditions, and lift and carry equipment up to 40 pounds, including man-portable server and radio components associated with the System Integration Laboratory and Mobile MAGTF Test Suites.

Reports To

Assigned Program Manager

Supervisory responsibilities

None

Work Environment

The work environment for this position includes a professional office setting, a System Integration Laboratory (SIL), and field and vehicle test environments. Test execution occurs during static, mobile, and afloat scenarios, including duties performed inside small vehicle passenger compartments where the individual will be required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) such as body and head protective gear. The role involves regular use of computers and related technology and frequent collaboration with technical and non-technical team members, including Government and vendor personnel. Work is generally performed during normal business hours, and the environment supports adherence to established cybersecurity, safety, and organizational policies. Due to the requirement to protect vendor proprietary data, the individual will be assigned to a designated vendor team or headquarters element and shall maintain strict non-disclosure between competing vendor solutions.

Security Clearance Requirements

Secret. Technical tasks associated with this position require access to classified information up to the Secret level. The individual shall not divulge information regarding files, data processing activities or functions, identifications, passwords, or other knowledge gained to anyone not authorized access to such information, and shall abide by all Government rules, procedures, and standards of conduct.

Travel Requirements

Travel is anticipated to be approximately 25% - 30% within the Continental United States. CONUS travel is currently forecast at twice per quarter at approximately two weeks per trip and must be preapproved in writing by the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR). Travel includes vendor site visits and the delivery and installation of Mobile MAGTF Test Suites. No travel outside the Continental United States is anticipated.

Compensation

Commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Lumbee Holdings is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate in employment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Lumbee Holdings reserves the right to share applications and related candidate information with its subsidiaries, affiliates, teaming partners, subcontractors, and prime contractors for purposes of evaluating candidates for this and other current or future openings.

title: Exercise Physiologist
description:
The Exercise Physiologist analyzes a patient's medical history, conducts fitness and stress tests, measures vital signs, and develops individualized exercise prescriptions to improve the patient's overall health and aid in the recovery from various medical conditions according to the physicians' individualized prescription and Plan of Care.
JOB FUNCTIONS
  • Conducts fitness evaluations and functional assessments to identify individual needs, limitations, and any potential risks exercise may pose
  • Assists in the orientation and intake of all new patients
  • Develops customized exercise programs based on prescribed goals, including cardiopulmonary training, strength training, flexibility exercises, and rehabilitation protocols
  • Administers breathing exercises, dyspnea management, therapeutic exercises, psychosocial
    assessment/management, work simplification strategies, and assistive technologies
  • Monitors progress through regular assessments, monitors heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation during exercise sessions
  • Identifies potential risks associated with exercise based on medical history and adjusts exercise plans accordingly
  • Provides patients with education on healthy lifestyle habits, nutrition, and exercise techniques to optimize therapy results
  • Performs cardiopulmonary exercise tests to evaluate cardiopulmonary functions and the presence of any limitations
  • Communicates assessments and updates on the patient's Plan of Care with members of the healthcare team and referring physicians
  • Documents accurate and complete clinical information in the patient's medical record
  • Maintains a safe and clean work environment by complying with all applicable rules, regulations, and procedures for safety management and infection control
  • Schedules patient's appointments for diagnostic and respiratory care services

The Vulnerability Assessment Analyst and Penetration Tester is responsible for the delivery of continuous cyber assessments, solving complex technology problems, building tools, and identifying and influencing response to and mitigation of threats. Perform manual assessment of systems, services, and software; specializing in security issues beyond those identified by static analysis tools. The individual ensures services, applications, and websites are designed and implemented to the highest security standards. Following are the essential functions of the position, along with the corresponding performance standards.

o Professional Requirements

 Maintains regulatory requirements including all state, federal, and Joint Commission regulations related to Health Information Services, as appropriate, to the facility.

 Always maintains patient confidentiality. Complies with all HIPAA Policies and Procedures, specifically with the use of "minimum necessary information" to perform job duties.

 Maintains an organized and clean work area.

 Actively participates in performance improvement and continuous quality improvement activities.

 Must be familiar with the following Policy and Procedures: Administration, HIS, Infection Control, Emergency Preparedness and Safety, and HIPAA. Ensures compliance with policies and procedures.

o Analyzes patient medical records and interprets documentation to identify all diagnoses and procedures. Assigns proper ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS and HCPCS diagnostic and operative procedure codes to charts and related records by reference to designated coding manuals and other reference material.



Remains abreast of developments in medical record technology by pursuing a program of professional growth and development, attending educational programs and meetings, reviewing pertinent literature, and so forth.

 Utilizes professional affiliations, etc., in order to stay current in professional developments.

 Attends all pertinent coding seminars.

 Maintains updated coding books.



o Works with the Coding Manager to identify and resolve coding issues.

 Attends staff meetings as directed by the Coding Manager.

Reports all aged accounts to the HIS Supervisor. Works with HIS Staff and/or Physician to obtain all necessary documentation to code all accounts in a timely manner.

 Maintains a listing of aged accounts and documentation of steps taken to obtain necessary documentation.

 Keeps Supervisor informed of all aged accounts.

title: Quality Assurance Supervisor
description:
Quality Assurance Supervisor

Join our team as a Quality Assurance Supervisor and take ownership of food safety and quality across a fast-paced seasoning production facility! In this role, you'll lead a team of QA technicians, keep production running with real-time quality checks, and help drive a culture where food safety and continuous improvement come first. If you thrive on details, love solving problems, and want to make a real impact on product quality every single day, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Daily QA Operations

  • Supervise QA technicians and coordinate daily quality checks across production lines, batching, blending, and packaging operations
  • Monitor CCPs, CPs, sanitation, allergen control, and other food safety metrics
  • Perform line audits, pre-op inspections, environmental checks, and lot verifications
  • Ensure timely completion and accuracy of all QA documentation, batch records, and testing logs

Food Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to HACCP, GMPs, SQF/BRC, FDA regulations, and company food safety programs
  • Support the maintenance of food safety plans, validation studies, and quality manuals
  • Participate in internal and external audits; assist with corrective action development and follow-up
  • Verify allergen segregation, label accuracy, metal detection, and traceability procedures

Testing & Product Evaluation

  • Oversee physical, chemical, and sensory testing of ingredients and finished seasonings
  • Coordinate hold-and-release programs for raw materials, WIP, and finished goods
  • Investigate out-of-spec results and assist with root-cause analysis
  • Partner with R&D and Production on product trials, scale-ups, and new formulations

Training & Team Leadership

  • Train QA technicians and production staff on food safety, GMPs, quality procedures, and documentation accuracy
  • Provide coaching, performance feedback, and scheduling for QA team members
  • Promote a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement across the facility

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Production, Sanitation, Maintenance, and Supply Chain leaders to address quality concerns
  • Assist with customer complaint investigations and corrective action documentation
  • Communicate quality trends and issues to leadership, offering recommendations for improvement

What You Bring

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Biology, Chemistry, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience accepted
  • 2–4+ years of QA experience in food manufacturing, spices/seasonings, or CPG production
  • Previous supervisory or lead experience strongly preferred

Skills & Competencies

  • High attention to detail and strong documentation habits

title: Protection Project Officer
description:
Protection Project Officer- National Position



Job Title: Protection Project Officer

Reports To: Protection Project Manager

Location: Dowa, Lilongwe, Malawi

Contract Type: Full time

Starting Date: As soon as Possible

Duration: 12-month contract with possibility of extension

CONTEXT

IsraAID is an international non-governmental organization that provides humanitarian aid. Our headquarters is in Israel, and we have been helping communities affected by crises in over 60 countries worldwide since our establishment in 2001. Our goal is to support these communities in rebuilding their lives and futures together, both in emergency and long-term development settings. We respond promptly to emergencies, including hurricanes, refugee crises, and global pandemics, and work closely with communities to help them become self-sufficient in preparing for and responding to emergencies and crises. IsraAID started its emergency and development activities in Malawi in March 2023 in response to Cyclone Freddy, with the aim of providing immediate relief and access to basic services. Over time, the program has expanded to focus on long-term development and resilience initiatives.

SUMMARY

  1. Protection Project Officer

The Protection Project Officer will execute all the established project plans in alignment with the IsraAID Malawi Program strategy, under the direct supervision and guidance of the Protection Project Manager. This role involves engaging with participants within schools and communities, facilitating community outreaches and community dialogue forums, and supporting the planning and organization of capacity-building training and workshops for Community Outreach teams and service providers. The officer will also collaborate with field teams in undertaking interventions and coordinate with the WASH, Health, and DRR teams to monitor project activities.


Main Responsibilities

1. Management

  • Ensure to meet targets by regularly reviewing performance data and project management arrangements, as well as leading regular spot checks.
  • Ensure the development and application of common standards, tools and practices for project planning, implementation, monitoring, learning and reporting.
  • Make sure to identify the key risks and come up with contingency plans related to projects and come up with plans on how to manage the risks.
  • Ensure regular data collection and data management, proper documentation of impact stories, and activity plans.

2. Planning and development

  • Coordinate with various stakeholders and district officials to address issues related to safety of vulnerable adults and children, safety and community resilience.
  • Support in creating work plans and content for training workshops for key stakeholders including district officials, community facilitators, service providers and community members.

3. Coordination

  • Support in organizing filed visits and meetings with all relevant stakeholders.
  • Support in training for service providers.
  • Support in coordinating community engagement workshops and training.
  • Take lead in strengthening relationships with relevant partners, including strengthening referral pathways and interagency SOPs.
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs to build local capacity for protection initiatives.
  • Fostering active community participation in protection efforts and engaging with relevant stakeholders and officials to promote all the policies for protection.

4. Reporting, monitoring and evaluation

  • Monitor progress of project plan and implementation and provide constructive feedback to partners.
  • Collect data and case studies, and draft reports.
  • Support in developing relevant tools and training staff on these tools.
  • Ensure adherence to all IsraAID reporting requirements.
  • Prepare and submit reports to the supervisor in a timely manner, on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis.

5. Advocacy

  • Advocate the rights of vulnerable adults and kids and promote policies that enhance their protection and how to access the groups in the community for help.
  • Conduct awareness training for communities and staff members.

6. Other Tasks

Any other duty may be assigned from time to time by the Protection Project Manager or Field Coordinator. The main responsibilities are not meant to be an exhaustive list of tasks. The need for flexibility is required, and the jobholder is expected to carry out any other related duties that are within the employees’ skills and abilities whenever reasonably instructed.

General

The chosen candidate will be expected to comply with IsraAID’s policies, including codes of conduct, health, safety, security, communications and sexual exploitation and harassment policies, among other relevant policies and procedures.



7. Skills, Experience, and Requirements

  • At least a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (i.e. Social Work, Psychology, Counselling and Development Studies).

  • At least 3 years of relevant work experience with a focus on Protection, safeguarding or prevention of gender-based violence
  • Experience working in hardship areas, emergency settings or fragile states and with displaced persons will be desirable.
  • Experience implementing capacity building projects in complex settings.
  • Experience in project planning, development, reporting, monitoring and evaluation.

  • Identifies participating payers and contractual pricing agreements
  • Verifies health insurance coverage using verification forms
  • Inquires about case management, with authorization number and pre-certification

title: Supervising Technician - Fleet
description:
About Us

Founded in 1937, the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC) has kept the promise of public housing alive. It has done so by maintaining and modernizing its buildings and enriching the lives of its residents through innovative social services, recreational and educational programs, and job training initiatives. What makes HABC successful is the dedication of its employees and its history of strong leadership.


HABC Benefits

Health and Well-Being

At the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC), we offer a competitive benefits package that supports our recruitment and retention goals and meets the diverse, evolving needs of our employees. HABC’s comprehensive benefit package includes:

Vacation and Leave

Health and Wellness
