  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Free health and wellness programs

Income Protection and Retirement

  • Life insurance with optional additional coverage
  • Short‑term disability
  • Voluntary Plans
  • Retirement programs with employee contribution options


Position Summary

Under the general supervision of the Senior Vice President of Administrative Services, the Supervising-Fleet Technician is responsible for the maintenance and operation of mechanical items such as vehicles e.g., automobiles and trucks) and specialized equipment (e.g., Bobcats, front-end loaders, backhoes). The employee is also responsible for the execution of a preventative maintenance program, mechanical repairs, body work, and contract/Purchase Order administration for the fleet. Technical knowledge and independent judgment are required in formulating and interpreting plans, scheduling tasks, and in the inspection and evaluation of work performed by staff and contractors. Acts as an agent for HABC.

All activities must support the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (“HABC” or “Authority”) mission, strategic goals, and objectives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The position duties and responsibilities listed below describe the general nature and scope of work. Other responsibilities, duties and skills may be required and assigned, as needed.

  • Creates Vehicle Cycle Replacement Plan.
  • Identifies obsolete/decommissioned equipment/vehicles.
  • Coordinates the auctioning of obsolete/decommissioned equipment/vehicles.
  • Assessment for Obsolescence.
  • Supervision of Fleet Maintenance & Administrative Staff.
  • Monitors and follows up on daily vehicle usage service requests.
  • Plans and schedules fleet maintenance work to be performed by contractors and technicians.
  • Requisitions materials and services from outside vendors.
  • Reviews fleet work that was requested and conducts inspection of completed work.
  • Maintains a supporting stockroom related to the fleet needs and requirements.
  • Travels to developments to inspect fleet vehicles on a quarterly basis.
  • Follows up on all vehicle accident reports to ensure repairs are conducted in a timely fashion.
  • Coordinates with the City of Baltimore on fuel and city ID cards for HABC vehicles and ensures removal of the same for HABC vehicles taken out of the system.
  • Coordinates with Maryland MVA for tags, title work, and emissions testing.
  • Responsible for maintaining the HABC fleet for emergency operations conditions.
  • Assures that proper safety precautions are observed; assists in training workers in proper methods and use of tools and equipment.
  • Coordinates with HABC developments & divisions for the identification of replacement vehicles.
  • Monitors, tracks, and reports GEOTAB GPS System for abnormal driving infractions.
  • Monitors monthly Income & Expense Statements to ensure fleet compliance with the annual fleet budget.
  • Maintains Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for fleet material inventory.
  • Ensures personnel are kept fully informed of all pertinent operating procedures and HUD policies and regulations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Minimum Education, Training, and/or Experience

  • Graduation from an accredited high school, vocational school, or equivalent.
  • Five (5) years' experience in automotive and other mechanical equipment maintenance as well as machine shop work, two (2) of which must have been in a supervisory capacity.
  • Must have at least one of forty Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) Certifications, preferably in Auto Maintenance and Light Repair, or be required to obtain certification within one year of employment in which the probationary period may be extended until certified.


Special Requirements

  • Lead Paint Maintenance & Repainting Supervisor's Accreditation certification within 12 months of employment.
  • Possession of a valid Maryland driver's license.
  • Must be able to be covered under the Authority's vehicle insurance policy.
  • Must not engage in private real estate business.
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.


Other Requirements:

  • Availability to work some evenings and weekends as needed.
  • On call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for fleet emergencies.
  • Successful completion of a prescreening investigation, including verification of employment history and education credentials.
  • A 6-month probationary period applies to this full-time permanent position.


This job posting will remain open until August 11th, 2026.

title: Shipping Supervisor
description:
Position Summary

The Shipping Supervisor is responsible for leading daily shipping operations across both the Cabinet Dock and Door Dock to ensure all customer deliveries, common carrier shipments, and internal shipping priorities are completed safely, accurately, and on schedule. This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role that requires active engagement on the warehouse floor rather than behind a desk.

The successful candidate will provide direction to shipping personnel, coordinate daily workload priorities, monitor operational performance, and support loading activities when needed. This position requires strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills to maintain productivity and meet daily shipping commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Daily Operational Planning

  • Arrive at the start of the shift (typically 5:00 AM) to review the shipping schedule and develop an operational plan for the day.
  • Review staffing requirements, workload forecasts, and labor plans to ensure resources are aligned with operational needs.
  • Identify potential risks or constraints that may impact daily shipping performance and develop solutions proactively.

Team Leadership and Communication

  • Conduct daily startup meetings with the Cabinet Dock and Door Dock teams to communicate priorities, expectations, safety requirements, and operational goals.
  • Partner with Shipping Administration to establish and communicate daily shipment priorities.
  • Provide clear direction, coaching, and support to team members throughout the shift.
  • Promote accountability, teamwork, and a positive work environment while maintaining high performance standards.

Shipping and Loading Operations

  • Ensure all trucks scheduled for delivery are loaded completely, accurately, and on time.
  • Prioritize common carrier shipments based on scheduled ship dates, pickup times, and customer commitments.
  • Monitor workflow throughout the day to ensure loading activities remain on schedule.
  • Assist with loading doors, cabinets, and other materials when operational demands require additional support.
  • Verify that all shipments comply with company quality, safety, and transportation standards.

Workforce Development and Cross-Training

  • Develop and maintain a cross-trained workforce capable of supporting both Door Dock and Cabinet Dock operations.
  • Reassign personnel as needed to address staffing shortages, call-outs, or fluctuating workloads.
  • Support employee development through hands-on training, mentoring, and performance coaching.
  • Ensure operational continuity by maintaining adequate coverage across all shipping functions.

Safety and Operational Excellence

  • Promote and enforce all company safety policies and procedures.
  • Maintain an active presence on the warehouse floor to monitor operations, identify improvement opportunities, and address issues immediately.
  • Drive efficiency, productivity, and quality while ensuring shipments are completed accurately and safely.
  • Lead by example through a strong work ethic, professional conduct, and hands-on involvement in daily operations.

Qualifications and Expectations

  • Proven leadership experience in shipping, warehouse, logistics, or distribution operations.
  • Strong understanding of loading procedures, freight handling, and shipping processes.
  • Ability to effectively lead teams in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to train and develop employees across multiple job functions.
  • Willingness and ability to perform physical work, including loading doors, cabinets, and other freight when necessary.
  • Proficient with basic computer systems; however, the primary focus of this role is floor leadership and operational execution rather than administrative tasks.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while maintaining service and productivity standards.

Success in This Role

A successful Shipping Supervisor maintains a strong presence on the warehouse floor, leads by example, ensures teams remain focused on daily priorities, supports loading operations when needed, and consistently delivers safe, efficient, and on-time shipping performance across both dock operations.

title: Senior Engineer, Transmission Lines
description:
Workplace Type: Hybrid


About Us:

Pickett, an ESP Associates company, is a highly innovative surveying and engineering company with over 60 years of industry experience serving clients throughout the US and Caribbean.

About The Role:

As a Senior Engineer, you will provide senior level engineering/technical expertise on complex electric transmission design projects for high-voltage (HV) and extra high-voltage (EHV) overhead utility systems.

Specifically, the position manages, prepares, reviews and/or provides guidance for line routing, survey coordination, PLS-CADD modeling, structure design, foundation design, clearance checks, plan/profile development, material specification and procurement, constructability evaluations, work order package preparation, permitting, vendor/subcontractor coordination and construction support.

  • Schedule project tasks for project support team

  • Attend internal design review meetings

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's in Engineering (required)
  • Professional Engineer (PE) certification (required)
  • 8+ years of related transmission line engineering experience in the electric utility industry (required)
  • Experience in using PLS-CADD for designing transmission lines (required)
  • Strong experience with design codes and standards such as NESC, IEEE, ASCE, and ACI
  • Strong experience with liaising substation, environmental, right-of-way construction and maintenance stakeholders

  • Ability to work in a safe manner and always obey safety regulations

  • Strong ability to collaborate with team members as well as peers in the electrical utility industry

  • Candidate must be able to pass a drug screen, background check, and have a satisfactory driving record in accordance with the company’s driving (MVR) policy

So...Why Join Us?

You will have the opportunity to learn, grow and directly contribute to our business. You will also have a very visible and tangible impact by solving real world problems.

You will contribute significantly to the growth and development of our company while also continuing to be challenged and inspired along the way!

Pickett offers an excellent employee benefits package including:

  • PTO (Paid Time Off) & 10 Paid Holidays

title: koneenkuljettaja talvikaudelle – Oulu
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme kokenutta koneenkuljettajaa talvikauden auraus- ja hiekoitustöihin Oulun alueelle.

Työvälineenä toimii noin 10 000 kg Liebherr-pyöräkuormaaja. Työtehtävät painottuvat talvikauden aikana lumen auraukseen ja hiekoitukseen. Työt alkavat sääolosuhteiden mukaan lumentulon käynnistyessä ja työmäärä vaihtelee luonnollisesti talven olosuhteiden mukaan.
Koneenkuljettajan tehtävien lisäksi asiakkaallamme on mahdollisuus tarjota kiinnostuksen ja osaamisen mukaan myös muita kiinteistöhuollon työtehtäviä Oulun alueella. Tavoitteena on löytää motivoitunut ja luotettava tekijä, jota pystytään työllistämään talvikauden aikana mahdollisimman monipuolisesti.

Mitä työ sisältää?
Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:
- lumen aurausta pyöräkuormaajalla
- hiekoitusta ja liukkaudentorjuntaa
- koneen päivittäiseen käyttöön liittyviä tarkastuksia
- tarvittaessa muita kiinteistöhuollon tehtäviä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan
Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Edellytämme aikaisempaa kokemusta pyöräkuormaajan tai vastaavan työkoneen kuljettamisesta. Erityisesti kokemus auraus- ja talvikunnossapitotöistä katsotaan vahvaksi eduksi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta sekä valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa. Talvikunnossapidossa työajat määräytyvät sääolosuhteiden mukaan, joten toivomme sinulta joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen.
Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta muista kiinteistöhuollon tehtävistä sekä halukkuutta tarttua monipuolisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin.

Mitä tarjoamme?
Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa talvikunnossapidon tehtävissä Oulun alueella sekä mahdollisuuden täydentää työmäärää muilla kiinteistöhuollon tehtävillä.
Työsopimus on tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava, ja työmäärä määräytyy sääolosuhteiden sekä asiakkaan työtilanteen mukaan. Tavoitteena on kuitenkin tarjota soveltuvalle ja motivoituneelle työntekijälle mahdollisimman paljon töitä talvikauden aikana.
Työt alkavat lumentulon ja talvikunnossapitokauden käynnistyessä.
Palkkaus määräytyy kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

Kiinnostuitko?
Klikkaa hakulinkkiä ja kirjaudu Eezy Osaajat -palveluun tai rekisteröidy uutena käyttäjänä. Täytä hakemus haettavaan tehtävään ja lisää CV:si – järjestelmä poimii työkokemuksesi automaattisesti profiilille.
Voit myös kirjoittaa lyhyen esittelyn itsestäsi (tilanne, koulutus, toiveet, millainen tekijä olet). Profiilin täyttämiseen kannattaa käyttää muutama minuutti, sillä samalla profiililla voit jatkossa hakea kaikkiin Eezyn tarjoamiin työpaikkoihin.

title: Varastokerääjä, Kauhava
description:

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu asiakastilausten keräily, tuotteiden ja määrien tarkistaminen sekä tilausten pakkaaminen ja lähetyskuntoon valmistelu. - Pystyt säilyttämään tarkkuuden myös kiireisissä tilanteissa

- Aiempi kokemus metallialalta katsotaan eduksi

title: Quality Associate
description:
Summary: The Quality Associate will perform independent examination (i.e., audit) of multiple trial related activities and documents, to determine whether the evaluated trial related activities were conducted, and the data were recorded, analyzed, and accurately reported, according to the protocol, standard operating procedures (SOPs), GCPs and the reporting any findings to the Internal Study Team and department management (e.g., Team Manager, Study Manager, Director, etc.).

The Quality Associate is responsible for building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal staff/external vendors. The ideal candidate will be responsive, thoughtful, self-motivated, highly organized, and a team-player. This role reports directly to the VP of Compliance.

Under supervision of a mentor/coach, the Quality Associate will be responsible for:

Duties and Responsibilities:

Quality Duties:

  • Responsible for quality control checks on study documents related to the conduct of the clinical trial in different therapeutic areas and phases
  • Audits phases of laboratory and clinical studies, reports, and performs related duties (e.g., issues findings and QA statements)
  • Will also support training for site staff, this include creating and presenting quality content.
  • Audits all disciplines (examples of disciplines include Screening, Recruiting, Clinical Operations, Laboratory, Data Services)
  • Assist with writing QA audit or QC reports
  • Works with internal clinical research team to ensure that inspection findings are clearly communicated and understood
  • Evaluates inspection finding responses to ensure they are written to address the findings appropriately
  • Ensures through phase and data inspections that the SOPs, which are involved in the conduct of a study, are current and practiced
  • Introduction to in-life audits, process audits, and vendor audits
  • Identifies and communicates opportunities for process improvement based on audit and inspection observations
  • Maintains necessary documentation of QA records and study files
  • Notifies management of observed quality and compliance trends in the areas inspected
  • Interprets GCP, and associated regulatory documents to facilitate auditing and process improvement recommendations
  • Carries out appropriate self-development efforts as directed
  • Performs other related duties as assigned


Regulatory Duties:

  • Ensures that the research site follows standard operating procedures, sponsor/CRO requirements, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, ICH guidelines, and good clinical practices pertaining to the conduct of clinical pharmaceutical and device protocols
  • Maintains subject and document confidentiality, understands, and complies with the appropriate sponsor requirements, regulations including the Food and Drug Administration, good clinical practice (GCP), International Conference on Harmonization (ICH), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Institutional Review Boards (IRB), and institutional policies and procedures
  • Works under limited supervision to assure compliance with federal regulations relating to human subject research
  • Understands and applies ethical principles and multiple regulations to clinical research protocols
  • Review study protocols, informed consent documents, and other study-related documentation, to assure conformance with all applicable requirements
  • Prepares, maintains, and provides oversight to all research-related regulatory documents
  • Populates and coordinates the entire process of initial regulatory documents' submission to the IRB, sponsors, and state or federal regulatory offices as necessary
  • Compiles study information and submits initial, continuing, and final reports to the IRB and/or sponsor
  • Prepares applicable submission forms and submits updated documents, including but not limited to amendments, addendums, investigator's brochures, safety information, form FDA 1572s, and informed consent documents
  • Accurately files and maintains all necessary logs within the regulatory binder(s), assists in and manages the archival of clinical trial documents/records
  • Prepares for monitoring visits and audits
  • Manages and updates employee curriculum vitas and ensures copies of all current and applicable medical licenses are on file
  • Creates error free written documents and reports such as cover letters, notes-to-file, and memos
  • Exercises judgement within the allowable limits defined within clinical trials protocols, standard operating procedures, and under the direction from the study Investigator and supervisor
  • Interacts with internal and external personnel, including but not limited to physicians, nurses, research staff members, administration staff, industry sponsor representatives, IRBs, central laboratory/imaging personnel, and clinical trial patients and attends site initiation visits
  • Coordinates multiple projects with competing priorities and deadlines, as needed based on clinical trial protocol directives and study volume
  • Other duties as assigned


Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in scientific area of study or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Previous experience in a clinical research environment or equivalent work environment
  • 2-4 years of previous experience as regulatory and/or quality associate in clinical research
  • Knowledge of regulations governing clinical research (CFR, GCP, HIPAA) preferred
  • Proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  • Familiarity with clinical trial management system software, preferably Clinical Research IO
  • Basic medical knowledge, including medical terminology
  • Demonstrated competence in oral and written communication
  • Must complete CITI and GCP training certification
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and outstanding time management, including keen attention to detail
  • Possess impeccable integrity and personal and professional values that are consistent with PCR’s high standards and mission
  • Comply with the company policies, code of ethics, and guiding values at all times

Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Detail oriented with the ability to perform at a high level of accuracy
  • Proactive at identifying and addressing issues in real time
  • Must be flexible with changing priorities and able to communicate in a diplomatic and professional manner
  • Must handle confidential matters and sensitive information with discretion and judgment
  • Ability to research regulatory issues and provide recommendations for resolution
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to manage small projects and work independently
  • Ability to understand and interpret clinical research protocols and other applicable sponsor documents

Work Environment and Physical demands:

The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Work is performed in an office/laboratory and/or a clinical environment.
  • Exposure to biological fluids and/or bloodborne pathogens.
  • Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves.
  • Travel between two NJ sites is required
  • Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for 6-10 hours per day.
  • Frequent mobility required.
  • Occasionally squatting, kneeling, or bending.
  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including medical equipment with a maximum lift of 20-50 lbs.

Salary and Benefits:

Pinnacle Clinical Research provides each of our team members with opportunities for personal and professional growth in a team-oriented working environment. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits, and the chance to grow professionally in the healthcare industry. The salary range for this position will be commensurate with experience.

  • 401k
  • Medical, dental, vision, long term disability, short term disability, HSA, and life insurance
  • 3 weeks of paid time off
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • Scrub voucher (specific positions apply)
  • And more!

Pinnacle Clinical Research is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, gender, national origin, age, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status or any other protected Federal, State/Province or Local status unrelated to the performance of the work involved.

title: Content Director (USA)
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Role Description – Content Director, USA


About Greenpark

Greenpark is a global, award-winning digital agency specializing in LLM visibility, search and social. Our raison d’être is to create amazing content that people and algorithms love. How? Through data-led and performance-driven search and social content to help brands create meaningful connections that impact people's lives. Our unique expertise in Omnichannel Search & Insights, Creative Content and Performance Tech is delivered to our clients via an ad agency and in-house models. We do this for a global client portfolio including Unilever, Campari Group, AIA, Opella, Nestlé, Lipton, Kimberly-Clark, Straumann, Ricola, Globe Telecom, and more.


Want the real inside scoop? Our Playbook gives you a peek into how we work, collaborate, and get things done at Greenpark. Check it out here



Our Values

As a company, we strive and act together in our ambition to make a positive impact for the people and brands we serve, we do everything with kindness and respect at the core. ‘We Strive’, ‘Acting Together’, ‘With Kindness’ are the values that guide us.



About the role

As Omnichannel Content Director, you will lead content strategy and delivery across both web and social for a portfolio of our US clients, spanning Greenpark’s verticals including food and drink, health and pharmaceuticals, beauty and wellness, and luxury. Based in the US, you’ll own an integrated content offering that works equally hard on site and on social – from search-led articles and product pages to social-first content and community – built to be found wherever people search: on Google, on platforms such as TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, and in AI assistants and LLMs such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Based in the USA, you’ll help to lead a multidisciplinary team of editors, writers and social specialists, champion the smart adoption of AI across our content workflows, and partner closely with our Search & Insights, Digital PR, Influencer and Performance Tech teams. You’ll report to the Head of Content.

What you’ll do

  • Set up and own omnichannel content strategy for a portfolio of US clients, creating a single narrative that activates cohesively across websites, social platforms and AI search.
  • Lead the delivery of performance-driven web and social content – from articles and product pages to social-first content – built on search, social and audience insight.
  • Drive client visibility wherever people search, championing LLM visibility (GEO/AEO) and social search alongside SEO.
  • Lead, mentor and grow a multidisciplinary team of editors, writers, strategists and social specialists, setting clear standards for quality and performance.
  • Champion AI adoption across the content team, embedding tools and workflows with clear quality standards and guardrails, and upskilling the team to use them well.
  • Set and govern tone of voice, editorial guidelines and ways of working – including team structures, processes and workflows – putting performance and efficiency at the heart of everything you do.
  • Act as a senior client partner, presenting strategy, performance and recommendations, and contribute to new business and the development of Greenpark’s content services.
  • Collaborate closely with our Search & Insights, Digital PR, Influencer and Performance Tech teams, and stay ahead of developments in search, social and AI.
  • Stay ahead of developments in search, social platforms and AI – including how AI models surface and cite content – and feed this insight into client strategy and Greenpark’s wider service offering.



About you

  • Significant experience (10+ years) leading and developing high-performing content teams, with a collaborative, mentoring style and a focus on delivery at pace.
  • Deep expertise across both web content and social media, with a proven ability to shape storytelling that performs on websites, on social platforms and in search.
  • A strong grasp of SEO and content for LLM visibility (GEO/AEO), including how to create and structure content that ranks in search and is cited by AI models.
  • A strong understanding of social platforms, best-practice content formats and social search, with hands-on experience of social listening and community management tools.
  • Fluent in omnichannel content planning and strategy, with experience aligning paid, organic, web and social activity.
  • An expert understanding of web, search and social analytics, with the ability to turn data into insight and clear recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and specialist content tools) to content workflows and leading teams through AI adoption; experience developing AI guidelines or governance frameworks is a strong advantage.
  • Agency experience across a range of sectors – including food and drink, health and pharmaceuticals, beauty and wellness, and luxury – with the ability to adapt tone, compliance and storytelling to each audience.
  • Confident with clients, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders and contributing to new business.
  • Based in the US with a strong understanding of the US market, and comfortable working within a global company across time zones.
  • You live & breathe Greenpark’s core values ‘We Strive’, ‘Acting Together’, ‘With Kindness’ -
    championing openness, respect, innovation, and teamwork - so that every interaction, both internally and externally, reflects our commitment to our values.

How we’ll support you

  • 25 days of holidays + US bank holidays and your birthday off.
  • Christmas Closure - (extra days on top of your holiday allowance)
  • A monthly entertainment subscription paid by the company (e.g. Amazon Prime, Netflix, Spotify, etc)
  • Access to VDU Eye Tests and Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).
  • Participate in wellness and peer recognition initiatives (e.g. On The Spot Awards and Value Champion Awards).
  • LinkedIn Learning – Access to a leading online learning platform, which offers a wide variety of courses including business, creative and technical skills.
  • Social Events – Join us for our major annual social events: Spring, Summer, Halloween and Christmas parties, plus many other ad-hoc events.

title: Applied Research Engineer, Evaluation
description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX — foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and videos. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

Frontier image and video models are now good enough that the hard question is no longer whether they work, but whether a new one is actually better, and how you'd know. Aesthetics, prompt following, editing fidelity, text rendering, character consistency: none of these collapse into a single number, and public benchmarks have fallen well behind the models they're meant to measure.

You'll work on the system BFL uses to answer that question. Every FLUX checkpoint, every finetuning and RL run, and every competitor release goes through our evaluation stack, and you'll help build and sharpen it. Product Research relies on what it shows to decide what to fix next, and to confirm the fix worked.

It gets harder from here. FLUX 3 is our first multimodal model, spanning image, video, audio and action, and each new modality needs its own way of being measured.

What You'll Work On

What you focus on will depend on where you're strongest and what the team needs most when you join.

In scope:

  • Building and maintaining the evaluation stack that every model checkpoint has to pass through and prove itself on, from automated benchmarking and LLM-as-judge pipelines, to human evaluation through panels (Prolific and otherwise).

  • Designing the breadth of evaluation across the taxonomy, from prompt adherence, editing fidelity, aesthetics, text rendering, subject and character consistency, to safety.

  • Evaluating the evaluation stack itself: checking that human and automated evals agree, that results stay stable over time, and improving them when they don't.

  • Benchmarking FLUX against the frontier models continuously, while obtaining a meaningful perspective on where we are better or worse than competitors and what such differences really mean.

  • Finding the ways in which the quality of the model's output falls short that are not captured by aggregate numbers.

  • Closing the loop, ideally, with the RL and finetuning researchers, by defining target metrics for them to aim for, and verifying that a new checkpoint improved the weakness without introducing new ones.

  • Designing how best to exploit the signals we already capture through the API and MCP, and what new signals we should capture, with help from research, data engineering and legal.

  • Maintaining the usefulness of existing metrics as their natural lifecycle brings up concerns of gaming and overfitting, and anticipating this for new metrics.

What We're Looking For

You have made meaningful contributions to the evaluation of generative models already. You understand that a benchmark figure without careful consideration of sample size and judge agreement with humans is at best uninformed optimism and at worst dangerously misleading, and you have been the person that found that inconvenient regression that nobody wanted to talk about.

You likely have:

  • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a relevant field or demonstrated equivalent practical experience

  • Practical experience with evaluating generative models, in a hands-on way. You may have worked with diffusion or flow-matching based image or video models already, but the capability to evaluate them in earnest transfers to other modalities too

  • Very strong Python and software engineering skills, with pipelines that run reliably and that other people can read if needed

  • Working knowledge of PyTorch and modern ML infrastructure and practices; you are not a pure Python developer, you know what the modern ML code looks like

  • Strong grasp of statistics and its shortcomings in practice, and how to work with those; sample sizes, inter-annotator agreement, confidence levels, etc., and a healthy skepticism about what those numbers say about the world

  • Practical experience with building and operating LLM-as-judge systems, and understanding their limitations

  • Working knowledge of modern benchmarking practices and of standard datasets and benchmarks in the field already; you have an idea of which to trust and which to disregard

  • The inclination to look at the actual outputs your system is judging, and to care about what is there beyond an aggregate score

We'd be especially excited if you:

  • Have practical experience with human evaluation, including study design and execution via panels, and analysis of disagreements and annotator performance

  • Have worked where evaluation meets training (reward models, preference data, RLHF, DPO or similar) and know that whatever you optimize for is what the model learns

  • Have evaluated agentic or multi-step systems and know how hard it is to attribute success or failure to a single step

  • Have built tools that people actually want to use internally

  • Have made public contributions to the field: papers, open source, or otherwise

How We Work Together

We're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in Freiburg, where you'll join us at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. We'll discuss what this will look like during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation : €150K-€220K base + equity depending on experience

title: Director, Leadership & Org. Training
description:

description:

Etsimme aitoa alan ammattilaista, jolla on jo vahva kokemus massalattioiden (esim. epoksi-, polyuretaani- tai akryylimassat) pohjatöistä, sekoituksesta, levityksestä ja viimeistelystä.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Vankkaa ammattitaitoa ja aiempaa kokemusta massalattia-asennuksista sekä pohjatöistä

* Itsenäistä, huolellista ja laatuun sitoutunutta työotetta

* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia (tulityökortti ja muut ammattikortit katsotaan eduksi)

* B-ajokorttia

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Vakituisen ja pitkäaikaisen työpaikan

* Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen: 17,00–25,00 €/h (Rakennusalan TES / neuvoteltavissa täysin ammattitaidon ja kokemuksen mukaan)

* Epassi-henkilöstöedun

Sijainti: Reissutyö (nykyiset/tulevat kohteet: Imatra, Kouvola, Pirkkala, Uusimaa)

Työsuhde: Vakituinen

Palkkaus: 17,00–25,00 €/h (Rakennusalan TES) + päivärahat ja reissukorvaukset

Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan / heti


Asiakkaastamme, työstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.

Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!



---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Peer Outreach Specialist
description:
TITLE: Peer Outreach Specialist


JOB SUMMARY:

The Peer Outreach Specialist conducts outreach activities with a focus on chronically homeless and highly vulnerable individuals. The Peer Outreach Specialist is a member of the Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) that will provide services to clients on the streets and in encampments. They will address the individuals’ immediate needs and work to engage them in the housing process.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS INCLUDE, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Conducts team-based and individual outreach activities to engage chronically homeless individuals toward pursuing permanent housing options.
  • Receives, assesses, and triages referrals from walk-ins and other collaborative partners.
  • Conducts standardized screening and triages chronically homeless individuals as part of a multidisciplinary outreach team, including experts in mental health, substance use, and physical health, including nursing/medical staff.
  • Assists individuals with collecting documents necessary for applying for permanent supportive housing.
  • Attends case conferencing meetings to coordinate services with other providers.
  • Connects individuals to supportive services as needed, such as mental health, health, substance abuse, employment, etc.
  • Documents services and completes data entry into HMIS database.
  • Provide linkage to mainstream resources, such as DPSS or Social Security Disability.
  • Provide transportation assistance for the purposes of stabilizing the current housing crisis.
  • Conduct follow-up activities to ensure completion of the crisis-housing plan.
  • Identify appropriate interventions to address and resolve the homeless status of program participants.
  • Assist individuals with accessing permanent housing opportunities, including permanent supportive housing, move-in assistance, shared housing, affordable housing, etc.
  • Other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Work indoors in a temperature-controlled environment and occasionally exposed to outdoor weather and driving conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Stand and sit for long periods of time; move and walk to various locations; climb stairs, stoop, kneel, reach, pull, push, bend, twist, and occasionally lift and/or move objects. Use hands and fingers to handle or feel.
  • See, hear, and speak clearly to give and receive information and instructions.
  • Ability to interact with other employees, clients, customers, and members of the public.
  • Ability to work effectively under time constraints, prioritize work, multi-task, and adapt to changing work demands.
  • Gather, analyze, synthesize, and classify information. Transcribe, enter, and post data.
  • Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or complaints.
  • Requires use of a computer keyboard.
  • Travel to off-site meetings.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of emergency housing, transitional, and permanent housing resources throughout Los Angeles County preferred.
  • Knowledge of housing issues in San Gabriel Valley preferred.
  • Knowledge of HUD guidelines and experience working with subsidized housing programs such as Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, and others preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing preferred.
  • Proficient in use of laptop computer and Microsoft Windows and Office software programs (Word, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Gmail) preferred.
  • Ability to accurately enter client data and notes in the Homeless Management Information System preferred.
  • Proficient with office communication equipment and machines (telephone, copier, calculator, fax machine, personal computer, laptop, computer printer and scanner) preferred.
  • Possess a valid California driver's license and have access to a properly registered vehicle preferred.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Personal familiarity with homelessness - having experienced homelessness.
  • Completion of a peer case manager or peer advocacy program preferred.

Union Station Homeless Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Lead Engineer, Transmission Lines
description:
Workplace Type: Hybrid


About Us:

Pickett, an ESP Associates company, is a highly innovative surveying and engineering company with over 60 years of industry experience serving clients throughout the US and Caribbean.

At Pickett, we use the acronym S.O.L.V.E. to define our core values that include: Safety first, Outstanding service, Lasting relationships, Valued teamwork and Engaged culture.

“We solve the problems that matter” and we are always looking to add passionate, motivated, and qualified individuals to our rapidly expanding team.

About The Role:

As a Lead Engineer, you will provide leadership and senior-level engineering/technical expertise on complex electric transmission design projects for high-voltage (HV) and extra high-voltage (EHV) overhead utility systems.

Some of the main responsibilities will be to ensure the team is meeting client requirements; both quality and schedule deadlines as well as ensuring the team is engaged and their input is valued. We want to inspire our team members to produce at the level of excellence for which Pickett is known.

This role will require you to be hands-on and manage, prepare, review and/or provide guidance for line routing, survey coordination, PLS-CADD modeling, structure design, foundation design, clearance checks, plan/profile development, material specification and procurement, constructability evaluations, work order package preparation, permitting, vendor/subcontractor coordination and construction support.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Supervise a team of engineers, technicians, and drafters
  • Communicate clear expectations, goals, and vision
  • Manage the performance of the team and delegate project work
  • Motivate, coach and mentor team members
  • Manage projects, ensure quality of work and on-time delivery
  • Review and approve engineering design submittals
  • Develop lasting relationships with clients
  • Estimate projects and develop proposals

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (required)
  • Professional Engineer (PE) certification (required)
  • 10+ years of related transmission line engineering experience in the electric utility industry (required)
  • Extensive experience using PLS-CADD (required)
  • Extensive experience with design codes and standards such as: NESC, IEEE, ASCE and ACI
  • Extensive experience liaising with substation, environmental, real estate, construction, and maintenance stakeholders
  • Deep understanding of industry standards and methods (engineering, procurement, and construction)
  • Strong project management skills and experience
  • Ability to work in a safe manner and always obey safety regulations
  • Adept self-starter who thrives in an unstructured, varied and deadline-driven work environment
  • Strong leadership skills and ability to coach other team members and provide direction for projects
  • Strong ability to collaborate with team members as well as peers in the electrical utility industry
  • Effective business and technical communication skills (verbal, written and presentation)
  • Candidate must be able to pass a drug screen, background check, and have a satisfactory driving record in accordance with the company’s driving (MVR) policy.

So...Why Join Us?

You will have the opportunity to learn, grow and directly contribute to our business. You will also have a very visible and tangible impact by solving real world problems.

You will contribute significantly to the growth and development of our company while also continuing to be challenged and inspired along the way!

Pickett offers an excellent employee benefits package including:

  • Competitive compensation with yearly performance reviews and discretionary annual bonuses
  • 401(k) (Traditional & Roth plans) with a guaranteed employer match of 100% up to the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% (eligibility after 60 days)
  • PTO (Paid Time Off) & 10 Paid Holidays

  • Pet Insurance

  • Flexible and Dependent Benefits Plan
  • Referral Bonuses

title: Partner Success Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Partner Success Coordinator
Location: Dallas, TX and surrounding areas
Employment Type: Full-Time, Hybrid


About MarcoPolo Learning
MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners. Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale.


Position Overview:
We’re looking for a driven Partner Success Coordinator based in Dallas, TX to join our growing team. You’ll help build and maintain strong relationships with our partners across Texas, supporting them from onboarding through renewal.


This is a travel-heavy, field-based role. You’ll be on the road regularly, visiting partner sites, classrooms, and early learning centers in and around Dallas and throughout Texas. Expect frequent local travel and regular overnight trips within the state. A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and enjoying time in the field are essential.

This role is ideal for someone with a hustle mentality and a passion for education. It is hybrid, and the candidate must live in or near Dallas, TX. You may occasionally need to work outside standard business hours, including some evenings and weekends, to support partner needs.


Growth Path: This role is designed as a stepping stone. Strong performers will have a clear path to a Partner Success Manager role, with more ownership of strategic partner accounts and success strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Travel frequently to partner sites in and around Dallas and across Texas for onsite visits, training sessions, and check-ins.
  • Build and maintain trust-based relationships with partners.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for partner questions, support, and engagement.
  • Conduct regular onsite visits to assess satisfaction and gather feedback.
  • Support the design and rollout of onboarding for new partners.
  • Help carry out the partner success strategy in line with company goals.
  • Identify opportunities for partner growth, collaboration, and retention.
  • Deliver training and resources that drive successful product adoption.
  • Act as a liaison between partners and internal teams so issues are resolved quickly.
  • Track and analyze partner data to spot trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Prepare reports on partner performance and success metrics.
  • Work with sales, marketing, and product teams.
  • Help resolve customer issues across the wider partner base.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in education or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a preschool or elementary school teacher, preferably in a public school setting.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently, including regular overnight travel within Texas.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
  • Proven initiative, grit, and self-motivation; resilient when things get hard.
  • Passionate advocate for early childhood education.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Your customers love working with you.
  • Comfortable working with data and turning insights into action.

title: Blaster/Paint Prepper
description:
SUMMARY OF THE POSITION:

This position is responsible for the tube vehicle from initial separation of the tubes, through the restoration process and again when the tubes are reloaded back on the vehicle. title: Keittiöapulainen / tiskaaja, osa-aikainen, OJAKKALA
description:
Haemme reipasta keittiöapulaista töihin Ojakkalaan! Tarjolla on osa-aikainen työ. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme Epassin!
Etsimme keittiöapulaista / tiskaajaa avustamaan ravintolan päivittäisissä tehtävissä. Työtä on tarjolla 20-30 h / viikko. Et välttämättä tarvitse vuosien aikaisempaa kokemusta, vaan asenne ratkaisee! Tehtäviisi kuuluu astiahuolto, keittiön siisteydestä huolehtiminen, kuormien purku ja kaikenlaiset avustavat tehtävävät.
Tässä tehtävässä noudetaan Maran työehtosopimusta. Palkka on tessin mukaan vähintään 11,97 € / h.
Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!


---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Coding Auditor

description:
Coding Auditor

AllCare Health | Quality Department | Grants Pass, Oregon

We Are Seeking Qualified Candidates to Join Our Team!

AllCare Health offers competitive wages and an excellent benefits package, including affordable healthcare, 401(k) retirement, wellness programs, and flexible scheduling options.

Summary of the Position

The Coding Auditor is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining auditing practices related to medical record coding and documentation to support accurate and complete risk adjustment outcomes for Medicare members.

This position reviews medical records and coding for accuracy and compliance with Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) requirements, identifies coding and documentation trends, and works collaboratively with providers and internal teams to improve documentation, coding accuracy, and risk adjustment outcomes.

Essential Duties

  1. Ensures the accuracy and correlation of diagnosis codes, dates of service, medical record documentation, and other information used to support risk adjustment.

  2. Identifies, analyzes, and communicates trends related to coding accuracy and documentation quality.

  3. Develops and supports intervention and education strategies for healthcare providers to improve coding and documentation practices.

Job Duties

  • Supports and contributes to AllCare’s mission, vision, and values.

  • Reviews medical records and supporting documentation to ensure accurate Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding and provides appropriate recommendations.

  • Performs medical record reviews, including prospective, retrospective, and concurrent reviews, in accordance with established processes and timelines.

  • Performs data analysis and prepares reports to support internal operations and external risk adjustment requirements.

  • Maintains established productivity expectations and addresses assigned work queues within required timeframes.

  • Maintains a minimum 95% accuracy standard across assigned coding and auditing projects.

  • Identifies coding and documentation trends and provides coaching, feedback, and education to support coding accuracy and continuous improvement.

  • Develops audit reports and communicates findings to providers and internal stakeholders in a clear, constructive, and actionable manner.

  • Supports complex internal audits in accordance with established auditing standards, procedures, timelines, and management direction.

  • Supports HEDIS medical chart auditing activities as needed.

  • Supports compliance efforts by comparing medical record documentation with claims data and identifying discrepancies.

  • Collects, organizes, analyzes, and communicates data to internal and external stakeholders to support quality and process improvement.

  • Assists with the development and presentation of corrective action plans when coding, documentation, or control weaknesses are identified and monitors progress through resolution.

  • Collaborates with the Provider Engagement team on provider outreach and education using coding expertise, audit findings, analytics, and industry best practices.

  • Develops and maintains training materials related to medical record abstraction, data entry, HEDIS, risk adjustment, and applicable auditing processes.

  • Researches coding guidance and participates in continuing education as necessary to maintain required professional certification.

  • Monitors and maintains compliance with HIPAA requirements, organizational policies, and applicable regulatory standards.

  • Maintains current knowledge of coding guidelines, payer requirements, CMS regulations, and risk adjustment requirements.

  • Prepares reports, documentation, and other materials as required.

  • Maintains punctual, regular, and predictable attendance.

  • Works collaboratively within a team environment.

  • Respectfully receives and follows direction from leadership.

  • Completes all required training, including assigned Relias Learning Management System (LMS) training.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

On-Call Responsibilities

This position does not have any on-call responsibilities.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position does not have any supervisory responsibilities.

Job Requirements

  • May require the use of a personal cell phone. A cell phone stipend may be provided in accordance with organizational policy.

  • Must be able to maintain all required professional certifications and continuing education requirements.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation. The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for the position.

Being bilingual in another language, including American Sign Language (ASL), is an invaluable skill that enhances our ability to deliver culturally responsive care. We strongly encourage bilingual candidates to apply.

Education

  • Completion of applicable coding, health information management, medical billing, or related postsecondary education or training preferred.

Experience

  • Two or more years of related coding experience required, including experience with Medicare and/or commercial risk adjustment.

  • Experience with Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding and medical record documentation review.

  • Experience interpreting medical records, coding guidelines, and supporting documentation to determine coding accuracy.

  • Experience with risk adjustment auditing, medical record review, or related coding quality activities preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, and/or Registrations

  • Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC) certification required or must be obtained within 12 months of hire.

  • Additional coding or auditing certifications, such as CPC, CCS, or CPMA, preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Medicare and commercial risk adjustment methodologies, including HCC coding.

  • Knowledge of CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) requirements and audit processes.

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM coding guidelines and medical terminology.

  • Knowledge of medical record documentation requirements and coding compliance standards.

  • Knowledge of healthcare industry requirements and HIPAA regulations.

  • Ability to review and interpret medical records, claims data, coding documentation, and audit findings.

  • Ability to analyze data, identify trends and discrepancies, and develop meaningful recommendations.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet established deadlines.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Communicates professionally and constructively with providers, employees, leadership, and other stakeholders.

  • Builds positive working relationships and collaborates effectively across departments and disciplines.

  • Synthesizes information from multiple sources to identify and resolve problems.

  • Demonstrates initiative, sound judgment, and appropriate independent decision-making.

  • Adapts effectively to changing requirements, priorities, and regulatory guidance.

Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from providers, employees, leaders, and other stakeholders.

Mathematical Skills

Candidates outside the area must be willing to relocate to Southern Oregon at their own expense. This position is not eligible for fully remote work, and relocation assistance is not provided.

Company Overview

AllCare Health is incorporated as an Oregon Benefit Corporation and has maintained Certified B Corporation® status since 2017. As such, AllCare Health considers its impact on the community, society, and the environment in its business decisions.

AllCare Health headquarters are located in Grants Pass in Southern Oregon along the Rogue River, surrounded by mountains, forests, small farms, and scenic views. The region offers access to outdoor recreation, including rafting, fishing, hiking, biking, wineries, outdoor concerts, the Oregon Coast, redwood forests, and more.

Purpose | Working together with our communities to improve the health and well-being of everyone.

Values | Trust, Innovation, Relationships, and Voice.

Vision | Thriving, Inclusive, and Equitable communities.

Brand Promise | Changing Healthcare to Work for You.

AllCare Health is dedicated to building a diverse and authentic workplace centered on belonging and serving our growing community. title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
DevSecOps Engineer

Houston, TX

About Intuitive Machines:

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

About the Position:

We are looking for a DevOps engineer to help build, automate, and support the infrastructure and CI/CD systems our engineering and mission teams rely on. Most of our environment is on-prem, with some AWS, so you will work hands-on with servers, pipelines, and the tools that tie them together.

Responsibilities:

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for builds, testing, artifacts, and deployments
  • Automate server provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools so environments are consistent and repeatable
  • Administer and troubleshoot Linux systems, including services, permissions, storage, and performance issues
  • Deploy and support containerized applications, including testing changes and rolling back when needed
  • Set up monitoring and alerting, investigate failures, and fix recurring problems at the root cause
  • Check backups and test restores for the systems you support
  • Handle secrets, service accounts, and access in line with security requirements
  • Document your work so other team members can support and maintain it
  • Work with developers, IT, and security on network, access, and infrastructure needs
  • Take part in incident response and follow up on fixes

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure, or systems engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Strong Linux administration skills and the ability to troubleshoot problems independently
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
  • Comfortable with Git workflows, including branching, merge requests, tagging, and releases
  • Scripting in Python and/or Bash to automate tasks, with good logging and error handling
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, Ansible, or other configuration management tools
  • Experience building, running, and troubleshooting Docker containers and registries
  • Solid networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and TLS
  • Experience using logs and metrics to track down and resolve issues
  • Works well independently, communicates clearly, and keeps others updated on progress

Preferred Requirements:

  • On-prem infrastructure experience with physical servers and virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V, or Proxmox)
  • HPC clusters, job schedulers, or compute-heavy workloads
  • Administering self-hosted GitLab and runners
  • AWS experience (IAM, VPC, EC2, S3), including GovCloud
  • Monitoring and secrets tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, HashiCorp Vault, or OpenBao
  • Background in aerospace, test labs, or other regulated engineering environments

title: Internal AI Enablement Lead
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: .

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s internal AI and automation capabilities into something every function can confidently use, build with, and learn from.

To make that happen, you’ll create the programs, experiences, and foundations that help teams across n8n build their AI and automation fluency:

DRIVE HANDS-ON ENABLEMENT

  • Run weekly, role-specific workshops, prioritizing less-technical functions such as Legal and Customer Support.

  • Lead hands-on sessions where you build live alongside teams, helping them turn real workflows and challenges into working automations.

  • Run Build Along Office Hours and Bounty Hunts that give teams regular opportunities to learn, experiment, and solve problems together.

  • Help teams identify useful automation opportunities, understand the process they are changing, and decide when to reuse an existing solution, build themselves, or involve the Automation team.

OWN DOGFOODING & EXPERIMENTATION

  • Own our monthly Dogfooding Day end-to-end, from planning and coordination through execution and follow-up.

  • Design and run hackathons and other experimentation initiatives that encourage teams to explore new ways of working with AI and automation.

  • Turn learnings and outputs from these initiatives into reusable assets that help other teams move faster.

SCALE AI FLUENCY & COMMUNITY

  • Own periodic AI fluency survey cycles alongside the People team and help calibrate what fluency means across different functions.

  • Build visibility around internal wins and reusable solutions so teams can learn from what others have already created.

  • Identify and support champions across functions, informally leading the emerging Guild and helping automation knowledge spread across the company.

ENABLE SAFE, REUSABLE AUTOMATION

  • Act as product owner for our internal “safe playground,” partnering with IT, Security, Data, and Solutions Engineering on access, credentials, environments, and requirements.

  • Turn outputs from workshops and office hours into reusable templates and resources that teams can easily discover and adopt.

  • Actively help teams reuse existing solutions rather than reinventing them, making automation more accessible and scalable across n8n.

  • Check whether the things built are still in use four weeks later; provide evidence that teams reuse existing assets and can make routine changes without handing everything back to the Automation team.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🛠️ Practitioner-level n8n fluency: You’ve built real, meaningful automations in n8n and are comfortable building live alongside others.

  • 🎓 Technical enablement experience: You’ve run structured, recurring enablement programs such as workshops, office hours, or build-alongs.

  • 🤝 Non-technical audience expertise: You have a strong track record of helping non-technical teams understand, adopt, and confidently use technical tools.

  • 🏗️ Cross-functional ownership: You’re comfortable partnering with IT, Security, and Data teams to define and own requirements around access, credentials, and environments without needing to implement the infrastructure yourself.

  • 🌍 CET overlap: You’re based in a time zone that gives you strong overlap with Central European working hours, within a couple of hours of Berlin.

  • 💬 English fluency: You have fluent or near-native English and can communicate clearly and confidently with audiences ranging from individual contributors to senior stakeholders.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🌱 Champion programs: You’ve helped build or run an internal ambassador, champion, or community program.

  • 📊 Fluency measurement: You have experience running capability, fluency, or adoption surveys and turning the results into actionable programs.

  • 🔐 Access & governance: You’re familiar with access or governance models and have worked with stakeholders responsible for secure environments and tooling.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll have the opportunity to build a brand-new enablement function from the ground up and shape how AI and automation become part of everyday work across the company. You’ll have a direct line to the Head of AI & Automation, high visibility across functions, and genuine autonomy to design an enablement model rather than inherit one.

As n8n scales, you’ll become a key connector between the people building our internal automation capabilities and the teams putting them to work. You’ll help create a culture where teams don’t just learn about automation — they confidently build, experiment, share what works, and help others do the same.

You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company that values autonomy, experimentation, and builder culture, with the opportunity to influence how we scale AI fluency across the organization.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ().

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
