Department Description

Technology sits at the centre of Allica. We design and build the platforms that power the bank, working closely with every part of the business to deliver real impact for customers. Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence.

What makes us different is the level of influence and autonomy engineers have. We work without the weight of legacy systems, which means we can focus on building for the future. Everyone contributes ideas and helps shape how we operate, and roles evolve as the organisation grows. This is a place for people who want to have a tangible impact and do their best work in a modern, collaborative environment.

Role Description

The Staff Full Stack Engineer is responsible for setting technical direction across multiple squads, typically overseeing 2–3 squads and line-managing 3–5 Full Stack Engineers. The role exists to shape architecture, ensure the success of these squads, and drive consistent, secure, and compliant delivery across Allica’s digital products.

You will use your expertise in Spring Boot microservices (Java/Kotlin) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript) to define and evolve cross-squad patterns, shared tooling, and platform capabilities.

Our backend microservices are containerised and deployed to Azure Container Apps, and our web applications are deployed to Azure Static Web Apps; you will help define and uphold the standards that make these platforms robust, cost-effective, and easy to operate.

You will own key cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, observability, performance, accessibility, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our systems meet the standards expected of a UK bank.

You are hands-on: you design and review architectures, pair with engineers, and contribute code to high-impact initiatives.

You work closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders to align technical direction with business goals and to unblock delivery.

You drive the responsible adoption of GenAI and agentic engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), setting organisation-wide standards and measuring impact.

Success in this role is reflected in simpler architectures, improved delivery consistency and reliability, stronger engineering effectiveness, and the growth and performance of your direct reports and squads.

Principal Accountabilities

Set and evolve cross-squad technical patterns and guardrails for:

  • Backend services (Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/OpenAPI, messaging, integrations).

  • Frontend architectures (React/TypeScript, shared design system, Nx, micro frontends where appropriate).

  • Authentication/authorisation, API gateways and API governance (versioning, contracts, deprecation).

  • Own platform-level technical initiatives that reduce complexity and duplication, including shared libraries, design system tokens, infrastructure templates, observability frameworks, and code/scaffolding templates.

  • Define and maintain organisation-wide standards for performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and operational excellence, in partnership with Architecture, InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance.

  • Establish and improve SLOs, error budget policies, and incident management practices across key services; lead post-incident reviews and drive follow-through on structural fixes.

  • Lead cross-squad system design for complex initiatives, ensuring coherent architectures, well-managed dependencies, clear domain boundaries, and effective interactions between services and frontends.

  • Shape and continuously improve cloud-native deployment patterns on Azure (Container Apps, Static Web Apps, networking, configuration, and scaling), working closely with Platform Engineering teams.

  • Drive improvements to developer experience (CI/CD, local development workflows, test strategy, release processes) across multiple squads, leveraging GitHub, Azure DevOps and other approved tools.

Define and champion responsible AI-assisted engineering practices, including:

  • Standards for using Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and other approved GenAI tools.

  • Expectations for review and validation of AI-generated code.

  • Measurement and optimisation of productivity gains and quality improvements.

  • Mentor and line-manage Senior Full Stack Engineers, supporting their growth in technical leadership, people leadership, and impact across squads.

  • Foster a culture of learning and continuous improvement through communities of practice, architecture forums, and regular knowledge-sharing.

  • Influence and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders (Product, Design, Operations, Risk, Compliance), aligning technical strategies with product and business roadmaps.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale using Spring Boot (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript).

  • Proven track record of simplifying complex architectures and defining cross-team patterns and platforms in a multi-squad environment.

  • Solid experience with containerised workloads and cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or Google Cloud also valuable), including deployment, monitoring, and scaling of microservices and web applications.

  • Deep understanding of secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP), privacy, auditability, and regulatory expectations in financial services or similarly regulated environments.

  • Strong experience with observability, SLOs, incident management, and operational excellence (logging, tracing, metrics, dashboards, on-call practices).

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices, ideally using GiHub actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and automated testing at multiple levels.

  • Experience designing and governing APIs at scale (REST, OpenAPI, API gateways, versioning, backwards compatibility, service contracts).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical programmes or initiatives that span multiple teams and systems, delivering measurable improvements to reliability, performance, or developer productivity.

  • Experience introducing and scaling the use of new tools and standards across organisations, including GenAI technologies (e.g. GitHub Copilot) with appropriate guardrails.

  • Proven people leadership experience: line-managing senior engineers, coaching technical leaders, and building high-performing, inclusive teams.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicate trade-offs clearly, and build consensus.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Assistant Controller (Remote, US)
description:
About Us

American Clinical Research Services Opco LLC (ACRS) is an organization dedicated to advancing clinical research and expanding access to new treatment opportunities. ACRS is comprised of two entities: Empathx Clinical Research and Clinical Site Services (CSS). Empathx Clinical Research conducts clinical trials across three research sites located in Montclair, California; Dallas, Texas; and Houston, Texas. Complementing our site operations, CSS provides full-service patient recruitment, enrollment, and retention services on a global scale to study sponsors and CROs.

Together, we connect patients with research opportunities, partner with sponsors to conduct high-quality studies, and contribute to the development of new treatments. As a member of ACRS, you are part of a growing organization where every role contributes to our shared purpose of advancing research and improving patient care.

Position Summary: The Assistant Controller supports the VP, Finance and Accounting in leading the accounting and financial reporting function for ACRS and its affiliated companies. This role oversees the monthly and annual close process, produces multi-entity financial statements, manages the audit process, and makes sure all reporting is accurate, timely, and US GAAP-compliant. The Assistant Controller also strengthens internal controls, drives process and system improvements, and supports budgeting, forecasting, and M&A activity so leadership has reliable financial information for decision-making.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare or review workpapers, journal entries, and reconciliations of general ledger accounts for the monthly and annual financial close.
  • Produce monthly and annual financial statements for multiple entities and business units; Ensure compliance with generally accepted accounting principles and established policies and procedures.
  • Research accounting pronouncements and develop policies for new, changing, or existing business transactions. Broadly communicate impacts to the organization and ensure understanding.
  • Actively review monthly billings and monitor collections on outstanding accounts receivable. Assess collectability and review proper accounting treatment for all transactions.
  • Drive continuous business process improvement, primarily through the design and implementation of technologies. Contribute to development of business requirements, reporting, and testing for all system changes impacting accounting.
  • Analyze complex customer sales contracts and arrangements to determine proper revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606 and US GAAP. Prepare and record accurate monthly revenue-related journal entries and deferred revenue reconciliations.
  • Manage the audit process relevant to assigned areas. Oversee and ensure overall responsiveness to audit requests, including preparation and review of PBC list items. Serve as key point of contact with auditors.
  • Contribute to the preparation of budgets and forecasts; Proactively review activity relative to forecasted expectations, identify deviations from plan and appropriately escalate findings for resolution.
  • Partner with VP, Finance & Accounting in M&A diligence; Assist in purchase accounting and ongoing transaction-related activities as needed.
  • Assist in the development of enterprise-wide policy and procedure documentation for all key accounting and financial reporting functions, identify and document relevant internal controls to minimize risks and protect assets, ensure accuracy of records, and promote operational efficiency.
  • Assist with special projects and ad-hoc reporting supporting management decision-making as required.

  • Travel to company meetings or site locations as required

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting

  • Solid knowledge of GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) and technical accounting research expertise
  • Clear grasp of accounting and financial processes (financial statement close process, analytical review, annual reporting, etc.)
  • Experience with Mergers & Acquisitions, due diligence, and purchase accounting

Certificates, licenses and registrations required:

  • Certified Public Accountant (preferred)

Systems & Technology skills required:

  • Experience with Oracle NetSuite (preferred) or other similar multi-entity integrated accounting software
  • Experience with CTMS (e.g. RealTime or Clinical Conductor) preferred
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook)

Other skills required:

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and decision-making
  • Ability to follow protocols, SOPs, and regulatory requirements
  • Ability to handle high-pressure or fast-paced environments

Physical Requirements and/or environmental factors:

JOB SUMMARY:

The Outreach Specialist will join the Pasadena HOPE Team, 5 days per week, to provide outreach, engagement and linkage to services. The Outreach Specialist will outreach individuals experiencing homelessness on the streets of Pasadena who may often be in crisis and experiencing symptoms of mental health and/or substance use disorders. title: Senior Program Quality Analyst
description:
Senior Program Quality Analyst

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Program Quality Analyst supports agency-wide program quality assurance, contractual compliance, audit readiness, and program-related financial oversight. The position conducts internal audits and fiscal compliance reviews; monitors program documentation, expenditures, service delivery, and performance; and develops expense trackers, auditing tools, and other systems that strengthen accountability and compliance.


Reporting to the Director, Program Quality, the Senior Program Quality Analyst serves as a technical resource and financial liaison among the Programs, Finance, Contracts and Compliance, and Data and Quality Assurance departments. This is a leadership position that may coordinate assigned projects and review activities but does not supervise employees.

ALLOCATION STANDARDS

Positions allocable to this professional classification report to the Director, Program Quality and perform analytical and technical assignments involving program quality assurance, internal auditing, contract compliance, expense monitoring, and financial coordination. Position incumbents independently conduct scheduled and risk-based reviews, interpret contractual and fiscal requirements, identify areas of concern, and recommend corrective actions.


Positions in this classification do not have formal supervisory responsibility. Incumbents may coordinate quality assurance projects, facilitate review activities, provide technical guidance, and train program staff. These responsibilities do not include hiring, performance evaluations, disciplinary actions, approving time off, or other personnel-management functions.


Assignments require incumbents to examine program records, case files, reports, invoices, budgets, financial reports, data systems, and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance. Incumbents use Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and agency-specific systems to develop and maintain audit workpapers, monitoring tools, expense trackers, spenddown reports, corrective action logs, and related documentation.


Program Quality Analysts exercise discretion when handling confidential client, employee, financial, and contractual information. At this level, incumbents perform complex analytical and administrative assignments that support consistent service quality, fiscal accountability, contractual performance, audit readiness, and continuous quality improvement.

EXAMPLES OF DUTIES

  • Conducts scheduled, risk-based, and targeted internal audits of program records, case files, fiscal documentation, operational processes, and contractual deliverables.

  • Develops audit plans, review schedules, sampling approaches, checklists, workpapers, documentation standards, and reporting templates.

  • Reviews program documentation and information entered into the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) or comparable systems for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with agency and funder requirements.

  • Interprets contracts, scopes of work, approved budgets, funder manuals, program policies, and other governing documents to determine applicable operational, documentation, reporting, and fiscal requirements.

  • Translates contractual and fiscal requirements into practical monitoring tools, procedures, checklists, and guidance for program staff and leadership.

  • Develops and maintains expense trackers, budget monitoring workbooks, spenddown reports, forecasting tools, audit logs, and other fiscal oversight resources using Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and agency financial systems.

  • Monitors program expenditures against approved budgets, contract periods, spending plans, and available funding.

  • Analyzes spending patterns and prepares projections to identify potential underspending, overspending, allocation discrepancies, unsupported expenses, or other fiscal risks.

  • Reconciles program-maintained expense information with Finance Department reports, invoices, general ledger information, reimbursement records, and supporting documentation.

  • Reviews expenses for consistency with approved budgets, contract requirements, agency policies, funding restrictions, and documentation standards.

  • Identifies transactions requiring additional documentation, correction, reclassification, or further review and coordinates follow-up with appropriate program and Finance staff.

  • Serves as a financial liaison between assigned programs and the Finance Department to support accurate expense tracking, resolution of discrepancies, and shared understanding of fiscal requirements.

  • Supports the preparation and review of reimbursement packages, invoice-support documentation, fiscal reports, and other contract-related financial submissions.

  • Documents audit and monitoring results in clear written reports that identify the requirement reviewed, condition observed, associated risk, recommended corrective action, responsible party, and expected completion date.

  • Communicates audit findings and fiscal concerns to program leadership, the Director, Program Quality, and other internal stakeholders in a clear, objective, and constructive manner.

  • Develops corrective action plans and tracking systems and conducts follow-up reviews to verify that identified concerns have been resolved.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills to collaborate with program staff, management, Finance, Contracts and Compliance, Data and Quality Assurance, funders, and other stakeholders.

  • Ability to facilitate meetings, coordinate cross-departmental projects, and provide functional leadership without formal supervisory authority.

  • Ability to serve programs supporting people experiencing homelessness with empathy, cultural humility, professionalism, and a commitment to improving service quality and participant outcomes.

  • Strong skill in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Ability to learn and use agency financial systems, contract-management platforms, HMIS, document-management systems, and other program databases.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, move within office, meeting, and program-site environments, and use standard office equipment.

EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE

title: Senior CAE Durability and NVH Engineer
description:
Senior CAE Durability and NVH Engineer


A Senior CAE Durability and NVH Engineer focuses on vehicle-level durability and NVH CAE simulation across the full development lifecycle. The engineer will drive design decisions using simulation insights while balancing NVH, durability, safety, weight, and cost targets.


Responsibilities:

• Lead NVH and durability CAE for full vehicle programs.

• Build and maintain high-fidelity FEA models at vehicle and subsystem level.

• Perform global stiffness, modal, frequency response, vibration, stress, and fatigue analyses.

• Predict durability life and identify potential failure locations.

• Optimize structural load paths for NVH and durability targets.

• Support lightweighting through topology optimization and material selection.

• Evaluate joints, welds, adhesives, and structural configurations.

• Correlate CAE results with test data and improve model accuracy.

• Provide clear simulation results and design recommendations.

• Work with Design, Body, Trim, Manufacturing, and Program teams globally


Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

• 8+ years of NVH and durability CAE experience in automotive.

• Strong knowledge of structural dynamics and fatigue mechanics.

• Experience with vehicle NVH and durability performance targets.

• Ability to correlate simulation with physical testing.

• Proficiency in Python, TCL, or similar scripting.

• Experience with OptiStruct, Nastran, Abaqus, LS Dyna, nCode, FEMFAT.

• Experience with HyperWorks, ANSA, MetaPost.

• Exposure to EV and hybrid vehicle platforms preferred.

• AI/ML-based CAE experience is a plus.

• Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Work Authorization: U.S. Citizenship, U.S. Permanent Residency, or valid EAD required.

title: Blender
description:

Rework steel, stainless steel and aluminum castings after mold removal by performing the following duties.

title: Solution Architect (Payments)
location: Almaty, Kazakhstan; Astana, Kazakhstan; Belgrade, Serbia; Cluj-Napoca, Romania; Krakow, Poland; Larnaca, Cyprus; Lodz, Poland; Lublin, Poland; Monterrey, Mexico; Montevideo, Uruguay; Brazil; Bulgaria; Colombia; Georgia; Kazakhstan; Poland; Riga, Latvia; Rosario; Sofia, Bulgaria; Tbilisi, Georgia; Varna, Bulgaria; Warsaw, Poland; Wroclaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
description:
As a Solutions Architect, you will define and guide architecture across card acquiring and payment processing domains. You will work on transaction flows, processing and routing components, scheme and partner integrations, resilience patterns, and technical standards.

You will work closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate complex payment requirements into scalable solution designs and guide engineering teams through implementation.

  • - Define and evolve the solution architecture for card acquiring and processing capabilities, covering authorization, switching, routing, clearing, settlement and reconciliation;
  • - Design end-to-end transaction flows for card-present and card-not-present scenarios, including authorization, capture, reversals, refunds and exception handling;
  • - Design integration patterns with card schemes, processors, banks, payment gateways and merchant-facing systems, including ISO 8583 message flows and scheme-specific variations;
  • - Define resilience and failure-handling patterns for high-throughput, low-latency transaction processing, including idempotency, retries, timeouts, duplicate detection and recovery;
  • - Ensure the architecture meets PCI DSS and payment security requirements, including cardholder data protection and tokenization;
  • - Translate business and product requirements into concrete technical solutions and communicate architecture decisions across engineering, product and business teams;
  • - Remain hands-on and contribute directly to implementation where needed, particularly for complex transaction processing, integrations and core platform components;
  • - Define technical standards and review solution designs and implementations across engineering teams;
  • - Contribute to the evolution and modernization of payment processing capabilities and legacy components where relevant.
  • - Strong experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect or Lead Architect in card acquiring or payment processing;
  • - Proven experience designing or significantly evolving an acquiring platform, payment switch or card transaction processing system, including real-time switching and routing;
  • - Deep understanding of the acquiring transaction lifecycle: authorization, capture, reversals, refunds, clearing, settlement and reconciliation;
  • - Strong practical knowledge of ISO 8583, including message flows and scheme-specific implementations;
  • - Strong knowledge of card-present and card-not-present transaction processing;
  • - Good understanding of EMV and 3-D Secure transaction flows;
  • - Experience integrating with card schemes, processors, banks, payment gateways or merchant-facing systems;
  • - Strong understanding of distributed systems, including idempotency, retries, timeouts, duplicate handling and recovery scenarios;
  • - Experience designing high-availability, high-throughput, low-latency transactional systems;
  • - Good understanding of PCI DSS, cardholder data security, tokenization and payment security principles;
  • - Strong software engineering background with recent hands-on development experience and the ability to contribute directly to production code when needed;
  • - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;
  • - Upper-Intermediate or higher level of English.
  • - Hands-on experience designing and certifying direct acquiring integrations with major card schemes, such as Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay, JCB, American Express and Discover;
  • - Experience with both POS and e-commerce acquiring;
  • - Experience with HSMs, PIN processing, payment cryptography and key management;
  • - Hands-on work with scheme clearing files and settlement processes, such as Visa BASE II and Mastercard IPM;
  • - Experience with processing platforms such as Way4, BASE24, SmartVista, TranzAxis or similar;
  • - Experience with acquiring platform modernization or migration;
  • - Experience with event-driven or microservices-based transaction processing architectures.

title: Pulmo Rehab Specialist
description:
The pulmonary health and rehabilitation program will staff (full time, part time, or consultant basis) respiratory care practitioners who will be responsible for implementing the respiratory regimen and assisting with pulmonary participant support.

  • Contributes expertise as a member of a multi-disciplinary team to offer comprehensive treatment strategies to provide positive outcomes for individual participants and for the pulmonary health and rehabilitation program
  • Demonstrates ability to communicate effectively with rehab team members about individual patient findings or concerns and about program improvement issues
  • Demonstrates a willingness to strive toward proficiency in the clinical competencies
  • Demonstrates the interpersonal and observational skills needed to effectively identify appropriate psycho social adaptation to illness and/or the presence of psychopathology (e.g., depression, anger, excessive anxiety, etc.)
  • Assesses patients' risk factors that are modifiable and demonstrates ability to offer support and strategies to aid patient in successful therapeutic lifestyle changes (TLC)
  • Understands and utilizes contemporary theories of health behavior change in helping participants identify learning and lifestyle modification goals
  • Participates in the program's educational efforts, classes, and/or individual sessions
  • Participates in the initial assessment and orientation of new participants
    • Assists in the development of individualized treatment plans with other staff members
  • Effectively applies knowledge of exercise science to a population with pulmonary disease and other potential co-morbidities
  • Develops and adjusts individual exercise prescription in accordance with GXT, daily patient response in rehab, and physician recommendations on a regular basis
  • Supervises exercise session, monitoring participants for inappropriate responses to exercise
  • Responsible for oximetry, heart rate, and blood pressure measurement
  • Assesses participants pre, during, and post exercise, making appropriate referrals, and/or recommendations to the participant, other staff, and Medical Director
  • Responsible for observation of telemetry responses, when indicated
  • Documents initial and daily assessment data in participant records
  • Immediately reports any new, changing, and/or significant participant conditions (oxygen desaturation, dysrhythmias, abnormal blood pressure responses, change in participants' status, etc.) to the physician supervising the program
  • Initiates ACLS measures and/or emergency care according to hospital policy
  • Participates in the collection, analysis, and reporting of identified individual patient outcomes and program outcomes
  • Keeps current in the field of pulmonary rehabilitation through journals, in-services, and conferences
  • Participates in emergency drills and mock codes on a routine basis
  • Attends all scheduled staff meetings

title: Jouluapulaisia Mikkelin myymäläämme
description:
Etsimme nyt iloisia ja innokkaita työntekijöitä Mikkelin Normal-myymäläämme jouluajan tueksi! Tarjoamme määräaikaisia 5-10h/vko sopimuksia. Työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin.

Mikäli etsit mukavaa, hauskaa ja vauhdikasta työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille!

Tietoa meistä

NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.

Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia normaaleja tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia useissa eri tuotekategorioissa.

NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.

Työ

Myyjänä sinulla on tärkeä rooli myymälässä ja erityisen ostoskokemuksen luomisessa asiakkaille. Tulet työskentelemään yhdessä myymälätiimin kanssa jännittävien tuotteidemme kanssa, ja meille on tärkeää, että voimme aina esitellä hyvin ylläpidetyn ja siistin myymälän asiakkaillemme. Sen lisäksi ystävällinen ja mukava asiakaspalvelu sekä tavalliset rutiininomaiset tehtävät ovat luonnollinen osa arkipäiväämme. NORMAL-myymälät ovat myös joulun aikaan jännittäviä paikkoja täynnä mielenkiintoisia tuotteita ja asiakkaita. Työpäiväsi etenee korkealla tempolla ja on tärkeää, että viihdyt hektisessä, inspiroivassa ja huumorintäyteisessä ilmapiirissä.

Vastuualueesi:

  • Palvella asiakkaita suurella sydämellä ja iloisella asenteella

  • Huolehdit myymälän siisteydestä

  • Hyllyjen täyttäminen

  • Kassatyöskentely

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Olet kiinnostunut myymälän toiminnoista ja sinulle asiakas on aina tärkein

  • Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja tehokkaasti

  • Asiakkaiden palvelu sujuu suomen kielellä (väh. taitotaso B1) - muu kielitaito aina plussaa

  • Olet työtä pelkäämätön tiimipelaaja

Mikäli kiinnostuit, lähde mukaan mahtavaan porukkaamme!

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae mukaan heti, käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista! Käytössämme on myös mahdollisuus laittaa hakemus videon muodossa ja arvostamme suuresti, mikäli tartut mahdollisuuteen!

Jotta rekrytointiprosessi sujuisi mahdollisimman mutkattomasti, suosittelemme hyväksymään tekstiviestiviestinnän.

In the community

Volunteering Coordinator

Service

Gloucestershire

The purpose of your role

As a Volunteer Peer Group Facilitator, you will play a key role in delivering our peer support groups. These groups run all around the county throughout the week. You will work alongside our team of peer support workers and other peer support volunteers.

title: General Foundry Worker
description:
Position Summary

The Foundry Worker will play a vital role in the casting process, ensuring the safe and efficient operation of equipment, the preparation and monitoring of molds, and the quality control of finished products. This role requires a strong attention to detail, a commitment to safety protocols, and a collaborative attitude within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Sal. Range- $20.00 - 22.00/hr.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Housekeeping, preparing box furnace and cleaning fixtures for mold.
  • Mold Preparation: Prepare molds, maintain molds, including cleaning, repairing, and patching, to ensure consistent product quality and extend mold life.
  • Inspect molds for defects, such as cracks, surface imperfections, and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Material Handling: Safely handle and transport raw materials and finished castings using appropriate equipment and protocols.
  • Safety Compliance: Adhere to all safety guidelines and protocols, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE), and participate in regular safety meetings and training.
  • Equipment Operation: Operate foundry equipment, such as furnaces, ladles, following operational procedures and performing routine maintenance tasks.
  • Documentation: Accurately record production data, material usage, and quality control information for each casting run.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

High school diploma or equivalent; related experience is a plus.

Previous experience in a foundry or metal casting environment is preferred.

Knowledge of different metal alloys, melting temperatures, and casting techniques is a plus.

Ability to read and interpret technique and specifications.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality products.

Good physical stamina and the ability to work in a hot and physically demanding environment.

Effective communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Basic computer skills for data entry and documentation.


Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

Ability to lift heavy objects and withstand prolonged standing, bending, and lifting.

Comfort working in a high-temperature environment while wearing appropriate PPE.

The Foundry Worker will primarily work in a manufacturing environment, which may involve exposure to heat, noise, and airborne particles. The worker will be required to follow strict safety protocols and wear provided protective gear.

Note

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) of this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee(s)will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at will relationship.

title: Lead Liens Specialist
description:
Position Summary: As a Lead Lien Specialist, you will be responsible for leading employees apart of the Liens team including providing direction, assigning tasks, and ensuring that work is completed according to the established standards and deadlines. An ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of liens and subrogation, managing the lien process, compliance with legal requirements, and facilitating the resolution of any outstanding issues related to liens. You will collaborate closely with other internal teams, departments and management to analyze problems and resolve challenges that arise. You will monitor performance and provide feedback to drive team performance and goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervising and guiding team members to ensure their work is complete and provide support and guidance to help team members meet their goals.
  • Review and analyze legal documents, medical bills, and records to identify lien-related obligations and requirements.
  • Thoroughly examine the case file and settlement documents to ensure accuracy and identify any existing liens or subrogation.
  • Conduct comprehensive checks to determine if there are any outstanding liens, subrogation or bankruptcy filings that may affect the settlement.
  • Verify that relevant entities, such as Medicare, Medicaid, and/or Tricare, if applicable, have been notified of the settlement, and ensure that you have received the appropriate responses.
  • Follow the attorney's instructions to review and, if necessary, dispute or negotiate reductions for any liens or subrogation associated with the case
  • Use case management system to accurately document the status of liens, ensuring that all information is up to date and accessible to the appropriate parties.
  • If there are specific liens that require additional verification, such as hospital liens, conduct a secondary check to ensure each lien is properly addressed before finalizing the payout.
  • Communicate effectively with attorneys, internal departments, external vendors, and clients to address lien-related inquiries or concerns.
  • Maintain organized records of lien-related documentation and correspondence for future reference and audit purposes.
  • Stay informed about changes in lien laws, regulations, and industry best practices to ensure compliance and mitigate risks.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Legal Studies, or related field preferred.
  • Prior experience as a legal closing specialist, subrogation analyst, settlements coordinator, lien processer, or related field preferred.
  • Strong understanding of lien and subrogation laws, regulations, and legal principles.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a keen attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

What will I be doing?

As a Principal Software Engineer at Kaluza, you will be the leading technical authority for a major global product area comprising multiple modules. You will lead innovation on some of the most complex, ambiguous, and large-scale solutions, aligning them with target architecture standards and contributing to the creation of a scalable platform.

You’ll have a broad sphere of influence, enabling multiple teams and serving as a strategic partner to our architecture leadership team and our community of principal and staff engineers.

Your impact will come mostly from 'hands-off' work; you’ll not be expected to write code day-to-day. But for some challenges, you may need to dive into code-level design or help build a proof-of-concept.

About You
Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Architect modern distributed, cloud-based systems applying modern architecture and engineering practices in an enterprise software environment.

  • Shape and influence technical vision and product roadmaps to align with business goals.

  • Provide hands-on leadership, making appropriate technical choices to satisfy requirements.

  • Mentor and guide engineers in delivering autonomous, loosely coupled distributed systems with proven architectural principles and patterns.

  • Lead technical due diligence and make high-stakes decisions with confidence.

  • Deliver results, influence diverse audiences, and orchestrate cross-functional solutions spanning multiple product features.

  • Engage effectively with both technical teams and executive leaders.

  • Work independently and collaboratively, bringing strong opinions while respecting others, communicating openly, and maintaining self-awareness with a continuous growth mindset.

What will set you apart

  • Experience enabling engineering teams to use AI and delivering AI/ML powered solutions.

  • Demonstrable experience in architecting solutions in complex business domains, particularly interface design and data modelling, ideally with experience in AWS and API design.

  • Proven track record delivering global B2B2C SaaS (energy or other mission‑critical industries).

  • Success driving adoption of modern engineering practices (e.g. DevOps, CI/CD).

  • Experience leading teams through significant changes in ways of working.

  • Ability to ramp up rapidly in new domains and technologies.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP

  • Life Assurance

  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app

  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests

  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts

  • 26 days holiday

  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family

  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!

  • Home Office Budget
    And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

title: Operator In Training (OIT)- 1st, 2nd and 3rd Shift
description:
PS Seasoning is a Wisconsin-based, family-owned spice and seasoning manufacturer with deep roots in craftsmanship and a passion for flavor. From signature sausage seasonings to custom blends for chefs and food brands across the country, every product we make starts with people who care. Our Iron Ridge plant runs multiple production lines — bottling, pouching, blending, and liquid filling — and we're growing.

We're hiring Operators in Training on all shifts. If you take pride in doing things right, like working with your hands, and want a team that invests in your growth, we'd love to meet you.

The Role

As an Operator In Training, you're the person who keeps our lines running clean, safe, and on-spec. You'll start on a structured 4-week training program that takes you from Day 1 onboarding through full sign-off as a certified Operator — including forklift certification, lockout/tagout, allergen training, and hands-on time at every major station. Once trained, you'll independently run production lines, troubleshoot equipment issues, document quality checks in our ERP system, and help mentor newer associates.

What You'll Do

  • Operate production equipment across our Bottling, Bartelt pouching, Matrix labeling, and Blending lines — startup, run, troubleshoot, shutdown.
  • Perform hourly quality checks: weigh checks, metal detector verifications, lot code accuracy, label and seal inspections.
  • Document production activity in our Deacom ERP system — issue materials, receive finished goods, complete batch records.
  • Make equipment adjustments (fill weights, label alignment, seal temperatures) to keep product on-spec.
  • Support sanitation and allergen changeovers between batches — keeping food safety the top priority.
  • Operate forklifts and power stackers safely (we'll certify you if you're not already certified).
  • Communicate with Leads, QA, and Maintenance to resolve issues quickly and keep the line moving.
  • Follow all GMP, HACCP, and OSHA requirements without cutting corners.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Reliable attendance and a strong work ethic — our team counts on you to show up.
  • Ability to stand for full shifts, lift up to 50 lbs, and work in a temperature-variable plant environment.
  • Comfort following written and verbal instructions in English (or Spanish — we are a bilingual workplace).
  • Basic math skills (counting, weighing, simple unit conversions like ounces to grams).
  • Willingness to learn equipment, software (Deacom ERP), and food safety standards.

Nice to Have (Not Required — We'll Train You)

  • Prior experience in food manufacturing, packaging, or any production environment.
  • Forklift certification (we'll certify you in Week 1 if not).
  • OSHA 10 General Industry card.
  • Familiarity with HACCP, GMP, or allergen management.
  • Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems.

What You'll Get

  • Competitive hourly pay: $20 - 22/hr based on experience, with shift differential for 2nd and 3rd shifts.
  • Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and paid holidays.
  • A real training program — 4 weeks of structured, paid training with a dedicated Trainer and Lead, not 'figure it out as you go.'
  • Career path: Associate → Operator → Lead → Trainer/Manufacturing Support. We promote from within.
  • Steady work in a family-owned company that's been in Wisconsin for decades.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours per week with regular overtime opportunities.
  • 1st shift, 2nd shift, and 3rd shift positions available — let us know your preference.
  • Monday–Friday with occasional Saturday production.

1st Shift: 6am - 2pm
2nd Shift: 2pm - 10 pm
3rd Shift: 10pm-6am

title: Software Engineer Observe Team
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world’s leading data platforms.

The Team:

We are hiring a Software Engineer, Enterprise for our Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake. As part of the Enterprise Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake, you’ll build and scale core features, APIs, and business logic powering a high-performance observability platform. You’ll develop reliable, production-grade systems designed to handle massive volumes of telemetry for enterprise customers. Working at the intersection of data, infrastructure, and user experience, you’ll help deliver solutions that enable fast, actionable insights at scale. This is an opportunity to own impactful systems that directly support the reliability and performance of some of the world’s largest organizations.

In this role your will:

  • Design, build, and own core features, APIs, and business logic powering a high-performance observability platform for enterprise customers

  • Take end-to-end ownership from technical scoping and architecture through deployment, ensuring systems meet enterprise reliability and performance standards

  • Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and data teams to deliver solutions that enable fast, actionable insights for engineering teams worldwide

  • Partner with SREs and customer-facing teams to diagnose and resolve production issues, applying AI-assisted workflows to accelerate root-cause analysis

  • Contribute to high engineering standards through thoughtful code review, mentorship, and architectural influence

Qualifications:

  • 2 - 5 years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on backend application systems or distributed platforms

  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems at scale, handling high throughput, low latency, and enterprise reliability requirements

  • Strong proficiency in one or more server-side languages such as Go, Java, Scala, Python, or similar

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical problems from scoping through delivery, without waiting to be directed

  • Experience collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a track record of shipping impactful, customer-facing work

  • A BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or distributed tracing and logging systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger)

  • Experience building or contributing to AI-assisted developer tools or LLM-integrated workflows

  • Background in SRE practices, incident response automation, or root-cause analysis tooling

  • Open-source contributions to observability, data infrastructure, or developer productivity projects

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Leadership & Culture Development Lead
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

The Leadership & Culture Development Lead owns how Neko's leaders are developed and how the leadership bar shows up in practice, plus which culture products get built and how they deploy across markets.

This role merges leadership and culture development deliberately: it is broader than either would be alone, and the combination is what earns the credibility to coach and challenge the ELT. It sits on the two priorities CHROs rank first and second for 2026.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Onboard every new leader into Neko's leadership standards, Vitals and culture code from day one of their leadership role. (Member-first, Always)

  • Turn the Neko leadership model into ongoing practice — coaching, mentorship, scans — with a measurable improvement in leadership capability, not a one-off training event. (Impact, Not Activity)

  • Ship a reusable culture product library that any market or clinic can deploy without this role being in the room. (Chase 10X, Not 10%)

  • Run the first leadership and culture scans that show where the gaps are and what to do about them. (Optimistic Truth-seeking)

  • Direct the AI Enablement releases: i.e leadership buddy and culture buddy live and in use by real leaders. (Tech-enabled, Human-centred)

Responsibilities

Leadership development

  • Own how leaders are developed and what the leadership bar looks like in practice.

  • Design and run leadership development programmes and leadership scans.

  • Provide coaching and mentorship directly to leaders, including holding the standard with the ELT.

Culture

  • Own culture design and iteration, ways of working, and input into the EVP.

  • Decide which culture products get built and how they are deployed across HQ and clinics.

  • Own culture activations that reinforce the Vitals in day-to-day work, not just at onboarding.

Decisions & Authority

  • Owns the leadership development and culture product roadmap.

  • Authority to coach and challenge ELT members on leadership behaviour; carries a credibility floor for this.

  • Directs the AI Enablement priorities within the frameworks this role sets.

Qualification Criteria

Education & Experience

  • Required — Has personally built something with AI — an agent, tool, script, or workflow — even an experiment that didn't scale. We're screening for hands-on builder evidence, not familiarity with AI as a concept.

  • Track record designing and running a leadership development programme at a scaling company, ideally 500–2,000 employees.

  • Experience building or evolving a company culture framework, including translating it into concrete products, not just a values deck.

  • Direct coaching experience with senior leaders, including giving unwelcome feedback to people more senior than them.

Skills & Competencies

  • Can turn an abstract leadership model into a scan, a coaching product and a habit — not just a slide.

  • Executive presence: credible challenging ELT members on leadership behaviour.

  • People management: sets direction for a builder role without micromanaging the build.

  • AI fluency: knows which parts of leadership and culture coaching are safe to delegate to an agent, and which require a human.

Mission & Vitals Alignment

  • Believes leadership capability is the highest-leverage lever available and acts like it, not like a training administrator.

  • Optimistic truth-seeker: delivers hard leadership feedback with care, not with a manual for tenure.

  • Comfortable being new at the top table: this credibility has to be earned in the room, not inherited from title.

title: 2027 Summer Intern - Survey
description:

ESP is a multi-discipline engineering design and consulting firm providing our clients with civil engineering, surveying, planning/landscape architecture, geosciences, environmental, subsurface utility engineering, and construction engineering inspection.

Through years of dedicated service to our clients, ESP has received a designation of 186 on the 2026 ENR Top 500 Design Firm rankings. For the firm's primary territory, the ENR Texas & Southeast Top Design Firms, ESP received a 2026 ranking of 53.

title: Buyer II
description:
Who We Are

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at .

View the SENS Product Catalog


Summary

The Supply Chain Buyer II independently manages a portfolio of assigned suppliers and commodities with increased complexity and business impact. This role ensures continuity of supply by balancing cost, quality, delivery, inventory, supplier performance, and operational risk while making purchasing decisions within established policies and delegated authority.


As an experienced purchasing professional, this position leads supplier performance improvement, resolves complex operational issues, coordinates engineering changes and supply transitions, and develops inventory solutions that support manufacturing requirements. The role also provides day-to-day guidance to less experienced buyers and collaborates with Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, and the Sourcing Team on cross-functional priorities.


Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of complex and business-critical suppliers, including domestic and international sources, to ensure material availability and reliable operational performance.
  • Independently evaluate purchasing alternatives and make decisions within delegated authority by balancing cost, quality, delivery, inventory, supplier capability, and business risk.
  • Develop and maintain effective supplier relationships that improve responsiveness, delivery reliability, quality, and issue resolution.
  • Lead supplier performance reviews, identify performance gaps, and drive corrective actions and recovery plans to improve supplier results.
  • Analyze demand, inventory, lead times, supplier capacity, and operational constraints to develop purchasing and inventory strategies that support production while minimizing excess inventory and supply risk.
  • Resolve complex supplier, material, and purchasing issues and coordinate cross-functional recovery activities to minimize operational disruption.
  • Coordinate routine engineering changes, product transitions, and supplier implementation activities with Engineering, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, and the Sourcing Team.
  • Conduct operational RFQs and market evaluations for lower-spend or non-strategic requirements while escalating major commercial decisions, supplier selection, contracts, and significant financial impacts to the Sourcing Team.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities, validate supplier price changes, and support implementation of sourcing decisions and commercial agreements established by the Sourcing Team.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance, onboarding support, and practical mentorship to less experienced buyers.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen purchasing processes, supplier performance, inventory management, ERP data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, and ERP data while ensuring compliance with company policies, contractual requirements, quality standards, and applicable regulations.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of progressive purchasing, procurement, or supply chain experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of purchasing, inventory management, supplier performance management, engineering change coordination, and ERP/MRP-driven manufacturing operations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage supplier relationships, resolve operational issues, and make sound purchasing decisions.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence outcomes and collaborate across multiple functions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, and experience using an ERP/MRP system such as Infor CSI/Syteline, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or a similar platform.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, provide practical guidance to others, and operate with accountability in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
  • Experience managing critical domestic, nearshore, or international suppliers.
  • Experience leading supplier performance reviews, corrective actions, engineering changes, or product transitions.
  • Experience with inventory optimization, supplier recovery, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • APICS/ASCM, Lean, Six Sigma, or other relevant professional certification or training.
  • Experience supporting engineered products or discrete manufacturing operations.


Location: This position is located in Longmont, CO.


Base Compensation: $73,000 - $102,000 is the projected base salary range and will be determined by the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.


Bonus: This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

Closing Date: October 15th. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

title: Shop Foreman
description:
Summary

The Shop Foreman is responsible for completing work orders and invoices, preparing warranty claims, reporting and minimizing aged work-in-process, maintaining service records and quality control records, completing job status reports, maintaining current billing cycle, assisting with yearly performance reviews, assisting with determining labor needed, assisting with diagnosing technical machine issues, assisting employees to obtain training, assisting in conducting safety meetings and other general service department duties as directed by the Branch Service Manager.

Essential Functions

  • Administrative – Maintain department communication in order to complete work and grow service labor sales. Utilize various computer programs and John Deere communication tools as resources. Plan work schedule. Maintain a clean, orderly and safe work area and appearance.
  • Inventory Control – Maintain service department tool inventory.
  • Service – Complete service data on invoices. Open and close work orders in a timely manner in order to minimize aged work-in-process. Performs basic diagnostics and determines what repairs are needed and advises customers of replacement parts as necessary. Repair and replace damaged or worn parts. Test mechanical products and equipment after repair or assembly to ensure proper performance and compliance. Prepare all reports and forms required in conjunction with work orders, taking note of the cause of failure/problems. Prepare warranty information. Service and maintain company vehicle and shop. Maintain flat rate in accordance with the Standard Pricing Guide (SPG). Utilize Marketing Service Times (MST’s) to quote jobs. Maintain current knowledge of Company and competitor products. Maintain condition of vehicles, inventory, tools and equipment. Read and understand operating manuals, blueprints and technical drawings. Assist in completing job status reports.
  • Manage – Assist in yearly performance reviews for Service Technicians. Assist in determining labor needed in preparation for workloads. Assist factory and engineers with diagnosing technical machine issues. Assists in maintaining billing cycle efficiencies, expenses and gross margins.
  • Training – Assist in working with employees in obtaining technician certification and complete training needs. Assist in conducting monthly safety meetings.

Other Functions

  • Deliver parts, run errands, etc. as needed.
  • Assist with other duties assigned and directed by corporate management within the frame work of Murphy Tractor and Equipment Company, Inc.’s objectives.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of methods, materials, tools and techniques used in the repair of heavy construction equipment.
  • Ability to identify complex problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.
  • Good skills in operating vehicles and equipment used for diagnostic purposes
  • Strong focus on customer service.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office and Internet.
  • Basic knowledge of office machines, including copier, fax and printer.
  • Able to communicate effectively as appropriate for the needs of customers or coworkers.
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Able to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Able to process work with accuracy.
  • Meet commitments and deadlines.
  • Able to complete required documentation and reports in a timely manner.
  • Able to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Able to work a flexible schedule as needed.
  • Able to organize and prioritize numerous tasks and complete them under time constraints.
  • Demonstrates openness to new procedures, technology and structure.

Physical Requirements and Work Schedule

Able to do occasional lifting of up to 50 lbs. Employee must be able to stand for an extensive amount of time. Able to work flexible schedule, including some evenings and weekends.

Education/Work Experience

High school diploma or GED required. One year certificate from a college or technical school or at least three years related experience and/or training in the subordinate position.

Murphy Tractor & Equipment Co. is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Program Scheduler (00610)
description:
The Program Scheduler independently manages complex program schedules and provides advanced analysis, forecasting, and reporting to support both internal stakeholders and client teams. This role requires hands-on experience with Primavera P6, project lifecycle understanding, and the ability to mentor junior staff. The ideal candidate will possess a working knowledge of CPM scheduling theory and demonstrate the ability to communicate schedule insights effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Organizational Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, maintenance, and status updates of project schedules using Primavera P6.
  • Develop and manage both summary and detailed schedules for large-scale or multiple concurrent projects.
  • Interpret contract requirements and ensure proper integration of scheduling deliverables.
  • Review and analyze general contractors’ cost- and resource-loaded schedules.
  • Track progress against baseline schedules, identify critical paths, and analyze variances and delays.
  • Develop and present schedule status reports, dashboards, and narratives for internal and client-facing audiences.
  • Conduct risk identification through trend and performance analysis and recommend corrective actions or workarounds.
  • Conduct what-if analyses, time impact studies, and recovery plan evaluations.
  • Evaluate current scheduling procedures and contribute to process improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with scheduling best practices and delivery method standards, including design/build projects.
  • Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and construction professionals to gather schedule data and status updates.
  • Attend and participate in project meetings and site visits to validate schedule accuracy and progress.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior-level Scheduler staff, supporting their technical development.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field required. Master’s degree in engineering, construction management, MBA, or a related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in project scheduling and controls within the construction or engineering industries.
  • Advanced proficiency in Oracle Primavera P6 and related reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Experience reviewing and analyzing schedules from general contractors.
  • Understanding of construction lifecycles and design/build delivery methods preferred.
Additional Requirements
Physical: Standing or sitting for long periods; must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times and spend extended hours in front of a computer screen.
Cognitive: Problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills; computer and software skills; and ability to read and interpret text online or in printed form.

* Mikäli olet itsenäinen osaaja, tehtävässä pärjää myös englannin kielen taidolla

Jätä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa nopeasti. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi erityisesti aiemmasta CNC-koneistuskokemuksestasi sekä Heidenhain-osaamisestasi.

description:
NOTE: This role is based at our DTM2 Fulfillment Center in Dortmund, Germany. Please note this is a warehouse/logistics environment. The site is within Dortmund city and accessible by public transport.


There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

• Plan and implement continuous improvement initiatives designed to innovate the driver experience and make our processes more efficient

• Analyse feedback and use data to own and implement process improvements at the site
• Work with station management and other stakeholders to identify and solve process-related issues

A day in the life
As a Process Improvement Specialist, you will be at the forefront of making Amazon better – which means improving safety, productivity, and quality. In this role, you will use data and AI to drive improvements and continue to grow our shipping capabilities.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Effective verbal and written communication
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment
  • Excellent organizational skills
