title: Security Director
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

TITLE: Riverbend Safety and Security Director

SUPERVISOR: Riverbend Christian School Director and Riverbend Church Facilities Director

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Exempt (Salaried)

LOCATION: 4214 N Capital of Texas HWY, Austin TX 78746

OVERVIEW:

Riverbend Church is seeking a Christ-centered Director of Safety and Security who is called to be part of a unique team. The role develops and directs security and loss prevention strategies and services, and implements safety programs that protect employees, school children, church members, physical and financial assets and critical / sensitive information.

Specifically, the incumbent will ensure a safe and secure environment for the weekend services, staff, children and students, volunteers and guests as well as property assets.

The role requires overseeing development and implementation of security and safety policies and practices, ensures compliance with local, state and federal rules and regulations, develops volunteers, provides training, and manages an annual budget.

This is carried out on the campus of Riverbend Church in Austin (which includes the Riverbend Christian School, Riverbend Remembrance Gardens, and Riverbend Center for the Arts), and may include any activities / locations where Riverbend has a presence.

The position is an Exempt Full-time position and reports to the Executive Operations Pastor.

The role will be split as follows: 75% at Riverbend Christian School, and 25% at Riverbend Church (and affiliates).

______________________________________________________________________________

CHARACTERISTIC DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: The essential functions, pursuant to the Americans with Disability Act, may include the characteristic duties, knowledge, skills and abilities noted herein, however, this list represents EXAMPLES ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by positions found in this job description.

_____________________________________________________________________________________

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

  • Provide direction to leadership, the school, and the campus teams on various security and safety plans, issues, and incidents to provide a secure environment.
  • Provide pastoral staff protection and coordinates the movement and safety of the lead pastor, his family, guest speakers, and others as needed at church sponsored services and or events.
  • Maintain and expand fully functioning security and safety volunteer teams.
  • Work with various church ministry teams to develop and implement security and safety procedures to minimize inherent risks.
  • Develop and document security and safety policies and procedures (e.g., weather, fire, active shooter, firearms, bomb, kidnaping, etc.).
  • Develop, implement and monitor current and future electronic surveillance systems at all campuses.
  • Participate in annual budget preparation to ensure adequate funds for the operation of the security and safety programs.
  • Produce and maintain purchase orders for security and safety equipment for the campus and process all payment requests.
  • Conduct regular risk assessments of premises for burglary, robbery, theft, fire and severe weather.
  • Plan and provide for protective services at various church sponsored events both on and off campus.
  • Establish and maintain relationships and serve as the point of contact with local law enforcement, private security firms, fire and EMS offices (services) to prevent or investigate incidents for protective services at various church sponsored services and events both on and off campus.
  • Help conduct interviews and background checks in compliance with church policies for Riverbend Church and school employees and volunteers; and assist with the interviewing and vetting of all volunteers in the guest service positions (security, ushers, greeters, parking, etc.).
  • Coordinate training for ushers, greeters, parking teams, etc. and other “front-line” church teams.
  • Manage all aspects of the day-to-day security of Riverbend Christian School
  • Approve, issue and maintain records of facility access keycards, keys and access codes
  • Maintain current knowledge of church related violence in the United States
  • Monitor weather during services and events for potential threats from nature
  • Conduct investigations of accidents or incidents on church properties
  • Promote employee safe security practices at work
  • Develop and maintain church volunteer medical team contacts that will address any medical issues that arise
  • Develop building exit plans for fire, active shooter, weather related, etc. responses
  • Coordinate First Responder staffing for services and events
  • Provide high-level coordination for sharing of best security practices, allocating resources, directing team initiatives, all while keeping an eye towards cost savings measures.
  • Provide input into campus traffic flow and safety
  • Skilled in conflict resolution / de-escalation techniques and problem solving with troubled individuals.
  • Must be available to work varied shifts and some holidays.

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Attitude of a servant, enjoyable to be with and devoted to the call of God and the Church.
  • Willing to go the ‘extra mile’ … to chase after the one of 99
  • A willingness to demonstrate and promote the vision of Riverbend
  • Experienced in interacting positively with children and parents in the school setting
  • A work ethic that is based on service-minded excellence. Is protective, and frugal with time and money.
  • Able to operate independently with minimal supervision on a wide variety of projects (self-motivated / organizational leader).
  • Effective communicator / team-oriented.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn and excel in the use of technology, including Enterprise Access Control (EAC) systems.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree (B. A.) in Criminal Justice or related field from four-year college or university preferred; or two years of related training; or equivalent combination of education and training.

Minimum of five years of Law Enforcement experience (5-10 years preferred).

Certification in the Texas Department of Public Safety Guardian Program or ability to obtain certification within first 6 months of employment.

First aid / CPR certified

10+ years of related experience in total. Related experience includes law enforcement or public safety experience, investigative and supervisory experience, monitoring (surveillance) systems, working knowledge of latest security protocols, proficiency in control techniques for hostile persons and ability to recognize and react to hostile / hazardous events and persons.

BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES INCLUDE:

  • Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Employer paid Life Insurance
  • 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan with Employer contributions
  • Short and Long-Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (React + SQL) – Data & Analytics | Bilingual
description:
We're hiring: Senior Full-Stack Developer (React + SQL) - Data & Analytics | Bilingual

On-site - Medellín, Colombia | English B2+ / C1

Are you a full-stack developer with a strong data background? Have you built React dashboards that stay fast even with hundreds of millions of records behind them? This role is for you.

You’ll work with a U.S. software company that builds demand analytics and forecasting products for retailers and CPG companies. This is not a traditional BI role in Power BI or Tableau. You’ll build native React visualizations inside the client’s platform and work with the data end to end, from the data model and SQL through the API to the screen.

The scale: around 800 million rows per day. The challenge is making that data load quickly and clearly in every visualization.

What you’ll do

  • Build and debug React dashboards and visualization components for KPIs, trends, forecasts, comparisons, and drilldowns.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL on very large datasets.
  • Extend the existing ETL pipelines and caching layer, which are already documented. You’ll add new functionality, debug it, and make sure the data is secure.
  • Design and optimize APIs that serve analytical data with low latency (filtering, aggregations, time series).
  • Partner with Product, Data Engineering, Data Science, and UX to turn business problems into clear analytics experiences.

Must-haves

  • 5+ years in full-stack development, data engineering, or analytics engineering.
  • Professional React experience (JavaScript/TypeScript): you’ve built and debugged visualizations in a real work environment. Personal projects alone won’t qualify.
  • Advanced SQL, including query optimization on high-volume data.
  • Experience with large-scale datasets (millions of records per day) and the techniques that make them fast to serve: caching, pre-aggregation, and optimization.
  • ETL pipelines and caching layers in production.
  • Dimensional modeling: star schema and snowflake schema.
  • Python for data processing or backend work. If your React and SQL are very strong, intermediate Python is fine.
  • English B2+ / C1, since you’ll work directly with the U.S. team.

Nice-to-haves

  • Databricks, Delta Lake, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Forecasting, time-series analysis, or machine learning
  • Retail, CPG, supply chain, or demand planning experience
  • Customer-facing SaaS analytics products

Stack:

React · TypeScript · SQL · Python · ETL · Caching · Star/Snowflake Schema · REST APIs · Databricks

This role will work closely with engineering, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and certification laboratories to support products from development through testing and production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain component libraries, footprints, BOMs, and PCB manufacturing files.
  • Support PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, prototype builds, and production releases.

  • Work with suppliers on quotations, availability, lead times, technical questions, and alternative components.

  • Support hardware bring-up, troubleshooting, and functional testing.
  • Use standard laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and electronic loads.
  • Coordinate internal and third-party product testing.
  • Support compliance and certification activities related to UL, IEC, CE, FCC, EMC, and electrical safety standards.

  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, test reports, drawings, schematics, BOMs, and certification records.
  • Support DFM, DFA, and DFT reviews with manufacturing partners.
  • Support NPI, pilot builds, and transition to mass production.
  • Track engineering, procurement, testing, and certification action items and provide regular project updates.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in electronics hardware design, PCB development, testing, manufacturing, or product compliance.
  • Hands-on experience with Altium Designer.
  • Experience with schematic capture and multilayer PCB layout.
  • Good understanding of electronic components and component selection.
  • Ability to read and review schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, BOMs, and technical specifications.
  • Basic understanding of PCB fabrication and PCBA manufacturing processes.
  • Hands-on experience with electronic test equipment.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple engineering and project coordination tasks.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with industrial electronic products.
  • Familiarity with power electronics, microcontrollers, FPGA, or DSP-based systems.
  • Experience with UL, IEC, CE, FCC, EMC, or similar certification processes.
  • Experience working with UL, Intertek, TÜV, CSA, or other certification laboratories.
  • Experience with component lifecycle management and alternate-part qualification.
  • Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems.
  • Experience supporting NPI and mass-production activities.

title: Manufacutring Engineer
description:
Job Posting Title: Manufacturing Engineer

Job Description
The Manufacturing Engineer will perform all duties in support of Polyurethane foam processing, including research and development, process specification, process optimization, quality assurance, and physical property testing. This position will provide technical support including setup, maintenance, and installation. Additionally, this position will supervise the day-to-day activities of assigned team members.


Duties and Responsibilities (but not limited to):

  • Supervises the daily activities of assigned Team Members, providing training, mentoring, coaching and performance feedback to ensure compliance to policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate with Foam Pad Process Engineer for foam hardness adjustments and foam pour patterns.
  • Assess, monitor, and set standards, examining samples of raw products or directing testing during processing, to ensure finished products are of prescribed quality.
  • Coordinate the development of formulations to meet production specifications.
  • Coordinate with production, processing and distribution in Foam Department to ensure manufacturing and quality objectives are accomplished; review with Quality Manager as needed.
  • Participate in the planning and execution of process improvement projects.
  • Manage all chemical inventory and coordinate shipments with suppliers; including Polyols, ISO, release agent, and anti-noise wax.


  • Inspect and test all incoming chemical shipments for acceptance to conformity.
  • Assist with all engineering changes, as well implementing final design; includes foam components and foam pad design.
  • Responsible for inspecting final repair, as well as optimizing mold function for optimal part quality.
  • Assist in developing and implementing production tracking and quality control systems, analyzing production, quality control, maintenance, and other operational reports, to detect production problems.
  • Recommend procedures for facility and equipment maintenance or modification, including the replacement of machines.
  • Assist in implementing and maintaining various programs such as preventative maintenance; environmental, health and safety; training; and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate with other departments to keep scrap at or below requirements.
  • Observe workflow and processes, and monitor gauges, dials, and other indicators to ensure operators conform to production, processing, and/or quality standards.
  • Follow all safety policies at all times.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in chemical, polymer science, or mechanical engineering with process experience preferred, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience with polyurethane foam systems and processing including high pressure mix heads required.
  • Automotive foam pad seating experience preferred, but not required.


Skills / Knowledge / Abilities:

  • Experience Automotive manufacturing process experience, including controlling inputs and outputs
  • Experience working with robot programming; Fanuc preferred.
  • Hands-on industrial maintenance experience required, including high-pressure mix heads, poly pumps, and flow meters.
  • Demonstrated experience with root cause investigative processes, either by serving as a team member, or as a facilitator
  • Demonstrated competencies in the areas of: leadership, initiative, teamwork, and interpersonal effectiveness
  • Demonstrated understanding of a leader's role in ensuring a safe work environment and a history of working safely and, complying with environmental, health and safety standards
  • Familiarity with TS 16949 or ISO/QS 9000 standards preferred
  • Must have proven critical thinking, problem-solving, analytical skills
  • Must have Organizational skills, the ability to multi-tasking, and a keen sense of urgency
  • Must be proficient in MS Office programs (i.e. Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
  • Must have strong leadership, initiative, teamwork, and interpersonal effectiveness
  • Must have excellent communication skills communicating with employees and management


Physical Demands:

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • Regularly required to talk and hear
  • Heavy walking and standing throughout the shift

Ensure compliance with federal and state employment laws and regulations, BHA personnel policy and union contracts. Receive and resolve complaints regarding staff. title: Estate Grounds & Horticulture Technician
description:
Position Title: Estate Grounds and Horticulture Technician
Department: Facilities
Reports To: Estate Manager and Property & Grounds Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
Employment Status: Full-Time


Position Summary

The Estate Grounds and Horticulture Technician is responsible for maintaining the appearance, functionality, and health of the Principal's residential properties, including landscapes, gardens, lawns, trees, shrubs, hardscapes, irrigation systems, and outdoor living areas, ensuring they are maintained to the highest estate standards.


This position combines horticultural, landscaping, groundskeeping, irrigation, and general property maintenance responsibilities, with an emphasis on plant health, landscape aesthetics, and proactive property care. The role plays a key part in preserving the overall presentation of the estate by identifying and addressing issues before they affect the property's condition or appearance.


The ideal candidate is a dependable, hands-on professional with horticultural knowledge and experience in landscape and grounds maintenance. Success in this role requires the ability to work independently, prioritize competing responsibilities, maintain exceptional attention to detail, and perform physically demanding work in various weather conditions. Strong organizational, communication, time management, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.


A strong work ethic, commitment to excellence, and pride in maintaining estate-quality grounds are critical to success in this role. The successful candidate must consistently demonstrate professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding the Principal, family members, guests, residences, and business matters.


Key Responsibilities


Horticulture & Plant Health

  • Perform horticultural care, including planting, transplanting, pruning, trimming, fertilizing, mulching, weeding, deadheading, and seasonal garden maintenance.
  • Maintain ornamental gardens, landscape beds, trees, shrubs, seasonal plantings, and specialty plant collections to the highest standards.
  • Monitor and assess plant health, identifying issues related to pests, disease, nutrient deficiencies, irrigation performance, and environmental stress.
  • Implement appropriate corrective actions and preventative plant health measures.
  • Assist in developing and executing seasonal planting plans and landscape enhancement projects.
  • Apply horticultural best practices to promote long-term plant vitality and sustainability.


Irrigation & Landscape Management

  • Monitor irrigation systems and identify performance issues, leaks, damaged components, and inefficiencies.
  • Perform basic irrigation troubleshooting and capable of performing repairs.
  • Ensure plant material receives appropriate watering based on seasonal conditions and landscape requirements.
  • Support property-wide landscape enhancement efforts through proactive maintenance and continuous improvement initiatives.

Grounds & Estate Maintenance

  • Maintain lawns, pathways, patios, outdoor living spaces, and landscape features in pristine condition.
  • Operate and maintain landscaping equipment, including mowers, trimmers, hedge trimmers, leaf blowers, and related tools.
  • Perform power washing of sidewalks, driveways, patios, decks, walls, gutters, and exterior surfaces.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of outdoor furnishings, storage areas, sheds, garages, and workspaces.
  • Assist with trash removal, recycling, shredding, and sanitation duties as needed.
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs. above head.

Property Support

  • Assist with inventory management of landscape materials, fertilizers, pesticides, tools, and supplies.
  • Retrieve materials and supplies from local garden centers, nurseries, and hardware suppliers.
  • Coordinate with landscape contractors, arborists, irrigation vendors, and specialty service providers as directed.
  • May be required to maintain accurate records related to plant care, fertilization schedules, pest management treatments, irrigation adjustments, and landscape projects.
  • Respond promptly to management requests and provide recommendations regarding landscape improvements and horticultural best practices.

Team Structure and Focus Areas

This position is part of a groundskeeping team dedicated to maintaining the property at the highest standards. Primary focus areas include:

  • Providing horticultural care with an emphasis on plant health, ornamental gardens, landscape enhancement, irrigation monitoring, and maintaining a meticulously manicured estate appearance.
  • Preserving and enhancing the overall aesthetic quality of the landscape through proactive plant care, seasonal improvements, and continuous property enhancement initiatives.
  • Supporting a collaborative team environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail, professionalism, and service standards.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of professional groundskeeping, gardening, or landscape experience.
  • Two (2) or more years of hands-on horticulture experience in a high-end professional setting.
  • Advanced horticultural knowledge and plant care expertise
  • Strong understanding of ornamental gardens and landscape aesthetics
  • Knowledge of irrigation systems and basic irrigation troubleshooting
  • Ability to identify common pests, diseases, and plant deficiencies
  • Attention to detail and commitment to maintaining exceptional standards
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and seasonal demands
  • Commitment to professionalism, confidentiality, and service excellence
  • Ability to recognize plant health concerns and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
  • Experience in safely operating landscape maintenance equipment and tools.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Professional demeanor, discretion, and ability to maintain confidentiality.


Key Competencies

  • Horticultural Expertise and Plant Health Management
  • Irrigation Systems Management
  • Ornamental Landscape Maintenance & Enhancement

Work Environment

  • This position involves year-round outdoor work in varying weather conditions and requires standing, walking, bending, lifting, carrying, and operating landscape equipment. The ability to perform physically demanding tasks safely and efficiently is required.

description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a Spanish Localization QA Tester / Proofreader to join a long-term.
As a Linguistic Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Spanish content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. Your main focus will be reviewing and refining localized content, making sure it reads smoothly and is free from errors. This includes checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, consistency, formatting, and cultural or contextual accuracy.
You’ll also work hands-on with products by executing test cases, identifying localization bugs, and reporting issues through internal bug-tracking systems. Once fixes are implemented, you’ll help verify that they’ve been resolved correctly. From time to time, you’ll also have the opportunity to translate content from English into Spanish. In addition, you’ll explore user interfaces to identify localization or functional issues, playing an important role in delivering a seamless and user-friendly experience.
This role is ideal for someone with native-level Spanish fluency, strong attention to detail, and an interest in quality assurance within digital products. If you’re looking for a stable, long-term role (no end date) where you can apply both your language expertise and technical skills, this is a great opportunity.
MAIN DUTIES
- Write and report relevant bugs and errors using best practices through the internal database system.
- Ability to understand and prioritize tasks and issues quickly and efficiently.
- Native language skills in Spanish and and cultural awareness of Spain
- Good oral and written communication.
- Highly organized with attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
- QA various products by accurately following testing instructions and test cases.
- Discover and report defects (bugs) using client-specific bug-tracking tools.
- Evaluate translations in the context of software, mobile apps, and documentation.
- Be a subject matter expert for linguistic issues in Spanish (from Spain ); be able to research and resolve linguistic questions.
- Adhere to project-specific quality standards, trademarks, style guides, and client-preferred checklists and glossaries.
- Troubleshoot basic problems; be able to communicate effectively and escalate testing issues.
- Complete assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner.
IDEAL BACKGROUNDS: Marketing, Journalism, Copy Editing, Proofreading, Writing, Translation, and/or Localization

title: Tax Intern
description:
Position Overview
Rudler is a full-service certified public accounting firm serving individuals and businesses throughout the greater Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky region.

Our Tax Internship provides students with a hands-on introduction to public accounting and the opportunity to experience what it's really like to work in a professional tax environment. Interns work alongside experienced CPAs and contribute to real client engagements, gaining practical experience that goes beyond the classroom.

Rather than simply shadowing professionals, our interns play an active role in the tax preparation process while receiving training, guidance, and mentorship from experienced members of our team.

Responsibilities
  • Load and organize client documents into our tax software, ensuring accuracy and completeness of source data prior to return preparation.
  • Prepare individual income tax returns (Form 1040), including schedules for common situations such as wages, interest, dividends, capital gains, and self-employment income.
  • Prepare state and local income tax returns in coordination with the related federal return.
  • Prepare estimated tax vouchers and quarterly payment calculations for individual clients.
  • Prepare extension requests
  • Assist with administrative tasks and duties as needed

Qualifications
Required
  • Currently pursuing a degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business.
  • Freshmen, Sophomores, Juniors, and Seniors are all welcomed to apply.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet firm deadlines during a high-volume season.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
Preferred
  • Completion of prior accounting coursework – specifically taxation.
  • Curiosity about the CPA exam pathway

What You Will Gain
Real-world tax experience preparing individual income tax returns for actual clients under the supervision and guidance of experienced CPAs.
  • Hands-on experience with professional tax software and the technology and workflow systems used in public accounting.
  • Exposure to a variety of real-world tax situations, giving you an opportunity to apply what you've learned in the classroom to actual client work.
  • Training and mentorship from experienced tax professionals who are invested in developing the next generation of accounting professionals.
  • A better understanding of public accounting and what a career in the profession can look like after graduation.
  • The opportunity to build relationships with experienced professionals.
  • Potential for an extended internship or full-time opportunity based on performance, interest, and business needs.

Details
This is a seasonal, paid, part-time internship aligned with the individual income tax filing season.
We understand that our interns are students first. Interns typically work approximately 20–24 hours per week, allowing them to gain meaningful professional experience while continuing to prioritize their college coursework. We offer flexibility around class schedules, exams, and other academic commitments.

Specific internship dates and schedules will be discussed during the interview process.

Strong-performing interns may have the opportunity to extend their internship beyond the tax busy season, providing additional experience and continued exposure to the firm. Extended internship opportunities are not guaranteed and are based on the firm's staffing needs, the volume and type of work available after busy season, and the intern's performance and interest in continuing with Rudler.

title: Operations Technologist
description:

title: Finch Bander/Strapper Operator 3rd Shift
description:
Position Overview:

The Bander/Strapper Operator is responsible for the final inspection, unitizing, and secure strapping of finished corrugated products prior to shipment or storage. This position ensures all finished units meet customer specifications and company quality standards, including proper packaging, labeling, palletizing, and strapping. The operator performs both automatic and manual strapping and is accountable for maintaining a clean, organized, and safe work area.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform final inspection of finished goods coming off production machines to ensure all specifications and quality standards are met.
  • Strap and unitize loads using both automatic strapping machines and manual hand strapping tools.
  • Verify that each order is completed per hard card directions, including any special packaging requirements such as poly bags, slip sheets, corner protectors, or custom pallets.
  • Ensure proper identification, labeling, and stacking of finished units for shipping or warehousing.
  • Perform basic preventive maintenance and cleaning of strapping and unitizing equipment.
  • Responsible for operating, monitoring, and maintaining automated equipment controlled by specialized software (computer skills).
  • Maintain good housekeeping and organization in the strapper/unitizer area.
  • Identify potential problems (such as damaged loads or improper stacking) before strapping to prevent quality or safety issues.
  • Assist with monthly inventory counts as needed.
  • Communicate effectively with machine operators, material handlers, and shift leads to ensure efficient workflow.
  • Follow all safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe work environment.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of 3 months of experience in the packaging industry.
  • Ability to read and follow hard card instructions, job tickets, and production specifications.
  • Proficient in both automatic and manual (hand) strapping operations.
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to product quality and accuracy.
  • Good mechanical aptitude and ability to perform preventive maintenance on equipment.
  • Ability to maintain a neat, clean, and organized work area at all times.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills:

  • Prior experience operating banders, unitizers, or strapping equipment in a corrugated or paper packaging environment.
  • Familiarity with machine center flow and packaging line operations.
  • Forklift certification or material handling experience.

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

title: Senior Specialist Manufacturing Engineering - Electrical
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. **Job Title:** **Senior Specialist Manufacturing Engineering - Electrical**

**Job Code: 43595**

**Job Location:** **On-site Norfolk, VA**

**Job Schedule:** **5X8 (M-F)**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris Technologies, Inc. is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer, Electrical in Norfolk, VA.  This role is responsible for supporting the design, sustainment, and continuous improvement of electrical and electronic products used in naval shipboard communication and navigation products. This role focuses on obsolescence management, printed circuit board (PCB) redesigns, development of production test equipment, and engineering support for manufacturing operations.

**Essential Functions:**

- Work closely with design engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and production teams to ensure products remain manufacturable, reliable, and compliant with customer and military requirements.
- Manage electronic component obsolescence by identifying at-risk components, evaluating replacement options, and implementing engineering solutions to maintain product availability.
- Design, update, troubleshoot, and maintain production and engineering test fixtures used for manufacturing, qualification, and acceptance testing.
- Perform PCB respins to address component obsolescence, design improvements, manufacturability enhancements, and defect corrections while maintaining form, fit, and function.
- Create and modify electrical schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation.
- Support root cause investigations and corrective actions for electrical failures encountered during production and testing.
- Develop and execute verification and validation testing for PCB revisions and test fixture modifications.
- Generate and maintain engineering change orders (ECOs), bills of materials (BOMs), assembly drawings, and technical documentation.
- Provide technical support to production personnel and assist in resolving manufacturing issues in a timely manner.
- Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, cost reduction, and manufacturing efficiency.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related engineering discipline and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.5+ years of experience in electrical engineering within a manufacturing environment.
- Experience with PCB design, schematic capture, and board-level troubleshooting.
- Knowledge of electronic components, component lifecycle management, and obsolescence mitigation.
- Experience designing or modifying production test fixtures and automated test equipment.
- Familiarity with engineering documentation, BOM management, and engineering change processes.
- Proficiency using electronic CAD tools such as Altium Designer, OrCAD, Cadence, or similar software.
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
- Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Experience supporting military, defense or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
- Knowledge of Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Testability (DFT), and IPC standards.
- Experience with microcontroller-based designs.
- Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
- Experience supporting military qualification testing and environmental testing.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in Virginia is $84,000- $156,000. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. title: BH School Wellness Coordinator
description:
About Us
Volunteers of America North Louisiana is a faith-based, nonprofit organization with a mission to provide opportunity, promote dignity, and inspire change in all who find their way to us. As a church without walls, we do this through personalized housing, health, and human services that benefit children and families, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and senior adults.
Founded in 1896 by social reformers Ballington and Maud Booth, Volunteers of America began as a movement of “volunteers” who were committed and sought to "reach and uplift" the American people. Volunteers of America North Louisiana began in Shreveport in 1935 with the opening of a shelter for women and children. Leading with our long-standing reputation and brand, the agency has grown to operate 40 programs, which tackle our communities’ most pressing issues and integrate our deep compassion with highly effective programs.
Thanks to our dedicated team of more than 350 employees, along with thousands of volunteers, donors, and supporters, we aim to give hope to thousands of people each year. We endeavor to attract qualified and caring individuals to consider a career with us and experience a collaborative culture that offers challenging, stimulating, and rewarding opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Position:
DeSoto Parish Behavioral Health School Wellness Coordinator
_________________________________________________________________________________________________
Position Type: Full-Time
Education Level:
Bachelor's degree in education, counseling, psychology, social work, or other human service-related field
Salary Range:
$18-23 per hour depending on experience
Travel Required:
Yes, local travel required
_________________________________________________________________________________________________
Benefits
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Accrue sick time and vacation time
  • Paid holidays
  • 401K with matching after 1 year of service
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
JOB SUMMARY:
Serves as a school-based member of an integrated behavioral health and trauma-services team, collaborating with the School Wellness Team to strengthen student well-being and school culture. The Coordinator provides trauma-informed prevention and social-emotional wellness activities, supports early identification and approved screening, delivers targeted interventions and crisis-prevention follow-up, and connects students and families to appropriate behavioral health and basic-needs resources before concerns escalate
JOB DUTIES:
1. Build trusting relationships with students, families, and other supports to improve student functioning at school, home, and in the community.
2. Work collaboratively with the School Wellness Team, school personnel, clinicians, community providers, and child-serving agencies to coordinate services, solve barriers, and promote continuity of care.
3. Work regularly in school and community settings, conduct outreach, connect families with behavioral health and basic-needs resources, and travel locally as required.
4. Help establish school-specific wellness goals and implement trauma-informed campus prevention, mental health awareness, social-emotional skill building, and student engagement activities.
5. Maintain an appropriate student caseload; assess needs and progress; provide approved individual and group supports; and engage caregivers through outreach, education, and advocacy.
6. Recognize and respond to escalating concerns using approved de-escalation and crisis procedures, including post-crisis follow-up and connection to higher levels of care.
7. Complete accurate, timely, and confidential documentation in the electronic health record and other approved systems; track required contacts, services, outcomes, and grant data.
8. Participate consistently in clinical supervision, team meetings, required training, fidelity monitoring, and quality-improvement activities; seek guidance when needs exceed the role’s scope.
9. Communicate promptly, manage competing priorities, meet established productivity and deadline expectations, and maintain professional and ethical standards.
JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

title: ADC Engineer, Identity
description:
Amazon Web Services is a dynamic and rapidly growing business. We are building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world and need world class people to help us implement and operate them.

We provide organizations with building block web services that allow them to innovate faster and operate their software more cost-effectively. These services-in-the-cloud include on-demand compute capacity, storage, content delivery, querying of structured data, message queuing, and more.

The AWS Identity & Access team is building and delivering the next generation of cloud computing security that supports public AWS offerings like S3, EC2, and CloudFront. We are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed security systems involving identity management, federation, web services security, single sign-on, and much more. We enable our customers to control some of the most sensitive secrets on the Internet.

A successful ADCE Engineer does much more than plug computers together and track changes. They are instrumental in deploying, operating, and scaling a massive always-on distributed system that is core to all of AWS. We are looking for a experienced and motivated engineer to join our fast-moving and passionate team.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Automation/CSV C&Q Technical Lead
description:
About Company:

JC Automation Corp. (JCA) was founded in 1997 with the mission of filling a gap between technology and regulatory requirements in the life science manufacturing industry. The company offers highly capable resources at an affordable cost to build solutions and execute projects in: Automation, Control Systems Integration, Information Technology, System Integration and Regulatory Compliance.

JCA is a HUBZone Certified Small Business Firm, NMSDC Certified Minority Business Enterprise, and Certified Critical Industry Supplier. It’s mission is to add value by delivering quality services & solutions on time all the time by transforming processes & technology into business advantages.

ABOUT THE ROLE


The CSV C&Q Technical Lead is responsible for defining, developing and delivering the CSV requirements, documentation and technical input needed by the C&Q program throughout its lifecycle — from Design and documentation preparation through FAT, CM oversight, MC, integrated execution and handover to the Client USER team.

RESPONSIBILITIES


The scope of CSV activities relates to the computerized systems and automation supporting Process and Process Support Equipment. The CSV SME owns the development, review and approval of CSV requirements, test plans, specifications and documentation, working closely with CQV leads/specialists, engineers, operations personnel, engineering and external vendors, contractors, sub-contractors including the automation integrator and CSV service provider(s).

Aside to delivering in line with the Client C+Q requirements, the CSV Lead will ensure that CSV-specific Compliance, Quality and HSE objectives are achieved in line with the overall Project Budget and Baseline Schedule. The CSV Lead will form part of the Client core team, attending core team meetings, providing CSV requirements and guidance at each project phase and representing PDP in terms of CSV-related contractual obligations.

Following are the summary of this role responsibilities:

  • Partner with process engineering to ensure automation requirements are aligned with business needs.
  • Manage technical changes and provide technical direction through all software development and testing activities.
  • Partner with the Design Verification Lead to ensure alignment between CSV and verification expectations.
  • Provide direction for CSV strategy, validation approach, and major CSV deliverables (Requirements, Design, Security Plan, Test Plan, etc.).
  • Lead development and execution of Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) for automation and control systems.
  • Develop all related CSV documentation (validation plans, requirements traceability matrices, test scripts, summary reports) ensuring it complies with GAMP 5 and applicable specifications and Lilly quality system procedures.
  • Coordinate CSV activities with Quality Assurance, Automation Engineering, and Commissioning teams to support project schedule and data integrity requirements.
  • Manage deviations, discrepancies, and change controls associated with C&Q and CSV activities.
  • Develop and maintain CSV training materials and matrices for the CSV team, automation integrator, CSV service provider, and Client USER groups.
  • Support FAT/SAT execution and assist with system handover to the Client USER team.
  • Provide CSV input to the C&Q schedule and progress reporting, including system definition/classification and baseline CSV milestones.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Automation, Controls, Chemical/Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical direction on automation system architecture, hardware/software platforms, and programming standards within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or comparable regulated capital-project environment.
  • Experience reviewing control system and packaged equipment vendor documentation and supporting automation hardware, software, and licensing procurement.
  • Working knowledge of data historians, batch reporting systems, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
  • Experience performing functional P&ID reviews, leading prototyping activities, and managing technical/engineering changes.
  • Strong understanding of Computer System Validation (CSV) principles, GAMP 5 methodology, and data integrity (ALCOA+) requirements.
  • Experience developing and executing C&Q protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) and major CSV deliverables, including validation plans, requirements traceability matrices, test scripts, and summary reports.
  • Ability to partner effectively with Design Verification, Process Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Commissioning teams.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills to drive technical direction across multi-disciplinary teams under a dynamic project schedule.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS

  • Prior experience as an Automation Lead or CSV/C&Q Technical Lead on a large-scale pharmaceutical or biotech capital project.
  • Familiarity with Client's systems, guidelines, and quality procedures.
  • Experience with alarm management strategy and manufacturing execution system (MES) implementation.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections and audits related to automation and computer system validation.

title: Mobile Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

  • Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

  • Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (React Native, Swift or Kotlin), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

  • Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

  • Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in active build phase, small, and growing.


The role

You lead the system. You act as the system architect of our tool: you own how it works as a whole, make the trade-offs between subsystems, and make sure optics, mechanics, electronics and software come together as one machine. You take over a growing part of this role as the team and the product mature.

You will:

  • Own the system architecture and the key technical decisions

  • Translate performance goals into system and subsystem requirements, and keep them traceable

  • Make and maintain the system budgets, and decide where performance is won or lost

  • Define and guard the interfaces between subsystems

  • Steer the subsystem engineers: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve conflicts between disciplines

  • Set up verification and integration: test plans, acceptance criteria and evidence that the system does what it should

  • Carry the system from prototype toward a product, and shape our systems engineering way of working


Your profile

  • 10+ years of experience in high-tech equipment, with several years in a system engineering or system architect role

  • Experience leading the technical development of a complex system in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Strong in requirements engineering, system budgets and interface management

  • A broad technical base: you hold your own in discussions on optics, precision mechanics, control and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid and you are as likely to be at the lab bench as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Optical metrology or computational imaging

  • Taking a product from prototype to production, including SEMI standards and CE marking

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

  • Customer-facing work such as specification negotiation or tool acceptance

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was different but you have led the technical side of a complex machine, apply anyway.


What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at .

View the SENS Product Catalog


Summary

SENS is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer with a strong product compliance focus to join our engineering team and help develop the next generation of industrial power products. This role is broader than a traditional compliance-only position: the engineer will translate customer, regulatory, and internal needs into clear system requirements, architectures, verification plans, and compliant product designs.


The Senior Systems Engineer will contribute across the full product lifecycle, from concept investigation and feasibility assessment through design, integration, certification, production launch, and ongoing product support. The role works at the center of electrical, mechanical, firmware/software, sales, manufacturing, product management, and external certification partners to ensure SENS products are reliable, manufacturable, certifiable, and clear in their technical intent.


SENS products include industrial power systems, battery chargers and inverters, engine starting systems, and DC back-up power systems across a wide power range from 150W to 100kW.


Responsibilities

  • Translate high-level product needs into system-level specifications, design requirements, interface requirements, and verification criteria that guide engineering decisions.
  • Develop and maintain validation and compliance test matrices for assigned products and platforms.
  • Identify technical, compliance, and programmatic risks early in the design process; assess tradeoffs and help develop mitigation plans that reduce risk to schedule, cost, quality, and certification.
  • Interpret and apply complex safety, EMC, performance, and environmental standards and codes to SENS product designs.
  • Provide actionable compliance design requirements such as pollution degree, creepage and clearance, hipot voltages, thermal limits, circuit protection, wiring, terminations, and enclosure requirements.
  • Coordinate product compliance submittals, testing, follow-up service reports, and maintenance with certification agencies such as UL, seismic certification bodies, ABS, and others.
  • Perform compliance assessments, testing, and documentation for self-declarations and customer requirements, including CE marking, NFPA 110, RoHS, REACH, Conflict Minerals, and related obligations.
  • Define and maintain traceability between requirements, design elements, compliance obligations, and verification activities.
  • Support system architecture definition across hardware, software, interfaces, wiring, data flows, and product-level dependencies.
  • Coordinate integration activities across electrical, mechanical, firmware/software, manufacturing, and documentation teams to ensure subsystems work together as intended.
  • Plan and support system-level testing to confirm that products meet functional, reliability, regulatory, and customer requirements.
  • Facilitate peer-to-peer and cross-functional design reviews to ensure designs satisfy system requirements and regulatory expectations.
  • Generate and maintain customer-facing technical specifications, specification tables, and specifying engineer documentation as needed.
  • Maintain compliance test equipment, calibrations, procedures, and working knowledge of standards changes that apply to SENS products.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, systems engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • 5+ years of relevant engineering experience in systems engineering, product engineering, regulatory compliance, or certification for hardware-based products.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering hardware-based products to market.
  • Strong understanding of AC/DC power circuits, circuit protection, system wiring and terminations, power supplies, batteries, and industrial power products.
  • Experience translating customer, regulatory, and product needs into clear requirements, specifications, design inputs, and verification plans.
  • Working knowledge of safety, EMC, performance, and environmental standards that apply to industrial electrical equipment and power conversion products.
  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70) as it relates to equipment design.
  • Experience interpreting standards and converting them into practical design, documentation, and test requirements.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, systems-level thinking, problem solving, time management, and critical thinking skills.
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities under time pressure while maintaining attention to technical detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, sales, manufacturing, product management, customers, and certification agencies.
  • Customer-focused and reliability-focused mindset with a strong commitment to product quality and engineering process discipline.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with industrial battery chargers, DC power systems, inverters, engine starting systems, energy storage systems, or related power conversion products.
  • Product certification experience with UL, seismic, ABS, CE marking, or similar certification and compliance programs.
  • Experience with standards such as UL 1012, UL 1236, UL 508A, UL 1973, and UL 1741.
  • Experience developing requirements traceability, system architecture documentation, validation matrices, or specifying engineer documentation.
  • Experience supporting products from concept and feasibility through certification, production launch, and field support.

title: Data Engineer (All Genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

Why Join Us?

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

Our Data & Analytics team will provide critical cross-functional support across all STARK defence programs. We build robust infrastructure, tools, and data pipelines that ingest and process massive streams of telemetry, sensor, and video data from our autonomous systems. Working in a collaborative and fast-paced engineering environment, our mission is to empower software, hardware, and operational teams with clean, reliable, and real-time data.

Your Mission

As a Data / Software Engineer, you will own the end-to-end data pipelines and tooling supporting STARK's autonomous defence systems. You will design, build, and optimize scalable data architectures to capture, process, and analyze complex telemetry, sensor, and video data across multiple product lines. description:

title: Program Coordinator, HCVP
description:
About Us

Founded in 1937, the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC) has kept the promise of public housing alive. It has done so by maintaining and modernizing its buildings and enriching the lives of its residents through innovative social services, recreational and educational programs, and job training initiatives. What makes HABC successful is the dedication of its employees and its history of strong leadership.


HABC Benefits

Health and Well-Being

At the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC), we offer a competitive benefits package that supports our recruitment and retention goals and meets the diverse, evolving needs of our employees. HABC’s comprehensive benefits package includes:

Vacation and Leave

  • Universal leave program
  • 12 paid holidays

Health and Wellness

  • Medical and dental insurance
  • Employer‑paid vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Free health and wellness programs

Income Protection and Retirement

  • Life insurance with optional additional coverage
  • Short‑term disability
  • Voluntary Plans
  • Retirement programs with employee contribution options


Position Summary

Under general supervision, provides leadership and oversight in units of the Housing Choice Voucher Program (HCVP). Administers aspects of the program and reviews for accuracy and quality of work completed in HCVP. Performs responsible analytical and administrative work in support of the HCVP/Section 8 programs. Provides detailed training to new and current Program Specialists and others on new initiatives and refresher topics, as necessary. Enforces adherence to HABC policies and procedures and HUD regulations. Works to maintain HCVP partnerships with the special referral programs, responds to complaints, and mediates solutions. Recommends methods to improve efficiency and accuracy and assists the Manager with general oversight. Serves as acting manager in the absence of the Manager. Provides excellent customer service assistance orally and in writing to employees, clients, landlords, applicants, participants, and other agencies. Performance of the duties requires the ability to understand and interpret policies, regulations, and procedures. Performance of the duties requires excellent supervisory skills, customer service skills, good problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail. Prepares for and attends Court Hearings, as assigned.

All activities must support the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (“HABC” or “Authority”) mission, strategic goals, and objectives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The position duties and responsibilities listed below describe the general nature and scope of work. Other responsibilities, duties, and skills may be required and assigned, as needed.

  1. Performs customer service functions
    • Provides customer service to applicants, participants, property owners, other agencies, and employees. Assists clients by responding to inquiries via mail, e-mail, and telephone.
    • Accurately disseminates HCVP information to applicants, participants, owners, and all other interested parties in the community.
    • Explains HUD regulations, HCVP policies and procedures, and contract terms to owners and tenants. Interprets HABC policies and procedures and HUD regulations to staff and customers.
    • Retrieves information from program software to answer inquiries and assist customers in resolving problems, concerns, and complaints.
  2. Trains and provides guidance to new and current HCVP employees, and other HABC stakeholders concerning the following:
    • HUD regulations and HABC Administrative Plan
    • HUD and HCVP Eligibility and Continued Assistance policies and procedures
    • Technical HCVP Program requirements
    • HCVP Landlord Portal, Applicant Portal and Resident Portal
    • Procedures for determining eligibility, calculating income and rent, the leasing process, Housing Quality Standards (HQS) Inspections, and denials and termination of assistance.
    • Methods to improve caseload management, productivity, and morale.
  3. Educate and advise HCVP applicants and participants, new and current landlords/owners, and community stakeholders concerning the following:
    • HUD regulations and HABC Administrative Plan
    • HCVP special housing programs
    • HCVP incentives
    • HCVP Landlord Portal, Applicant Portal and Resident Portal
  4. Attends internal management and staff meetings and external meetings with property owners or landlords, housing agencies, and government officials.
  5. Drafts and types a variety of written correspondence to clients, applicants, participants, landlords, employees, and other agencies.
  6. Responds to and troubleshoots complaints from private/public sectors. Mediates and arbitrates landlord/tenant disputes, negotiates fair and equitable solutions to problems involving repairs, rents, maintenance, terminations, or payment reimbursements.
  7. Monitors special programs and projects; tracks and reports on statuses and outcomes.
  8. Coordinates special events that can include (but not limited to) expedited interviewing and briefing sessions, housing fairs and outreach, and hosting informational landlord sessions for landlord recruitment.
  9. Evaluates termination referrals. Examines applicant and participant folders, verifying that the correct documentation is in the file. Gathers evidence and prepares cases to present at hearings concerning terminations and repayment of funds as assigned. Attends and presents testimony in district and circuit court.
  10. Complies with HUD Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Enterprise Income Verification (EIV) requirements.
  11. Provides weekly reports of program activity to Managers.
  12. Serves as Acting Manager in the absence of the Manager.
  1. Performs the following quality control tasks:
  • Reviews and monitors the work of others to ensure quality control, adherence to HABC policies and procedures and HUD regulations, and ensures compliance with applicable performance and production standards.
  • Conducts desk audits to confirm confidential documents are not visible and monitors the number of files at the desk.
  • Audits monetary transactions for accuracy to prevent fraud and abuse.
  • Identifies, corrects, and tracks errors; monitors progress with MAP errors.
  • Reviews and recommends changes to policies and procedures to minimize errors and/or the impact of errors.
  • Investigates accounts to determine the validity of payments, terminations, payment, or reimbursement of payment.
  • Controls payments and/or suspends, terminates, reinstates, and recovers money.
  1. Performs the following leadership tasks:
  • Recommends hiring and promoting.
  • Assigns staff daily work schedules.
  • Collaborates with manager to implement unit goals and procedures
  • Completes weekly case reviews.
  • Monitors and reviews quality and quantity of daily production.
  • Ensures accuracy of work performed,
  • Meets with staff to gather updates, answer questions, and review workload.
  • Recommends improvements in workflow efficiencies.
  • Assists with addressing staff concerns.
  • Mentors employees toward improvement, recommends corrective actions (up to termination) and ensures that necessary corrective actions are taken.
  • Interviews New Hires.
  1. Performs other duties as assigned.

Additional Duties based on assignment:

  1. Continued Assistance, Site Based, RAD, Applications & Waiting List:
    • Reviews rent calculations for completeness and accuracy to determine tenant portions and housing assistance. Investigates to determine the validity of payments, terminations, or reimbursement of payments.
    • Provides applicants and participants with community-based information, i.e., social services and housing agencies such as shelters, fair housing agencies, Legal Aid Bureau Inc., and government-sponsored social services agencies. Makes referrals to other service agencies and organizations as warranted.
    • Monitors applicant selection, preference policies, portability, denials of assistance, voucher issuance, expiration, and withdrawals.
    • Ensures documents are processed within the required timeframe.
    • Monitors procedures for specific actions, reviews household composition and income, explains regulations, and informs the client of results.
    • Maintains accurate records for assignments, initiates payments, suspends, terminates, or reinstates payments and recovers monies. Compiles and updates data and prepares reports. Assists with correcting and processing errors.
    • Completes caseload as assigned.
    • Monitors contract renewal dates, rent increase requests, and current vacancies; ensures timely submission of move-in documents from landlords for project-based programs,
    • Supervises and ensures home visits are scheduled and conducted within required time frames. Creates and maintains a log of home visit outcomes and prepares reports.


Minimum Education, Training, and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, social service, or related field(s) and a minimum of three (3) years of experience in low-income, HUD Housing Choice Voucher Program (HCVP), dealing with property management, leasing, and contracting. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.


Special Requirements

  • Possession of a valid Maryland driver's license.
  • Must be able to be covered under the Authority's vehicle insurance policy.
  • Must not engage in private real estate business.


Other Requirements:

  • Availability to work some evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Successful completion of a pre-screening investigation, including verification of employment history and education credentials.
  • A 6-month probationary period applies to this full-time permanent position.


FOR INTERNAL CANDIDATES ONLY: Current HABC employees who are on probation, whether due to initial new hire status (6 months) or promotion (3 months), will have the opportunity to apply for other roles within HABC once their probationary period is successfully completed. This allows time for growth, development, and the demonstration of their skills and commitment, paving the way for new opportunities within the organization.

If you are currently under the progressive disciplinary process or have received disciplinary action within the past six (6) months, it may impact your ability to be considered for promotion within HABC. Please refer to the Manual of Personnel Policies or the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement for additional information regarding the disciplinary process.

title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**_Job Title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering_**

**_Job Location: Millersville, MD; Northampton, MA or Camden, NJ_**

**_Job Schedule: 9/80_**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a highly motivated **Business Process and Systems Team Leader** to lead a team responsible for the support, optimization, and continuous improvement of business processes and systems within our **SAP environment**. This role will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders, IT, and functional teams to ensure SAP solutions effectively support operational objectives, drive process efficiency, and enable scalable business performance.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of **people leadership, business process expertise, SAP functional knowledge, and cross-functional collaboration skills**. This position will oversee process standardization, system enhancements, issue resolution, and strategic improvement initiatives across SAP-related platforms and integrated applications.

**Essential Functions:**

- Lead and develop a team responsible for business process support and system administration within SAP environments.
- Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into scalable SAP process and system solutions.
- Drive continuous improvement of end-to-end business processes, with emphasis on efficiency, standardization, compliance, and user experience.
- Oversee day-to-day support for SAP modules, related business systems, and integrated applications.
- Manage prioritization, troubleshooting, and resolution of system/process issues in coordination with IT, SAP functional analysts, developers, and third-party support teams.
- Lead requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, testing, training, and deployment of SAP enhancements and projects.
- Ensure business processes and system configurations align with company policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.
- Support SAP upgrades, migrations, integrations, and transformation initiatives.
