title: B106 Operator 1st Shift
description:
Position Overview:

The B106 Operator is responsible for the safe, efficient, and conforming operation of the B106 work center. This role leads the machine crew through proper setup, operation, quality checks, and preventive maintenance tasks to ensure consistent production performance. The operator must understand all aspects of die-cutting operations and maintain high standards of product quality, machine readiness, and crew coordination.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

- Machine Operation & Production

· Lead and perform all setup, operational, and preventative maintenance functions for the B106 work center.

· Ensure safe and efficient operation of the machine at all times.

· Maintain product conformity through accurate setup, quality checks, and sampling procedures.

· Verify tooling readiness and ensure all tooling, dies, and components meet production requirements.

· Perform external make-ready activities to minimize downtime.

· Oversee and execute all make-ready tasks, ensuring proper alignment, calibration, and adjustment.

· Complete setup verification checklists to ensure compliance with standards.

· Input accurate and timely production information into required systems or logs.

- Quality & Sampling

· Perform and oversee the sampling plan according to customer and internal quality specifications.

· Communicate any quality concerns, obstacles, or production needs to supervisors, maintenance, quality, or other relevant personnel.

- Crew Leadership & Coordination

· Direct crew members in all aspects of B106 work center operations.

· Participate in feeding and off-bearing as necessary to support efficient production flow.

· Provide clear communication regarding priorities, issues, and expectations

Maintenance & Housekeeping

· Perform and oversee preventive maintenance tasks required for safe and reliable machine operation.

· Maintain machine and surrounding area in clean, organized condition.

Required Education, Skills & Qualifications:

· Basic understanding of overall plant operations and manufacturing workflow.

· Thorough knowledge of die-cutting principles, equipment, and operational techniques.

· Ability to lead and coordinate crew members in all machine-related tasks.

· 1–3 years of related experience in corrugated manufacturing, die-cutting, or equivalent combination of training and experience.

· Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to safety and product quality.

Preferred Skills:

· Strong communication skills and ability to work well under pressure.

· Mechanical aptitude and ability to troubleshoot routine machine issues.

· Proactive approach to improving setup times, quality, and productivity.

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

JOB SUMMARY:
The Talent Development Specialist attracts, retains and develops talent to support employer relationships, economic gardening, retention, and expansion. The Talent Development Specialist is charged with the responsibility to ensure that services are business customer focused and outcome based with the ultimate placement of job candidates to meet businesses hiring needs being of the highest priority.   1. Actively participate in continuous quality improvement processes.
  1. Perform other duties as assigned.

  1. Excellent analytical skills - strong problem solving skills, communicates in a clear and succinct manner and effectively evaluates information and data to make decisions, anticipates obstacles and develops plans to resolve.
  1. Interpersonal skills necessary to effectively communicate in both oral and written form with prior experience in public speaking.
  1. Communication and organizational skills that contribute to a quality work environment and the ability to work as a team.
  1. Planning and time management skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
  1. Considerable ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, fellow employees, state and local agencies, and the general public.
  1. Ability to organize, prioritize, and maintain confidentiality while providing patient, friendly, and participant centered services.
  1. Proven customer focus - ability to evaluate decisions through the eyes of the customer builds strong customer relationships and creates processes from customers viewpoint.
  1. Change oriented - actively generates process improvements supports and drives change and confronts difficult circumstances in creative ways.

About Company:

JC Automation Corp. (JCA) was founded in 1997 with the mission of filling a gap between technology and regulatory requirements in the life science manufacturing industry. The company offers highly capable resources at an affordable cost to build solutions and execute projects in: Automation, Control Systems Integration, Information Technology, System Integration and Regulatory Compliance.

JCA is a HUBZone Certified Small Business Firm, NMSDC Certified Minority Business Enterprise, and Certified Critical Industry Supplier. It’s mission is to add value by delivering quality services & solutions on time all the time by transforming processes & technology into business advantages.

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Engineer is responsible for planning, executing, and documenting commissioning and qualification activities for facilities, utilities, equipment, and manufacturing systems within regulated environments. They ensure systems are properly installed, operate as intended, and meet approved design, quality, and regulatory requirements before release for operational use.


Focus: Focuses on commissioning, qualification, testing, and turnover of equipment, utilities, and systems. Emphasizes technical execution, documentation accuracy, system readiness, regulatory compliance, and verification against approved requirements and specifications.


RESPONSIBILITIES

1.Develop and execute C&Q protocols, including FAT/SAT and IQ/OQ/PQ.

2.Review URS, specifications, drawings, P&IDs, and vendor documentation.

3. Verify equipment installation and functional performance.

4. Perform field inspections, testing, and system verification.

5. Manage discrepancies, punch-list items, and deviations.

6. Prepare qualification reports and turnover documentation.

7. Support startup, troubleshooting, and operational readiness.

8. Ensure compliance with GMP and site quality requirements.


REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required

1. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or related technical discipline.

2. Experience in commissioning, qualification, validation, engineering, or equipment startup within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or regulated manufacturing environments.

3. Knowledge of GMP requirements and qualification lifecycle principles.

4. Experience developing and executing commissioning and qualification protocols.

5. Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, electrical drawings, equipment specifications, and engineering documents.

6. Understanding of equipment, utilities, instrumentation, control systems, and manufacturing processes.

7. Strong technical writing, troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills.

8. Ability to perform field activities and collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams.


Preferred

1. Experience with process equipment, clean utilities, HVAC, purified water/WFI, compressed gases, manufacturing equipment, or automation systems.

2. Knowledge of ASTM E2500, ISPE guidance, and risk-based qualification approaches.

3. Experience with FAT, SAT, commissioning, IQ/OQ/PQ, and system turnover.

4. Familiarity with electronic C&Q platforms such as Kneat or similar systems.

5. Experience supporting equipment startup and troubleshooting in pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

6. Knowledge of instrumentation, PLC/HMI systems, and automation interfaces.

7. Experience supporting regulatory inspections and quality audits.

title: Putkistosuunnittelija
description:
Haemme putkistosuunnittelijaa Helsinkiin, Lahteen tai Tampereen toimipisteelle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Roolissa tulet työskentelemään asiakasyrityksiemme projektien ja suunnittelutehtävien parissa.

Tarjoamme sinulle haastavan toimenkuvan mielenkiintoisessa työympäristössä, erilaisten teknisten suunnitelmien tuottamisessa. Hakemallamme henkilöllä on aikaisempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden putkistosuunnittelusta.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

– Soveltuva alan koulutus, insinööri tai diplomi-insinööri

-Ainakin yhden putkistosuunnitteluohjelmiston tuntemus (esimerkiksi AutoCADPlant 3D, E3D, Vertex G4)

– Aikaisempaa työkokemusta suunnittelutehtävistä tai teollisuuden projekteista

– Sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomen- ja englannin kielen taitoa

– Hyviä kommunikointi- ja tiimityötaitoja, oma-aloitteisuutta ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

Vastuut:

– Suunnitelmien laatiminen asiakasvaatimusten sekä kussakin kohteessa sovellettavien standardien mukaisesti

– Lähtötietojen hankkiminen teollisuuskohteista yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa

– Tiimityö yhdessä sähkö-, mekaniikka-, ja rakennussuunnittelutiimien kanssa

– Huolehtiminen oman työn aikataulussa pysymisestä, ja koordinointi/suunnitelmien päivitys tarvittaessa projektipäällikön kanssa

ALTEN Finland tarjoaa monipuolisen ja haastavan toimenkuvan, jossa sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittyä omien kykyjesi ja kiinnostustesi mukaan. Pääset työskentelemään rennossa ja matalan hierarkian omaavassa työyhteisössä yhdessä ammattitaitoisten ja auttamishaluisten oman alansa ammattilaisten kanssa. Hyvän ilmapiirin ja kiinnostavien työtehtävien lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle myös kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kilpailukykyiset työsuhde-edut. Laaja työterveyshuolto pitää huolta työntekijöidemme terveydestä ja haluamme huolehtia myös työajan ulkopuolella työntekijöidemme turvallisuudesta sekä hyvinvoinnista laajalla vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella.

title: Merchandise Planner - Apparel & Accessories
description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

Title & Reporting Relationships

Position Title:

Merchandise Planner – Apparel & Accessories

Reports to:

Director – Planning & Retail

Department:

Operations

Oversees:

N/A

Interactions:

Merchandising, Ecommerce, Retail, Wholesale, Finance


Main Purpose and Major Challenges of the Role


The Merchandise Planner is responsible for driving sales and profit by managing product assortments, inventory and pricing, using data analysis to forecast demand, optimize online/direct to consumer presentation and wholesale availability to ensure the right products are available at the right time to support the company's financial goals. The Merchandise Planner will primarily focus on maximizing inventory turn and margin, analyzing trends, and adapting to fast paced digital demand signals. This role reports to the Director – Planning & Retail and will be highly cross-functional, partnering with Merchandising and Channel Owners by bringing strategic and analytical insights to influence the brand’s strategy and vision.

​

ACCOUNTABILITY: DEMAND & INVENTORY PLANNING


Demand Planning

  • Manage in-season forecasting to meet or exceed key performance indicators, including sales, margins, and inventory health, balances, age/turns, and weeks of supply.
  • Maintain models and forecasting techniques to improve demand accuracy.
  • Ensure demand forecasts incorporate historical data, business inputs, and market trends.
  • Collaborate with each sales channel (Ecommerce, Wholesale and Retail), merchandising, marketing, supply chain, operations and finance to drive alignment on forecasts, 3PL capacity and inventory planning.
  • Responsible for the aggregation of data across channels for initial projections and pre- and post-market margin roll out.
  • Partner with Director of Planning & Retail to develop and build standardized reports to perform in-season selling analysis and post season hind-sighting.


Inventory Planning

  • Ensure forecasting objectives are achieved, review potential risks/opportunities between the demand plan and financial plan, and collaborate cross functionally to mitigate and reduce inventory risk
  • Analyze inventory levels, turnover rates, and sell-through data to identify potential stockouts, overstock situations, and slow-moving items.
  • Monitor and adjust model stock levels as needed to ensure adequate inventory availability.
  • Review sales forecasts and current orders to assess inventory status and upcoming production needs
  • Evaluate inventory aging and recommend price action based on WOS/sell-thru and seasonality to project/select permanent markdowns.
  • Monitor and manage inventory levels weekly to ensure optimal stock availability.
  • Optimize stock levels and develop/maintain replenishment strategies to balance sales goals with inventory costs.
  • Develop size curve analysis to better purchase in-season and pre-season inventory and avoid out of stocks


ACCOUNTABILITY: MERCHANDISE PLANNING

Merchandise Planning

  • Collaborate on aligning inventory with product launches and seasonal trends.
  • Partner with Product Operations to ensure product availability meets merchandising strategies and promotional plans.
  • Partner with Merchandising to develop Sku plan guidance to drive Sku productivity on quarterly/seasonal basis and eliminate unproductive Skus
  • Analyze the business on an on-going basis to understand core drivers; identify opportunities and risks and partner with Merchandising and Product Operations to respond appropriately
  • Present qualitative and quantitative hind sighting for Merchandising team’s quarterly business reviews and senior management meetings; identify product and delivery flow risks and cross-division opportunities

Style Master Management

  • Responsible for inventory data integrity through accurate style master set up and maintenance in company ERP, Full Circle.
  • Work closely with Ecommerce team to ensure Shopify style master aligns with ERP.
  • Partner with Merchandising and Product Operations to ensure all in season item, cost, origin changes are captured and reflected in ERP and Shopify.

Finance

  • Partner on inventory budgeting and financial planning to manage costs and meet financial targets.
  • Align inventory investment with financial goals and performance metrics.
  • Conduct monthly inventory audits and reconciliations to maintain accuracy


ACCOUNTABILITY: WHOLESALE PLANNING

  • Supports and maintains yearly and season category sales plans by demand planning and forecasting inventory budgets, sales, projected dilutions (RTV, Discounts, MD), margins, and related KPI’s (bottoms-up planning).
  • Partner with the sales department to prepare seasonal plans considering current business trends and the company's annual business goals.
  • Contribute to the monthly shipment planning process to ensure wholesale orders are accurately forecasted.
  • Support sales team during and post-market, including rolling up final inventory buy and adjusting purchase orders, as necessary.


ACCOUNTABILITY: RETAIL STORE ALLOCATIONS

  • Manage the timely and accurate allocation of merchandise to retail stores using historical sales data, current trend analysis, and key performance metrics to maximize sell-through.
  • Monitor and balance store-level stock-to-sales ratios, identifying overstocks and understocks to execute timely inventory rebalancing, transfers, and replenishment.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Marketing and Retail Store Operations to coordinate initial new-product rollouts.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of allocation strategies by tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) like store fill rates, size-level stock outs, and inventory turn rates to refine future allocation models.


ACCOUNTABILITY: PERSONAL MEASURABLES

  • Continually retain an open mind, while always reserving the right to exercise best professional judgment.
  • Take a global mind-set, acting as one company, one brand and putting the company’s best interests above those of any one individual or team.
  • Live the company vision and values.
  • Don’t be afraid to challenge the status quo, take risks, innovate and learn from failures.



ESSENTIAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 3+ years merchandise planning experience
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and experience managing multi-location teams to maintain a unified, high-performing culture.
  • Excellent negotiation skills with a strategic mindset and the ability to handle complex business discussions. High level of business acumen with a focus on long-term profitability and growth.
  • Demonstrated retail math and business acumen, including elements of markup, margin planning, selling and inventory productivity measures
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills including presenting complex material in an organized and compelling manner
  • Strategic thinker who recognizes opportunities and can recommend strategies by building business case and influence senior leaders to move to execution
  • High level of conceptual creative ability. Strong product sense with proven experience in driving product assortments and partnering with divisional leaders to lead investment strategies that drive business
  • Strong time management skills, attention to detail, problem solving, interpersonal and organizational skills – communication between functional groups is very critical

title: Lead Vehicle Artist
description:
The Studio

We are a video game development studio with offices in Guildford, UK and Utrecht, Netherlands. Sitting within the heart of thriving communities of game developers and publishers, we focus on quality and excellence our partners and players are always at the front of everything we do.

Games are not just about gameplay. We believe in balancing every element a player experiences what you see, how you play, and how it makes you feel.

It couldn’t be a more exciting time to join us as we embark on a new, unannounced project pushing the boundaries of all aspects of development to create a truly AAA experience.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Lead Vehicle Artist to join our Guildford team and own the vehicle art on our next AAA project. You'll be accountable for every vehicle that ships in the game, from the first block out to the final optimised, in-engine asset. You'll set the quality bar, build the pipeline that gets there, and drive a team of internal and external artists to deliver on time, at volume, without compromising fidelity.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll build vehicles yourself, defining the look, detail, and technical standard the rest of the fleet is measured against. You'll also run the vehicle production cycle: planning, scheduling, reviewing, unblocking, and shipping. Working closely with the Studio Art Director, you'll shape how vehicles look, feel, and read in our world, and make sure the team delivers them reliably in every milestone.

As a natural leader and communicator, you’ll bridge creative ambition and technical execution, guiding the team toward excellence and helping grow a culture of collaboration, innovation, and pride in craft.

You will:

  • Lead the creation of high-quality vehicles and hard surface assets for a cutting edge AAA title.

  • Collaborate with the Art Director, Technical Art, and Design teams to ensure all assets meet gameplay, narrative, and aesthetic goals.

  • Set and maintain visual quality benchmarks. You’ll be producing key assets that define style and fidelity.

  • Provide feedback and mentorship to internal and external artists, ensuring consistency and efficiency.

  • Work with production to define workflows, pipelines, and documentation for vehicle development.

  • Ensure all assets meet engine performance and optimization requirements.

  • Foster a collaborative and motivated team culture across multiple disciplines.

  • Partner with external development teams to ensure delivery of assets that meet quality and style expectations.

Requirements

What we’re looking to see on your CV:

  • Proven experience as a Lead or Principal Vehicle Artist, with at least one shipped AAA title where vehicles were a core part of the experience.

  • A portfolio dominated by vehicles. We need to see realistic, high-fidelity vehicle work built for modern real-time engines, including exteriors, interiors, and material detail. Portfolios without a clear vehicle focus will not be progressed.

  • A track record of delivering vehicle content to milestone. Through interview you should be able to talk through how you planned, scoped, tracked, and shipped a vehicle roster.

  • Hands-on experience managing outsourced vehicle production, from briefing through review to final integration.

  • Deep knowledge of vehicle art pipelines: high-to-low workflows, modular and variant systems, damage and destruction, LODs, material and shader setup, and real-time optimisation.

  • Expert knowledge of Substance Painter and Designer, Unreal Engine (UE5 strongly preferred, with Chaos Vehicles experience a plus), and at least one 3D package (Maya, 3DS Max, or Blender).

  • Strong grasp of art fundamentals: form, function, composition, design, and colour theory.

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, able to inspire and guide a team toward consistent excellence.

  • Experience collaborating across disciplines (animation, tech art, design) to achieve cohesive results.

  • Experience managing and mentoring artists, supporting both creative and professional growth.

  • Ability to balance artistic vision with technical and production constraints.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience developing visual prototypes or establishing pipelines from scratch.

  • Familiarity with outsourcing workflows and providing structured feedback.

  • Experience creating documentation and best practices for asset development.

  • A passion for innovation, quality, and collaboration in all aspects of game art.

Benefits

What you can expect from us:

  • Flexible hybrid working (we work 3 days per week on-site)

  • Holiday Accrual Scheme

  • International AAA game projects;

  • Access to cutting-edge hardware;

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private Healthcare Plan incl. Dental and Eye care

  • Pension Plan

  • Life Assurance

  • Employee Assistance Programme - Wellness Support

  • Regular Team Incentives and Social Events

We’re on an important journey with our teammates, candidates and industry partners to tackle barriers to equality and promote diversity, inclusion and accessibility across the markets we work in. If you need any support during the interview process or any feedback on our processes, please let us know.

title: Commis à la bibliothèque / Library Assistant
description:
OFFRE D’EMPLOI

Commis à la bibliothèque



À PROPOS DU COLLÈGE MARIANOPOLIS

Fondé en 1908, Marianopolis est un collège privé de langue anglaise à Montréal spécialisé dans l'enseignement préuniversitaire pour environ 2 000 étudiants. Une porte d'entrée vers les meilleures universités du monde, le Collège se distingue par son bilan inégalé au Québec en matière d'excellence académique, de niveaux d'obtention du diplôme dans les temps prescrits et de taux d'acceptation dans des programmes universitaires compétitifs.

En tant que membres d'une communauté à échelle humaine, les employé(é)s de Marianopolis ont la possibilité d'exceller sur le plan professionnel et de profiter d'avantages sociaux généreux ainsi que d'un environnement de travail stimulant dans un établissement reconnu comme un leader en enseignement supérieur au Québec.


POSTE:

Titre :

Commis à la bibliothèque

Se rapporte à :

Coordonnatrice des services de la bibliothèque

Classification :

Agent(e) de soutien administratif classe I

Catégorie :

Personnel de soutien

Statut :

Saisonnier, à temps partiel

Horaire :

Du lundi au vendredi, 30 heures par semaine, de 12 h à 18 h.

Veuillez noter que cet horaire n’est pas négociable.

Taux horaire :

De 25,65 $ à 28,68 $

Durée du contrat :

Dès que possible jusqu’au 27 mai 2027



NATURE ET PORTÉE

Sous la supervision de la coordonnatrice des services de la bibliothèque, le ou la commis à la bibliothèque fournit divers services administratifs au comptoir de prêt, effectue les tâches quotidiennes d’entretien des collections, et assure la fermeture de la bibliothèque.



RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Agir comme premier point de contact de la bibliothèque pour la communauté de Marianopolis.
  • Effectuer les tâches liées au prêt et au retour des documents (p. ex. enregistrer les prêts et les retours, renouveler les prêts de documents, traiter les amendes, etc.).
  • Effectuer les tâches quotidiennes d’entretien et de mise à jour des collections (p. ex. trier, ranger, localiser, récupérer et déplacer les documents, vérifier l’ordre des documents sur les rayons et épousseter les collections).
  • Effectuer des recherches dans le catalogue de la bibliothèque.
  • Répondre aux questions générales concernant la bibliothèque et son emplacement.
  • Diriger les demandes de renseignements plus approfondies vers le comptoir de référence.
  • Participer à la réparation et au traitement des livres et des périodiques.
  • Participer à la préparation des présentoirs, des activités, des événements, etc.
  • Veiller au respect des politiques et des procédures de la bibliothèque par les usagers.
  • Assurer la fermeture de la bibliothèque à la fin de chaque journée.

QUALITÉS PROFESSIONNELLES

  • Appréciation de la mission, de la vision et aux valeurs du Collège.
  • Sens du service à la clientèle, avec une approche accueillante et positive.
  • Grande capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement de travail dynamique et rapide.
  • Excellente capacité à effectuer plusieurs tâches simultanément tout en portant une attention particulière aux détails.
  • Bonnes aptitudes en organisation et en communication.
  • Capacité à pousser ou à tirer des chariots chargés de documents pesant plus de 150 livres, dans les rampes et sur des surfaces inégales.
  • Capacité à travailler dans le respect des directives établies.
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler de façon autonome et en collaboration au sein d’une équipe.



QUALIFICATIONS

  • Diplôme d’études collégiales (DEC), diplôme d’études secondaires (DES) ou diplôme d’études professionnelles (DEP)
  • Connaissance de l’informatique et maîtrise des logiciels de la suite Microsoft Office (un test pourrait être exigé).
  • Une expérience en bibliothèque constitue un atout. Une expérience avec le système de (CDD) constitue également un atout.
  • Expérience dans la manutention de documents et/ou le transport quotidien de chariots chargés.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais. La maîtrise du français constitue un atout.



CANDIDATURE

Marianopolis encourage les candidatures de personnes qualifiées, y compris les femmes, les membres des minorités visibles et ethniques, les peuples autochtones et les personnes handicapées. Si nous pouvons vous proposer des mesures d’accommodations spécifiques pour rendre le processus de recrutement plus accessible, veuillez nous en informer et nous travaillerons avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins. Nous apprécions toutes les candidatures, mais nous ne communiquerons qu’avec les personnes sélectionnées pour participer au processus de recrutement.

Pour postuler, veuillez vous rendre sur notre portail de carrières pour télécharger votre CV et votre lettre de motivation (les candidatures incomplètes ne seront pas prises en compte) au plus tard à 16 h, le lundi 26 octobre 2026.



EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Library Assistant

ABOUT MARIANOPOLIS COLLEGE

Founded in 1908, Marianopolis is a private English-language college in Montreal specializing in pre-university education for about 2,000 students. A gateway to the world’s top universities, the College’s record of academic excellence, on-time graduation levels and university-acceptance rates into competitive programs is unmatched in Quebec.

As members of a close-knit community, Marianopolis employees have the opportunity to excel professionally and enjoy generous benefits as well as a stimulating environment associated with working at one of the province’s premier post-secondary institutions.



POSITION

Title:

Library Assistant

Reporting to:

Coordinator, Library Services

Classification:

Administrative Support Agent, Class I

Category:

Support Staff

Status:

Seasonal, part-time

Hourly salary:

$25.65 to $28.68

Working Hours:

Monday-Friday, 30 hours, 12:00 PM–6:00 PM

Please note that this schedule is non-negotiable.

Contract Dates:

As soon as possible to May 27, 2027



NATURE AND SCOPE

Under the direction of the Coordinator, Library Services, the Library Assistant provides a variety of administrative services at the Circulation Desk, performs daily collection maintenance activities, and closes the Library.



RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Acts as the Library’s first point-of-contact for the Marianopolis community.
  • Performs circulation duties (i.e. check materials in and out, renew materials, processes fines, etc.).
  • Performs collection maintenance activities (i.e. sort, shelve, locate, retrieve, shift, shelf-read, and dust materials).
  • Navigates the Library catalogue.
  • Answers basic informational and directional questions about the Library.
  • Refers in-depth queries to the Reference Desk.
  • Assists with book and periodical repairs and processing.
  • Assists with preparation of displays, activities, events, etc.
  • Ensures that Library users follow policies and procedures.
  • Closes the Library at the end of each day.

PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Appreciation for the College’s Mission, Vision, and Values
  • Service-oriented, with an approachable and positive demeanor.
  • Highly adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.
  • Strong capacity to multitask while maintaining attention to detail
  • Good organizational and communication skills
  • Ability to push or pull carts loaded with materials weighing more than 150 pounds up and down ramps, and over uneven surfaces
  • Capacity to work within established guidelines
  • Proven capacity to work autonomously and collaboratively within a team



QUALIFICATIONS

  • DEC or a High School Diploma (DES) or Diploma of Vocational Studies (DEP)
  • Computer literacy and proficiency with Microsoft Office software (testing may be required)
  • Library experience is an asset. Experience with the DDC system is an asset.
  • Experience lifting materials and/or transporting loaded carts daily
  • Excellent communication skills in English. Communication skills in French are an asset.

APPLICATION

Marianopolis encourages applications from qualified individuals, including women, members of visible and ethnic minorities, Indigenous peoples and persons with disabilities. If we can provide a specific accommodation to make the recruitment process more accessible for you, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. While we appreciate all applications, we will only contact candidates who are selected to participate in the recruitment process.

To apply, please visit our careers portal to upload your CV and your cover letter (incomplete applications will not be considered) by 4 p.m. on Monday, October 26, 2026.

title: K9 Feeder 2nd Shift
description:
Position Overview:

We are looking for a motivated individual to supply material to the K9 by utilizing a hand truck working ahead of each machine's demand so that stock is always available.

Job Responsibilities

  • Work with the assistant and aerators to ensure all tooling and materials are available to the machine.
  • Inspect loads for defects, especially defects that will cause down time. An example would be damaged sheets that could smash a print blanket.
  • Efficiently feed the press with minimal amount of feeder related stoppages.
  • Consume load tags at 100% accuracy
  • Keep accurate count of non-fed waste.
  • Assist the operator in driving improvement through training and process initiatives. Examples of process initiatives include but are not limited to: Safety, Preventative Maintenance, 5S/ Lean Manufacturing, and PTG.
  • Maintain quality and efficient production in the absence of the assistant.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Possess good time management skills.
  • Able to operate an electric pallet jack.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work well in a team environment and independently while aligning with PSC values.
  • Willing to participate in ongoing training and development to enhance technical skills and knowledge.
  • Perform other tasks and responsibilities as required

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Any experience working on an offset printing press.
  • Comfortability and experience working an electric pallet jack.

title: Detail Lot Coordinator

title: Kylmälaiteasentaja, Lahti
description:
Haluatko hyödyntää kylmätekniikan osaamistasi monipuolisissa asiakaskohteissa ja tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitystä? Haemme kiinteistöpalveluihimme kaupan kylmään erikoistunutta kylmälaiteasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tule mukaan satavuotiaan suomalaisen perheyrityksen ammattilaisten joukkoon rakentamaan kestävää ja vastuullista yhteiskuntaa.

Kylmälaiteasentajana vastaat laaja-alaisista kylmäteknisistä asennus-, korjaus- ja huoltotöistä asiakaskohteissamme. Työskentelet muun muassa kaupan kylmän CO2-laitosten ja vedenjäähdyttimien parissa sekä asennat uusia laitteita. Työpäiväsi koostuvat projekti- ja huoltoasennuksista sekä vikakeikoista arkisin klo 7–15.30.

Kiinteistöpalveluissamme työskentelet erityyppisissä kohteissa, kuten kaupan kylmän parissa sekä kauppakeskuksissa, hotelleissa ja toimistokiinteistöissä. Yhdessä varmistamme asiakaskiinteistöjen luotettavan ja energiatehokkaan toiminnan sekä miellyttävät olosuhteet niiden käyttäjille.

Toivomme sinulta:

- Kylmätekniikan perus- tai ammattitutkintoa

- Y3-pätevyyttä tai uuden mallin mukaisia pätevyyksiä A1 F-kaasu- ja hiilivetykylmäaineille sekä B hiilidioksidille

- Kaupan kylmän yleisimpien automaatiojärjestelmien tuntemusta

- Voimassa olevia työturvallisuus-, sähkötyöturvallisuus-, tulityö- ja EA1-kortteja

- B-ajokorttia

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

- Nuhteetonta taustaa

Arvostamme itsenäistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä halua tehdä laadukasta työtä asiakkaan arjessa. Hallitset kokonaisuuksia ja viihdyt työssä, jossa asiakaspalvelu ja tekninen osaaminen kulkevat rinnakkain.

ARE – arvostettujen ammattilaisten talo

ARE:lla ammattilaisuus, yhdessä toimiminen ja turvallisuus ovat kaiken tekemisen perusta. Suunnittelemme työt huolellisesti, toimimme ennakoivasti ja pidämme huolta siitä, että jokainen pääsee päivän päätteeksi turvallisesti kotiin. Saat tueksesi arvostettujen ammattilaisten yhteisön, hyvän perehdytyksen ja vaihtelevia tehtäviä, joissa ammattitaitosi vahvistuu osana arjen tekemistä. Kannustamme uuden oppimiseen omaehtoisen opiskelun tuella, oppisopimuskoulutuksilla ja kattavalla verkkokurssivalikoimalla.

Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten työterveyspalvelut, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun sekä vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 6.11.2026. Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätäthän hakemuksesi pian. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa yksikönpäällikkö Harri Honkanen, puh. 040 300 5066 tai sähköpostitse harri.honkanen@are.fi.

Tutustu meihin työnantajana

[ARE työnantajana](https://www.are.fi/ura/are-tyonantajana/)
[Arelaisten uratarinoita](https://www.are.fi/uratarinat/)


ARE

ARE on suomalainen perheyritys, jolla on yli sadan vuoden kokemus talotekniikasta. Tarjoamme ratkaisuja ja palveluita kiinteistön koko elinkaarelle uudiskohteiden talotekniikkaurakoinnista, ylläpitoon ja huoltoon, huollosta modernisointiin ja korjausrakentamiseen. Tahdomme olla talotekniikan suunnannäyttäjä ja siksi kehitämme toimintaamme jatkuvasti. Työskentelemme tiiviisti yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa löytääksemme parhaat ratkaisut, oli kyseessä sitten toimisto, hotelli, sairaala tai teollisuuslaitos. Tavoitteena on aina energiatehokkaat tilat ja tilojen käyttäjille miellyttävät sisäolosuhteet, kustannustehokkaasti toteutettuina.

title: Wireless Network Development Engineer , ONE-NAT, ONE Access Engineering (LAN/Wireless)
description:
Are you strong in network automation? then this might be a great opportunity for you.

Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.

Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.

You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.

No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.

We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.

We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.

title: Internal Context Engineer
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: .

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and operate n8n’s shared context infrastructure — our “company brain” — so both people and AI agents can reliably access accurate, well-structured, and appropriately governed knowledge across the company.

To make that happen, you’ll shape how our knowledge is structured, contributed, accessed, and maintained as we build the context layer powering n8n’s agentic future:

DESIGN OUR INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE

  • Define the taxonomy, structure, contributor guidelines, and templates that turn fragmented company knowledge into reliable, reusable context.

  • Establish standards that make knowledge easy to navigate, maintain, and use without creating duplication or another layer of content sprawl.

  • Evolve these standards as our functions, knowledge sources, and agentic use cases grow.

ONBOARD & ENABLE TEAMS

  • Onboard functions to the company brain and train designated champions to structure and maintain their own knowledge over time.

  • Give non-technical contributors the guidance, templates, and support they need to contribute high-quality context independently.

  • Partner with the Internal AI Enablement Lead to develop a shared network of champions who help scale strong knowledge practices across n8n.

OPERATE OUR CONTEXT PLATFORM

  • Configure and operate ingestion from qualitative sources such as Slack, Gong, Drive, and Notion using our context platform’s tooling.

  • Own day-to-day platform configuration and basic troubleshooting, escalating genuine engineering challenges to our Automation team or vendor when needed.

  • Partner with IT, Security, and Legal to define requirements for how people and AI agents access sensitive company knowledge.

BUILD FOR LONG-TERM TRUST & REUSE

  • Keep content structures, contributor guidelines, and knowledge freshness current as n8n and the platform evolve.

  • Work with functions to ensure the company brain becomes a trusted source of context rather than another parallel knowledge repository.

  • Provide product feedback to our context platform vendor and anticipate shared context patterns and capabilities that future agents will need.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🗂️ Information architecture: You have proven experience designing structured content or knowledge programs at scale, including taxonomies, style guides, contributor guidelines, templates, or information architecture.

  • 🧠 Knowledge systems experience: You’ve worked hands-on with knowledge or context systems and understand what it takes to turn fragmented qualitative information into something others can reliably use.

  • ⚙️ SaaS platform fluency: You’re comfortable configuring and operating SaaS knowledge or context platforms, working with APIs and integrations, and independently troubleshooting basic issues.

  • 🎓 Stakeholder enablement: You have a track record of training non-technical stakeholders and enabling them to confidently maintain high-quality content themselves over the long term.

  • 🔐 Governance collaboration: You’re comfortable partnering with IT, Security, and Legal on access requirements and compliance-sensitive data flows without needing to own the underlying technical architecture.

  • ✍️ Communication: You have strong written and verbal communication skills and can set a clear quality bar for how company knowledge is structured, documented, and shared.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🤖 Context platforms: You’re familiar with or a comparable agent-context platform.

  • 🔌 MCP: You have experience with or a strong understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • 🏷️ Knowledge governance: You have a background in knowledge management, metadata, or data governance.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how an entire company’s knowledge becomes usable — not only by people, but by the AI agents increasingly working alongside them. You’ll build a capability we don’t have today and help establish the context layer that future agentic initiatives across n8n will depend on.

You’ll have real ownership over how company knowledge is structured, governed, and maintained, while working closely with teams across IT, Security, Legal, Data, and AI & Automation. You’ll also have the support of a strong technical team and vendor partner, so your focus can stay on creating a trusted, scalable knowledge system rather than building every piece of infrastructure from scratch.

As n8n grows, you’ll help turn fragmented knowledge into a shared company brain that teams can contribute to confidently and agents can depend on reliably.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the context layer for the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ().

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

  • Future planning 💰 –

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

title: Propulsion Engineer - Plumbing Design and Fabrication
description:
Propulsion Engineer - Plumbing Design and Fabrication

Houston, TX

About Intuitive Machines

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. We believe our mission is to further research, communications, and exploration beyond low lunar orbit. With multiple NASA lunar missions in the making and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

About the Role

For this role, we are seeking a Propulsion Plumbing Design and Fabrication Engineer to support the design, CAD routing, fabrication, and assembly of propulsion system plumbing and associated ground and flight hardware. This role will be responsible for generating and maintaining plumbing layouts and detailed manufacturing drawings using industry-standard CAD tools, while also supporting welding, assembly, and facility readiness activities in execution of propulsion hardware builds. Depending on experience, the position may be filled at the junior engineer or engineer level and will operate within the propulsion engineering organization, contributing to both dedicated fabrication efforts and broader propulsion system development and test activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and route propulsion system plumbing, including tubing, fittings, brackets, and interfaces
  • Generate and maintain detailed CAD models, drawings, and build documentation to support fabrication and assembly
  • Design and implement welding fixtures and support development and execution of welding procedures, process controls, and inspection practices
  • Provide engineering oversight of fabrication, welding, assembly, and integration activities for propulsion hardware
  • Assist with propulsion system assembly, checkout, and integration for ground test and flight hardware
  • Support anomaly resolution and rework activities associated with plumbing and fabricated hardware
  • Contribute to general propulsion engineering tasks as required, supporting system build, test, and operations efforts

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or related Engineering discipline
    • Junior Engineer level: Bachelor’s degree (0–1 years of relevant experience)
    • Engineer level: Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree
  • Experience or demonstrated capability in CAD-based mechanical design and detailing (CREO, SolidWorks, or similar), including fabrication drawings
  • Working understanding of fluid or pressure systems, including tubing, fittings, and basic propulsion or pressurization concepts, or demonstrated ability to learn in a flight hardware environment
  • Ability and willingness to work hands-on in a lab or shop environment in support of hardware fabrication and assembly
  • Strong attention to detail, configuration control, and safety in execution of flight or test hardware
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary engineering environment and manage multiple parallel tasks
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and alignment with Intuitive Machines core values: Respect, Integrity, Dedication, and Excellence

Preferred / Differentiating Experience:

  • Experience supporting aerospace, propulsion, pressure systems, or test hardware
  • Exposure to propulsion system integration, ground testing, or launch operations
  • Experience with welding processes, procedures, or inspection (hands-on or oversight)
  • Familiarity with manufacturing workflows, travelers, or build records
  • Experience using CREO or other CAD software for mechanical design
  • Experience working closely with technicians, welders, or fabrication personnel

EEOC Statement

Intuitive Machines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Bilingual Helpline Counselor - Part Time
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Position: Helpline Counselor

Reports To: Manager, Helpline

Department: Helpline
Location: Bronx
Classification: Part-Time (25 hours/week)

Work Model: In-Person
Compensation: $24.73/hour



Who We Are

Established by Black and Latina activists in 1984, the Violence Intervention Program (VIP) is NYC’s only culturally specific organization with a mission to address domestic and sexual violence within Latine communities. Each year, we provide intensive support and services to 3,500+ survivors and children and reach 15,000+ community members through community events and preventive education. We are committed to developing innovative programs that respond to the needs of our diverse community and reflect our organizational values.



What We Offer

As an organization led by and for people of color and survivors of violence, we care deeply about our team’s wellness. We offer flexible work schedules, opportunities for professional development, a staff-led wellness committee, time to play and laugh together, and more.



We are a work in progress and welcome input from our team as we continue building an affirming and uplifting workplace.



A Great Fit

This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate, bilingual professional who is passionate about supporting survivors of domestic and sexual violence.

As a Helpline Counselor, you’ll provide confidential, survivor-centered support to callers experiencing domestic and sexual violence. You’ll help callers assess their immediate safety, explore their options, and connect with services and resources while respecting their needs, choices, and autonomy.



What You’ll Do

  • Provide crisis counseling, emotional support, safety assessment, and safety planning to Helpline callers.
  • Conduct intakes and shelter screenings and connect callers with VIP programs, emergency shelter, and other community resources.
  • Respond to calls, voicemail messages, and referrals during assigned shifts and provide timely follow-up.
  • Accurately document caller contacts, services, safety planning, and referrals in Salesforce and complete required shift reporting.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records, identify language access or data concerns, and communicate issues to the Helpline Manager.
  • Participate in required trainings and program and agency meetings and support other Helpline responsibilities as needed.



Specific Job Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish is required.
  • Experience providing crisis intervention or hotline counseling is a plus.
  • Ability to provide culturally responsive, survivor-centered support.
  • Understanding of the needs and experiences of diverse communities, particularly Latine and immigrant communities, communities of color, and people with low incomes.
  • Strong verbal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong computer and technology skills, including Microsoft Office and the ability to learn and use phone and client database systems.



If you’re excited about this opportunity but don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. We value transferable skills, a willingness to learn, and the different experiences candidates bring to their work.


The Violence Intervention Program (VIP) is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Clinical Rater
description:
About Us

At Empathx, we drive equitable access to complex trials at any phase by providing industry-leading patient access, clinical trial management, and analysis across cardiology/nephrology, psychiatry/neurology, metabolic, and infectious disease studies throughout the therapeutic pipeline.

(20 hours a week)

Duties and Responsibilities:

Clinical Rating & Assessment

  • Administer and score validated rating scales in accordance with sponsor protocols, training guidelines, and rater certification requirements.
  • Conduct structured and semi-structured diagnostic and symptom-based interviews with study participants.
  • Perform baseline, post-baseline, and follow-up assessments as required by study protocols and visit schedules.
  • Apply clinical judgment to ensure accurate, standardized, and unbiased ratings across all assessments.
  • Maintain inter-rater reliability through participation in calibration exercises, reliability checks, and ongoing rater training as required by sponsors.
  • Document all assessment results accurately and contemporaneously in source documents and EDC systems within required timelines.
  • Adhere strictly to blinding procedures in blinded study designs to protect data integrity.

Participant Management

  • Build and maintain positive, professional rapport with study participants to support engagement, retention, and reliable assessment completion.
  • Educate participants on the purpose and procedures of rating assessments in a clear, supportive manner.
  • Identify and promptly report any participant safety concerns, changes in clinical status, adverse events, or suicidality risk to the Investigator and clinical team.
  • Maintain participant confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and company policies.

Study Operations & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Clinical Research Coordinators, Investigators, and sponsor representatives to coordinate assessment scheduling within study visit windows.
  • Participate in study start-up activities including protocol review, rater training, and certification exercises prior to site activation.
  • Attend and actively participate in sponsor Investigator Meetings, rater training sessions, and calibration calls as required.
  • Communicate assessment-related questions, protocol clarifications, and site issues to the Principal Investigator and site leadership in a timely manner.
  • Support sponsor monitoring visits and audits by ensuring rating documentation is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Perform phlebotomy or other study procedures only if qualified, trained, and delegated by the Principal Investigator (not required for this position).

Regulatory Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure all assessments and documentation comply with GCP, FDA regulations, ICH guidelines, HIPAA requirements, sponsor protocols, and site SOPs.
  • Maintain rater qualification documentation, training records, and certification logs in the site regulatory binder and delegation of authority log.
  • Complete sponsor-required rater qualification and reliability assessments prior to conducting study ratings.
  • Immediately report any protocol deviations related to assessment conduct to the site coordinator and Principal Investigator.
  • Support audit and inspection readiness, including participation in sponsor audits, regulatory inspections, and internal quality reviews
  • Complete all required SOP training and company-required trainings as assigned and when updated
  • Maintain all required licenses and certifications and ensure they remain current and in good standing
  • Travel to company meetings, site locations, or study-related activities as required
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or higher in psychology, counseling, neuropsychology, social work, or a closely related clinical or behavioral health field required.
  • Doctoral degree (Ph.D., Psy.D., or M.D.) preferred.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience administering psychometric, psychiatric, cognitive, or behavioral rating scales in clinical research, clinical practice, or related settings.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of clinical research experience in industry-sponsored interventional clinical trials required.
  • Prior CNS/psychiatry clinical trial experience required.
  • Experience supporting Phase I, II, III, and IV clinical trials.
  • Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), clinical trial procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience conducting structured and semi-structured clinical interviews and assessments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain sponsor-specific rater certifications as required.
  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Must be able to work on site at the Houston, TX location; occasional travel to the Dallas site may be required.
  • Experience administering CNS rating scales and assessments, including but not limited to:
    • SCID-5-CT
    • C-SSRS
    • CGI
    • MADRS
    • HAM-A / HAM-D
    • ESS
    • MINI
    • LSAS
    • MGH-ATRQ
    • ISI
    • HDRS-17
    • PANSS
    • YMRS
    • ADAS-Cog
    • CDR
    • MMSE
    • BARS
    • AIMS
    • NPI-C / NPI
    • CMAI / CMAI-IPA
    • CGI-S
  • Experience with sponsor certification processes, calibration exercises, and centralized rating programs.
  • Certificates, licenses and registrations required:
    • Texas licensure (e.g., LPC, LCSW, Licensed Psychologist) preferred; may be required by sponsors for certain scales.
    • Rater Qualification Certificate or willingness to obtain sponsor-specific certifications.
    • ACRP or SOCRA certification (preferred).
  • Computer skills required:
    • Internet Software;
    • Spreadsheet Software (Excel);
    • Word Processing Software (Word);
    • Electronic Mail Software (Outlook);
    • Presentation software (PowerPoint);
    • Experience with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems
    • Experience with RealTime CTMS
    • Experience with eRegulatory systems
    • Experience with Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR)
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat
  • Other skills required:
    • Fluency in Spanish is preferred.
    • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
    • Strong clinical interviewing and assessment skills.
    • Strong organizational and time management skills
    • Effective communication and interpersonal skills
    • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
    • Ability to exercise sound judgment and decision-making
    • Ability to follow protocols, SOPs, and regulatory requirements

Physical Requirements and/or environmental factors:

  • Continually required to stand.
  • Continually required to walk.
  • Continually required to sit.
  • Continually required to utilize hand and finger dexterity.
  • Occasionally required to climb, balance, bend, stoop, kneel or crawl.
  • Continually required to talk or hear.
  • Continually exposed to bloodborne and airborne pathogens or infectious materials.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • The employee must
    • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include:
    • Close vision
    • Distance vision
    • Color vision
    • Peripheral vision
    • Depth perception
    • Ability to adjust focus
  • This position operates in a clinical research and office setting. The role involves interaction with study participants, healthcare professionals, and research staff. Work may include use of electronic systems and medical equipment, as well as occasional travel to clinical sites or meetings.

Equal Opportunity: Empathx is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

title: Pharmacy Tech / Clinical Assistant
description:
PHARMACY TECH / CLINIC ASSISTANT


As a Pharmacy Technician / Clinical Assistant, your job will consist of three functions: 1) assisting with daily operations of the retail in-house pharmacy, 2) assisting with conducting monthly and annual 340B, and 3) facilitating medication refills for the medical offices. The Pharmacy Technician / Clinical Assistant may float to other areas of the organization when the Pharmacy is slow. Maintain patient confidentiality and ensure compliance with HIPAA policies and procedures.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

In-house pharmacy responsibilities

  • This position will be a PRN and back-up technician for the in-house retail pharmacy. Weekly staffing responsibilities will be incorporated to allow for continued understanding of pharmacy operations.
  • Greet patients in a prompt, pleasant, and helpful manner and provides any necessary instructions/directions.
  • Receive and process prescriptions that have been sent electronically, by phone, or by prescription drop-off.

- Create and update patient profiles appropriately in the pharmacy management system. Utilizes the electronic health record system to support this function, as necessary.

-Complete accurate and timely data entry of prescriptions received in the pharmacy.

-Use math to solve a problem, such as calculating day’s supply or dispense quantity of a prescription.

-Fill prescription orders with correct medication(s) and dosages and apply labels to the bottle.

  • Process (corrects and resubmits) third party claims in a timely and efficient manner, and performs other clerical duties, regarding prescription processing as assigned by the Pharmacy Manager/pharmacist on duty.
  • Responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on the cash register, collects and handles cash as required.
  • Handle telephone calls that do not require personal attention of the pharmacist, including those to and from physicians’ offices.
  • Assist and support Pharmacy Department on inventory management activities including:

-Check and remove outdated medications from usable pharmacy stock on a monthly basis.

-Determine if a particular medication should be ordered to maintain inventory.

-Sort, label, and stock all incoming medication.

-Manage OTC inventory and product placement.

  • Help facilitate the day-to-day activities of the 340B program in collaboration with the pharmacist on duty and troubleshoot any issues that arise for patients.
  • Provide immunizations to patients when appropriate.
  • Use effective time management skills to manage multiple competing responsibilities and appropriately prioritizes these items to execute appropriate patient centered care (data entry, filling prescriptions, managing patients at POS system, assisting with answering phones, etc)
  • Able to anticipate when something is wrong or likely to go wrong; recognizing there is a problem and collaborate with the pharmacist on duty on resolution.
  • Follow established procedures concerning quality assurance, security of controlled substances, and disposal of drugs designated as hazardous waste.

340B Auditing/Administrative Assistant responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain an understanding of the 340B program.

Clinical Assistant responsibilities

  • This role will communicate and work effectively with patients and various members of the healthcare team including office staff, nursing triage units, and providers. Job responsibilities include but may not be limited to:

-Receiving prescription refill requests by e-prescriptions from pharmacies, patient portals, or patient phone calls.

-Completing refill requests in a timely and accurate manner according to protocols.

-Troubleshoots patients and/or clinic staff refill questions and concerns.

REQUIRED SKILLS / ABILITIES

  • Clinical—demonstrates a working knowledge of medical theory and practice to evaluate and provide patient care; skill in taking medical history to assess medical condition and interpret findings; maintains knowledge of, and acts in accordance with, current NHC policies and procedures.

  • Written communication—edits work for spelling and grammar, presents numerical data effectively and is able to read and interpret written information.
  • Planning/organizing—prioritizes and plans work activities, uses time efficiently.

  • Adaptability – adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands and is able to deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.
  • Dependability – consistently at work and on time, follows instructions, responds to management direction and solicits feedback to improve performance.
  • Safety and security – actively promotes and personally observes safety and security procedures, and uses equipment and materials properly.
  • Information Technology/Medical Equipment – proficient in the use of computers and other medical equipment/instruments to administer patient care and accurately retrieve/record patient data.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Education / Training

High School Diploma or GED. Advanced training as a pharmacy technician.


Experience

Five (5) years of community pharmacy experience preferred.


Licensure/Certification

Possession of an Indiana State Pharmacy Technician license.

Within 1 year of employment, must successfully complete all training / testing required to receive certification as a Pharmacy Technician in the state of Indiana.


Physical Requirements

Prolonged standing and walking, some stooping, bending, and stretching. Requires eye-hand coordination sufficient to operate medical instruments, equipment, and computer keyboard. Requires ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 50 lbs. Requires ability to handle and assist patients. Requires corrected vision and hearing to normal range to record, prepare, and communicate appropriate reports. Requires ability to work under stressful conditions. Normal medical office environment. Work may include irregular hours, including evenings and weekends. Involves frequent contact with other staff, physicians’ offices, patients, and the public. Contact may involve dealing with sick, angry, or upset people. Frequent exposure to communicable diseases, toxic substances, medicinal preparations, and other conditions common to a clinic environment. title: REIMBURSEMENT SPECIALIST
description:
Position: Full-Time

Location: Farmville, Virginia

Minimum Qualifications

General Description
Crossroads Community Services Board is seeking a detail-oriented and organized Reimbursement Specialist to join our Finance team. This position is responsible for billing, reimbursement, collections, and follow-up activities related to both consumer and insurance account balances.

The Reimbursement Specialist works closely with the Reimbursement/Accounts Receivable Coordinator and other agency staff to ensure accurate billing, timely follow-up, and proper resolution of reimbursement issues. This position is non-exempt under FLSA and is designated as Level Two under the HIPAA Privacy Rule.

The successful candidate must be organized, able to establish priorities, manage multiple responsibilities, and complete assigned tasks accurately and within established deadlines.

This position requires flexibility in scheduling and the ability to travel throughout the Crossroads CSB service area and occasionally attend meetings outside the area.

A valid Virginia driver's license and acceptable driving record are required.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of required background screenings, which may include fingerprinting, Sex Offender Registry and Crimes Against Minors Registry checks, and any other screenings required by Crossroads Community Services Board.

Knowledge Preferred

  1. Community Service Boards’ reimbursement policy and procedures as promulgated by DBHDS fiscal/ reimbursement office.
  2. Computer operations related to reimbursement and billing systems with emphasis on Accounts Receivable.
  3. General office operations including secretarial/reimbursement operations.
  4. General collection policies and procedures to maximize fee collections (e.g. Debt Set Off).
  5. Confidentiality policies, procedures and regulations related to reimbursement functions as mandated by both internal policy and external governing bodies (e.g. HIPAA, Code of Virginia, etc.).
  6. The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) and the Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) security and privacy regulations relate to the protection of confidential medical information and personal health information as required by law, professional ethics and accreditation requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Responsible for identification and follow-up of past-due consumer accounts.
  2. Identify accounts to be submitted to the Virginia Department of Taxation.
  3. Manage the tracking and submission of these accounts to the Virginia Department of Taxation.
  4. Execute monthly clinical service billing via electronic, paper, and direct data entry platforms.
  5. Partner with the Reimbursement/AR Coordinator to analyze and resolve daily third-party claim denials, including voiding, correcting or submitting appeals.
  6. Collaborate directly with insurance providers to analyze underpayments, overturn claims denials, and resolve payment variances to maximize revenue recovery.
  7. Assists with training for agency staff in reimbursement functions.
  8. Generate, review, and mail all client statements monthly once the billing has been completed.
  9. Assist individuals and staff requesting information regarding services and billing statements.
  10. Acts as a backup to Reimbursement Department staff.
  11. Other duties assigned are consistent with job description and expectations for the position.


Required Skills and Abilities

  1. Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, Outlook)
  2. Familiar with accessing and maneuvering through insurance payer platforms: including but not limited to Availity, Palmetto GBA, Tricare, and the Medicaid MES system.
  3. Typing, filing, use of office machines, computer, data entry and general secretarial/clerical tasks.
  4. Oral and written communications.
  5. Interpersonal relations, including working with staff, consumers, other professionals and the public.
  6. Utilization of time management and organizational techniques.

Compensation and Benefits at Crossroads Services Board

At Crossroads Services Board, we are committed to offering a salary and fringe benefits package that is competitive with other agencies and businesses in our area. To support this goal, we conduct regular salary and benefits studies to ensure our offerings remain in line with market standards.

Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes:

We look forward to a meaningful and rewarding partnership with each employee, built on mutual respect and shared success.

You’ll own the full insights cycle - from data collection and structuring to analysis and conclusions - while building AI-powered workflows that make insights faster, scalable, and easier to act on across the business. You step into ownership. You move fast and take responsibility for what you build. You focus on work that matters, not on noise that slows things down. You own end-to-end insights execution while scaling impact through AI-enabled workflows and structured analysis.

You won’t

How you’ll succeed

We look for people who think big, stay curious, and aren’t afraid to go all in to make things happen. You’ll turn ambiguous questions into structured analyses, consistently deliver decision-ready insights, and continuously improve speed and quality through AI-enabled workflows.

What you’ll bring

Still listening?

title: Software Development Engineer, Special Projects
description:
Are you excited about building software that empowers scientists to develop new products? As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you will design and deliver systems at the intersection of machine learning and the life sciences. We are scaling our model and method execution infrastructure so scientists can generate, analyze, and deliver new products and insights to researchers and internal teams across Amazon. Today the platform processes thousands of ML inference jobs weekly, and we need a collaborative, curious engineer to help us meet rapidly growing demand. You will work alongside scientists, engineers, and product managers in a startup-like environment where your contributions directly shape products that reach customers and accelerate scientific discovery.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build scalable ML inference pipelines in collaboration with scientists and engineers, ensuring reliable model execution as data volumes grow.
- Architect and improve the metadata systems that track workflows and their outputs, weighing performance, maintainability, and extensibility trade-offs.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools where they can accelerate development or improve code quality, applying responsible AI practices throughout.
- Contribute to every phase of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Conduct thorough code reviews, mentor teammates, and document your software so the broader team can maintain and extend it confidently.

A day in the life
You might start the morning in standup, sharing progress on the inference pipeline you are optimizing. After that, you join a design review where you and your teammates debate the right data model for a new workflow. In the afternoon, you pair with a scientist to prototype a feature, then wrap up by reviewing a teammate's pull request and leaving constructive feedback. Throughout, you balance hands-on coding with cross-team coordination to keep projects moving forward.

About the team
Our team builds the ML execution platform that life-sciences researchers rely on to turn complex scientific models into products customers use every day. We are investing in scaling this platform to handle rapidly growing data, and this is a great moment to join and shape that trajectory.

description:
