We strive to create an environment where employees feel supported and are empowered to excel in their roles. If you're looking for a career with a company that puts people first and makes a difference in the communities we serve, Byline Bank is the place for you.

Objective of Position:

The Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and Fraud Solutions System Administrator I is responsible for the implementation, administration, optimization, and ongoing support of Anti-Money Laundering (AML), fraud detection, and sanctions screening platforms supporting the Bank's traditional banking and fintech/BaaS programs. The role serves as the primary administrator for the Bank's fintech transaction monitoring platform and leads partner onboarding activities including system configuration, data mapping, testing, user administration, and production deployment of new fintech and sponsorship banking relationships.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the administration of AML, fraud detection, sanctions screenings and watchlist filtering systems, including user access provisioning, role assignments, and basic configuration updates.
  • Support system monitoring activities, including review of alerts, cases, and transactional activity across traditional banking, BaaS, and Sponsorship Banking programs, and escalate as appropriate.
  • Lead AML system onboarding and implementation for new BaaS and Sponsorship Banking partners, including requirements gathering, configuration, testing, validation, training, and production readiness.
  • Manage and validate data integrations, file transmissions, Application Programming Interface (API) connections, data mapping configurations, and data quality controls to ensure accurate monitoring and alert generation within AML and fraud platforms.
  • Coordinate with solution providers, implementation partners, fintech organizations, and internal technology teams to facilitate system enhancements, issue resolution, upgrades, and implementation activities.
  • Support system governance and change management processes by documenting system changes, configuration updates, implementation activities, testing results, and production releases.
  • Configure, test, tune, and maintain transaction monitoring rules, fraud detection scenarios, alert workflows, watchlists, user roles, and system parameters in accordance with regulatory requirements and business objectives.
  • Assist with troubleshooting system or data issues, including those impacting partner integrations, and coordinate resolution with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Perform testing for system upgrades, patches, new products, and partner implementations.
  • Maintain and update system documentation, including procedures, job aids, and controls, with consideration for BaaS and Sponsorship Banking requirements.
  • Assist in generating reports and dashboards to support BSA/AML, sanctions, and fraud monitoring, including reporting specific to BaaS and Sponsorship Banking activity.
  • Support audits and regulatory examinations by providing system data, reports, and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and enhanced controls across both traditional and partner-related system activities.
  • Perform administrative and support tasks as needed to ensure efficient team operations.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Note: Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, risk management, or related field preferred (or equivalent work experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in banking, financial services, or related environment, with experience in Bank Secrecy Act and OFAC regulatory requirements.
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) designation or comparable credential preferred; if not already obtained, expected within a reasonable period based on role requirements and exam availability.
  • Familiarity with one or more BSA/AML transaction monitoring, fraud detection, or sanctions watchlist screening systems.
  • Experience supporting or working with fintech, Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS), or Sponsorship Banking programs, either in a front-line (operations, onboarding, support) or back-end (systems, data, integrations, or risk/compliance) capacity preferred.
  • Experience participating in system implementations, conversions, onboarding projects, or software deployment initiatives preferred.
  • Experience administering platforms such as Verafin, Oscilar, Actimize, or similar AML/fraud monitoring solutions preferred.
  • Experience or exposure to Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning-driven tools, data analytics, or automation technologies supporting fraud detection, AML monitoring, or fintech/BaaS environments preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Demonstrated willingness to learn and grow within system administration and financial crime compliance.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Usual office environment with frequent sitting, walking, and standing, and occasional climbing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and balancing. Frequent use of eye, hand, and finger coordination enabling the use of office equipment. Oral and auditory capacity enabling interpersonal communication as well as communication through automated devices.


At Byline Bank, we value work-life flexibility and support a hybrid work environment for this position. This role allows for a combination of remote and in-office work, with occasional visits to the office based on business needs. Specific in-office days may vary and will be discussed during the interview process.


Byline Bank offers competitive industry rate salary bands with the goal of retaining and growing talented individuals. We regularly review and adjust our compensation structure as needed to ensure equity across teams and levels.

title: DCEO Technician
description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:
- Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in an industrial environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
- This role supports data centers in various o perational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:

- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
- Improve effectiveness through process innovation
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

title: Data Engineer - COL
description:
Note: To be eligible for this role, you must be based in Medellín, Colombia and able to work from our office three days per week. Working hours are 10:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. (Colombia time), Monday to Friday a schedule designed to provide overlap with our teams across multiple U.S. time zones.

About Deckard Technologies

Deckard Technologies is a GovTech data company helping local governments address residential property-related challenges, with a focus on compliance and tax collection. Founded in 2018, we operate globally with offices in the U.S., Colombia, and Australia.

Trusted by over 400 jurisdictions worldwide, our scalable, cost-effective products leverage patented processes and combine best-in-class data collection with intuitive, AI-powered solutions, transforming how local governments monitor and manage properties.

Joining us means you'll be working with a diverse group of inspiring people from industry experts and extraordinary technology and data operations teams to innovative product leaders in a down-to-earth and supportive culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our operational office in Medellín, Colombia. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring database health, overseeing end-to-end data pipeline flows, and developing scalable analytics tools, dashboards, and operational workflows within Snowflake and Sigma Computing.

You will work closely with cross-functional Implementation, Data, and Client Experience teams to ensure data integrity, streamline business intelligence delivery, and build self-service reporting assets that drive customer value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Database Monitoring & Data Flow Quality/Oversight: Proactively monitor SQL and cloud data warehouse pipelines, staging tables, and automated data ingestion to ensure continuous availability, high performance, and data integrity.
  • Sigma BI Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards, complex data workbooks, and custom internal and external reporting tools within Sigma.
  • Data Transformation & Modelling: Write efficient, robust SQL queries, data models, and transformation scripts to prepare raw, multi-source datasets for BI consumption.
  • Troubleshooting & Anomaly Detection: Quickly identify, isolate, and resolve pipeline bottlenecks, data synchronisation failures, broken schemas, or report calculation discrepancies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Implementation Coordinators, Program Managers, and Data Engineers to structure client-specific data workstreams, including legacy records and spatial data assets.
  • Documentation & Standards: Document data dictionary definitions, metric logic, workflow automations, and reporting best practices to support team scalability.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

  • Snowflake and Sigma Computing: Demonstrated practical experience working with cloud data warehouses and building dashboards and calculation models in Sigma Computing or deep expertise in platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, with a strong ability to quickly master Sigma. Experience with cloud data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or Amazon Redshift is valued, with direct Snowflake experience being highly regarded.
  • Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data analysis, BI development, or database monitoring in a production environment.
  • Advanced SQL—Essential: Strong, hands-on SQL capability is essential for this role. Candidates must be proficient in writing and optimising complex queries using CTEs, window functions, joins, and aggregations across cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or Amazon Redshift.
  • Data Flow & Pipeline Knowledge: Solid understanding of ETL/ELT principles, database schema design, and tracking data lineage from ingestion through to dashboard display.
  • English and Spanish Language Proficiency: A minimum B2 level of English proficiency, both verbal and written, is required, alongside native or fluent Spanish. This role involves regular communication and collaboration with English-speaking colleagues across the United States and Australia.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with rigorous attention to detail regarding data accuracy and quality assurance.
  • Analytical & Model Literacy: Comfort working with the outputs of predictive and classification models, such as booked-versus-blocked night inference and occupancy estimates. This includes understanding confidence thresholds, precision and recall trade-offs, known failure modes, and representing predicted values as distinct from observed values in dashboards and client-facing reporting.
  • Data Governance & Confidentiality: Sound judgment when handling sensitive client data and public records containing personally identifiable information, including address-level and parcel-level data. Familiarity with access controls, row-level security, and the principle of exposing only the minimum data a given report or user requires.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling: Ability to explain data limitations, methodology, and confidence levels to non-technical partners, Implementation Coordinators, Program Managers, and client stakeholders in clear terms. You'll be the person who explains what a number does and does not support and translates a schema change or data gap into what it means for a client's deliverable.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems—or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • DBT Experience: Experience working with DBT would be an asset, demonstrating exposure to large-scale, modern SQL pipelines and structured data transformation practices.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages for data automation, such as Python, R, or Bash.
  • Experience with GIS or spatial data layers, such as Esri ArcGIS integrations.
  • Prior experience in a SaaS, civic technology, GovTech, or data-intensive analytics start-up environment.
  • Experience working directly with U.S.-based distributed teams.

English-Language Requirement

As this role works closely with colleagues across the United States and Australia, candidates must have a minimum B2 level of English proficiency and be comfortable participating in meetings, discussing technical matters, and communicating clearly in writing.

Equal Opportunity

At Deckard Technologies, we select candidates solely on merit, experience, and suitability for the role, in line with Article 13 of the Political Constitution of Colombia and Law 931 of 2004. The English-language requirement for this position is directly related to the operational responsibilities of the role and the need to collaborate with English-speaking colleagues across the United States and Australia.

We do not discriminate based on age, sex, race, national or family origin, language background, religion, or political or philosophical opinion.

We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and will make reasonable adjustments to our selection process upon request, in keeping with Law 361 of 1997. Deckard is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and workplace violence, in line with Law 1010 of 2006 and supported by our Comité de Convivencia Laboral.

    • Inspect and document the condition of received materials, reporting any discrepancies or damage.

    • Report any equipment malfunctions or maintenance needs to his supervisor

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Use of material-handling equipment as needed.

This Shipping and Receiving Clerk position is vital to the manufacturing process, ensuring that materials and products flow smoothly from suppliers to production and, ultimately, to customers. - Language Skills: Fluent professional English (written and spoken). Finnish is not required.

Experience with Azure Cloud environment is seen as a plus.

Şube Lideri olarak sorumlu olduğu mağazaya gelen gönderilerin zimmet bölgelere ayrılması, dağıtım için devrinin yapılması ve operasyonun günlük takibinin sürdürülmesi, sarf malzemeleri ve dağıtımların bölümleri, mağaza bölümlerinin bölümlenmesi, ekibin yönetimi ve büyümenin sınıflandırılması, 6S–İSG bölümlerinin uyumun izlenmesi ile müşterilerin aralıklı görevlerinden sorumlu olarak kilit bir rol.

Sorumluluklar

  • Mardin / Nusaybin'de görev yaptığı X Dock' a (şubeye), ring (Hat) aracı ile gelen gönderilerin zimmet alınıp taşıyıcıların bölgesi bazında ayrılması
  • Zimmet alınan gönderilerin iş ortaklarına zimmet devrinin yapılması ve kontrol edilmesi
  • İş ortakları ile mutabakat yapılıp sorunsuz operasyon işleyişinin günlük takip edilmesinin denetlenmesi
  • Sarf malzeme takibinin yapılması dağıtıcı ihtiyaçlarının belirlenmesi satın alma sipariş bildirimlerinin sağlanması
  • İadelerin sisteme girişleri ve takibi tekrar sevk işlemleri
  • Sistem üzerinden şube performansının takip edilmesinin sağlanması
  • Bağlı bulunan ekibin yönetimin de gelişimsel süreçlerinin desteklenmesi ve performanslarının ölçümlerinin denetlenmesi
  • Şubenin 6S-ISG uyumluluğunun denetlenmesi
  • Müşterilerden gelen taleplerin yönetilmesi, taşıyıcılara bilgi akışının sağlanıp takip edilmesini sağlayacak ekip arkadaşları arıyoruz.

Beklenen Nitelikler

  • Üniversitelerin ilgili bölümlerinden mezun
  • Minimum 5 yıl pozisyon deneyimine sahip
  • Microsoft Office uygulamalarına hakim
  • Analiz, planlama ve organizasyon becerisine sahip
  • Takım çalışmasına yatkın
  • Bu pozisyon sorumlu rollerini kapsar
Trendyol’da Sizi Neler Bekliyor?
- FlexBenefits: Günlük yemek bütçeni özelleştirebilir, sağlık sigortanı upgrade edebilir, akaryakıt desteği veya Trendyol alışveriş bakiyesi gibi ek haklar arasından ihtiyacına göre seçim yapabilirsin.
- İyi yaşam desteği: Lokasyon bazlı kurum içi doktorlarımızdan, psikolog ve diyetisyen desteğinden ve HPV aşısı kapsamından faydalanabilirsin.
- Kişiselleştirilmiş öğrenme ve gelişim fırsatları: Yıllık eğitim bütçeni ihtiyacana uygun olduğunu düşündüğün eğitim veya konferans için kullanabilirsin. LMS platformumuzdan dilediğin an faydalanabilir, yıl boyu sunulan yüz yüze eğitimlere katılabilirsin.
- İlk günden sorumluluk alma kültürü: Trendyol’da her ses duyulur ve değer görür. Sen de daha ilk günden itibaren inisiyatif alarak etki yaratabilirsin.
- Tek ruhlu, çok kültürlü bir ekip: Berlin’den Dubai’ye, Amsterdam’dan İstanbul’a... Farklı bakış açılarını bir araya getiren, start-up ruhuyla çalışan uluslararası bir ekibiz.
- En iyilerle birlikte gelişme imkânı: Anlamlı işlerde sorumluluk alabilir, deneyimleyerek öğrenebilirsin. Farklı ülkelerdeki ekip arkadaşlarımızdan mentorluk alabilir ve alanında uzman ekip arkadaşlarımızla birlikte kendini geliştirebilirsin.
- İş dışında da anlamlı bağlar: Ekip ritüelleri, etkinlikler ve sosyal aktiviteler sayesinde yalnızca birlikte çalışmıyor; birlikte gülüyor, öğreniyor ve ilham alıyoruz.
Kariyerinde Bir Sonraki Adıma Geçmek İstersen;
Bu rol seni heyecanlandırdıysa hemen başvur, bir sonraki adımı birlikte atalım.
Ekibi daha yakından tanımak mı istiyorsun?
Kariyer Sitemizi, LinkedIn sayfamızı veya YouTube kanalımızı ziyaret ederek #LifeatTrendyol ve çalışma şeklimiz hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinebilirsin.

title: Senior Software Engineer (PHP)
description:
NFQ is a core technology partner for HomeToGo – a dedicated team of software engineers and data science professionals driving innovation to power a marketplace with the world’s largest selection of vacation rentals. We are expanding HomeToGo’s technology teams in Lithuania and Poland and are looking for the brightest talents to join the company.

HomeToGo is the SaaS-enabled marketplace with the world's largest selection of vacation rentals, listing millions of offers from thousands of trusted partners, including Booking.com, Vrbo and TripAdvisor. From vacation homes, cabins, beach houses, apartments, condos, house boats, castles, farm stays and everything in between, HomeToGo combines price, destination, dates and amenities to find the perfect accommodation for any trip worldwide.

Founded in 2014, HomeToGo operates localized apps and websites in more than 30 countries across Europe, North America, South America, Australia, and Asia-Pacific. HomeToGo Group includes brands such as Agriturismo.it, AMIVAC, Interhome, Smoobu, Casamundo, EscapadaRural, Kurzurlaub, Tripping.com, Wimdu, and others.


We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (PHP) to join our Distribution team, which connects thousands of HomeToGo's partners to our marketplace through a wide range of channels: White Labels, APIs, tailored integrations and more. Your work will span from building in house tooling that helps individual travel agents find the best vacation rentals for their customers, to designing integration systems for industry leaders such as Google, TUI, Amadeus or Lidl.

You'll join a team of experienced engineers driving initiatives with global impact. We value independence, teamwork, honesty and the drive to keep growing. You'll work across a mix of systems, from greenfield microservices to mature monoliths, all actively developed and maintained. Engineers take part in the full product life cycle and have real influence on where our products go next.

In this role, you will

  • Take end-to-end ownership of the features you deliver, from refinement to production
  • Design and build entire applications, working closely with our architects
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements, plan milestones and refine features based on measured performance
  • Choose the right technologies, guided by data and experience
  • Build AI-driven solutions and integrations, going beyond using AI tools day to day
  • Help build new distribution channels for our marketplace
  • Contribute to technical and architectural standards across the company
  • Mentor teammates and take part in hiring
  • Work with a broad stack including PHP, SQL databases, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, SQS, Kubernetes and AWS

What we offer

  • Growth and development opportunities. Build your career with support from an international and experienced team. We offer mentoring, regular feedback through our 360° feedback process, performance evaluations, and opportunities to grow professionally
  • A culture where you can make an impact. Join a workplace built on trust, empowerment, recognition, and autonomy. We share company goals transparently every quarter and encourage everyone to contribute ideas and take ownership
  • A supportive and international environment. Become part of a diverse team of 30+ nationalities, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mutual support are part of everyday life. We value work-life balance and create an environment where people can thrive
  • A great benefits package. We offer a competitive salary, health insurance, additional days off, flexible working hours, employee-led workshops, office perks, regular team-building activities and company events
Salary range:

131 - 179 PLN/h + VAT (B2B)

18 260 - 24 900 PLN gross (Permanent)

  • You are self-motivated and detail-oriented

Be a changemaker

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

title: Key Holder
description:
Basic Purpose:


The Brahmin Leather Works Part Time Key Holder will partner with the Store Manager and Assistant Store Manager in creating a store environment which provides exceptional sales and customer service, execution of visuals directions, recruiting, developing and retaining a strong selling team. The Key Holder position manages a staff of sales associates. This position is responsible for a sales goal and is eligible for a sales commission.


PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:


Talent Management:

● Coordinate staff by providing timely coaching and feedback to maximize individual and team performance.

● Develop and maintain positive working relationships that support a positive work environment.

● Support the education of the store team fashion trends and product knowledge.

● Maintain two-way communication with the store Manager to stay abreast of company and store information and brand initiative, as well as inform the manager of
all store activities.

● Ensure associates follow dress code and meet appearance standards that professionally represent the brand.

● Support an environment that positions Brahmin Leather Works as an Employer of Choice.

● Support effective on boarding and support learning opportunities.

● Provide basic direction to associates and appropriately delegate tasks.

● Support Store Manager with recruiting functions: Network and Recruit.

● Support Store Manger with developing talent: Ensure effective on-boarding.

● Provide timely coaching and feedback to associates when appropriate: Support the Store Manager with performance issues.

Sales and Service:

● Achieve sales and service metrics in key measurable areas including: DPTs, UPTs, AURs and Customer Conversion.

● Use Company resources and personal leadership to facilitate and sustain a strong selling environment that holds associates accountable for
achieving productivity standards and other sales metrics.

● Analyze store reports to optimize performance and take action based on business trends.

● Lead by example and maintain consistent selling and service standards through communication, training and individual accountability. Assist in identifying
opportunities to maximize sales and ensure financial goals achieved.

● Demonstrate a high level of selling and customer service skills to achieve sales.

● Service multiple customers at a time, multi-task or handle projects simultaneously.

● Exhibits knowledge of industry trends and the competitions

Building Clientele:

● Manage and guide associates to consistently market Brahmin brand initiatives and grow key sales and service metrics

● Ensure exceptional selling interactions that guarantee meaningful experience and build brand relationships.

● Drive brand loyalty by supporting all service enhancers to build strong relationships, including active use of clients books and marketing initiatives with local
business for store events.

● Take an active role in assisting the Store Manager to build store business.

Store Operations:

● Plan and prioritize tasks and responsibilities to meet the needs of the business.

● Maintain store cleanliness and housekeeping standards.

● Protect company assets and maintain a safe work environment.

● Ensure compliance to all company policies and procedures as well as local, state and federal employment laws.

● Support the planning and execution of Brahmin brand visual direction.

● Participate and lead special projects and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

● Leads with integrity and enthusiasm to motivate to total store achievement.

● Has a strong sense of drive, ambition and passion for selling ensuring the overall store business success.

● Must be outgoing and assertive with the ability to make store business successful.

● Ability to communicate professionally and in a timely matter with the Store Manager, customers, associates, and company partners.

● Ability to lead by example and maintain consistent selling and service standards through communication, training and individual accountability.

● Ability to partner with management on store issues.

● Maintain professional appearance that reflects the brand.

● Ability to work a flexible schedule based on the needs of the business including opening/closing shifts as well as weekends and holidays.

Physical requirements: Must be able to stand up to 100% of a work shift standing and moving. This role involves constant moving, talking, hearing, reaching, grabbing and standing for the entire work shift. Occasionally involves stooping, kneeling, crouching and climbing ladders. Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds.

● High School or General Equivalency Diploma (GED) required and 1-2 years of retail experience.

Note: This job description is intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by associates assigned to this job. It is not intended to be
inclusive of all duties and responsibilities and is subject to change.

title: ARDMS Technologist
description:
Coffee Regional Medical Center


ARDMS Technologist

POSITION SUMMARY

• The ARRT Technologist performs a variety of imaging procedures and is responsible for patient safety protocols. Functions as the first line with customers in the successful accomplishment of their imaging needs.

• Perform a variety of specialized technical tasks in Diagnostic Ultrasound utilizing high frequency sound waves to assist medical and professional personnel in detecting anatomical abnormalities.

OVERVIEW

• The evaluation is to assure individual performance, departmental goals and organizational goals are aligned. It is designed to support communication between the manager and the employee. Employee perception of their own performance is very important. To maximize the benefit of this process, both the manager and the employee participate in the evaluation process.

QUALIFICATIONS

A. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Excellent customer service skills.

• Reads and understands the English language.

• Ability to think critically and analytically with little or no supervision.

• Ability to work effectively in situations of high stress and conflict and communicate goals and outcomes.

• Ability to process information and prioritize.

• Possesses exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

• Possesses independent work habits, is self-reliant and self-directed.

• Ability to learn, adapt, and change as required by the job functions.

• Ability to maintain absolute confidentiality of material and information accessed and reviewed.

• Basic computer literacy

• Ability to move freely, reach, bend, and complete light lifting.

• Ability to use good body mechanics while performing daily job functions and ability to follow specific OSHA guidelines.

• Ability to maintain attendance to meet standard job practices.

B. Education

• High School Diploma or GED

• Graduate from an AMA approved school of Radiologic Technology

• Successful completion of an approved one-year ultrasound technology program preferred.

C. Licensure

• Registered with the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists

• BCLS certification

• Additional certifications may include CT, Echo, MRI, US, and Nuclear Medicine

• ARDMS

D. Experience

• One year of relevant experience preferred.

E. Interpersonal skills

• Technologist must possess compassion, a gentle touch, good communications skills, patient focus and attention to detail.

F. Essential technical/motor skills

G. Essential physical requirements

• Medium: Exert 20 - 50 lbs. of force occasionally and/ or up to 15 lbs of force frequently - >75%

H. Essential mental requirements

I. Essential sensory requirements

J. Other

K. Equipment used.

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

A. Exposure to hazards (body fluid exposure level)

o Level I

B. Age of Patient Populations Served

o Neonates 1 - 30 days

o Infants 30 days - 1 year

o Children 1 - 12 years

o Adolescents 13 - 18 years

o Adults 19 - 70 years

o Geriatrics - 70+ years


JOB SPECIFIC DUTIES AND PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

• Below are those tasks, duties, and responsibilities that comprise the means of accomplishing the position’s purpose and objectives. These are critical or fundamental to the performance of the position. They are the major functions for which the person in the position is held accountable. Following are the essential functions of the position, along with the corresponding performance standards.

o Demonstrates the skills and judgment necessary to provide direct care to patients as evidenced by:

 Responsible for the care and safety of patients undergoing treatment and use of equipment to minimize hazards of electric shock, burns and extraneous radiation patients.

 Responsible for safe handling of equipment.

 Instructs and prepares patients for examinations.

 Selects appropriate equipment to use for procedure.

 Determines most suitable anatomical posture and positions and shields patient accordingly.

 Makes special radiographic examinations requiring special equipment and procedures such as: intravenous pyelograms, mammograms (per license), hysterosalpingograms, tomograms, arthrograms and surgical procedures.

 Programs portable or stationary imaging equipment and makes images for a variety of examinations.

 Processes images

 Practices medical and surgical aseptic procedures.

 Assists in maintaining basic records and reports.

 Assists in maintaining files as required.

 Assists in training of students and ancillary personnel. Interacts professionally with patient and family members.

 Completes all work before clocking out leaving, this includes checking with the organizer/ supervisor as needed.

 Is acquainted with local fire and safety regulations as well as hospital codes.

 Complies and maintains quality assurance information for all States Agencies and regulatory departments, such as FDA, State, JCAHO, and the ACR, as required.

 Provides care appropriate to condition and age of the patient, including pediatric, geriatric, and general population.

 Completes and maintains assigned duties.

• Follows the hospital exposure control plans/blood borne and airborne pathogens as evidenced by:

 Demonstrates knowledge of techniques, procedures, and correct use of protective barrier equipment.

 Attends annual education programs.

title: Senior Communications Strategist, Campaigns
description:
Organization:

United Food and Commercial Workers International Union (UFCW) is North America’s neighborhood union; standing together to improve the lives and livelihoods of workers, families and communities. Our members work primarily in the retail food, meatpacking, poultry, food processing and manufacturing and retail store industries.

Location:

Washington, DC, near Metro (on-site)

Position Description:

The Senior Communications Strategist, Campaigns conceives, develops, plans and implements comprehensive and diversified strategic communications, media and messaging strategies to support UFCW’s objectives. This position assesses communications capacity across UFCW International campaigns and affiliates and develops strategies to improve communications effectiveness. The role works closely with the Director and Assistant Director, Campaigns to ensure UFCW communications programs and messaging are implemented effectively in the field.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned. This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented.

Conceives, develops and leads the implementation of strategic communications plans for assigned campaigns with minimal supervision.

Conceives and prepares cohesive communications packages for specific UFCW campaigns and programs, including written materials and visual content for print and digital platforms.

Ensures effective messaging strategy and brand identity are applied consistently across all platforms and audiences for assigned campaigns.

Assists with and/or leads the coordination and on-the-ground execution of rallies, press conferences and other events for assigned campaigns across the United States and Canada.

Develops functional expertise in UFCW-represented industries and topics related to the work performed by UFCW members.

Exercises expert judgment in identifying opportunities and risks in difficult messaging environments and provides crisis communications support, as assigned.

Develops and provides training and ongoing support for local leaders, members and workers on effective messaging, media-content production, and UFCW communications practices and platforms.

Assesses new communications technologies for union-wide program potential and recommends strategies to improve and expand the communications capacity of UFCW campaigns and affiliated local unions.

Works with outside organizations and partners to execute joint communications and campaign goals.

Provides communications support for UFCW conferences, International Executive Board meetings, and other work-sponsored and related events. Responsibilities include writing speeches and remarks, developing visual materials and presentations as directed, staffing rehearsals, and providing logistical support.

Performs other related duties incidental to the work described herein.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must satisfactorily perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline. A minimum of five years of communications experience in communications and/or media relations or public relations for a nonprofit, political campaign or similar organization is required.

Experience developing and executing a comprehensive communications plan within a campaign environment is required.

Computer/Software Skills

Knowledge of word-processing and graphic-design software, including Canva, and mass email and text-message platforms.

Understanding of digital communications platforms, including websites, text messaging, social media, email and video, with an eagerness to adapt to emerging trends.

Experience using Microsoft Office, including Outlook and PowerPoint, as well as Google Drive and Zoom.

Communication Skills

Ability to write, prepare and edit creatively and clearly with minimal supervision. Strong oral communication and presentation skills, including public speaking, are required.

Exceptional interviewing skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly and elicit personal stories from speakers with varied backgrounds and communication abilities.

Ability to interpret abstract concepts and craft narratives that communicate complex information in a compelling, reader-friendly manner.

Ability to exercise discretion involving the relationships among the International Union, regional offices, local unions and members.

Other Knowledge/Skills/Abilities Required

Ability to plan and execute the moving parts of a comprehensive plan effectively, with excellent documentation, follow-through and attention to detail, often with minimal supervision.

Ability to organize time efficiently and work quickly and accurately on multiple long- and short-term projects and last-minute requests.

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and present potential solutions to supervisors.

Team player who takes direction well and works collaboratively.

Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate among parties while respectfully managing differing priorities and sensitivities.

Ability to respond to and manage numerous requests from various sources in a timely and efficient manner while accurately incorporating feedback from multiple stakeholders.

Understanding of basic graphic-design principles and effective visual communications.

Familiarity with the principles of videography and photography, with the ability to stage portraits, events, and photo and video shoots visually.

Job Demands

Experience working in a fast-paced environment with quick turnaround, both in the office and at designated work locations.

Proactive problem-solving ability, with the capacity to multitask and work effectively under deadlines while ensuring assigned campaign timelines are met with minimal supervision.

Work is often performed under stressful conditions, with multiple projects occurring simultaneously under deadline. Irregular or unpredictable hours are required. Frequent and last-minute travel is necessary.

Working Conditions

Work involves travel, sometimes at the last minute, and may require extended stays, typically five to ten days, at designated work locations. Occasional irregular and/or unpredictable hours are required. Most work is performed in a normal office environment but may also be performed at designated locations throughout the United States or Canada. Attendance at off-site events outside normal working hours may be required. The noise level in a normal office environment is moderate but may be loud at certain work locations.

Physical Demands

The position involves, but is not limited to, written and oral communication, use of a computer keyboard, close and color vision, sitting for long periods, stooping, bending, lifting and reaching.

This is an exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

Reasonable accommodations will be provided pursuant to state and federal laws.

COMPENSATION

Salary Range: $78,633 - $95,570

The UFCW provides a very generous benefits package, including:

  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
  • Life insurance provided with ability to purchase supplemental life insurance at favorable rates.
  • Retirement Savings Account.
  • 401(k) plan with employer matching.
  • Pension plan.
  • Dependent care reimbursement account program.
  • Health care reimbursement account program.
  • Transportation program benefits.
  • Three weeks of paid vacation, 12 days of paid short-term sick leave, Extended Sick Leave program, and paid parental leave.
  • Prepaid Legal Plan (for DC/MD/VA only).

Duration:

  • This is a full-time position; posting closes when position is filled.

We believe our success rests on recruiting and retaining a diverse staff. UFCW is an equal opportunity employer.

Women and people of color are encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodations will be provided pursuant to state and federal laws.

title: Program Specialist I
description:
About Us

Founded in 1937, the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC) has kept the promise of public housing alive. It has done so by maintaining and modernizing its buildings and enriching the lives of its residents through innovative social services, recreational and educational programs, and job training initiatives. What makes HABC successful is the dedication of its employees and its history of strong leadership.


HABC Benefits

Health and Well-Being

At the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC), we offer a competitive benefits package that supports our recruitment and retention goals and meets the diverse, evolving needs of our employees. HABC’s comprehensive benefits package includes:

Vacation and Leave

  • Universal leave program
  • 12 paid holidays

Health and Wellness

  • Medical and dental insurance
  • Employer‑paid vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Free health and wellness programs

Income Protection and Retirement

  • Life insurance with optional additional coverage
  • Short‑term disability
  • Voluntary Plans
  • Retirement programs with employee contribution options


Position Summary

Under direct supervision, provides case management to Housing Choice Voucher Program (HCVP) applicants and participants; Performs client eligibility, move, and recertification activities in compliance with HUD guidelines and the Housing Authority of Baltimore City’s (HABC) policies. Provides clear and informative information orally and in writing to applicants, participants, landlords, other agencies, and employees. Maintains caseload, performs data entry, and creates reports. Maintains error rate below the established departmental thresholds. May be trained in multiple functions and be reassigned as needed to support workload priorities. Position requires excellent customer service skills and mathematical abilities.

All activities must support the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (“HABC” or “Authority”) mission, strategic goals, and objectives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The position duties and responsibilities listed below describe the general nature and scope of work. Other responsibilities, duties, and skills may be required and assigned, as needed.

  • Performs case management functions. Maintains and analyzes information on account activities and accurately completes related data entry.
  • Determines client eligibility and completes HUD’s re-certification and re-examination procedures for new and existing clients. Verifies household composition and income following verification procedures, coordinates unit inspections, contacts voucher holders, and prepares paperwork.
  • Communicates with clients, property owners, tenants, other agencies, and employees by telephone, in writing, or in person.
    • Assists with new & existing client and landlord orientations.
    • Explains HUD regulations and contract terms.
    • Obtains documentation to assist clients.
    • Completes accurate and expedient contract work.
    • Provides information about housing assistance programs.
  • Provides applicants and participants with community-based information, i.e., social services and housing agencies such as shelters, fair housing agencies, Legal Aid Bureau Inc., and government-sponsored social services agencies. Makes referrals to other service agencies and organizations as warranted.
  • Maintains records and notates software and trackers for all communication, throughout the process. Ensures participant files are complete and uploaded electronically.
  • Conducts home visits and site visits as needed.
  • Serves as a resource for new and existing team members
  • Performs other related duties.


Duties & Responsibilities based on Assignment

  1. Continued Assistance
    • Conducts interviews and reviews client documents for completeness and accuracy to determine tenant portions and eligibility for continued housing assistance.
    • Calculates Total Tenant Payments (TTP), Housing Assistance payments (HAP), and utility allowances. Reviews rent calculations for completeness and accuracy to determine tenant portions and housing assistance.
    • Determines move eligibility, coordinates/hosts voucher briefings, monitors voucher issuance and expiration
    • Completes caseload as assigned within the required timeframe.
  1. Site-Based & RAD Functions
    • Conducts interviews and reviews client documents for completeness and accuracy to determine tenant portions and eligibility for continued housing assistance.
    • Calculates Total Tenant Payments (TTP), Housing Assistance Payments (HAP), and utility allowances. Reviews rent calculations for completeness and accuracy to determine tenant portions and housing assistance.
    • Monitors applicant selection, preference policies, portability, denials of assistance, voucher issuance, expiration, and withdrawals.
    • Determines move eligibility, coordinates voucher briefings and transfer requests, monitors voucher issuance and expiration. Ensures timely submission of move-in documents from landlords for project- and tenant-based programs.
  1. Applications & Waitlist Functions
  • Conduct interviews and review applicant documents for completeness and accuracy.
  • Verify applicant selection, preference policies, denials of assistance, voucher issuance, expiration, and withdrawals.
    • Conduct on-site and off-site eligibility interviews and briefings for voucher issuance.
    • Process applications and make final eligibility determination.
  1. Leasing & Contracting Functions
    • Complete voucher holder moves, perform rent reasonableness and rent affordability, rent increases, and utility change requests.
    • Coordinates with HCVP Inspections to request unit inspections.
    • Ensures landlord leases are within HUD and agency guidelines, verifies landlord documents are legitimate, and complies with HABC policies and procedures
    • Prepares Housing Assistance Payments (HAP) Contracts
  1. Portability Functions
    • Process incoming and outgoing portability requests in accordance with HUD regulations and agency policies
    • Process billing and coordinate absorption with initial and receiving Public Housing Authorities (PHAs)
    • Monitor and track portability activity to ensure timely processing and compliance deadlines


Minimum Education, Training, and/or Experience

Graduation from a four (4) year college or University with a bachelor’s degree in business or a social service-related field of study. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.


Special Requirements

  • Possession of a valid Maryland driver's license.
  • Must be able to be covered under the Authority's vehicle insurance policy.
  • Section 8 Rent Calculation and Section 8 Occupancy certification within 12 months of employment.


Other Requirements:

  • Availability to work some evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Successful completion of a pre-screening investigation, including verification of employment history and education credentials.
  • A 6-month probationary period applies to this full-time permanent position.


FOR INTERNAL CANDIDATES ONLY: Current HABC employees who are on probation, whether due to initial new hire status (6 months) or promotion (3 months), will have the opportunity to apply for other roles within HABC once their probationary period is successfully completed. This allows time for growth, development, and the demonstration of their skills and commitment, paving the way for new opportunities within the organization.

If you are currently under the progressive disciplinary process or have received disciplinary action within the past six (6) months, it may impact your ability to be considered for promotion within HABC. Please refer to the Manual of Personnel Policies or the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement for additional information regarding the disciplinary process.


This job posting will remain open until October 27, 2026.

title: Supervising Technician
description:
About Us

Founded in 1937, the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC) has kept the promise of public housing alive. It has done so by maintaining and modernizing its buildings and enriching the lives of its residents through innovative social services, recreational and educational programs, and job training initiatives. What makes HABC successful is the dedication of its employees and its history of strong leadership.


HABC Benefits

Health and Well-Being

At the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (HABC), we offer a competitive benefits package that supports our recruitment and retention goals and meets the diverse, evolving needs of our employees. HABC’s comprehensive benefit package includes:

Vacation and Leave

  • Universal leave program
  • 12 paid holidays

Health and Wellness

  • Medical and dental insurance
  • Employer‑paid vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Free health and wellness programs

Income Protection and Retirement

  • Life insurance with optional additional coverage
  • Short‑term disability
  • Voluntary Plans
  • Retirement programs with employee contribution options


Position Summary

The primary purpose of this position is to perform oversight, planning, and coordination of activities under operational programs such as work order reduction or vacant unit preparation for assigned HABC properties. The employee in this classification performs diversified duties in skilled, technical, and supervisory work. The incumbent's responsibilities and assignments require independent judgment on issues that are complex task. This position is responsible for ensuring that established standards are maintained with regard to the execution and effectiveness of maintenance/repair work, and vacant unit turnover. The incumbent is expected to follow all HABC policies, perform all work accurately and thoroughly, and respond to the needs of residents and management in a timely, courteous, and respectful manner at all times.

All activities must support the Housing Authority of Baltimore City (“HABC” or “Authority”) mission, strategic goals, and objectives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The position duties and responsibilities listed below describe the general nature and scope of work. Other responsibilities, duties, and skills may be required and assigned, as needed.

  • Engage in mentoring, including providing guidance or advisement concerning courses of action and strategies to maintenance staff.
  • Prepare various reports on productivity and other maintenance activity operations and activities.
  • Ensure staff follow applicable state and federal regulations and Housing Authority policies.
  • Supervise maintenance technicians/maintenance workers in all areas of maintenance, including carpentry, painting, metal work, plumbing, electrical work, and other labor-intensive maintenance services as required.
  • Perform spot inspections of grounds and vacant unit conditions, review quality standards of maintenance as established by the Authority.
  • Adhere to maintenance standards, federal, state, or local codes, and review operations to increase productivity and effect net cost reductions, and operations within the limits of authorized budgets.
  • Assist with monitoring and inspecting the work of contractors providing related services to
  • Execute performance evaluations. for subordinates in the review of performance evaluations for the maintenance department in accordance with the Housing Authority standards.
  • Maintain a routine work order average completion time of less than 30 days.
  • Ensure emergency work orders are abated/completed within twenty-four (24) hours.
  • Maintain a unit turnover average of less than 26 days
  • Assist with the preparation of required reports and documentation as required by Housing Authority and HUD policies and procedures.
  • Receive, investigate, and respond to residents’ complaints as required.
  • Provide leadership and work with staff to develop and retain highly competent, customer service-oriented staff through selection, training, and day-to-day management practices to accomplish the agency’s mission.
  • Coordinate maintenance staff on-call and overtime processes.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with resident councils, residents, peers, subordinates, supervisors, vendors, and the general public.
  • Demonstrates courteous and cooperative behavior when interacting with clients, visitors, and HABC staff.
  • Works in coordination with subcontractors for maintenance work as required. Inspects work completed by subcontractors.
  • Completes appropriate work order documentation for all maintenance tasks.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Minimum Education, Training, and/or Experience

High school diploma or GED with additional training related to maintenance, HVAC, and HUD quality standards supplemented by ten (10) of building/facilities maintenance and repair which includes two (2) years of supervisory or lead experience; OR ten (10) years equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.


Special Requirements

  • Possession of a valid Maryland driver's license.
  • Must be able to be covered under the Authority's vehicle insurance policy.


Other Requirements:

  • Availability to work some evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Successful completion of a prescreening investigation, including verification of employment history and education credentials.
  • A 6-month probationary period applies to this full-time permanent position.


This job posting will remain open until June 19, 2026.

title: Ground Stations Network Operations Engineer
description:
Ground Station Operations Engineer

Houston, TX

About Intuitive Machines

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With the first commercial lunar landing in history, multiple NASA lunar missions in development, and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting our customers and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

About The Role

Intuitive Machines is seeking multiple Ground Station Operations Engineers to join our team. This role can be filled at experience levels from early- to mid-career. These positions will support ongoing operations, along with development and testing of a commercial Telemetry, Tracking and Control (TT&C) network of ground stations. The applicant(s) will be located on-site at Intuitive Machines’ Houston, TX location, and will operate in a cross-functional team on the design, development, test, and operation of ground station hardware, including associated software.

Responsibilities:

  • Support advancement and real-time operations of IM’s global ground station network
  • Assist in development and execution of test plans for ground station hardware, encompassing: Base Band Units (BBUs), AWS cloud infrastructure, RF systems, mission control center systems, and other critical ground elements
  • Develop real-time operations products, including procedures, asset schedules, troubleshooting documentation and Interface Control Documents (ICDs)
  • Support (and potentially lead) technical and programmatic meetings, including working groups, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), etc.
  • Serve as a real-time operator, eventually leading a small team of subsystem experts
  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to integrate ground software and network automation
  • Participate in Integration & Verification activities
  • Develop and enforce Mission Rules to ensure vehicle/system health and mission objectives
  • The candidate will be encouraged to take on as much responsibility as practical and will be expected to play a role in the entire cradle-to-grave development process, including requirements development, conceptualization, supplier relationships, procurement, procedure development, and on-console mission operations support.

Qualifications:

  • B.S. degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in ground station development/testing, real-time mission operations or related discipline; or M.S. degree in Aerospace Engineering or related discipline and a minimum of 2 years of experience
  • Proficiency in conducting ground station testing and operations
  • Familiarity with test equipment such as network analyzers, oscilloscopes, modems, etc.
  • Conducting benchtop testing of RF, analog and digital signals
  • Knowledge of ground station hardware, including HPAs, LNAs, circulators, diplexers, etc.
  • Experience making time-sensitive decisions in high-pressure, high-risk environments
  • Preflight training and development of integrated procedures and mission rules
  • Demonstrated cross-discipline support
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite and other collaboration tools (e.g., Atlassian Confluence, Jira, etc.)

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with ground station design and operations, including hardware, software, communications (RF)
  • Experience with spacecraft and associated systems, e.g., flight control, flight dynamics, orbital mechanics, power systems, avionics, ground support systems (command, telemetry)
  • Real-time spacecraft/satellite operations, preferably spanning multiple disciplines or functions
  • Fundamental grasp of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DHCP, UDP, routing)
  • Proficiency in operational leadership and risk management
  • Experience with international partners

US EEO Statement

Intuitive Machines is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:

title: Inventory and Demand Planning Analyst
description:
Job Title: Inventory & Demand Planning Analyst

Reports to: VP of Strategy & Operations

Location: Modesto, CA (Hybrid may be considered)

Salary: $70-100K. Eligible for a performance bonus. Base range dependent on experience and skillset.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical, hands-on Inventory & Demand Planning Analyst to help transform our inventory and demand planning functions, with a primary focus on paper roll stock inventory. This role is critical in shaping a scalable, data-driven approach to managing inventory levels, forecasting demand, and supporting an effective Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) process.

The ideal candidate will bring both vision and tactical execution to mature our current practices, help implement best-in-class tools and methodologies, and ensure we maintain optimal inventory levels that meet customer demand while minimizing working capital.

What Makes You a Good Fit

Pacific Southwest Container is a 50-year-old, family-owned paper packaging manufacturer that has thrived through an unyielding commitment to growth and staying on the cutting edge of the industry. Our people have enabled us to do this by being bold, taking action, driving initiatives, and maintaining a start-up mentality. PSC has established a culture where the status quo is never settled for, and we constantly look for the next opportunity to propel the business. We believe that there is an opportunity now to further leverage best-in-class practices to improve our inventory and demand planning and bring greater sophistication to our SIOP process.

The right person for this role already has some experience in inventory and demand planning and is excited about the opportunity to bring that experience to a company entering a new phase of growth and transformation. Success in this position will lead to additional opportunities within PSC as we pursue inorganic and organic growth, and we continue to look to cultivate leaders to manage critical parts of the business.

Duties and Responsibilities

Inventory Planning & Optimization

  • Develop and implement inventory strategies for paper roll stock and other materials (inks, pallets, etc.).
  • Define and maintain appropriate service levels, safety stock, reorder points, and inventory targets.
  • Optimize stock levels across multiple plants to reduce obsolescence and bloated inventory.
  • Analyze usage trends, lead times, and vendor variability to inform inventory decisions.
  • Partner with procurement to assess supplier impact on inventory planning.

Demand Planning

  • Build a scalable, repeatable demand planning process, starting with basic forecasting and maturing toward more advanced models.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Finance to develop rolling demand forecasts (monthly, quarterly, annual).
  • Analyze historical sales, customer data, seasonality, and promotional activity to improve forecast accuracy.

SIOP Process Integration

  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment between sales, operations, and supply chain to balance supply and demand.
  • Prepare and present inventory and demand-related insights in SIOP meetings.

Tooling & Process Development

  • Identify, recommend, and implement planning tools (e.g., Excel-based models, planning software, dashboards) appropriate for our scale and complexity.
  • Develop KPIs and reporting mechanisms to monitor forecast accuracy, inventory turns, fill rates, and stockouts.

Key Attributes

  • You’re a builder. You thrive in environments where processes and tools are limited or evolving, and you're excited to establish foundational systems from the ground up.
  • You balance detail and strategy. You can dig into the data, build a model, and also step back to recommend operational policies or long-term planning improvements.
  • You communicate well across functions. You can translate analytical insights into operational actions and influence stakeholders in Procurement, Operations, and Sales.
  • You understand manufacturing dynamics. You appreciate the tradeoffs between cost, lead time, space constraints, and service levels, especially in a materials-heavy business like ours.
  • You want to make a lasting impact. You take pride in improving systems and leaving things better than you found them.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in inventory planning, demand planning, or supply chain roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience in manufacturing or distribution environments; ideally in packaging, pulp & paper, or similar materials-heavy industries.
  • Basic familiarity with ERP systems and inventory modules; experience selecting or implementing planning tools/software.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience building or using planning models.
  • Understanding of supply chain fundamentals: lead times, EOQ, safety stock, reorder points, etc.

Preferred

  • Experience with paper roll stock or other bulky raw materials.
  • Exposure to SIOP/IBP processes.

description:
Principal - Water Environment

Chesterfield, MO

Build Your Future with GBA

You have built the technical expertise, earned the trust of clients, and learned what it takes to lead complex Water Environment work. Now you are ready to help shape what comes next.

GBA is seeking a Principal - Water Environment to provide strategic, client, business, and technical leadership for our Water Environment practice in St. Louis. The right leader will bring strong Water Environment experience together with business insight, client credibility, and a passion for building teams and opportunities. You will operate with broad autonomy to establish priorities and make strategic and operational decisions within GBA's overall strategy and governance.

How You'll Make an Impact

Drive Business Development & Market Growth

  • Take an active leadership role in business development, developing and executing strategies to grow GBA's Water Environment presence across St. Louis and the broader Missouri market.
  • Identify new opportunities, build prospective client relationships, lead strategic pursuits, and expand service offerings that position GBA for long-term growth.

Build Relationships That Last

Lead with Business and Technical Insight

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for complex Water Environment projects and programs from planning and design through implementation.

Lead, Supervise & Develop Future Leaders

  • Provide direct supervision and leadership for team members, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and supporting individual and team success.
  • Attract, coach, and develop talented professionals and future leaders, creating opportunities for growth while building a high-performing team.
  • Support succession planning and intentionally develop people who can take on greater responsibility for clients, teams, and projects.
  • Build a culture rooted in teamwork, integrity, honesty, learning, service, and innovation, where people feel supported, challenged, and empowered to grow.

Strengthen GBA's Industry Presence

  • Represent GBA in professional organizations, industry events, client forums, and other opportunities that strengthen our reputation and relationships.
  • Turn client and project challenges into opportunities for better approaches, new services, and responsible innovation.
  • Help teams test, learn, and improve while maintaining sound professional judgment and oversight.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for a leader who has already built credibility in the A/E and Water Environment industry and is ready to use that experience to grow clients, people, and the business.

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related field from an accredited program, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 12+ years of combined A/E industry experience, including leadership experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license appropriate to the role; Texas licensure or ability to obtain Texas licensure where required.
  • Deep Water Environment experience, including municipal treatment, utility infrastructure, planning, conveyance, and related services.
  • Experience leading complex projects from concept and planning through design and implementation, with an understanding of scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk.
  • Demonstrated business development success, including building client relationships, leading pursuits, winning new work, and contributing to market or practice growth.
  • Strong understanding of contracts, proposals, fee structures, project profitability, and resource decisions.
  • Ability to translate client needs into practical project and business solutions while maintaining strong, trusted relationships.
  • Supervisory and people leadership experience, including managing team performance, developing talent, mentoring future leaders, and building high-performing teams.
  • Successful completion of ACEC Principals Bootcamp or equivalent program leadership certification/coursework, or willingness to complete as part of leadership development.

What Will Help You Thrive

You enjoy the intersection of clients, people, strategy, and technical excellence. You can move comfortably from an executive client conversation to a market strategy discussion, a complex project decision, or a coaching conversation with a developing leader.

You think beyond the next project. You look for ways to strengthen key accounts, build new capabilities, connect disciplines, improve performance, and create opportunities for others. You are willing to make decisions, manage ambiguity, take balanced risks, and put the company and client relationship ahead of individual interests.

Most importantly, you build trust. You communicate clearly, follow through, take accountability when challenges arise, seek feedback, and continue learning as the market and industry evolve.

title: Compliance Specialist
location: AllCare Health Headquarters, Grants Pass, OR, US
description:
Compliance Specialist


AllCare Health | Compliance Department | Grants Pass, Oregon


We Are Seeking Qualified Candidates to Join Our Team!

AllCare Health offers competitive wages and an excellent benefits package, including affordable healthcare, 401(k) retirement, wellness programs, and flexible scheduling options.


Summary of the Position

The Compliance Specialist is responsible for assisting in the oversight of an enterprise-wide Corporate Compliance Program to detect, correct and prevent violations of Federal and State laws, rules, or regulations. The position is responsible for assisting the Chief Compliance Officer with implementing, maintaining and monitoring the compliance program elements that includes investigations, policies, standards, workforce training, and awareness of general compliance requirements, reporting, and investigating concerns of FWA. This position will help in the evaluation of the FWA and Compliance Program. The Compliance Specialist will report to the Chief Compliance Officer in the investigation of suspected violations and in the development and oversight of corrective action plans. The Compliance program involves a continuous process of adhering to legal, ethical and professional standards applicable to AllCare employees, Board of Governors, providers, contractors, temporary employees, consultants and subcontractors.


The Compliance Specialist will cooperate and assist in submitting appropriate referrals and case documentation to enforcement agencies such as the Medicaid Fraud Unit (MFCU), Office of Program Integrity (OPI), Office of Inspector General (OIG), Department of Justice (DOJ), Centers for Medicaid and Medicare Services (CMS) and the Oregon Health Authority (OHA) for auditing, monitoring and oversight of external subcontractors (delegates).


Essential Duties

  1. Investigate all suspected cases of FWA.
  2. Conducts investigations, utilizing data analytics, forensic tools and conduct thorough fact-finding inquiries.
  3. Write investigations reports to be submitted to OHA, MFCU and OPI.
  4. Maintain a comprehensive knowledge of applicable federal and state laws, regulations and other requirements.
  5. Assist in audits conducted by outside regulatory agencies.
  6. Assist in audits conducted by AllCare Health of its subcontractor (delegates) or First Tier Entities.
  7. Upholds the highest level of confidentiality in verbal, written or electronic communications pertaining to Compliance, FWA or HIPAA Privacy and Security referrals.

Job Duties

  • Investigations & Risk Management:
    • Manage the investigative process for potential compliance violations, including fraud, abuse, conflicts of interest, and other regulatory breaches.
    • Oversee the identification, reporting, and investigation of compliance concerns, and provide guidance on risk mitigation strategies.
    • Utilize investigative techniques, data analytics, and forensic tools to identify suspicious activity and conduct thorough fact-finding inquiries.
    • Prepare investigative reports with findings, conclusions, and recommendations for corrective actions.
  • Regulatory Guidance & Reporting:
    • Act as the organization’s subject matter expert on healthcare regulations, including but not limited to Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, and others.
  • Maintain a comprehensive knowledge of applicable federal and state laws, regulations and other requirements.
  • Assists in conducting the annual enterprise-wide risk assessment and program evaluations.
  • Assist the Chief Compliance Officer in the development of risk-based compliance monitoring work plan and protocols.
  • Actively participate in the Compliance program, FWA and HIPAA Privacy & Security activities.
  • Accurately log and maintain records of reported or discovered compliance concerns.
  • Provide guidance to internal staff on appropriate interpretation and application of internal and regulatory policy/procedures.
  • Use sound logic and reasoning to identify opportunities to improve processes.
  • Effectively communicate with peers and other departments on compliance matters, work collaboratively in a team environment with a spirit of cooperation.
  • Maintains punctual, regular and predictable attendance.
  • Respectfully takes directions from Chief Compliance Officer and Corporate Legal Counsel.
