title: GN&C Hardware Engineer
description:
GN&C Hardware Engineer

Houston, TX

About Intuitive Machines:
Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

About the Position:
The GN&C Hardware Engineer will support the design, development, integration, and test of GN&C flight hardware across all Intuitive Machines programs. This role focuses on sensors, actuators, and associated avionics hardware critical to spacecraft navigation and control performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the selection, specification, and integration of GN&C flight hardware, including sensors and actuators, across multiple missions.
  • Develop hardware requirements andinterfacedefinitions in collaboration with GN&C, avionics, and systems engineering teams.
  • Support procurement, vendor technical management, and hardware qualification activities.
  • Perform hardware trade studies, performance analyses, and risk assessments.
  • Support environmental testing (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMI/EMC) and acceptance testing of GN&C hardware.
  • Assistwith hardware integration, troubleshooting, and anomaly resolution during assembly, integration, and test (AIT).
  • Support GN&C hardware verification and validation activities, including test planning and execution.
  • Contribute to hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and integrated system test campaigns
  • Generate hardware documentation, including specifications, test procedures, and verification reports.
  • Support flight readiness, mission operations preparation, and post-test/post-flight analysis asrequired.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting spacecraft GN&C hardware development, integration, or test.
  • Experience working with aerospace flight hardware suppliers and qualification processes.
  • Familiarity with GN&C sensors and actuators such as IMUs, star trackers, sun sensors, reaction wheels, and thrusters.
  • Experience with camera and lens design parameters (focal length, IFOV, FOV, etc.), camera calibration, and hardware testing.
  • Understanding of spacecraft avionics architectures and hardware interfaces.
  • Experience supporting environmental and functional testing of flight hardware.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
  • Flexible and adaptable to changing program needs and schedules.

Preferred:

  • Experience with integrated optical design and software tools (ZEMAX, etc.), multi-bounce ray-tracing tools (FRED, etc.), camera baffledesignand optimization.
  • Experience with camera/optical thermal and radiation testing.
  • Experience with principles of optical navigation and/or observational astronomy, including image processing as it pertains to spacecraft navigation.

immune-mediated diseases. Our product candidates include budoprutug, an anti-CD19
monoclonal antibody that presents us with an exciting opportunity given its broad potential
applicability across a number of B-cell mediated diseases, including systemic lupus
erythematosus, immune thrombocytopenia, and membranous nephropathy and CLYM116, an
anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody in development for IgA nephropathy.
At Climb Bio, our team has a knack for seeing what no one else sees—and a drive to achieve
results no one expects. We believe that our combined strength conquers any summit, and our
core values – Build Trust, Decide & Commit, Accelerate Impact, and Mark the Moment – guide
how we work, collaborate and innovate. They reflect our commitment to patients, each other,
and the pursuit of transformative science.
This is a cross-functional leadership role accountable for defining and executing the asset strategy
of CLYM116 and for leading late-stage development, registration, and life-cycle management for
the program. The Program Leader will report to our Chief Business Officer and is responsible for
leading and driving performance of the program team, ensuring alignment of program strategy,
timelines, resources, and operational execution, and delivery against goals and is the line
manager for asset Program Manager(s). The role also serves as the company’s main alliance
manager with our partner, running the collaboration day to day and making sure both companies
stay aligned on development, regulatory, CMC, and commercial priorities.
Key Responsibilities:
• Develop, maintain, and own the asset strategy for CLYM116 - the integrated global
development plan, its underlying assumptions, and its performance against them - from
late-stage development through launch.
• Develop and own the lifecycle management strategy for CLYM116 beyond initial launch -
indication expansion, combination opportunities - to sustain and grow the asset's value
over its full commercial life.
• Lead the cross-functional CLYM116 program team across key disciplines, including
Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory, CMC, Medical Affairs, Finance,
and Commercial, setting the vision, strategy, goals and priorities and holding the team
accountable for an aligned plan and delivery.
• Serve as alliance lead for the program. Build trusted partner relationships at the working
and executive levels, chair joint governance (JSC, JDC, and working groups), and manage
contract obligations and milestones with Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development.
Identify and resolve issues early and keep collaboration and decision making between
the companies running smoothly.
• Partner with Program Management to translate asset strategy into the execution plan,
timelines, interdependencies, and resourcing - maintaining a shared view of what the
program has committed to and where it stands against it. Program Leader owns the
integrated program plan with the asset Program Manager leading day-to-day execution.
• Lead program level governance and work with Program Management to establish clear

title: Kätilö
description:
Tule kätilöksi Kaunis Odotukseen – Kuljetaan yhdessä perheiden rinnalla tärkeissä hetkissä.

Työntekijämme perhevapaan johdosta etsimme sydämellistä työkaveria pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Turun tiimiämme täydentämään.

Meille jokainen perhe on ainutlaatuinen. Kohtaamme asiakkaamme yksilöllisesti ja vahvalla ammattitaidolla ja haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme lämpimän ja kiireettömän kokemuksen. Kaunis odotuksen-koulutuspolku on rakennettu vuosien kokemuksella tukemaan uutta työntekijää pitkällä aikavälillä. Meillä saat tehdä työtä, jossa ammattitaitosi pääsee näkyviin ja osaamistasi arvostetaan.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle:

Kaunis odotuksessa pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja iloista tiimiä kannustavaan ja palkitsevaan työympäristöön. Tässä työssä pääset toteuttamaan omaa ammattitaitoasi ja jakamaan sitä vauvaa odottaville perheille julkista terveydenhuoltoa täydentäen. Ymmärrämme myös vapaa-ajan tärkeyden ja tarjoamme sinulle täyden vapauden pitää kaikki pyhät ja sunnuntait aina vapaapäivinä. Halutessasi voit myös toivoa näille päiville vuoroja ja niitä annetaan mahdollisuuksien mukaan. Palkitsemme onnistumisista ja järjestämme virkistysiltoja, sillä pidämme vahvaa yhteishenkeä tärkeänä ja haluamme tarjota työpaikan ja ihanien kollegojen lisäksi mahdollisuuden saada myös elinikäisiä ystäviä.

Jos sinulla ei ole kokemusta ultraäänitutkimusten tekemisestä, sinulla on mahdollisuus saada laadukkaasti toteutettu koulutus ultraäänitutkimusten tekoon. Tämän kanssa emme halua kiirehtiä, vaan jokainen kätilö opettelee aina yhden palvelun kerrallaan. Näin emme tingi palvelumme laadusta, vaan pystymme tarjoamaan asiakkaillemme parasta mahdollista palvelua, josta Kaunis Odotus on tullut tunnetuksi. Samalla tarjoamme kätilöillemme mahdollisimman stressittömän ja rauhallisen ympäristön oppia uutta. Vaikka vastaanottotyö on itsenäistä, sinulla on aina käytettävissä kollegojen ja erikoislääkäreidemme asiantunteva tuki ja konsultointimahdollisuus.

Opin karttuessa myös työpäivät monipuolistuvat ja eri palvelut tuovat mukavaa vaihtelevuutta työpäiviisi. Tarjoamme sinulle vakaan, inspiroivan, sekä kauniin työympäristön, jossa vastuullisuus, ihmisläheisyys ja yhdessä onnistuminen ovat keskeisiä arvoja.

Työ on kaksivuorotyötä ja työvuorot sijoittuvat n. klo 8-21 välille. Toimipisteemme sijaitsevat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella, joten kulku on pyritty tekemään helpoksi myös ilman autoa. Etsimme tiimiimme kokoaikaisia työntekijöitä, mutta osa-aikaisuuskin on mahdollinen. Palkkaus TPTES mukaisesti, kokemuksestasi riippuen kokoaikatyössä noin 3000-3600€/kk.

Mitä etsimme?

Etsimme kätilöä jolle kaikenlaisten perheiden kohtaaminen on sydämenasia ja joka on kokenut työssään. Ymmärrät, että yksityisellä puolella omat asiakkaat huolehditaan loppuun asti ja olet luotettava työntekijä, joka ottaa asiakkaamme ilolla ja ammattitaidolla vastaan. Olet joustava ja levität hyvää ilmapiiriä ympärillesi. On eduksi jos osaat tehdä ultraäänitutkimuksia. Tärkeintä meille on hakijan aito kiinnostus ja halu oppia jatkuvasti uutta. Koulutus ultraäänitutkimuksiin ja perehdytys vastaanottoihin tapahtuu pääkaupunkiseudulla. Tämän lisäksi koemme tärkeäksi, että tehtävään valitulla kätilöllä on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, itseohjautuvaa työskentelyotetta ja vastuunkantoa. Olethan siis kätilö, jolla on jo opiskeluiden jälkeistä kokemusta kätilön työstä ja osaat oman työn ajanhallinnalla rytmittää omia päiviäsi. Yksin asioita ei kuitenkaan tarvitse ratkoa, sillä saat tueksesi mahtavan tiimin täynnä ammattilaisia. Osaathan kuitenkin pitää asiakasvastaanottoa itsenäisesti. Työkielenä on suomi ja englanti. Myös muu kielitaito lasketaan eduksi. Työvuorot rakennetaan asiakkaiden toiveita kuunnellen, joten erotut eduksesi mikäli olet innokas ilta- ja viikonloppuvuorojen tekijä. Emme tarjoa pelkkää aamuvuoroa. Meille kaikenlaiset perheet ja odottajat ovat tärkeitä ja toivomme tämän kuuluvan myös omiin arvoihisi. Vaikka kyseessä on haku perhevapaiden vuoksi hyvän tekijän löytyessä tehtävä voi jatkua. Meillä etsinnässä pitkäaikainen tiimiläinen.

Mitä työnkuvaan kuuluu?

Työn pääpaino on kätilön vastaanotoissa raskauden eri vaiheissa ja ultraäänitutkimus on osa vastaanottoa (emme tee seulontaultraääniä). Lisäksi työssä jokainen asiakas kohdataan yksilönä ja keskustellaan juuri heitä mietityttävistä teemoista. Toisinaan työpäiviin voi tulla erilaista vaihtelua esimerkiksi tapahtumien, esillepanojen tai vaikka asiakkaitamme kiinnostavien tietojen jakamisessa. Työhön kuuluu myös hyvä työvälineiden ja työympäristön siistinä pitäminen ja muut mahdolliset vastuutehtävät. Position Title: Program Manager

Job Summary

The Program Manager is a strategic position accountable for leading all aspects of a collection of projects (i.e. Program). This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owner, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on mission critical projects and other department initiatives as required.


On a per project basis, the role may include managing the design and construction administration phases of projects either directly, or through direction provided to Project Managers. These duties may include performing site visits, leading, and representing DLB in client meetings, coordinating with internal and external members, and general project overhead tasks.


The Program Manager will be self-directed on day-to-day work and independently performs most responsibilities. Will lead project teams of complex scope and broader programs. Will coordinate activities of other personnel. Assists in the development of policies and procedures.


The Program Manager will communicate and operate in line with organizational and client goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (40%)

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Promote a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology to optimize performance and scalability.

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

  • Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices
  • Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods and coordination of people and resources
  • ​Knowledge of materials, methods and the tools involved in the construction mission critical, commercial buildings or other structures
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled at using construction management software such as Procore
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled at managing personnel and material resources
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)

  • Meaningful work contributing to the sustainable development of shipping in the Baltic Sea Region.

Datan valmistelu ja käsittely sekä piirteiden muodostaminen
Koneoppimis- ja tekoälymallien kehittäminen, koulutus ja optimointi
Mallien testaus ja arviointi: suorituskykymittarit, validointi oikealla datalla ja tulosten luotettavuuden varmistaminen
Mallien vieminen tuotantoon yhdessä kehittäjien ja arkkitehdin kanssa
Tuotannossa olevien mallien seuranta ja jatkokehitys käyttäjäpalautteen ja datan muutosten perusteella
Tulosten ja mallien rajoitteiden viestiminen liiketoiminnalle

Vaatimukset:
Vahva kokemus koneoppimismallien kehittämisestä, testaamisesta ja viemisestä tuotantoon
Sujuva Python ja keskeiset kirjastot (esim. pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch tai TensorFlow)
Kokemus Geminin ja Microsoftin AI -työkaluista sekä Snowflaken datatyökaluista
Kokemus MLOps-käytännöistä, kuten mallien versionhallinnasta, automatisoiduista koulutus- ja julkaisuputkista sekä tuotantomallien seurannasta
Kokemus mallien arvioinnista ja testauksesta sekä onnistumismittareiden määrittelystä
Kokemus datan laadun varmistamisesta ja datan muutosten (data drift) havaitsemisesta
Kyky viestiä tulokset, epävarmuudet ja rajoitteet selkeästi myös ei-teknisille sidosryhmille

Eduksi katsotaan:
Kokemus energia-, prosessi- tai muun teollisuuden datasta, esim. aikasarjat, prosessi- ja sensoridata, ennustava kunnossapito tai kysyntä- ja tuotantoennusteet
Kokemus SAP, Salesforce ja ServiceNow -ympäristöjen datasta ja mallien integroinnista niihin
Kokemus LLM-pohjaisista ratkaisuista ja niiden yhdistämisestä perinteiseen koneoppimiseen
Kokemus pilvipalveluista (Azure, AWS tai GCP) ja konttiteknologioista (Docker, Kubernetes)
Kokemus yritystason tekoälyratkaisujen kytkemisestä olemassa oleviin liiketoimintaprosesseihin

Hakemus kannattaa lähettää mahdollisimman pian, liittämällä päivitetty CV, joka selkeästi osoittaa tähän rooliin liittyvät taitosi ja kokemuksesi.

title: Sähköasentajia sähkövarusteluun
description:
Olemme Helsinki Shipyard, yksi maailman johtavista vaativiin meriolosuhteisiin tarkoitettujen alusten rakentajista. Helsingin sydämessä sijaitsevalla telakallamme on yli 160 vuoden kokemus laivanrakennuksesta. Suunnittelemme ja rakennamme muun muassa jäänmurtajia, rannikkovartioston ja merivoimien aluksia, risteilyaluksia, jahteja sekä muita erikoisaluksia julkisen ja yksityisen sektorin asiakkaille ympäri maailmaa. Yli puolet maailmalla käytössä olevista jäänmurtajista on rakennettu meillä, joten olemme todellinen edelläkävijä arktisessa laivanrakennuksessa.

Helsinki Shipyard on osa kansainvälistä Inocea-meriteollisuuskonsernia, jolla on viisi telakkaa kolmessa maassa: kaksi Suomessa, yksi Kanadassa ja kaksi Yhdysvalloissa. Helsinki Shipyardilla on tässä kokonaisuudessa merkittävä rooli laivasuunnittelun ja arktisen teknologian osaamiskeskuksena.

Työllistämme tällä hetkellä yli 600 ammattilaista, ja joukkomme kasvaa vauhdilla.

[Täältä](https://helsinkishipyard.fi/category/news-en/) voit lukea lisää tämänhetkisistä projekteistamme!

Etsimme Helsingin telakalle motivoituneita ja ammattitaitoisia sähköasentajia vahvistamaan kasvavaa tuotantoamme!

Tehtävänkuva

Sähköasentajana vastaat laivojen sähköjärjestelmien asennuksesta, käyttöönotosta sekä testauksesta. Työsi kattaa muun muassa sähköntuotanto- ja jakelujärjestelmät, valaistuksen, automaatio- ja ohjausjärjestelmät, turvajärjestelmät sekä navigointi- ja viestintäjärjestelmät.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat esimerkiksi mm:

- Sähköpiirustusten, kytkentäkaavioiden ja järjestelmäkuvien tulkinta

- Kaapeleiden vetäminen ja asentaminen

- Suur- ja pienjännitekaapeleiden kytkennät

- Kaapelireittien rakentaminen ja kaapeleiden sitominen kaapeliratoihin

- Sähkökeskusten, muuntajien, taajuusmuuttajien ja automaatiokaappien kytkennät

- Valaisimien, pistorasioiden, kameroiden, kaiuttimien, puhelinten ja paloilmaisimien asennukset

- Kaapeliläpivientien pakkaaminen ja sulkeminen

- Sähköjärjestelmien mittaukset, testaukset ja käyttöönotot

- Tiivis yhteistyö muiden tuotanto-osastojen kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Sähköasentajan perustutkintoa tai vastaavaa koulutusta

- Kokemusta sähköasennustöistä

- Piirustusten ja sähkökaavioiden lukutaitoa

- Sähkömittausten ja testauksien osaamista

- Sähköturvallisuusmääräysten tuntemusta ja noudattamista

- Voimassa olevaa sähkötyöturvallisuus- ja jännitetyökoulutusta sekä työturvallisuuskoulutusta tai valmiutta suorittaa ne

- Ymmärrystä teollisuuden tai laivarakennuksen sähköjärjestelmistä

- Hätäensiapukoulutusta tai valmiutta suorittaa se.

Työ on ajoittain raskasta ja työasennot voivat olla hankalia ja staattisia, joten edellytämme hyvää fyysistä kuntoa.

Miksi tämä voisi kiinnostaa sinua?

- Näet konkreettisesti työn tuloksen – joka viikko alus etenee silminnähtävästi.

- Teet töitä osaavien ammattilaisten kanssa matalassa organisaatiossa: meillä tehdään töitä porukalla, ei urakalla. Vältämme siiloja ja teemme yhdessä.

- Työ on monipuolista, merkityksellistä ja täynnä oppimismahdollisuuksia.

- Helsingin telakka toimii Helsingin sydämessä ja meidän laivat seilaavat maailman merillä. Täällä yhdistyy suomalainen osaaminen, pitkä historia ja kansainväliset huippuhankkeet.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jätä avoin hakemuksesi ja yhteystietosi rekrytointijärjestelmäämme 13.12.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme hakemuksien läpikäynnin ja haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Lisätietoa tehtävästä voit kysyä sähköpostitse rekry@helsinkishipyard.fi.

Huomioithan, että hakemukset otetaan vastaan vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta GDPR-vaatimusten täyttämiseksi.

Osana valintaprosessia tehtävään valituille henkilöille tehdään terveystarkastus, joka sisältää myös huumetestin. Rekrytointiprosessiin ei sisälly turvallisuusselvitystä, mutta tehtävän hoitaminen saattaa myöhemmin edellyttää turvallisuusselvityksen tekemistä.

Job Title: Admissions/Program Counselor

Program: IOTSS / Partial Care

Position Type: Full Time

Location: 725 Airport Road, Lakewood New Jersey 08701

Salary: $50,000.00

Job Description/Summary

Performs comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments on adults 18+ seeking outpatient mental health services. Collaborates with Clinical Director and Program Director regarding the assignment of clients to clinical staff. Provides referrals outside the department when appropriate.

Essential Job Functions/Responsibilities

  • Review incoming referrals, process within 24 hours of receipt, and coordinate and schedule intake appointments in a timely manner.
  • Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments and formulate diagnosis:
    • Diagnosis is congruent with assessment content, and assessments completed in compliance with organization policy.
    • Written assessments include MSE, provisional diagnosis, risk category, level of compliance and preliminary treatment plan with recommendations for ongoing treatment.
    • Demonstrates familiarity about psychotropic medication use, side effects, and indications for psychiatric intervention.
  • Admits/Refers clients to agency program(s) or external service providers according to current needs and/or clinical recommendation
    • Recommendations include identification of special treatment needs or referral of high-risk clients.
    • Collaborates with Clinical Director and Program Director regarding the assignment of clients to clinical staff.
  • Complete medical record documentation:
    • Medical record documentation will comply with organization policy
    • Records will reflect client contact within required time frames
    • Records will reflect referrals for separate assessments as per policy
    • Problem List will reflect current integration of client needs
  • Provide crisis intervention support when clients present in crisis during intake appointments or when presenting symptomology indicates a need for immediate clinical response
  • Adheres to appointment and office assignment schedule
  • Manages a small caseload and provides coverage for clinicians as operational needs allow (IOTSS)
  • Completes all necessary third-party billing documentation;
  • Ensures accuracy of caseload reports;
  • Participates in supervision and attends staff meetings as directed;
  • Is available for evaluations, examinations and court appearances as necessary to protect the interest of the client and of PBH, for a negotiated fee;
  • Completes all Individual Service Plans with Adult Partial Care clients.
  • Plans and facilitates therapeutic groups and activities, which involve psycho- education, medication education, nutrition, group counseling, behavior management, community meetings, coping skills, pre-vocational skills, social skills, daily living skills, leisure activities, and alcohol/drug education, support groups as needed.
  • Have primary responsibility for service coordination, provision or arrangement of services needed, personal advocacy, and development, review and updating of individual treatment and service plan.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Competencies

• Must maintain required CPR/First Aid certification.

• Demonstrates computer proficiency as required by job function and duties.

Qualifications

• Education: Master’s degree in social work, mental health counseling, or another recognized mental health discipline

• Licensure: NJ licensure as LSW, LAC, LAMFT, LCSW, LPC, or LMFT

• Experience: Working with adults with a wide range of emotional and behavioral needs

o Disability and Life Insurance

o Employee Assistance Program

o Voluntary Benefits, such as Vision Insurance, Aflac, Pet Insurance

title: Coordinator (JOM Culture)
description:
MAKAH TRIBE

POSITION DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE: Coordinator (JOM Culture)


EXEMPT: No JOB CODE: N/A

TARGET SALARY: $20.93 to $23.26/DOQ

SHIFT: 7 hrs/day 9 mo per year

PROGRAM: Employment & Training

LOCATION: Tech Center

REPORTS TO: Case Manager (Education)


SUMMARY: The purpose of the position is to preserve the Makah Culture and assist and empower eligible tribal students, by instructing children aged three through twelfth grade in history, customs, arts, & crafts, signing & dancing and Makah Language, and utilize collaborative efforts with the schools and Parent Committee to provide supplementary assistance to meet the specialized and unique academic and cultural needs of tribal students on a daily basis.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following.

Because of the Tribe’s commitment to community service and the well-being of its members, each employee may be expected to perform a wide range of office and field duties from time to time. Such duties may or may not be related to their regular responsibilities.


Develop, coordinate, maintain, and monitor JOM services by ensuring compliance with federal, state, and tribal policies and regulations. Submits annual reports and related information, grant application, and tracks student progress.


Provides tutoring, mentoring, career counseling, and cultural enrichment activities.


Assists in implementing, planning and designing age-appropriate curriculum to maintain established educational standards.


Arranges for and instructs children aged three through twelfth grade students in Makah History, customs, arts & crafts, signing and dancing, and Qʷi·qʷi·diččaq on a daily basis.


Utilizes teaching tools such as virtual resources, audio-visual techniques, puppets, and flannel board stories.


Researches cultural resources in the Neah Bay community and incorporates those into classroom activities, i.e., storytelling, beading, basket weaving, language, carving, and singing and dancing.


Works closely with school district staff, tribal agencies, and the Parent Advisory Committee to plan and deliver services.


Participates in staff meetings with Head Start, Neah Bay Schools, Makah Cultural Research Center, and E&T.


Teamwork with the E&T, Makah Cultural and Research Center, Makah Head Start and Neah Bay Schools. Work with program partners in presenting lessons on Makah History, Language, and Culture.


Assesses student needs, tracks attendance/academic progress and evaluates program effectiveness.


May be required to attend JOM related conferences, meetings, and training opportunities. Must promote a healthy and positive lifestyle by being drug and alcohol free.


Communicates with parents, school leadership, and tribal organizations regarding JOM activities and student achievement.


Maintain and manages file plan records and provides information for E&T activities. Prepares and submits reports to E&T Case Manager as required.


Coordinates and schedules monthly and/or quarterly meetings with the JOM Parent Committee and serves as ex-officio to the Committee. Establishes agendas for the committee meetings; ensures and performs the development of appropriate, complete, accurate, and timely materials to support deliberating body decisions, and serves as the Recording Secretary for the Committee. Serves as the official liaison to report all official actions and recommendations to the E&T Case Manager.


Participates, plans, and/or organizes family activities and other events related to JOM services. Develops, writes, and implements newsletters to inform parents of updates to student services.


QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or general education degree (GED).


Experience in human services and educational programs.


Must have minimum of 5 years documented experience with Makah Culture Programs.


Must have a minimum of two years classroom experience.


State of Washington First People, Language, Cultural & Oral Traditions Certificate or obtain during the probationary period.


LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read and interpret documents such as regulations, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of students, employees of organization, and the general public.


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.


REASONING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Must have a valid Washington state Drivers license and insurable. May be required to drive a Tribal GSA vehicle to perform job duties. If so, a driving history/background check will be conducted on the applicant.


This position is classified as a sensitive Tribal position. Therefore, applicant must submit to and clear a pre-employment criminal background check.


OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Knowledge of the Johnson O’Mally (JOM) Act.


Must have knowledge of Qʷi·qʷi·diččaq, Makah arts & crafts, dances and songs.


Ability to work with children in a pleasant and professional manner. Must have a positive attitude and strong commitment to education and our youth while exhibiting professional behavior.


Ability to instruct children of all ages.


Ability to work independently and in a group setting.


Ability to coordinate extracurricular activities for parents, children, and the community.


Ability to communicate well and establish good working relationships with staff, including Makah Head Start program, Makah Cultural Research Center, Neah Bay Schools and the general public.


Ability to operate a computer and knowledge of the Google platform, MS Word, MS Excel, and MS Publisher.


Must have good organizational skills.


Ability to work independently and follow instruction.


Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.


Must submit to and clear a pre-employment alcohol and drug test and random testing, in accordance with the Drug and Alcohol-Free Workplace Act of 2002.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 5o pounds.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: K&B 145 Assistant Operator 1st shift
description:
Position Overview:

The K&B 145 Assistant Operator works directly with the Machine Operator to support the safe, efficient, and high-quality operation of the K&B 145 die cutter. This position is responsible for assisting with machine setup, operation, and preventive maintenance activities, as well as performing quality checks and ensuring the machine center meets production and safety standards. The Assistant Operator plays a key role in maintaining productivity, quality, and housekeeping standards on the K&B 145 work center.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist the Operator in all aspects of machine setup, operation, and tear-down.
  • Support efficient and accurate make-ready activities, including material staging and tooling preparation.
  • Attend to the feed or delivery end of the machine as directed by the Operator during production runs.
  • Conduct quality checks in accordance with established sampling plans and report any nonconformance issues promptly.
  • Perform cleaning, lubricating, and inspection tasks as part of the preventive maintenance schedule.
  • Assist with troubleshooting and adjustments to ensure continuous, conforming production.
  • Maintain the work area in a clean, safe, and organized manner consistent with AIB and 5S standards.
  • Ensure that all materials, tooling, and supplies are properly handled and accounted for.
  • Work collaboratively with the Operator and crew to minimize downtime and improve efficiency.
  • Participate in cross-training to develop proficiency in die-cutting, foil, and embossing processes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support production operations.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 1–3 months of related experience in manufacturing or corrugated packaging preferred.
  • Ability to read and understand factory cards, CAD drawings, and production specifications.
  • Ability to read a tape measure and perform basic math functions including multiplication and division.
  • Must be able to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude and interest in developing technical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, quality, and safety.
  • Ability to follow directions and work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willingness to learn and grow into higher-level die cutter or operator roles.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience assisting on die-cutting or embossing equipment, preferably K&B systems.
  • Basic understanding of foil and embossing operations or willingness to train in these processes.
  • Familiarity with production reporting systems and basic computer skills.

TRIAL PERIOD REQUIRED: 90 Days

title: Data Center Infra Engineer - 2027 Internship, Logistics Team
description:
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers — from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful — and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us!

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree (graduating 2027) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

About the Role

As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do – Are these job responsibilities accurate for the internship?
- Perform design and equipment submittal reviews for new data centers in your region
- Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures
- Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support
- Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered
- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday to Friday.

Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
- Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you help support power it all.
- Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
- Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

title: Chief Managed Care Officer
description:
Chief Managed Care Officer

Southwest Michigan Behavioral Health • Executive Leadership • Hybrid

Reports To

Chief Executive Officer

FLSA Status

Exempt

Compensation

Commensurate with experience

THE CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER OPPORTUNITY

As Chief Managed Care Officer, you'll lead SWMBH's managed care operations as a key member of the executive leadership team — overseeing program integrity, compliance, customer services, and provider network management across the region.

WHAT THE CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER WILL OWN

  • Executive strategy for program integrity, compliance, customer services & provider network management
  • Regulatory and contractual compliance across Medicaid managed care requirements
  • Direct oversight of Program Integrity, SIU, and Customer Services leadership
  • Provider network contracting, negotiation, and performance
  • Advising the CEO on managed care risk and organizational strategy

WHAT THE CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER NEEDS TO BRING

  • Bachelor's required (JD/Master's preferred) in a related field
  • 8+ years progressive leadership in managed care, Medicaid, or healthcare compliance
  • Deep knowledge of PIHP operations and complex contract terms
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional teams through change

Keep scrolling for the full position details, or jump straight to applying below.

◆ ◆ ◆

CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER — FULL POSITION DETAILS

The Chief Managed Care Officer reports to the CEO and serves as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing executive oversight of program integrity and compliance, customer services, and provider network management. As Chief Managed Care Officer, this role ensures the organization meets federal and state regulations, managed care rules, and contractual requirements — driving access, accountability, quality, and transparency across the region's PIHP managed care responsibilities.

CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Executive Leadership & Regional Alignment

  • Sets strategic direction for managed care functions in alignment with agency mission and federal/contractual obligations
  • Advises the CEO and executive leadership on managed care operations, risk, and improvement opportunities
  • Collaborates with regional CMHSP partners to ensure delegated managed care functions run effectively
  • Interprets contract language, Managed Care Regulations, and the Administrative Code for agency-wide application
  • Leads cross-functional planning and implementation for regulatory changes, audits, and corrective actions
  • Ensures required MDHHS and EQRO reporting/audit standards are met

Program Integrity & Compliance

  • Provides executive oversight of program integrity and compliance functions
  • Oversees the Director of Program Integrity & SIU and the Compliance Officer
  • Oversees monitoring, reporting, corrective action follow-up, and audit readiness
  • Partners with legal counsel, regulators, and delegated entities to resolve compliance issues
  • Maintains policies, workflows, and records that support regulatory compliance

Customer Services

  • Provides executive oversight ensuring timely, accurate, and culturally responsive customer service
  • Ensures effective access for inquiries, complaints, grievances, and appeals
  • Supports the Fair Hearing Process and escalation of complex fair hearing cases
  • Monitors customer service data and trends to inform quality improvement
  • Promotes a customer-focused, transparent, and continuously improving culture

Provider Network Management

  • Provides executive oversight ensuring an accessible, qualified, and compliant provider network
  • Oversees provider contracting, credentialing interfaces, and contract compliance
  • Negotiates and operationalizes complex provider agreements
  • Monitors provider performance, access standards, and network capacity
  • Leads strategies to strengthen provider relationships and resolve network issues

CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Provides strategic vision and executive oversight of program integrity, customer services, and provider network management
  • Ensures managed care operations comply with federal/state regulations, MDHHS contracts, and accreditation standards
  • Facilitates cross-department collaboration on new models and service improvements
  • Leads monitoring, reporting, risk identification, and corrective action processes

CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supervises assigned managed care functions; provides leadership, coaching, and accountability
  • Works collaboratively with the CEO and executive team on compliance and continuous improvement

CHIEF MANAGED CARE OFFICER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's in Business Administration, Public Health, Social Work, Law, Public Administration, or related field required; Juris Doctor or Master's strongly preferred
  • 8+ years of progressively responsible leadership experience in managed care, behavioral health, Medicaid, healthcare administration, compliance, or provider network operations
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Medicaid managed care requirements, PIHP operations, and complex contract terms
  • Ability to negotiate, interpret, and operationalize complex contracts into policy and practice
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and organizational change
  • Strong analytical, communication, and relationship-building skills; proficient in Microsoft Office 365
  • Commitment to culturally competent, trauma-informed, person-centered practices

WORKING ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Primarily an office environment; frequent sitting, standing, and walking
  • Occasional local/regional travel for conferences and related events
  • Ability to occasionally lift up to 20 lbs

HOW TO APPLY

Ready to lead SWMBH's managed care operations as our next Chief Managed Care Officer? Apply online at www.swmbh.org. Emailed resumes will not be accepted.

title: Ophthalmic Assistant
description:
Ophthalmic Assistant



Who are we?

Newmedica are one of the leading providers of NHS ophthalmology services in England, providing outpatients appointments, diagnostic testing and eye surgery. We aim to change lives through better sight and eye health.

We care for thousands of NHS and private patients a year in our specialist eye clinics across the country. We have significant growth plans over the next few years as we look to establish a national footprint and open many new sites across the UK.

We are thrilled to say that following an independently conducted survey of Newmedica colleagues, we have been certified as a Great Place to Work®. This is a global benchmark that recognises employers who create an outstanding employee experience.

Role overview

After a period of successful growth, we are looking to expand our team of Ophthalmic Assistants at our Newmedica Leicester site. The role is full-time (40 hours per week) over 5 days.

Our Ophthalmic Assistants are the face of Newmedica – they’re often amongst the first people that our patients interact with on clinic visits and so having a welcoming, friendly, empathetic approach is vital.

It’s a busy role - you’ll be seeing a number of patients each day and will play a key role in the successful operation of our outpatient clinics and theatres, ensuring that patients receive exceptional care throughout their visit. Your responsibilities will range from assisting in pre-operative and post-operative processes to providing vital support in diagnostics and theatre. You’ll be using a variety of different equipment and systems so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable using systems and is fairly tech savvy.

The thought of eye surgery can be a daunting prospect for patients to deal with, so our Ophthalmic Assistants need to be able to put patients at ease. They also need strong communication skills to be able to explain the purpose of the different tests to ensure the patient understands their treatment.

This is a great role to progress your clinical skills or to take the first step on a clinical career path. Newmedica is committed to the growth and development of all our colleagues and the Ophthalmic Assistant is a great platform to potentially explore a career in diagnostic (clinic) or theatre teams

What skills and experience do I need?

We’ll provide training so experience isn’t always needed, but the following things will be advantageous:

  • Previous experience of working with patients or in a customer facing role
  • Knowledge of eye physiology and treatment or a keen interest to build knowledge in this area
  • A competent user of all Office 365 programmes & comfortable working on new systems such as patient record systems or diagnostic programmes.
  • An excellent grasp of the English language both verbally and in written format
  • Experience of dealing with a variety of data for example patient records, GP and patient correspondence and diagnostic test results
  • A good team player – happy to jump in and support others when required

What we’re offering

  • A salary of up to £27,000pa depending on experience
  • 25 days annual leave and 1 day birthday leave plus bank holidays
  • Blue Light discount scheme
  • A company pension scheme
  • Access to a range of benefits including free eye tests, discounted or free glasses and death in service cover
  • An environment where your learning and development is supported through a range of various learning tools and courses.
  • Working with a friendly multi-disciplinary team passionate about improving the lives of our patients
  • A bright, spacious and modern working environment, built to the highest standards

If you would like an informal chat about the opportunity or to request a job description, please contact leicester.hr@newmedica.co.uk

Our employment offers are subject to receipt of satisfactory pre-employment checks. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK and a Disclosure and Barring Service check will be necessary in the event of a successful application which we will pay for.

At Newmedica, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunities, and we are committed to this in both the running of our services and how we recruit our staff. We actively encourage applications from everyone with the essential requirements of the job, regardless of any protected characteristics.

Newmedica is fully committed to safeguarding the welfare of all people, irrespective of gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, race, language, religion, ethnic or social origin.

title: Mariposa Shipping Clerk 2nd Shift
description:

The Shipping Clerk maintains inventory records, performs cycle audits, and ensures that all shipments are handled safely and accurately.

  • Work independently to meet deadlines and complete assignments accurately.
  • Handle math and numerical calculations related to shipping activity, such as weight, quantity, and inventory counts.

  • Communicate with internal teams and carriers to ensure timely and accurate delivery of product.

Qualifications and Requirements:

Job Title: Family Intervention Specialist

Program: Intercept

Location: Main Office 591 Lakehurst Road, Toms River New Jersey

Position Type: Full Time

Salary: Bachelors level $55,300.00 - Masters level $59,300.00

Job Description/Summary

The implementation of Intercept offers a unique opportunity to become immersed in an evidence-based program model to serve youth & their families, as identified through the Division of Child Protection and Permanency (DCP&P). The Intercept program serves a broad population of youth and families residing in Ocean, Monmouth and Mercer counties, including including those involved with multiple child-serving systems and those at high risk of removal from their families. Specialists carry a small caseload of 5 families at a time.

Responsibilities

  • Family intervention specialists are an advocate for the families in any involved system they are a part of, such as CP&P or CSOC (Children’s System of Care), with the purpose of gathering information specific to intervention development and advocating in the best interest of the child’s long-term stability. Specialists work with DCP&P staff regularly to assist families in successfully addressing needs and strengthening the family system.
  • Family intervention specialists carry a small caseload of 5 families at a time. Specialists provide individualized family sessions in the home & community settings in order to safely maintain the youth in the home. Specialists provide an average of three face-to-face sessions with the family a week, including youth & support system, at the convenience of the family.
  • Family intervention specialists are expected to attend and actively participate in trainings and individual and team supervision and professional development and to follow up and/or implement feedback and recommendations received from the Team Supervisor, Program Director and Licensed Program Expert. Specialists are expected to adhere to all ethical and legal guidelines, including confidentiality and mandated reporting.
  • Schedules for this position are non-traditional, but flexible and based around the family's availability. Since specialists are heavily involved with each family, long hours may be required to respond to families’ needs. Intercept specialists may be able to work remote, however, will be expected to report in-person for program-specific meetings at their agency. Specialists must also have their own transportation to use for work purposes. Family intervention specialists are responsible for providing after hours support to families using a rotating on-call schedule and are expected to respond in person during some crisis situations as deemed necessary by their leadership team.
  • Family intervention intercept specialists are not required to provide transportation for families they are serving; however, it may be a need if all other means of transportation support have been exhausted. Specialists may utilize an agency vehicle to provide transportation support.

Competencies

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to multi-task and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable and possess the ability to maintain a flexible schedule.
  • Receptive to constructive feedback and willingness to implement new ideas and strategies during session
  • Practices a trauma informed philosophy as demonstrated through behaviors and communications, embracing it as a cultural value.

Qualifications

  • Education - Master’s degree in the field of social work, psychology, or related field is preferred or bachelor's degree in social services with one-year related experience in counseling and/or case management is required.
  • Experience - Prior case management and/or counseling experience preferred.
  • License - Valid New Jersey Driver's License in good standing
  • Bilingual in Spanish a plus - incentive $1000.00
